### [1] [STATERA: Hidden Mass Estimation via Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Kinematics using Frozen Temporal Tubelets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00003)
*Animesh Varma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 STATERA，用冻结的 V-JEPA 视频骨干加轻量时序 tubelet mixer 从单目短视频中预测不透明非对称刚体的质心轨迹，并发布 HiddenMass 基准；仿真显著降低质心误差，零样本 sim-to-real 中发现监督目标的相位权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉模型多在帧级外观上预训练，难以从运动推断隐藏物理属性。质心定位任务中，自遮挡使表面线索与点跟踪不可靠，需要利用时序运动表征而非几何外观。

Method: 提出 STATERA：适配预训练视频骨干 V-JEPA（权重大多冻结），加轻量时序 tubelet mixer，输出逐帧质心热图与轨迹。构建 HiddenMass Benchmark，含 5 万条 MuJoCo 轨迹与 63 段物理标定质心真值的真实测试序列。对比方法包括 DINOv2 等，并设计相位感知与相位无关两类监督目标。

Result: 仿真中 STATERA-50K-Sigma 将归一化质心误差从 41.7%（DINOv2）降至 25.2%。零样本 sim-to-real 中呈现监督权衡：相位感知目标可致双峰预测，相位无关目标易坍缩到统计安全质心。相位感知的 STATERA-50K-Crescent 是唯一持续朝真实隐藏偏移移动的方法，虽因单目矢量过冲略增绝对欧氏误差，但物理捕捉率从 2.6% 提升至 41.0%。

Conclusion: 冻结的时序表征能更好分离惯性动力学与视觉几何，用于隐藏参数估计，为从运动推断物理属性提供了可行方向。

Abstract: Vision models pretrained for frame-level appearance often struggle to infer hidden physical properties from motion. We study center-of-mass (CoM) localization for opaque, asymmetric rigid bodies from short monocular videos, where surface cues and point tracking are unreliable under self-occlusion. We propose STATERA, which adapts a pretrained video backbone (V-JEPA) with mostly frozen weights and a lightweight temporal tubelet mixer to predict per-frame CoM heatmaps and trajectories. To support this task, we introduce the HiddenMass Benchmark, comprising 50K MuJoCo trajectories and a 63-sequence real-world test set with physically calibrated CoM ground truth. In simulation, STATERA-50K-Sigma improves normalized CoM error from 41.7% (DINOv2) to 25.2%. In zero-shot sim-to-real transfer, we observe a fundamental trade-off in supervision: phase-aware targets can induce bimodal predictions, while phase-agnostic targets can collapse toward statistically safe centroids. Nevertheless, our phase-aware STATERA-50K-Crescent is the only evaluated method that demonstrates consistent movement toward the true hidden offset. While this leads to a monocular vector overshoot artifact that marginally increases absolute Euclidean error compared to a static geometric centroid, it improves physics capture from 2.6% to 41.0%. These results suggest that frozen temporal representations can better separate inertial dynamics from visual geometry for hidden-parameter estimation.

</details>


### [2] [Emergent Object Binding Has a Finite Spatial Horizon](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00006)
*Mayank Singal*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 预训练ViT的冻结特征中存在可解码的"IsSameObject"绑定信号，但该信号本质上是具有有限空间尺度的局部一致性：同物体两patch的解码概率随距离指数衰减并趋于非零下限，这一结构可解释大物体绑定减弱、"同类不同物体"比"异类物体"更难区分、部件与整体聚合等现象，且不受遮挡影响（控制尺寸后）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有工作表明自监督预训练可让ViT编码"两patch是否属于同一物体"（IsSameObject）信号，并以单一准确率数值报告。作者认为该聚合指标掩盖了信号的空间结构，无法解释诸多具体行为，因此需要刻画绑定的距离依赖结构并检验其跨模型、跨数据集、跨探针的一致性。

Method: 从冻结的patch embedding中训练探针解码IsSameObject；测量解码概率随两patch距离的变化曲线并拟合指数衰减，得到长度尺度与下限；在ADE20K与COCO上、使用三类探针家族、在DINO与CLIP骨干上验证；逐一控制混淆因素，映射大物体绑定减弱、同类不同实例区分、部件-整体聚合、遮挡等行为；并初步比较DINOv2与DINOv3中该"作用范围"与"下限"所处的层深。

Result: 绑定的解码概率随patch间距单调下降，可用具有有限长度尺度的指数良好描述，并稳定在非零下限；该衰减跨物体尺寸、三类探针、ADE20K与COCO、DINO与CLIP骨干均成立，说明是表征属性而非解码器属性。局部空间一致性视角解释了聚合分数无法解释的行为：绑定在大物体上减弱；同类不同物体比异类物体更难区分；部件与整体被归为一组；在控制物体尺寸后，遮挡不影响绑定。初步观察显示，DINOv2与DINOv3中"作用范围"与"下限"组织在不同层深，但因探测层数少且两模型间存在混淆，仅作提示性报告。

Conclusion: IsSameObject不是全局的、与距离无关的物体归属判断，而是具有有限作用范围的局部空间一致性；单一准确率掩盖了该结构。将绑定重述为带有限范围的局部一致性，可统一解释多种现象，并提示该信号的层次组织（作用范围与下限的深度分离）值得进一步研究。

Abstract: Pretrained Vision Transformers encode whether two image patches belong to the same object. This IsSameObject signal is decodable from frozen patch embeddings at high accuracy, which suggests that object binding emerges from self-supervised pretraining alone. We show that this single accuracy number hides the structure of the signal. Binding is local: the probability that two patches of the same object are decoded as bound falls off monotonically with the distance between them and levels off at a nonzero floor, a falloff well described by an exponential with a finite length scale. This decay holds across object sizes, across three families of probe, on both ADE20K and COCO, and across DINO and CLIP backbones, which indicates that it is a property of the representation rather than of the decoder. Reading binding as local spatial coherence with a finite range accounts for a set of behaviors that the aggregate score leaves unexplained: binding weakens on large objects, separates distinct objects of the same class less reliably than objects of different classes, and groups object parts with their wholes. It is, by contrast, unaffected by occlusion once object size is controlled. We map each behavior with confounds controlled. As a preliminary observation, the horizon and its floor are organized at different depths in DINOv2 and DINOv3, which we report as suggestive given the small number of layers probed and the confound between the two models.

</details>


### [3] [Spatial Lifting for Dense Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00017)
*Mingzhi Xu,Tao Zhou,Yong Li,Yizhe Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出空间提升（SL）方法：将2D图像等标准输入提升到高维空间，用3D U-Net等适用于高维的网络处理，在密集预测任务中实现低参数量、低推理成本且性能良好。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对密集预测任务中高效、准确、可靠深度网络的需求，探索一种简单通用的建模策略，以在降低参数量和推理成本的同时保持良好性能。

Method: SL将标准输入（如2D图像）提升至更高维空间，再使用为该高维空间设计的网络（如3D U-Net）进行处理。该提升在沿提升维度上产生内在结构化输出，从而支持训练中的密集监督，并在测试时实现单次前向传播的自洽性质量与不确定性估计。

Result: 与传统方法相比，SL在基准任务上取得良好性能，同时降低推理成本并大幅减少模型参数数量；其输出沿提升维度具有内在结构，可用于密集监督及测试时的质量与不确定性估计。

Conclusion: 空间提升是一种简单且通用的建模策略，为视觉密集预测任务中更高效、准确和可靠的深度网络提供了有前景的路径。

Abstract: We present Spatial Lifting (SL), a novel methodology for dense prediction tasks. SL operates by lifting standard inputs, such as 2D images, into a higher-dimensional space and subsequently processing them using networks designed for that higher dimension, such as a 3D U-Net. Counterintuitively, this dimensionality lifting allows us to achieve good performance on benchmark tasks compared to conventional approaches, while reducing inference costs and \textbf{drastically lowering the number of model parameters}. The SL framework produces intrinsically structured outputs along the lifted dimension. This emergent structure facilitates dense supervision during training and enables single-forward-pass self-consistency-based quality and uncertainty estimation at test time. Spatial Lifting introduces a simple and general modeling strategy that offers a promising path toward more efficient, accurate, and reliable deep networks for dense prediction tasks in vision.

</details>


### [4] [Encoded but Disconnected: Decomposing Vision-Language Model Failures under a Patching Null](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00024)
*Genpei Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 在三种视觉语言模型上发现中层可解释性的普遍负结果：中层虽编码正确答案但非因果活跃，错误可操作地分为三种失败模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究视觉语言模型中层表征是否对最终预测具有因果作用，验证中层可解释性的普遍性。

Method: 在LLaVA-1.5-7B、Qwen2.5-VL-7B、InternVL3-8B三种架构上，于POPE基准进行残差流patch与逐头patch的因果干预，并结合错误分类分析。

Result: 中层在68-91%的错误中编码真实答案，但层级patch导致0%非平凡翻转，Qwen逐头patch 0/12,600；唯一例外InternVL3第20层第2头为局部效应（p<1e-4）。错误可分为感知失败、编码但断连、先验覆盖三类，三架构均超60%可学习。

Conclusion: 中层编码信号对最终预测非因果活跃，但失败模式在机制上真实存在；缓解效果基于oracle标签，仅作证据而非可部署方法。

Abstract: Across three vision-language model architectures (LLaVA-1.5-7B, Qwen2.5-VL-7B, InternVL3-8B), we report a universal negative finding for mid-layer interpretability. On POPE -- the benchmark common to all three -- the mid layers encode the ground-truth answer in 68-91% of errors, yet this signal is not causally active for the final prediction: residual-stream patching yields 0% non-trivial flip at the layer level on all three architectures, and on two of three at the per-head level (Qwen: 0/12,600 patched forwards). The lone exception, InternVL3 layer-20 head-2, is a non-vocab, self-attending head whose effect is localized to that specific head (p < 1e-4). Despite the null, the errors separate operationally into three failure modes -- Perception Failure, Encoded-but-Disconnected, Prior-Override -- learnable above 60% on all three architectures, and the architecture's prior direction predicts which of two interventions elicits a category-specific response. We report these mitigation effects under oracle labels as evidence the categories are mechanistically real, not as a deployable method.

</details>


### [5] [Domain generalization and synthetic data in object detection: the enabler, the probe, and the gap](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00030)
*Elfi I. S. Hofmeijer,Ella P. Fokkinga,Friso G. Heslinga,Klamer Schutte,Jörgen M. Karlholm*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文综述了面向目标检测的域泛化研究，并从合成数据的三种角色出发，探讨其在提升分布偏移下检测鲁棒性中的作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 目标检测模型在部署时因天气、环境或目标外观变化等分布偏移而性能下降；而专门针对目标检测的域泛化研究较少，且该任务在定位与多尺度表征上存在额外挑战。

Method: 以目标检测为中心的域泛化综述，从三个互补视角分析合成数据：(1) 通过多样化与对齐策略作为域泛化的使能手段；(2) 作为探针支持受控实验以识别和理解失效模式；(3) 讨论合成到真实的域间差异这一特殊域偏移。

Result: 梳理了合成数据在目标检测域泛化中的多重作用，并指出当前域泛化方法在目标检测任务上的局限。

Conclusion: 未来研究需要表征感知的方法，在域偏移下同时显式处理定位与分类问题。

Abstract: Object detection models often experience performance degradation when deployed under distribution shifts, caused by for example changes in weather type, operational environment, or object appearance. Domain Generalization (DG) aims to develop models that remain robust under such shifts and generalize well to unseen domains. DG research specifically focused on object detection models is scarce, although these models face additional challenges around localization and multi-scale representations. Synthetic data is a promising tool to support in DG, by enabling large-scale generation of diverse new samples. In this paper, we present an object detection-centric review of DG and examine the role of synthetic data from three complementary perspectives. First, synthetic data acts as an enabler of DG through diversification and alignment strategies that aim to improve robustness to distribution shifts. Second, it serves as a probe that enables controlled experimentation to identify and understand failure modes. Third, we discuss the synthetic-to-real gap, a particularly challenging form of domain shift that arises when models trained on synthetic imagery are deployed on real-world data. Through reviewing these perspectives, we identify limitations of current DG approaches for object detection and argue that future research requires representation-aware methods that explicitly address both localization and classification under domain shift.

</details>


### [6] [Seeing the City or Recognizing the Place? What Street-View Imagery Adds Beyond Existing Urban Data in VLM Urban Sensing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00031)
*Kaizhen Tan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文比较街景图像预测与已有城市数据在七项城市属性上的信息价值，发现图像优势取决于视觉可辨识性与本地数据覆盖度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 街景图像被广泛用于推断城市属性，但仅凭预测精度无法说明图像在同一地点已有数据之外提供了多少增量信息。作者希望量化图像的"边际价值"，并厘清派生城市地图的数据来源。

Method: 对同一城市单元，分别使用图像、任务上下文、邻近观测和公开记录进行评估；通过图像替换与冲突记录测试模型的来源依赖。涉及七项属性、五个公共资源和三个视觉语言模型（VLM）。

Result: 在道路损坏、路缘坡道和房价上，已有城市数据达到或超过纯图像模型；邻近官方统计在人口上接近最佳图像结果。图像在建筑类型、建筑功能和低层楼层数上更具信息量。楼层数方面，距最近标注建筑距离每翻倍，图像优势增加5.7个百分点；高层建筑因屋顶线常超出画面而优势下降。模型常跟随冲突记录。OpenFACADES楼层标注由OSM楼层值生成，其高度相关误差模式与纯图像重跑相反。

Conclusion: 街景图像的价值取决于视觉可辨识性和本地数据覆盖度。将图像与已有城市数据对比，可指导图像采集并明确派生城市地图的数据来源。

Abstract: Street-view imagery is increasingly used to infer urban attributes, but predictive accuracy alone does not reveal how much a photograph contributes beyond data already available for the same place. We compare image-based predictions with existing urban data across seven attributes from five public resources and three VLMs. The same urban units are evaluated using images, task context, nearby observations, and public records, while image replacements and conflicting records test source reliance. Existing urban data matched or exceeded image-only models for road damage, curb ramps, and house price, while neighbouring official statistics nearly matched the best image result for population. Images were more informative for building type, building function, and low-rise floor count. For floor count, image advantage increased by 5.7 percentage points per doubling of distance to the nearest labelled building and declined for tall buildings whose rooflines often fell outside the frame. Models frequently followed conflicting records. OpenFACADES floor annotations were generated with OpenStreetMap floor values and showed the opposite height-dependent error pattern from image-only reruns. Street-view image value therefore depends on visual legibility and local data coverage. Comparing images with existing urban data can guide image collection and clarify the provenance of derived urban maps.

</details>


### [7] [DSSR-3D: Decoupled Reasoning for View-Dependent Referring in 3D Gaussians](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00040)
*Thanh-Khoi Nguyen,Thien-Phuc Tran,Minh-Triet Tran*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出推理时框架DSSR-3D，将视角相关的指代分割形式化为姿态不变语义定位与姿态条件空间推理两个接口，无需重训练即可在3D高斯场上实现视角相关的指代分割，并发布ViewRef-GS基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D高斯泼溅的指代/开放词汇分割将语言特征嵌入全局视角不变空间，无法解决依赖相机位姿的观察者中心空间关系（如"在……左边"）。

Method: 将任务形式化为两个接口：姿态不变的语义定位与姿态条件的空间推理，任何满足约束的函数对均可构成有效实现；以温度锐化的softmax定位机制和基于投影的方向打分函数实例化两接口，通过轻量、免训练的步骤融合，且不依赖包围盒等离散几何代理。另构建ViewRef-GS基准，并与增强的Ref-LERF联合评测。

Result: 在3DGS指代方法上取得一致提升，除基础语义场外无需额外训练；两接口可零样本迁移到结构不同的语义场，无需适配；在ViewRef-GS与增强Ref-LERF上提供视角相关空间定位的综合测试平台。

Conclusion: 通过解耦语义定位与空间推理并引入视角条件，可在不重训练的前提下实现视角相关的3D高斯场指代分割，为观察者中心空间定位提供了通用、可迁移的推理时方案与基准。

Abstract: Recent advances in 3D Gaussian Splatting have enabled open-vocabulary and referring segmentation by distilling semantic knowledge from 2D foundation models into 3D representations. However, existing referring fields embed language features in a globally view-invariant space, making them fundamentally unable to resolve observer-centric spatial relations (e.g., "to the left of") that depend on camera pose. We propose DSSR-3D, an inference-time framework for view-dependent referring segmentation on continuous 3D Gaussian fields, formalized as two interfaces - pose-invariant semantic localization and pose-conditioned spatial reasoning - such that any pair of functions satisfying these constraints yields a valid instantiation, requiring no retraining of the underlying semantic field and no reliance on discrete geometric proxies such as bounding boxes. We instantiate the two interfaces with a temperature-sharpened softmax localization mechanism and a projection-based directional scoring function, fused via a lightweight, training-free step, and show they transfer zero-shot to structurally distinct semantic fields without adaptation. We further propose ViewRef-GS, a benchmark isolating view-dependent segmentation on 3D Gaussian fields, evaluated jointly with an augmented Ref-LERF to provide a comprehensive testbed for viewpoint-dependent spatial grounding. Experiments show consistent gains over existing 3DGS-based referring methods, with no additional training beyond the base semantic field

</details>


### [8] [Reachability Is Not Generalization: Understanding Verb--Noun Decomposition in Assembly Action Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00064)
*Changyi Li,Yu Xiao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文系统分析了装配动作识别中动词-名词分解方法的组合泛化能力，发现其仅能部分突破原子分类器的组合上限，性能仍受训练数据共现结构制约。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 装配动作具有组合性，部署中系统常遇到熟悉组件的新组合，但原子动作分类器对任何未见组合都赋予零概率。主流解决方案是动词-名词分解，然而其在组合偏移下的泛化机制尚缺乏系统理解。

Method: 在三个装配数据集（MECCANO、HAViD、IMPACT）上系统分析动词-名词分解方法，考察其相对于原子分类器天花板的泛化表现、与训练数据共现结构的关系、组件词汇量不对称性以及共享编码器训练带来的纠缠效应。

Result: 分解虽能突破原子上限，但其泛化仅在有限程度上超越；未见组合性能与训练数据共现结构高度相关，增益主要来自密集支撑区域的插值而非无约束重组。失败一致集中于词汇量更大的组件，IMPACT的动词密集词汇将瓶颈从名词反转为动词。共享编码器训练引入组件纠缠，使调和平均性能最多落后独立重组6.0倍。

Conclusion: 动词-名词分解在实践中只能实现部分组合泛化。作者识别出原始支撑、词汇不对称和组件纠缠这三个相互关联的误差来源，并提供了一个可移植的诊断框架，用于超越聚合准确率地研究组合识别。

Abstract: Assembly actions are compositional: they combine a manipulation with a part or tool. In deployment, systems routinely encounter novel combinations of familiar components, yet an atomic action classifier assigns every unseen combination exactly zero probability by construction. The prevailing solution is verb--noun decomposition, which predicts components separately and recombines them to reach unseen actions. While widely adopted, how decomposition generalizes under compositional shift remains poorly understood. We present a systematic analysis of verb--noun decomposition across three assembly datasets (MECCANO, HAViD, and IMPACT). Although decomposition escapes the atomic ceiling, its generalization extends only partially beyond it. Unseen-composition performance remains strongly tied to the co-occurrence structure of the training data, indicating that much of the observed gain arises from interpolation within densely supported regions of the compositional space rather than from unconstrained recombination. Across datasets, failures consistently concentrate on the larger-vocabulary component, and IMPACT's verb-heavy vocabulary reverses the bottleneck from nouns to verbs. We further show that shared-encoder training introduces component entanglement, encouraging reliance on co-occurrence patterns that transfer poorly to unseen compositions and trailing independent recombination by up to $6.0\times$ in harmonic mean. Taken together, these findings explain why decomposition achieves only partial compositional generalization in practice. The probe edits the image so the ground truth flips, holds the reasoning trace fixed, and asks whether the verdict follows. Applying a conservative rejection threshold certifies several cells as false alarms outright, the clearest being a judge that detects the injected error essentially every time while still scoring as if it had not used the image at all. <details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉-语言模型的视觉token压缩几乎都被视为“选择问题”，即保留部分token、丢弃其余token；而效果最好的排序准则依赖语言模型对token的注意力，这使排序成为所提问题的函数。单轮基准中这一问题不明显，但当压缩表示被写入一次、多次读取（如多轮对话缓存或设备-服务器传输）时会变得关键。

Conclusion: 视觉token压缩不应仅被视为token选择问题；将每个token保留并优化其码率，可得到查询无关、一次编码多次复用的压缩表示。该方法在等比特预算下提升输出分布与答案保持能力，并在跨查询复用场景中优于依赖注意力排序的剪枝方法。

Abstract: Visual-token compression for vision--language models is posed almost entirely as a selection problem: decide which tokens to keep and discard the rest. The criteria that work best rank tokens by the attention the language model pays them, which makes the ranking a function of the question being asked. That is invisible in a single-turn benchmark and decisive whenever a compressed representation is written once and read many times, as when it is cached across the turns of a conversation or transmitted between a device and a server. We take the other half of the classical transform-coding toolkit instead: keep every token and vary its rate. A transform code exposes each token's measured distortion--rate curve, and a fixed bit budget is distributed across tokens by exact integer rate--distortion optimisation on those curves. No text enters the pipeline, so one compressed representation serves any query. </details>

Motivation: MRI分割对临床诊断与病情监测至关重要。U-Net及其变体虽在医学图像分割中有效，但难以同时保留细粒度细节与全局上下文信息；而MRI解剖结构边界不规则、形状/对比度/尺度多变，使该问题更为突出。现有方法缺乏跨不同解剖结构通用的分割方案。

Result: 在两个公开基准MRI数据集上评测：脊髓MR扫描的脑脊液（CSF）分割，以及MSD挑战赛的左心房心脏分割。结果表明MRFFU-Net在多项评价指标上优于当前最先进模型。

Conclusion: MRFFU-Net通过多分辨率特征融合有效兼顾细节与全局上下文，验证了其在不同解剖结构MRI分割任务中的有效性与通用性。

Conclusion: 结果说明，引入字符感知的结构先验对于低资源历史文献的可靠修复具有重要意义，为满文文献数字化提供了超越像素重建的新思路。

Abstract: Historical Manchu documents preserve invaluable linguistic and cultural heritage, yet their digitization is hindered by severe degradations and the scarcity of paired training data. ### [20] [EgoRefine: Ego-Referenced Predictive Alignment and Trajectory-Conditioned Reliability-Aware Fusion for Asynchronous Collaborative Perception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00319)
*Lingzhao Kong,Yongsheng Zang,Yu Kang,Kailun Yang,Jie Fu,Yukun Zuo,Zhiyong Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出EgoRefine框架，利用自车当前特征引导协同特征预测对齐，并基于轨迹差异自适应加权融合，缓解异步通信下的时序错位问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异步通信导致协同特征存在时序延迟，现有基于预测的方法主要依赖发送方自身历史进行补偿，与自车当前观测之间仍存在残余错位；且后续融合往往忽略对齐质量的空间差异。

Method: 1）Ego-referenced Predictive Alignment模块：以自车当前特征引导协同轨迹场预测，并沿自车参考轨迹方向细化采样偏移；2）Trajectory-conditioned Reliability-aware Fusion模块：将自车与协同流之间的轨迹差异及方向细化幅度作为对齐线索，用于调节对齐特征间的关系，并在卷积融合前对两路特征自适应重加权。

Result: 在V2V4Real和DAIR-V2X-Seq数据集上，EgoRefine在AP@0.5和AP@0.7上平均分别超过TraF-Align 1.6和2.9个点。

Abstract: Collaborative perception enables connected agents to share complementary observations for 3D object detection, extending sensing range and mitigating occlusion. Under asynchronous communication, however, cooperative features arrive with temporal delay. Existing prediction-based methods compensate for these features mainly from the transmitting agent's own history, leaving residual misalignment with the ego agent's current observation; subsequent fusion also often overlooks spatial variations in alignment quality. We propose EgoRefine, an ego-referenced predictive alignment and reliability-aware fusion framework for asynchronous collaborative perception. Its Ego-referenced Predictive Alignment module uses the current ego feature to guide cooperative trajectory-field prediction and refines the sampling offsets along an ego-referenced trajectory direction. Its Trajectory-conditioned Reliability-aware Fusion module treats the trajectory discrepancy between the ego and cooperative streams and the directional refinement magnitude as alignment cues, using them to condition the relation between aligned features and adaptively reweight the two streams before convolutional fusion. Experiments on V2V4Real and DAIR-V2X-Seq show that EgoRefine outperforms TraF-Align by 1.6 and 2.9 points on average in AP@0.5 and AP@0.7, respectively. The source code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/godk0509/EgoRefine.

</details>


### [21] [LEGO-OPD: Factorized Teacher Composition for Multimodal On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00333)
*Jaeyun Shin,Hangeol Chang,Jong Chul Ye*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LEGO-OPD 通过将语言专家与视觉定位专家的输出因子化组合为单一教师分布，并引入自适应校准控制视觉似然对语言先验的更新强度，在多模态与纯文本推理任务上均优于单/多教师 OPD 基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态 on-policy distillation 希望提升视觉定位能力，同时保留语言模型强大的推理能力。现有多教师方法虽结合 LLM 与 VLM 教师提供互补监督，但直接使用 VLM 的完整预测分布会把视觉定位信号与其自身语言先验纠缠在一起，导致定位信息无法独立迁移；而单纯增强视觉监督又会过度强调视觉证据、损害语言推理。因此需要在视觉定位与语言推理之间取得可控平衡。

Method: 提出 LEGO-OPD，选择性地将 Language Expert 与 Grounding Expert 的因素组合为一个教师分布。基于广义贝叶斯表述，语言专家提供候选 token 上的先验，定位专家提供视觉似然来更新该先验，而非迁移其完整预测分布，从而实现语言推理与视觉定位的独立控制。并引入自适应校准，以定位专家的图像诱导预测偏移作为前缀相关的参照，在每个解码前缀上确定视觉似然更新语言先验的强度，避免视觉监督不足或过度。

Result: 在 Qwen3 模型上的实验表明，LEGO-OPD 在多模态和纯文本推理任务上均持续优于所评估的单教师与多教师 OPD 基线，并在提升初始学生模型视觉感知的同时保留了纯文本推理能力。

Conclusion: 通过因子化的贝叶斯式教师分布组合与自适应校准，LEGO-OPD 解耦了视觉定位与语言推理的监督信号，有效缓解多模态 OPD 中视觉监督与语言推理之间的权衡问题。

Abstract: Multimodal on-policy distillation (OPD) aims to improve visual grounding while preserving the strong reasoning capabilities of language models. Recent multi-teacher approaches combine LLM and VLM teachers to provide complementary supervision. However, directly using a VLM's full predictive distribution entangles its visual grounding signal with its own language prior, preventing the grounding information from being transferred independently. Conversely, increasing the strength of visual supervision can improve perception but may overemphasize visual evidence and degrade language reasoning. To address this trade-off, we introduce LEGO-OPD, which selectively composes factors from a Language Expert and a Grounding expert into One teacher distribution for multimodal OPD. Under a generalized Bayesian formulation, the language expert provides a prior over candidate tokens, while the grounding expert contributes a visual likelihood that updates this prior, rather than transferring its complete predictive distribution. This factorized composition allows language reasoning and visual grounding to be controlled independently. We further introduce adaptive calibration to determine how strongly the visual likelihood should update the language prior at each decoding prefix. Specifically, LEGO-OPD uses the grounding expert's image-induced prediction shift as a prefix-dependent reference, preventing both insufficient and excessive visual supervision. Experiments with Qwen3 models show that LEGO-OPD consistently outperforms the evaluated single- and multi-teacher OPD baselines on both multimodal and text-only reasoning tasks. Moreover, it improves the initial student's visual perception while preserving text-only reasoning.

</details>


### [22] [Vmem-$\varphi$: Low-Compute Out-of-Distribution Detection in Spiking Neural Networks from Membrane-Potential Statistics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00350)
*Arul Rana,Agrim Tripathi,Shoaib Ahmed Dipu,Md. Shaown Miah,Syed Ishtiaque Ahmed,Sayeed Shafayet Chowdhury*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出利用脉冲神经网络中膜电位的阈下动态作为OOD检测信号，并构建Gen1-C事件相机损坏基准与MDD方法，实现低成本、有效的分布偏移检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 事件相机数据处理中，脉冲神经网络虽具能效优势，但OOD检测仍具挑战。现有OOD检测方法依赖目标检测SNN中不可用的模型输出或计算组件，且不适合低算力部署，因此需要一种内部、低成本的检测信号。

Method: 利用阈下膜电位V_mem(t)作为内部信号，基于膜动态提取逐通道简单统计量进行OOD检测；构建Gen1-C基准（基于Prophesee Gen1汽车检测数据集，含六种传感器驱动的直方图级压力测试、五级严重程度）；提出Multi-Descriptor Deviation (MDD)，一种对损坏不敏感、作用于膜电位统计量的方法。

Result: 在最高损坏严重程度下，MDD仅使用有界64帧观测窗口，在六种损坏中的五种上AUROC超过0.88；剩余一种损坏也是对底层检测器影响最小的损坏。

Conclusion: 时间膜电位动态可为SNN事件感知中的OOD检测提供有效且低成本信号。

Abstract: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) offer an energy-efficient approach to processing event-camera data, yet out-of-distribution (OOD) detection remains challenging in this setting. Existing OOD detection methods often depend on model outputs or computational components that are unavailable in object detection SNNs or are poorly suited to low-compute deployment. To that effect, we show that the subthreshold membrane potential \(V_{\mathrm{mem}}(t)\) provides a useful internal signal for detecting distribution shifts. Simple per-channel statistics derived from these membrane dynamics enable OOD detection. To evaluate this approach, we introduce Gen1-C, an event-camera corruption benchmark developed upon the Prophesee Gen1 automotive detection dataset, containing six sensor-motivated histogram-level stress tests at five severity levels. We further propose the Multi-Descriptor Deviation (MDD), a corruption-blind method that operates on membrane-potential statistics. At the highest corruption severity, MDD achieves an AUROC of more than 0.88 on five of the six corruptions using only a bounded 64-frame observation window. Notably, the remaining corruption is also the one that has the smallest effect on the underlying detector. These results show that the temporal membrane-potential dynamics can provide an effective and low-cost signal for OOD detection in SNN-based event perception.

</details>


### [23] [From Image Latent Space to Fuzzy Rules: Interpretable Analysis of Gastrointestinal Foundation Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00414)
*Michael D. Vasilakakis,Dimitris K. Iakovidis*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于原型的模糊规则框架，在无需微调的情况下解释预训练基础模型内部层输出的图像块特征，在三个医学影像任务上达到与黑盒分类器相当的精度，并将规则用于分析合成医学图像。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基础模型在医学影像任务中迁移性强，但其潜在表征如何编码临床相关信息仍不清楚，这在安全攸关领域是一个待解难题；同时黑盒分类器缺乏可解释性，合成医学图像的评价也常仅以单一分数概括，缺少对偏离真实组织的定位说明。

Method: 在特征空间中对类别特定原型进行聚类，得到紧凑的视觉模式；将图像块特征表示为与原型的相似度，并用具有人类可读的语言化IF-THEN条件的模糊规则进行分类。框架应用于在ImageNet-1K与GastroNet-5M上预训练的ViT-S/16骨干的最后两个block，无需任何微调，与k近邻、核SVM和线性探测在相同冻结特征下对比，任务包括无线胶囊内镜分类、胃肠内镜分类和结肠息肉分割。

Result: 在不微调骨干的情况下，所提方法达到与黑盒分类器相当的精度；领域特定预训练产生的特征既具判别性又可符号化压缩；提取的规则被用于分析合成医学图像，可给出生成器复现或未能复现哪些真实原型与规则的可读说明，并定位合成图像偏离真实组织的位置，而非仅给出单一分数。

Conclusion: 该框架提供了关于基础模型如何组织临床相关结构的透明、深度分辨视角，并展示了所提取规则的实际下游用途。

Abstract: Foundation models pretrained on large-scale datasets demonstrate strong transferability to medical imaging tasks. However, understanding how their latent representations encode clinically relevant information remains an open challenge in safety-critical domains. This study proposes a prototype-based fuzzy-rule framework that interprets the patch-level features produced by the inner layers of pretrained foundation models, without any fine-tuning. Class-specific prototypes are learned by clustering in the feature space, yielding compact visual patterns. Patch features are then expressed as prototype similarities and classified by fuzzy rules with linguistic IF-THEN conditions that are human readable. The framework is applied across the final two blocks of ViT-S/16 backbones pretrained on ImageNet-1K and GastroNet-5M, and benchmarked against k-nearest neighbours, kernel SVM, and linear probing under identical frozen features, on wireless capsule endoscopy classification, gastrointestinal endoscopy classification, and colonic polyp segmentation. The experimental analysis shows that the proposed method, without backbone fine-tuning, reaches accuracy comparable to these black-box classifiers, and that domain-specific pretraining yields features that are both discriminative and symbolically compressible. Because the resulting rules are extracted from real data and expressed in interpretable terms, they are further used as an instrument to investigate synthetic medical images, providing a human-readable account of which real prototypes and rules a generator reproduces or fails to reproduce, localising where a synthetic image departs from real tissue rather than summarising it with a single score. Abstract: Automated classification of brain tumors from MRI is a heavily published application of deep learning in medical imaging, with reported accuracies on public benchmarks routinely exceeding 98%. However, accuracy does not capture a critical dimension of benchmark quality: dataset integrity, defined as the independence of test from training data at the image, patient, and acquisition-source levels. We audit the three most widely used corpora against a chest-radiograph negative control and quantify each layer's effect on measured performance across nine architectures and three evaluation conditions. Contamination is severe at every layer: 28.8% of the dominant corpus's official test split has a near-twin in its own training split, a second corpus leaks 22.3% of its test images byte-identically, 95.5% of traceable test images share a patient with training, and file-header features containing no anatomy separate tumor from no-tumor at 0.959 balanced accuracy, at parity with fine-tuned ResNet backbones. The unexpected result is that removing every identified leaked test image leaves balanced accuracy essentially unchanged: stable performance after deduplication does not establish benchmark integrity. For biomedical research, reported accuracy on these corpora alone does not establish that a model has learned to recognize tumors rather than exploit dataset-specific cues. We release the contaminated-file lists, recovered patient identifiers, and deduplicated splits.

Abstract: Human motion, environmental contacts, and interaction forces are governed by common physical laws, yet existing approaches typically separate visual pose reconstruction from contact and force estimation. This separation limits joint reasoning and can propagate errors between stages. We introduce PACT, an end-to-end model that jointly learns to estimate human pose, contacts and contact forces from monocular video. Our approach augments a human reconstruction foundation model with learnable contact-force tokens and a temporal transformer that integrates visual features with world-space motion. Joint prediction heads refine human poses and estimate contacts and forces, while physics-based supervision encourages consistency between the reconstructed motion and interaction forces. To address the scarcity of force annotations, we develop a data annotation pipeline that combines contact labeling with physics-based motion and force optimization, producing training supervision from synthetic and real-world videos. We also introduce a real-world climbing benchmark ForceWall with climbing videos and corresponding ground-truth contact forces obtained from the force sensors. Experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art contact and force estimation, outperforming staged reconstruction approaches and generalizing to interactions beyond the training distribution. These results support end-to-end joint learning as an effective approach to recovering human motion and physical interactions from video.

*Lehan Yang,Daiqing Qi,Wenhao Zhang,Avery Li,Yiqing Yang,Yifan Li,Yu Kong,Haitian Zheng,Zhifei Zhang,Zhe Lin,Varun Jampani,Sheng Li*

TL;DR: PixelDense通过将语义与几何教师分为两条投影流并施加权重空间正交惩罚，解决了多教师REPA中梯度竞争问题，在多个生成评测与密集预测探针上超越单教师与未分解多教师方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有REPA对齐目标几乎只用DINOv2、CLIP等语义编码器，而近期分析表明对齐效果主要来自空间结构而非全局语义，但预测该结构的密集预测基础模型（SAM2、Depth Anything v2、Metric3D v2）作为REPA目标被忽视；且简单求和多教师会因语义与几何梯度竞争同一去噪器投影而劣于最佳单几何教师。

Abstract: Representation alignment (REPA) accelerates diffusion transformer training, but its alignment targets are almost exclusively semantic encoders such as DINOv2 and CLIP. Recent analysis points to spatial structure, not global semantics, as the carrier of the alignment effect, yet dense-prediction foundation models trained to predict that structure remain overlooked as REPA targets. In pixel-space diffusion, SAM2, Depth Anything v2, and Metric3D v2 each outperform the DINOv2-only GenEval baseline, with the two geometric teachers leading the segmentation teacher. A flat sum of all four teachers, however, lands below the best single geometric teacher, as semantic and geometric gradients compete for one denoiser projection. We introduce PixelDense, which routes DINOv2 and SAM2 through a semantic projection stream, routes Depth Anything v2 and Metric3D v2 through a geometric projection stream, and adds a weight-space orthogonality penalty that keeps the two streams in disjoint subspaces. All four teachers are frozen during training and dropped at inference. Applied to PixelGen and DeCo with a single recipe, PixelDense improves GenEval, DPG-Bench, and HPS v2.1, raises PixelGen-XXL's GenEval Overall from 0.7927 to 0.8093, and beats every single-teacher and unfactored multi-teacher variant. In partial-noise reconstruction, independent panoptic, depth, and surface-normal probes show up to 53.1% PQ gain and 36.0% depth AbsRel reduction at $τ=0.5$ across COCO and Flickr30K. From random initialization, PixelDense also reaches the baseline's peak GenEval 1.23x faster. In SDEdit editing on PIE-Bench, PixelDense keeps more of the source background and layout at every edit strength, raising background PSNR by up to 2.2 dB.

### [27] [Memorizon: Training World Models Beyond Their Context Window](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00544)
*Tingting Liao,Xuezhi Liang,Hao Li,Guangyi Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Memorizon 解耦了长跨度监督与注意力开销：训练样本可覆盖任意长跨度，但仅对最后 k 个 chunk 打分，通过相机共视检索构建有界共享 latent bank，使序列长度与跨度无关，从而以低成本实现流式世界模型的重复访问一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流式世界模型需在重复访问同一地点时保持一致渲染，而直接监督此类回访需要同时包含两次访问、跨越数分钟的训练样本。对完整跨度做稠密注意力会带来二次成本，使长跨度监督极其昂贵。

Method: 将"监督所需的长跨度"与"注意力所需的长序列"解耦：样本覆盖任意长跨度但只对最后 k 个 chunk 计分；每个被打分 chunk 不 tokenize 之前历史，而是按相机共视检索各自的 top-K latents，其并集构成共享 bank；bank 规模上界为 kK，使序列长度与跨度无关。最短跨度时等价于常规训练。在滑动窗口基线上引入该检索机制。

Result: bank 带来的成本仅一次性增加；更长跨度成本几乎不变，跨度从 100 s 增至 400 s 仅使单步耗时增加 12%。相比滑动窗口基线，检索在每个数据划分上都提升回访一致性；跨度长到能覆盖每次回访的首次访问时再提升 24%–30%，但图像质量有所下降，超过该跨度后继续加长无进一步收益。用另一 episode 填充 bank 会使回访相关性下降 83%，表明模型确实使用了检索到的内容。

Conclusion: Memorizon 通过有界检索 bank 实现了高效的长跨度回访监督，在序列长度受限的前提下显著提升重复访问一致性，并验证了检索内容被模型有效利用；但一致性提升伴随一定图像质量代价，且跨度收益存在饱和点。

Abstract: Streaming world models should render a place consistently across repeated visits. Directly supervising such revisits requires training samples that capture both visits, often spanning minutes. Yet dense attention over the full span incurs quadratic costs, making long-span supervision expensive. Memorizon breaks this coupling: long spans are needed for supervision, but not for attention, since the two visits can share a forward pass without including every intervening frame. A training sample covers a span of any length but is scored only on its last $k$ chunks. Instead of tokenizing the history before them, each scored chunk retrieves its own top-$K$ latents by camera co-visibility, and the union of these requests forms a shared bank. The bank is bounded by $kK$, so the sequence stays bounded however long the span; at the shortest span the recipe is exactly conventional training. Adding the bank raises the cost of a step once; beyond that, a longer span costs little, and going from 100 to 400 s adds 12% to the step time. Against a sliding-window baseline, retrieval raises revisit consistency on every split, and a span long enough to reach the first visit of each return adds a further 24% to 30%, at some cost in image quality; beyond that span, more length no longer helps. Filling the bank from another episode lowers revisit correlation by 83%, so the model uses what it retrieves. Project page: https://tingtingliao.github.io/memorizon

</details>


### [28] [PhysVista: Benchmarking Physical Intelligence in VLMs via a Perception-Reasoning-Assessment Loop](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00559)
*Xinge Peng,Yiting Lu,Tianwu Zhi,Wen Wen,Jianzhao Liu,Xin Li,Zhibo Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 PhysVista 基准，通过"感知—推理—评估"闭环认知框架，联合评测视觉语言模型（VLMs）的物理状态感知、物理动力学推理与物理合理性评估能力，揭示其视觉识别与真实物理理解之间的显著差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 VLMs 虽具备较强的多模态推理能力，但是否真正掌握真实世界动态背后的物理一致性尚不明确。已有基准评测范式存在碎片化问题，仅关注孤立的认知阶段，忽视感知、推理与物理判断之间的内在协同，缺乏整体视角，难以诊断 VLMs 能否可靠评估生成模型的物理真实性。

Method: 受人类"看—推理—判断"过程启发，构建闭环认知回路框架 PhysVista。该基准联合评测三个环节：物理状态感知、物理动力学推理、物理合理性评估；并进一步区分事件级推理与尺度级推理，以实现细粒度的物理理解分析；同时纳入真实世界视频与 AI 生成视频，覆盖多样领域与新兴生成场景。

Result: 在多种 VLMs 上的大量实验表明，模型在物理推理与物理合理性评估方面存在明显局限，视觉识别能力与真正的物理理解之间存在持续性的鸿沟。

Conclusion: PhysVista 为物理基础的多模态智能提供了更系统化的评测范式，指出未来应面向更具原则性的设计，以弥合视觉识别与物理理解之间的差距，推动物理基础扎实的多模态智能发展。

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown strong multimodal reasoning capabilities, yet whether they truly capture the physical consistency underlying real-world dynamics remains unclear. Existing benchmark paradigms often suffer from fragmented evaluation, focusing on isolated cognitive stages while overlooking the inherent synergy between perception, reasoning, and physical judgment. The lack of a holistic perspective limits the ability to diagnose whether VLMs can reliably evaluate the physical authenticity of emerging generative models. To address these issues, we introduce PhysVista, a benchmark designed to evaluate physical intelligence in VLMs through a closed cognitive loop framework inspired by the human seeing-reasoning-assessment process. PhysVista restores this loop by jointly evaluating physical state perception, physical dynamics reasoning, and physical plausibility assessment. It further distinguishes event-level reasoning and scale-level reasoning to enable fine-grained analysis of physical understanding. In addition, PhysVista incorporates both real-world and AI-generated videos, allowing evaluation across diverse domains and emerging generative scenarios. Extensive experiments across a diverse set of VLMs reveal substantial limitations in physical reasoning and plausibility assessment, highlighting a persistent gap between visual recognition and genuine physical understanding, and pointing toward more principled designs for physically grounded multimodal intelligence.

</details>


### [29] [FORTE: Adaptive Scoring and Exact Keyframe Selection for Long-Video Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00573)
*Haifeng Huang,Biyin Xu,Chunsheng Xin,Yang Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FORTE：一种免训练、两阶段的查询感知关键帧选择框架，通过自适应相关性打分与全局关键帧优化，在有限打分预算下提升长视频问答准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于打分的关键帧选择方法通常在固定、均匀采样的候选池内搜索，导致池外证据永远无法被选中；在打分预算受限时，核心挑战在于如何自适应地将打分评估分配给有潜力的帧，同时持续探索时间轴上代表性不足的区域。

Method: FORTE 分两阶段：1）自适应相关性打分——从稀疏均匀观测出发，用高效高斯过程相关性预测器估计未打分帧的相关性，利用时间局部性与近似带状核结构，将固定带宽下的核心计算由立方复杂度降为关于帧数的线性复杂度；该阶段以预测相关性与时间覆盖度的平衡来决定下一批打分帧，兼顾潜力区域与欠探索区域。2）全局关键帧优化——最大化同时刻画实测相关性与时间覆盖度的目标函数，并利用对数覆盖度结构导出精确算法，在固定最终帧预算下以关于候选池规模的线性时间求出最优子集。

Result: 在四个长视频问答基准上，FORTE 在所有测试的打分预算下均取得所比较选择器中最高的平均准确率；进一步实验表明其在不同相关性打分器与下游 MLLM 上均保持稳定有效性。

Conclusion: FORTE 以免训练方式将自适应探索与精确组合优化结合，在有限打分预算下实现更优的关键帧选择，且具备跨打分器与跨模型的可迁移性。

Abstract: Query-aware keyframe selection enables multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to process long videos using only a small set of question-relevant frames. Existing score-based methods, however, typically search within a fixed, uniformly sampled candidate pool, preventing evidence outside this pool from ever being selected. Given a limited relevance-scoring budget, the key challenge is to allocate evaluations adaptively to promising frames while continuing to explore underrepresented temporal regions. We introduce FORTE, a training-free framework that addresses this challenge through two stages: adaptive relevance scoring and global keyframe optimization. Starting from sparse, uniformly distributed observations, our efficient Gaussian-process relevance predictor estimates relevance for unscored frames, exploiting temporal locality and the approximately banded kernel structure to reduce the core computation from cubic to linear time in the number of frames for fixed bandwidth. The scoring stage then selects which frames to score next by balancing predicted relevance with temporal coverage, prioritizing promising regions while also exploring less-represented parts of the video. The optimization stage selects the final keyframes by maximizing an objective that jointly captures measured relevance and temporal coverage. We derive an exact algorithm that leverages the logarithmic coverage structure to identify the optimal subset of the scored candidate pool in time linear in the pool size, for a fixed final-frame budget. Experiments on four long-video question-answering benchmarks show that FORTE achieves the highest observed mean accuracy among the compared selectors under every tested scoring budget. Further evaluations demonstrate its consistent effectiveness across different relevance scorers and downstream MLLMs.

</details>


### [30] [Gestalt: Large Multimodal Interplay Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00576)
*Zequn Yang,Yu Miao,Haotian Ni,Ziheng Chen,Chengxiang Huang,Dongzhan Zhou,Kai Chen,Qi Zhang,Ji-Rong Wen,Yake Wei,Di Hu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 Gestalt，一种以多模态交互为核心的新型大型多模态模型范式。基于人类多感官感知的多阶段特性，构建"多模态交互金字塔"，将建模组织为从模态专有处理、跨模态对齐到深度多模态整合的递进过程，并采用统一离散扩散框架与交互分区架构。实验表明其在图像生成、多模态理解与纯文本评测上均表现强劲。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大型多模态模型主要致力于容纳更多模态，却忽视了各模态自身的独特特性及模态间关系，导致发展遭遇瓶颈。受人类多感官感知多阶段特性启发，作者希望以交互为核心重新组织多模态建模。

Method: 提出"多模态交互金字塔"，将建模组织为从模态专有处理、跨模态对齐到深度多模态整合的递进层次；在此指导下，Gestalt 采用统一离散扩散框架和交互分区架构，并通过可学习的交互 token 作为中介实现跨模态交换与整合；该金字塔同时用于组织数据组织方式与训练策略。

Result: 在图像生成、多模态理解以及纯文本评测上均取得强劲表现，显著提升了跨模态整合能力，同时保留了模态专有信息。

Conclusion: Gestalt 有效发挥了基于扩散的多模态模型的优势，验证了以多模态交互为中心、按金字塔分层组织的建模范式的可行性，为迈向统一多模态智能提供了有前景的路径。

Abstract: In this paper, we propose Gestalt, a new paradigm of large multimodal model built around multimodal interplay. Despite rapid advances, large multimodal models are reaching a bottleneck: existing approaches focus primarily on accommodating additional modalities while overlooking the distinct characteristics of each modality and the relations among them. Motivated by the multistage property of human multisensory perception, we propose a multimodal interplay pyramid that organizes multimodal modeling as a progression from modality-specific processing, through cross-modal alignment, to deeper multimodal integration. Guided by this pyramid, Gestalt adopts a unified discrete diffusion framework and an interplay-partitioned architecture, with learnable interplay tokens mediating cross-modal exchange and integration. The pyramid also structures its data organization and training strategy. Strong performance across image generation, multimodal understanding, and text-only evaluation shows that Gestalt significantly improves cross-modal integration while preserving modality-specific information, effectively harnessing the strengths of diffusion-based multimodal models and offering a promising path toward unified multimodal intelligence.

</details>


### [31] [Discrete Annotation, Continuous Preference: Rethinking Supervision for Accurate and Generalizable Aesthetic Image Cropping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00582)
*Ziqing Zhang,Xiao Liu,Kai Liu,Jianze Li,Weihang Zhang,Linghe Kong,Yulun Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出连续偏好场（CPF）将裁剪偏好建模为多峰、连续且锐利的场，据此训练VLM裁剪模型CPIC并重建基准CPICD，解决标注主观性与离散性问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有美学图像裁剪数据集存在两大缺陷：(1) 人类主观性导致标注噪声；(2) 固定采样网格带来的刚性离散性。这些问题既限制了模型精度与泛化能力，也严重扭曲了公平评测。

Method: 提出连续偏好场（CPF），通过(1) 峰值聚类、(2) 离格精炼、(3) 负向塑形、(4) 场组装四个步骤，从离散标注恢复稠密偏好景观；基于CPF奖励，用GRPO优化训练VLM裁剪模型CPIC；并提出CPICD对现有真值框进行系统性重校准。

Result: CPIC克服了模板坍塌问题，达到SOTA性能并具备出色的域外泛化能力；CPICD修正了主流基准中受网格约束的伪影，为裁剪研究建立可靠评测基础；大量实验与用户研究验证了CPF、CPIC、CPICD的优越性。

Conclusion: 将裁剪偏好建模为连续多峰场可有效缓解标注主观性与离散性问题，CPF、CPIC、CPICD三者协同为美学图像裁剪提供了新的建模范式与可信评测基准。

Abstract: Aesthetic image cropping aims to identify the optimal crop of an image in terms of aesthetics and composition. While supervision based on annotated data is fundamental, the field has been hindered by a long-standing problem: existing datasets suffer from (1) human subjectivity and (2) rigid discreteness confined to fixed sampling grids. These flawed annotations not only limit the accuracy and generalization of trained models but also severely distort fair evaluation. To overcome this, we propose to model human cropping preference as a multi-peaked, continuous, and sharp field over the crop space. We introduce the Continuous Preference Field (CPF), which recovers a dense preference landscape from discrete annotations through (1) peak clustering, (2) off-lattice refinement, (3) negative shaping, and (4) field assembly. Based on this, we train CPIC, a VLM-based cropping model optimized via GRPO with the CPF reward, which overcomes template collapse, achieving state-of-the-art performance and exceptional out-of-domain generalization. Finally, to resolve the long-standing benchmark evaluation crisis, we introduce CPICD, a comprehensive recalibration of existing ground-truth boxes. By leveraging the CPF to correct grid-bound artifacts across mainstream benchmarks, CPICD establishes a rigorous and reliable foundation for future cropping research. Extensive experiments and user studies demonstrate the superiority of our CPF, CPIC, and CPICD. Code, model, and data are available at https://github.com/zzqingz/CPIC.

</details>


### [32] [Just Align $\bm{x}$: Aligning Predictions, Not Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00600)
*Yuyao Zhang,Yuwei Hu,Ziyang Mai,Yu-Wing Tai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出JAx：通过跨噪声水平的干净图像预测对齐进行预测监督，替代表示对齐，提升像素空间扩散模型训练。在ImageNet 256×256上改善FID、加速收敛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表示对齐虽能加速扩散训练，但其收益无法可靠迁移到像素空间干净图像预测。作者发现辅助特征对齐会提升语义特征可用性，却削弱干净图像预测所需的图像变异信息，造成辅助目标与去噪任务不匹配。因此需新原则：辅助监督应改进预测目标本身，而非施加独立的表示目标。

Method: JAx（Just Align x）在不同噪声水平间对齐干净图像预测：用保持原始JiT输入分布的马尔可夫退化，将噪声更大的学生观测与更干净的观测耦合。理论证明更干净状态的oracle预测与最优JiT目标条件均值相同，且条件目标协方差更小，故oracle预测对齐在常数意义下保持总体JiT目标并提供低方差训练目标。为适配不完美EMA教师，结合真值监督与可靠性门控耦合带（按预测风险选邻近教师状态）。

Result: 在ImageNet 256×256上，JAx在JiT-B/16、L/16、H/16上一致提升FID并加速收敛，且无需外部编码器、不改变架构或采样过程。梯度诊断显示小批量梯度方差降低；消融表明增益无法仅由时间重加权解释。

Conclusion: 预测空间监督为像素空间生成模型提供了一个简单、有原理依据的表示对齐替代方案。

Abstract: Representation alignment has become an effective way to accelerate diffusion training, but its benefits do not transfer reliably to pixel-space clean-image prediction. In JiT, we find that auxiliary feature alignment can improve access to semantic features while reducing access to image variation needed for clean-image prediction, creating a mismatch between the auxiliary objective and the denoising task. This suggests a different principle: auxiliary supervision should improve the prediction target itself rather than impose a separate representation target. We introduce JAx (Just Align x), a prediction-supervision method that aligns clean-image predictions across noise levels. JAx couples a noisier student observation with a cleaner observation through a Markov degradation that preserves the original JiT input distribution. Under this coupling, the oracle prediction from the cleaner state has the same conditional mean as the optimal JiT target, while its conditional target covariance is no greater. Thus, oracle prediction alignment preserves the population JiT objective up to a constant while providing a lower-variance training target. To make this construction practical with an imperfect EMA teacher, JAx combines ground-truth supervision with a reliability-gated coupling band that selects nearby teacher states based on prediction risk. On ImageNet 256x256, JAx consistently improves FID and accelerates convergence across JiT-B/16, L/16, and H/16, without an external encoder or changes to the architecture or sampling procedure. Gradient diagnostics further show reduced minibatch gradient variance, while ablations demonstrate that the gains cannot be explained by time reweighting alone. These results show that prediction-space supervision provides a simple and principled alternative to representation alignment for pixel-space generative models.

</details>


### [33] [HAWK: Rethinking Multimodal Drafting for Speculative Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00623)
*Wenhan Yang,Anirudh Rao,Ashwin Chandra*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 HAWK，通过目标层表征融合与压缩视觉隐状态输入提升 LVLM 草稿模型质量，并训练草稿器建模自身提议后目标预测的变化，显著提高投机解码的接受长度与加速比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 投机解码在 LLM 上已实现显著无损加速，但在大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）上效果有限：轻量草稿器难以利用丰富的多模态信息；同时标准蒸馏仅在原始训练轨迹上监督草稿器，未建模草稿器自身提议后目标预测的偏移，导致草稿偏离轨迹时与目标模型分歧增大，后续步骤接受率下降。

Method: HAWK 包含三部分：1）利用表征相似度选择信息量高的目标层，并学习如何组合其隐状态；2）在视觉信息上，直接向草稿器提供目标模型压缩后的视觉隐状态，而非原始视觉 token，降低浅层草稿器的使用难度；3）训练草稿器捕捉其自身提议后目标预测的变化，提升多步起草过程中与目标模型的一致性。

Result: 在 SmolVLM-256M 的十个多模态基准上，贪心解码下平均接受长度从 EAGLE-3 的 3.32 提升至 4.08，加速比从 2.19x 提升至 2.60x；采样解码下接受长度从 2.89 提升至 3.41，加速比从 1.92x 提升至 2.19x。

Conclusion: HAWK 通过改进目标层表征利用、视觉信息传递方式以及多步起草下的目标预测建模，有效缓解了 LVLM 投机解码中草稿器与目标模型分歧的问题，在多项多模态基准上稳定提升接受长度与加速比。

Abstract: Speculative decoding has achieved substantial lossless speedups for LLMs, but remains less effective for large vision-language models (LVLMs), where lightweight drafters struggle to use rich multimodal information. A second limitation is that standard distillation supervises the drafter only along the original training trajectory, without modeling how target predictions shift after the drafter's own proposals. As drafting moves away from this trajectory, the drafter can increasingly disagree with the target, reducing acceptance in later steps. We propose HAWK to address both limitations. HAWK uses representation similarity to select informative target layers and learns how to combine their hidden states. For visual information, it directly provides the drafter with compressed visual hidden states from the target model instead of raw visual tokens, making the visual information easier for a shallow drafter to use. HAWK also trains the drafter to capture how target predictions change after its own proposals, improving its agreement with the target during multi-step drafting. On SmolVLM-256M across ten multimodal benchmarks, HAWK raises average acceptance length from 3.32 to 4.08 and speedup from 2.19x to 2.60x over EAGLE-3 under greedy decoding, and from 2.89 to 3.41 and 1.92x to 2.19x under sampling.

</details>


### [34] [VisionQ: VLM-as-a-Judge Taxonomy, Dataset and Benchmark for Qualitative Analysis in Computer Vision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00666)
*Vu Dinh Xuan,Duc-Hai Nguyen,Minh-Dung Dao,Vu Quynh Giao,Quang Hong Nguyen,Binh-Son Hua,Barry O'Sullivan,David Murphy,Hoang D. Nguyen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 VisionQ，首个基于同行评审 CV 论文对比图的基准，将视觉判断锚定到明确命名的视觉准则上，要求评判模型按指定准则选出作者标注的最优输出，从而避免"选对图像但理由错误"的奖励漏洞。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 定性对比图是计算机视觉论文的核心证据，VLM 被越来越多用于评判这类图像。但现有基准只给标量质量分数或整体偏好，评判者可能因错误的视觉理由而选中偏好图像却仍获高分，缺乏对"判断依据是否正确"的约束。

Method: 定义"准则条件视觉判别"任务：每题显式给出视觉准则，仅当评判者选出作者在该准则下认定的最佳输出才计分。构建 VisionQ，包含：(1) 1,409 篇 CVPR/ICCV 论文、1,800+ 经校验对比图、3,911 条人工标注数据点，将方法裁剪图与作者声称的视觉论点关联；(2) 六轴、51 叶的视觉准则分类体系；(3) 隐藏方法名、标题与论文身份的准则条件评测协议，按准则报告准确率；(4) VisionQ-Judge——在对称证据对上做 DPO 微调的 Gemma-4-E4B 评判模型。

Result: VisionQ-Judge 将末选项预测降低 7.0 个百分点，在留出测试集上准确率提升 2.5 个百分点。评测 20 个开源与闭源 VLM 评判模型，最强仅达 63.1% 准确率（随机基线 32.2%），且不同准则间可靠性差异显著。

Conclusion: 现有 VLM 评判在准则条件下的视觉判别能力有限且不均衡，暴露了既定基准评测的盲区；VisionQ 提供了可解释、可归因的评测框架与专用评判模型，推动对定性对比图证据的严谨评估。

Abstract: Qualitative comparison figures are central evidence in computer vision papers, and vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used to judge them. Yet existing benchmarks score only scalar quality or overall preference, so a judge can be rewarded for picking the preferred image for the wrong visual reason. We introduce VisionQ, the first benchmark built from peer-reviewed CV comparison figures that grounds every judgment in a named visual criterion: each question states the criterion, and a judge is credited only when it selects the output the authors identify as best on that criterion. We call this task criterion-conditioned visual discrimination. VisionQ comprises (1) a corpus of 1,409 CVPR and ICCV papers with 1,800+ validated comparison figures and 3,911 hand-annotated data points linking method crops to author-stated visual claims; (2) a six-axis, 51-leaf taxonomy of the visual criteria behind qualitative judgment; (3) a criterion-conditioned evaluation protocol that hides method names, captions, and paper identity and reports accuracy per criterion; and (4) VisionQ-Judge, a DPO-tuned Gemma-4-E4B judge trained on symmetric evidence pairs, which reduces last-option predictions by 7.0pp and improves accuracy by 2.5pp on a held-out test set. Evaluating 20 open- and closed-source VLM judges, we find that the strongest reach only 63.1% accuracy (chance 32.2%) and that reliability varies sharply across criteria. Code: https://github.com/ReML-AI/visionq. Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/visionq-anon-2026/VisionQ-1k.

</details>


### [35] [Harnessing Vision-Language Models for Perceptual Quality Assessment and Autonomous Content Adjustment in Augmented Reality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00677)
*Elias Rotondo,Lin Duan,Yanming Xiu,Sangjun Eom,Conrad Li,Maria Gorlatova*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出基于视觉语言模型(VLM)的自动化AR内容评估与优化框架，构建了RateAR基准，验证VLM预测与人类主观评分高度相关，并搭建自动调整系统，用户研究显示超90%参与者认为系统提升了虚拟内容的放置与尺寸一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AR头戴显示器面临场景几何受限、空间抖动和时间不稳定性等问题，优化终端用户的沉浸感与舒适度仍具挑战。用户研究是评估视觉质量的标准方法，但成本高、可扩展性递减且不灵活，成为迭代设计中的瓶颈。因此需要一种自动化评估与优化方案替代或辅助人工用户研究。

Method: 1) 构建RateAR基准，收集涵盖多样场景与环境条件的AR图像和视频，在物体放置、尺度、阴影一致性等感知因素上具有良好的信度(ICC(2,5)>=.90)；2) 在RateAR上评估11个商用VLM；3) 开展消融研究，比较不同提示策略，提出情境化提示(contextual prompting)；4) 基于上述发现构建自动化AR内容调整系统，并开展21名参与者的用户研究。

Result: VLM质量预测与人类主观判断强相关，Spearman秩相关最高达0.8695；消融研究表明情境化提示相比其他提示策略，在平衡引入的复杂性线索的同时与人类评分对齐更好；21名参与者中超过90%认为系统提升了虚拟内容的放置与尺寸一致性。

Conclusion: 基于VLM的自动化框架能够有效预测AR场景的视觉保真度并自动调整内容，可在一定程度上替代或减轻传统用户研究的负担，为AR内容的迭代设计与优化提供可扩展的解决方案。

Abstract: Advancements in augmented reality (AR) continue to foster innovative solutions, facilitating novel methodologies within educational systems, healthcare delivery, and risk-mitigation protocols. However, optimizing for end-user immersion and comfort remains challenging, as AR head-mounted displays contend with constrained scene geometry, spatial jitter, and temporal instability. User studies are the standard AR evaluation method for visual quality, but their cost, diminishing scalability, and inflexibility pose bottlenecks during iterative application design. To address this problem, we present an automated framework for AR content evaluation and refinement, built on vision-language models (VLMs), to evaluate and predict the visual fidelity of AR scenes as perceived by users. First, we introduce RateAR, a benchmark of AR images and videos collected across diverse scenes and environmental conditions, with good-to-excellent reliability (ICC(2,5) >= .90) across perceptual factors, including object placement, scale, and shadow consistency. Subsequently, we evaluate eleven commercial VLMs on the crafted benchmark. Results support that VLM-based quality predictions strongly correlate with human subjective judgments, achieving Spearman's rank-order correlations of up to 0.8695. An ablation study further suggests that, compared to other prompting strategies, our contextual prompting yields better alignment with human ratings while balancing introduced complexity cues. Building on these findings, we construct an automated AR content adjustment system and conduct a 21-participant user study. More than 90% of participants found that the system improved placement and size coherence of virtual content.

</details>


### [36] [SemanTok: Predictable Semantic Tokens for Efficient Autoregressive Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00686)
*Mikhail Dereviannykh,Vikram Voleti,Simon Donne,Mallikarjun Byrasandra Ramalinga Reddy,Shimon Vainer,Mark Boss*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SemanTok，一种灵活长度视频分词器，将冻结的DINO特征输入编码器，并用轻量头从每个token前缀单独重建语义特征，实现高语义对齐与视频保真度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频世界模型结合自回归预测的可扩展性与扩散模型的视觉质量，其性能高度依赖场景分词器。灵活长度的粗到细分词器可同时提供全局语义（早期粗token）与细节（后期token）。但已有灵活分词器仅在解码器早期隐藏状态上施加表征对齐（REPA）损失，而解码器可部分从加噪输入中直接满足该目标，导致语义对齐不足。

Method: SemanTok在编码器中引入冻结的DINO特征，并增加轻量预测头，使每个保留的token前缀能单独重建DINO语义特征。通过对每个token前缀施加语义重建约束，强化语义对齐信号。

Result: SemanTok在各种AR模型规模下均实现高语义对齐与视频保真度：201M的SemanTok AR模型可匹敌或超越3.4倍规模的VideoFlexTok AR模型，更大模型进一步提升保真度。在分布外类别上保持语义对齐；在每个噪声水平（含纯噪声）下解码器语义对齐更高；在重建与生成两方面表现良好；短token前缀预测成本更低且生成保真度更好，像素细节延后到后续token。

Conclusion: SemanTok通过从每个token前缀重建冻结DINO特征，显著提升灵活视频分词器的语义对齐与保真度，兼顾重建与生成，并以更小模型规模取得具有竞争力的性能。

Abstract: Recent video-based world models pair the scalability of autoregressive (AR) prediction with the visual quality of diffusion models. The choice of scene tokenizer is paramount for the optimal performance of each of these, both in terms of fidelity and semantics. Flexible-length, coarse-to-fine tokenizers yield exactly that: the first coarse tokens carry the clip's global semantics while later tokens further specify details. Existing flexible tokenizers only apply a representation-alignment (REPA) loss on early decoder hidden states, a target the decoder can partly meet from its noised input instead. We introduce SemanTok, a flexible video tokenizer that feeds frozen DINO features into its encoder and adds lightweight heads that reconstruct them from each retained token prefix alone. SemanTok achieves high semantic alignment and video fidelity at every AR model size: a 201M SemanTok AR model matches or beats a VideoFlexTok AR model $3.4\times$ its size, and larger SemanTok AR models further improve fidelity. It keeps semantic alignment on out-of-distribution classes and gives the decoder higher semantic alignment at every noise level, including pure noise. It performs well in both reconstruction and generation, and its short token prefixes are cheaper to predict and give better generation fidelity, with pixel detail deferred to later tokens.

</details>


### [37] [Soundwich: Video Generation with Layered and Controllable Audio](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00691)
*Zhuo Ning,AmirHossein Naghi Razlighi,Sagi Polaczek,Daniel Cohen-Or,Ali Mahdavi-Amiri*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Soundwich 是一个免训练框架，可将冻结的联合音视频流匹配模型改造为生成多条与共享视频同步且可独立编辑的音轨（stems）的生成器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有联合音视频生成模型通常只生成单一混合音轨，缺乏源级控制，与实际工作流中语音、音乐、音效、环境音分离为可编辑音轨的表示方式不符。

Method: 提出免训练框架 Soundwich：对冻结的联合音视频流匹配模型进行改造，支持显式控制各音轨的时间活动；引入共享场景表示以跨音轨传递全局音视频上下文，同时保持源级分离；并将每条音轨与对应视觉源之间的跨模态交互进行路由，以提升音视频一致性。

Result: 生成的音轨与视频保持同步，可独立重新计时、静音、替换或重新混音。实验与人工评估表明，在时间控制、源分离和自然度方面均有提升，并支持在连贯的音视频生成中实现灵活的音源级编辑。代码已开源。

Conclusion: Soundwich 在无需额外训练的前提下实现了多音轨、可独立编辑且与视频同步的音视频生成，兼顾了源级分离与全局一致性，为实际音视频工作流提供了更高的可控性。

Abstract: Recent joint audio-video generative models can synthesize realistic videos with synchronized sound, but typically generate audio as a single mixed track. This limits source-level control and differs from practical audiovisual workflows, where speech, music, sound effects, and ambient sounds are represented as separate editable tracks. We introduce Soundwich, a training-free framework that transforms a frozen joint audio-video flow-matching model into a generator of multiple synchronized, independently editable audio stems coupled to a shared video. Soundwich generates separate audio stems with explicit control over their temporal activity. To keep separately generated sounds coherent, we introduce a shared scene representation that communicates global audiovisual context across stems while preserving their source-level separation. We further route cross-modal interactions between each audio stem and its corresponding visual source, improving audiovisual consistency. The resulting stems remain synchronized with the video and can be independently retimed, muted, replaced, or remixed. Experiments and human evaluations show improved temporal control, source separation, and naturalness, while enabling flexible source-level editing within coherent audiovisual generation. Code is available at https://github.com/CodyNing/Soundwich.

</details>


### [38] [FedMAD: Modulation-Aware Directional Aggregation for Federated Learning in Remote Sensing Image Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00693)
*Barış Büyüktaş,Begüm Demir*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出个性化联邦学习框架FedMAD，通过分离全局共享表征参数与客户端特有适应参数（调制模块+本地批归一化），并结合调制感知的方向性聚合策略，缓解遥感图像分类中客户端数据异构导致的性能退化。

Abstract: Flow matching (FM) learns generative transport by fitting continuous-time motion from a simple source distribution to the data distribution. Method: 以短视频为对象，在计算社会科学（CSS）的两个任务（情感分类、主题分类）上，对上述启发式配置进行系统评估。每个配置沿三条通常被文献分开处理的轴线衡量：分类准确率、下游推断的有效性、每视频token成本。

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) enable video annotation at scale, but costs accumulate quickly: processing a typical 60-second short-form video at one frame per second requires millions of tokens. To reduce costs, researchers rely on heuristics such as sampling a subset of frames, compressing videos into image grids, or using only a single modality. However, it remains unclear which heuristics save cost, and whether they preserve the downstream conclusions these annotations enable. To address this gap, we conduct a systematic evaluation of these heuristics using short-form videos, on two computational social science (CSS) tasks: sentiment and topic classification. We evaluate each configuration along three axes the literature typically treats separately: classification accuracy, validity of downstream inference, and per-video token cost. First, we find that accuracy and validity diverge: the highest-accuracy configuration can produce wrong conclusions. Second, modality value is not guaranteed: text alone can yield strong performance, indicating that adding modalities can add cost without adding signal. Finally, we find that cost can be decoupled from video length when annotating short-form videos: a single $2\times8$ image grid built via simple shot-transition detection approaches full-video understanding ($κ$ within~.05), at $\sim 15\%$ of the token cost. Abstract: Video generation has rapidly progressed from short, low-quality clips to high-resolution, long-duration sequences with complex spatiotemporal dynamics.   <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 配音质量控制需要一个无参考的判定器：仅有无声视频和候选文本（配音音频可能尚不存在），就要判断文本行是否在内容与时序上与说话人的可见口型匹配。现有视觉语音识别器和视频-语言模型不适合该场景——即便微调后能从唇动恢复语音内容，它们对时序错误仍几乎不敏感。

Method: ATR先建立帧级唇部表征与候选文本音素单元之间的单调对齐，再基于该对齐进行推理得出最终判定。具体地，对齐评分器向LLM同时提供每个音素单元的局部证据和经过校准的全局对齐分数，使其能联合推理内容与时序。

Result: 在七语言基准上，2B、4B、9B推理器相比对应Qwen3.5 SFT基线，平均AUC分别提升59.4%、50.2%、50.8%；跨LLM家族泛化，LLaMA-3.1-8B与Mistral-7B分别比最佳基线提升45.9%和46.6%；可迁移到三个未见过的MuAViC语言。下游任务：配音行重排序上ATR-9B比最佳唇读基线高52.0%，脚本到片段指配上高17.7%。

Conclusion: ATR通过"先对齐、后推理"的范式，弥补了现有模型对时序不敏感的缺陷，实现了内容与时序的联合判定，在多语言、多模型、跨数据集及下游任务上均取得显著且稳健的提升。

Abstract: Dubbing quality control requires a reference-free judge that can determine whether a candidate text line matches a speaker's visible articulation in both content and timing, using only silent video and text because dubbed audio may not yet exist. An alignment scorer provides the LLM with both local evidence for each phonetic unit and a calibrated global alignment score, enabling it to reason jointly about content and timing. On a seven-language benchmark, our method improves mean AUC over the corresponding Qwen3.5 SFT baselines by 59.4%, 50.2%, and 50.8% with 2B, 4B, and 9B reasoners, respectively. </details>

TL;DR: 该论文提出 GeoSim 框架，系统分析 AR 模型与 DiT 两类视觉语言模型在 24 项低层图像复原任务中的表征相似性，揭示其几何组织原则与跨任务/跨模型一致性局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Result: 揭示了低层视觉表征的组织原则，同时暴露出其在跨任务与跨模型一致性上的局限：不同范式间的共享几何结构存在但并非普遍成立，模型在任务或模型特定场景下表现出可诊断的表征偏差。

Conclusion: GeoSim 为探测低层视觉中的潜在可迁移性、诊断任务特定或模型特定的性能局限提供了可解释性分析视角，为构建可迁移的统一复原 VLM 与适配器奠定了分析基础。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have emerged as powerful candidates for universal vision backbones, with representative architectures including autoregressive (AR) models and diffusion transformers (DiTs). Yet, adapting them efficiently for all-in-one low-level image restoration remains a challenge. Crucially, the field lacks an understanding of how VLMs organize hidden-layer representations and whether these structurally distinct paradigms share a common geometric organization for pixel-level perception. Such shared organization is a prerequisite for building highly transferable, unified restoration VLMs and adapters. In this paper, we systematically investigate representational similarity across 24 low-level tasks spanning 5 categories. We propose GeoSim, a unified four-level framework that analyzes task-conditioned representations from global similarity, local geometry, sparse feature decomposition, and topological verification perspectives. Our formulation applies to the analysis of hidden states in AR models and feature maps in DiTs across same- and cross-task/model settings. Our results reveal the organizing principles of low-level visual representations while exposing their limits in cross-task and cross-model agreement. Ultimately, GeoSim provides an interpretability lens for probing latent transferability in low-level vision and diagnosing model limitations in task- or model-specific scenarios.

</details>


### [47] [SmoothOperator: Enhancing Representations for Fine-grained Open-set Recognition via Modulated Label Smoothing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00851)
*Thiru Thillai Nadarasar Bahavan,Yu Xia,Sachith Seneviratne,Saman Halgamuge*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出即插即用方法 SmoothOperator，根据样本嵌入空间的 prominence 自适应设置标签平滑系数，增强球面表示学习在开集识别中的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开集识别中未知类分布无法在训练时建模，现有球面表示学习通过压缩和分离已知类取得好效果，其中标签平滑是关键驱动因素，但其对所有样本使用统一系数，忽略了各样本嵌入质量的差异。

Method: 作者揭示 OSR 中的球面表示学习目标共享单一 alignment–uniformity 结构，标签仅通过 alignment 项进入，因此标签平滑相当于一个 alignment 调节旋钮，固定系数使所有样本被调到同一值。据此提出 SmoothOP：由样本的 prominence（样本自身类相对最强竞争类的嵌入空间区分度信号）决定其平滑系数，高 prominence 样本获得强平滑，降低其 alignment 并放松拉近约束；该方法可嵌入四种现有球面表示学习目标，训练开销极小。

Result: 在 Semantic Shift Benchmark 上，SmoothOP 增强变体在多数数据集、不同语义偏移程度及多种 OSR 后处理下普遍优于基线目标，AUROC、OSCR 和闭集准确率最高提升 4.7%。

Conclusion: 标签平滑在球面表示学习中充当样本级的 alignment 调节器，其系数应按样本嵌入质量自适应设定；SmoothOP 以 prominence 为信号实现这一点，作为通用即插即用模块有效提升开集识别的鲁棒性与准确性。

Abstract: Open Set Recognition (OSR) aims to enable models to accurately classify known classes while rejecting samples from unseen classes. A key challenge in OSR lies in the inability to model the unbounded distribution of unknown classes during training, often leading to the misclassification of samples from these classes. Rather than modeling unknowns, recent work shapes the feature space so that known classes are compact and well separated, and spherical representation learning methods have achieved strong results this way. Label smoothing has been identified as one of the key drivers of this success, yet it applies the same coefficient to every training sample, regardless of how well each sample is already embedded. We show that the spherical representation learning objectives used in OSR share a single alignment--uniformity structure in which labels enter only through the alignment term. Label smoothing therefore acts as an alignment dial, and a fixed coefficient sets this dial to the same value for every sample. We propose a plug-in, SmoothOperator (SmoothOP), which sets the smoothing coefficient of each sample from its \textbf{prominence}, an embedding-space signal measuring how clearly the sample's own class stands out against its strongest competing class. Our method integrates into four existing spherical representation learning methods at minimal training overhead. SmoothOP assigns strong smoothing to samples with high prominence, which reduces their alignment and relaxes their pull. On the Semantic Shift Benchmark, SmoothOP-augmented variants generally outperform their base objectives across datasets, degrees of semantic shift, and OSR post-processors, with gains of up to 4.7\% in AUROC, OSCR, and closed-set accuracy.

</details>


### [48] [Lang3DSeg: Annotation-Free Open-Vocabulary 3D Segmentation with Point Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00855)
*Cigdem Kokenoz,Amir Salarpour,Alkim Domeke,Christopher Salas,Pedram MohajerAnsari,Long Cheng,Mert D. Pesé,Bing Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Lang3DSeg，以点变换器为骨干，实现室外LiDAR无标注开放词汇3D语义分割，从零训练，通过类优先级与深度截断修正投影噪声，在nuScenes与SemanticKITTI上取得无标注方法最优结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 监督式LiDAR分割受限于封闭类别体系与逐点人工标注的高成本；现有开放词汇方法依赖2D视觉语言模型投影并蒸馏到3D网络，但几乎只用体素稀疏卷积，点变换器仅限室内稠密有界场景，室外稀疏LiDAR尚未被覆盖。

Method: 以点变换器作为室外3D LiDAR的骨干，从零训练、不做几何预训练。针对2D到3D标签投影中的噪声（尤其深度歧义导致物体后方点被误赋语义标签），采用显式类优先级规则合成掩码，并在每个投影实例深度分布的首次间隙处截断，直接修正投影误差而非在配准序列上平均。

Result: 在nuScenes验证集上达到52.8% mIoU，在SemanticKITTI上达到41.4%，均为已发表无标注方法中的最高水平。每次3D语义分割基于单帧LiDAR，且推理实时，无需运行视觉语言模型。

Conclusion: 点变换器可有效用于室外LiDAR的开放词汇语义分割，无需几何预训练与人工标注；通过显式投影纠错策略抑制深度歧义噪声，可在保证实时单帧推理的同时实现无标注方法的最佳性能。

Abstract: Accurate 3D semantic perception is critical for safe autonomous navigation. However, supervised LiDAR segmentation remains tied to closed taxonomies and to the cost of point-wise manual annotation. Open-vocabulary methods avoid that cost by projecting the output of 2D vision-language models onto LiDAR and distilling it into a 3D network. These methods rely almost exclusively on voxel-based sparse convolutions, and point transformers have so far been limited to indoor environments, where 3D data is dense and bounded. We present Lang3DSeg, which establishes a point transformer as the backbone for annotation-free open-vocabulary segmentation of outdoor 3D LiDAR, and is trained from scratch without geometric pre-training. This training paradigm necessitates addressing the inherent noise in 2D-to-3D label projections; specifically, naive projection often suffers from depth ambiguity, where points behind an object are erroneously assigned its semantic label. We therefore composite masks using an explicit class-priority rule and truncate each projected instance at the first gap in its depth distribution, correcting the projection error directly rather than averaging it over registered sequences. Lang3DSeg achieves 52.8% mIoU on nuScenes validation and 41.4% on SemanticKITTI, the highest among published annotation-free methods on both benchmarks. Every 3D semantic segmentation is on a single LiDAR sweep, and inference operates in real-time without running vision-language models.

</details>


### [49] [CtrlWAM: Controllable World Action Models with Aligned Intent and Foresight](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00859)
*Chensheng Peng,Wenhao Ding,Ran Tian,Zewei Zhou,Jef Packer,Maximilian Igl,Peter Karkus,Yan Wang,Masayoshi Tomizuka,Boris Ivanovic,Marco Pavone,Yuxiao Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出CtrlWAM，通过在执行扰动动作后用模拟器生成对应的反事实视觉结果，替代传统"扰动动作+加噪真实视频"的配对方式，并引入warped噪声调度与多智能体动作接口，提升世界动作模型的可控性与预测一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准世界动作模型训练对动作和视频同时加噪，导致语义错配：扰动后的动作对应反事实未来视觉，而加噪视频仍绑定于真实录制。在低噪声区间，噪声视频中场景几何与动态行为仍清晰可见，使动作与视觉监督不一致，从而损害动作预测精度、生成视频与动作的一致性以及指令跟随能力。

Method: 1) 在模拟器中执行扰动动作，将其与对应的加噪视觉后果配对，用于联合WAM学习；2) 针对视频与动作不同的去噪需求，设计warped video–action噪声调度，使动作预测演进过程中视觉布局保持可响应；3) 将动作接口从仅自我（ego-only）控制扩展为可变数量的智能体流，使统一模型能表示多智能体的预测未来或指令未来。

Result: 驾驶实验显示：动作预测更准确，生成视频与动作的一致性更高，对给定指令的跟随更好；机器人实验显示运动保真度与可控性更强。匹配对照实验支持离路径渲染（off-path renders）对指令跟随与操作保真度的收益。

Conclusion: 通过以模拟器执行扰动动作产生的反事实视觉替代绑定于真实录制的加噪视频，并配合warped噪声调度与可扩展多智能体动作接口，CtrlWAM实现了更可控的世界动作模型，提升了动作预测、视频-动作一致性与指令跟随性能。

Abstract: World action models (WAMs) jointly predict actions (intent) and visual future (foresight). Standard training adds noise to recorded actions and video simultaneously, but such training paradigms introduce a mismatch: perturbed actions imply counterfactual future visual, while the noised video remains tied to the GT recording. In low-noise regime, the scene geometry and even the dynamic behavior remain clearly visible from the noisy future frames despite the added noise. We present CtrlWAM, which executes perturbed actions in a simulator and pairs them with their noised visual consequences for joint WAM learning. To accommodate the different denoising requirements of video and actions, we introduce warped video--action noise schedules that aim to keep visual layout responsive as action predictions evolve. We further extend the action interface from ego-only control to a variable number of agent streams, allowing a unified model to represent predicted or commanded futures for multiple agents. Driving experiments show more accurate action forecasts, closer agreement between generated video and actions, and better following of supplied commands; robotics experiments show stronger motion fidelity and controllability. Matched controls support the benefit of off-path renders for command following and manipulation fidelity. Together, these findings contribute to a more controllable world action model. Project page: https://ctrl-wam.github.io/

</details>


### [50] [Machine Translation for Sign Languages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00881)
*Ozge Mercanoglu Sincan,Anton Pelykh,Edward Fish,Harry Walsh,JianHe Low,Karahan Sahin,Oline Ranum,Sobhan Asasi,Steven Emery,Richard Bowden*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文综述手语机器翻译领域，梳理从孤立手语识别到端到端翻译系统的演进，分析技术挑战与伦理考量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 手语机器翻译近十年取得显著进展，但数据集规模有限、评价指标难以捕捉语言质量、模型需处理手语的同时性、多层性和三维结构等挑战依然存在，亟需兼顾技术难题与利益相关者诉求的系统性总结。

Method: 采用跨学科综述方法，结合计算机视觉、手语语言学和聋人研究视角：剖析手语在计算上的独特语言属性，追溯识别、翻译与生成系统的演进脉络，分析持续存在的技术挑战，并探讨数据治理、社区参与和合理使用等伦理议题。

Result: 综述指出手语机器翻译的进展由姿态估计、Transformer 架构和大规模数据集采集驱动，但受限于资源规模、评价指标的语言学效度不足，以及手语三维同时性结构的建模困难；同时揭示伦理与数据治理问题尚未得到充分重视。

Conclusion: 手语机器翻译的持续进步需要计算机视觉、手语语言学与聋人研究等领域的长期协作，并与聋人社群共同开展。

Abstract: Sign language machine translation has progressed substantially over the past decade, evolving from isolated sign recognition to end-to-end translation systems. Advances in pose estimation, transformer architectures, and large-scale dataset collection have driven progress, yet challenges remain. Datasets are limited compared to spoken-language resources; evaluation metrics inadequately capture the linguistic quality of output; and models must capture the simultaneous, multi-layered, and three-dimensional structure of sign languages. This manuscript provides a comprehensive review that seeks to balance technical challenges with stakeholder considerations. We examine the linguistic properties that make sign languages computationally unique, trace the evolution of recognition, translation, and production systems, and analyze ongoing technical challenges. Crucially, we address ethical considerations around data governance, community involvement, and appropriate use. Drawing on interdisciplinary perspectives spanning computer vision, sign language linguistics, and deaf studies, our analysis emphasizes that continued progress requires sustained collaboration across these fields and with deaf communities.

</details>


### [51] [EyeTAG: Eye Trajectory-Aware Gaze Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00922)
*Jungmin Lee,Niamat Ullah,Yoseob Han*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出EyeTAG，一种因果多帧视线估计框架，引入显式一阶视线轨迹先验作为运动学token，在Gaze360上平均角度误差降低约1.0°，在EVE上与最强基线持平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自然头眼运动下的视线估计存在帧间抖动问题：单帧方法逐帧独立预测导致输出波动，多帧方法虽能缓解但隐式学习运动，视线轨迹从未作为显式变量被建模。

Method: EyeTAG采用因果多帧框架，核心是显式一阶视线先验：每步对自身近期预测做差分，得到紧凑的运动学token并反馈。由于差分在视线空间中具有平移不变性，该token携带与受试者无关的运动信息而非个人视线偏置。人脸流与眼部流提供视觉证据，经交叉注意力融合并由因果Transformer解码器处理。

Result: 在Gaze360上平均角度误差降低约1.0°；在EVE上与最强基线持平（2.56° vs. 2.58°）。模型内消融实验（固定编码器与其余架构，仅改变视线历史）表明，差分公式而非单纯时间上下文，消除了即使使用绝对视线历史先验仍存在的系统性扫视偏置。

Conclusion: 显式建模视线轨迹的一阶差分优于隐式运动学习，证明了差分表述在消除扫视偏置上的有效性，为多帧视线估计提供了新思路。

Abstract: Gaze estimation under natural head-eye motion underpins applications from driver monitoring to human-computer interaction. Single-frame methods predict each frame independently, so consecutive outputs fluctuate as jitter. Multi-frame methods reduce this, but they learn motion implicitly inside appearance features, so the gaze trajectory is never an explicit variable. We propose EyeTAG (Eye Trajectory-Aware Gaze Estimation), a causal multi-frame framework built around an explicit first-order gaze prior: at each step it differentiates its own recent predictions and feeds the resulting trajectory back as a compact kinematic token. Because differencing is translation-invariant in gaze space, this token carries subject-invariant motion rather than personal gaze offsets. Face and eye streams supply visual evidence, fused by cross-attention and a causal Transformer decoder. EyeTAG reduces the mean angular error by about 1.0$^\circ$ on Gaze360 and performs on par with the strongest baseline on EVE (2.56$^\circ$ vs. 2.58$^\circ$). Within-model ablations, which keep the encoder and the rest of the architecture fixed and vary only the gaze history, show that the differential formulation, rather than temporal context alone, removes the systematic saccade bias that persists even with an absolute gaze-history prior. Our code is available at https://github.com/peter8366/EyeTAG.

</details>


### [52] [Joint Branch-Space Transform Coding for Diffusion Activation Quantization with Classifier-Free Guidance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00930)
*Mingrun Jiang,Yuejia Liu,Zishan Shao,Ting Jiang,Qinsi Wang,Hancheng Ye,Yixiao Wang,Rui-Feng Wang,Kangning Cui,Yixuan Chen,Fan Yang,Xiang Cheng,Hai Li,Yiran Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文揭示匹配的CFG激活构成强相关的二维源，提出分支空间变换编码及闭式解GCBT，在等比特预算下提升扩散模型PTQ保真度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有扩散模型后训练量化虽已利用时间步、特征和层结构，并开始引入CFG结构，但激活量化仍在条件与无条件坐标上独立进行，跨激活结构未被利用。作者发现匹配的CFG激活具有强相关的二维结构，且分支编码基的选择在固定比特预算下显著影响量化保真度。

Method: 提出分支空间变换编码：通过离线推导的2x2正交矩阵旋转匹配的CFG分支，对模型参数与量化流程改动极小。进一步推导GCBT，联合利用CFG引导方向与跨分支二阶矩；在等速率量化噪声代理下，GCBT具有逐层闭式解，无需梯度优化或角度搜索。

Result: 将GCBT叠加于现有扩散PTQ方法之上，在多数评估比较中获得统计显著的保真度提升，且没有统计显著的性能下降，同时不改变底层宿主量化流程。

Conclusion: 跨CFG激活结构是扩散模型PTQ中被忽视但有效的自由度；分支空间变换以极小改动和闭式解实现量化保真度提升，可作为即插即用模块兼容现有量化流程。

Abstract: Post-training quantization for diffusion models increasingly exploits timestep, feature, and layer structure. <details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前馈3D视觉模型（如VGGT）存在二次全局注意力导致长序列代价高的问题，而现有稀疏方法偏向高注意力但值冗余的区域，造成计算浪费与信息损失。

Method: VASC 为免训练稀疏注意力方法，包含两部分：1）值感知块选择，将池化后的查询-键相关性（pooled query-key relevance）与邻域值对比度（neighboring value contrast）结合，在减少冗余的同时保留与查询相关且具区分度的内容；2）执行感知跨层记忆，追踪跨层未被服务的需求，并依据实际执行情况更新状态，使此前未被充分服务的块在固定计算预算下获得竞争机会。

Result: 在 7Scenes 与 NeuralRGB-D 数据集上，结合 VGGT 与 π³ 的实验中，VASC 相比 FasterVGGT 提升了位姿估计与重建质量，推理速度较稠密 VGGT 最高加速 2.29×。

Conclusion: VASC 在不需训练的前提下，通过值感知与跨层记忆机制有效缓解了稀疏注意力的冗余与需求分配不均问题，兼顾精度与效率，为长序列前馈3D视觉提供可行方案。

Abstract: Feed-forward 3D vision models such as VGGT have achieved remarkable progress, unifying camera estimation and dense scene reconstruction in a single pass. However, their quadratic global attention makes long image sequences expensive, while existing sparse methods may favor highly attended yet value-redundant regions.
