Experiments on SafeWatch-Bench and XD-Violence show that ATPO substantially improves multi-label performance, increasing the Jaccard Index from 40.66 to 75.44 on SafeWatch-Bench-Real. Moreover, ATR enables reliable steering of the precision-recall operating point, supporting deployment scenarios with heterogeneous policy requirements. Code and checkpoints are provided at https://bruceyg.github.io/ATPO-project-page/ .

</details>


### [268] [Old Ideas, Novel Problems: The Instability of LLM-Based Novelty Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02022)
*Noy Sternlicht,Simra Shahid,Peter Jansen,Daniel S. Weld,Pao Siangliulue,Tom Hope*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究系统考察了LLM新颖性评审器的设计选择，发现微小提示改动即可导致成对准确率波动超50个百分点，且现有专用评审器表现不及简单的提示基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动化创意生成系统常以LLM评判其想法的新颖性，但这类评审器多为临时搭建，且仅用人类论文（而非其实际要打分的目标生成想法）进行验证，因此其可靠性存疑，作者据此提出"新颖性评审器表现究竟如何"这一问题。

Method: 构建受控实验评测集：自动从OpenReview挖掘评审者明确肯定或质疑论文原创性的段落，仅保留在其研究领域两端获得一致同意（极端一致）的投稿，并将其与朴素LLM生成器的想法配对；随后在六种评审器上系统比较提示设计、检索、推理预算等设计选择。

Result: 小的提示设计差异影响巨大：仅告知评审器"评审者认为其中一个想法新颖、另一个不新颖"，就能改变其对超过一半相同想法对的判断，使成对准确率波动超过50个百分点，有时甚至低于随机水平；同一改动对不同评审器效果相反；检索与更大推理预算帮助有限；两种专门构建的新颖性评估器被最廉价的提示基线超越。

Conclusion: 结果对自动化创意系统所报告的新颖性提升提出质疑，并呼吁建立更稳健的新颖性评估方法。

Abstract: Automated ideation systems are often evaluated on the novelty of the ideas they produce, and that judgment is increasingly delegated to large language models. Such judges are typically built ad hoc and validated, if at all, on human-authored papers rather than on the generated ideas they are meant to score. So, how do novelty judges perform?
  Not well. We present a systematic controlled study of novelty evaluation design choices. We first build an evaluation set automatically, mining OpenReview for passages where reviewers explicitly affirm or dispute a paper's originality and keeping only submissions with unanimous agreement at the extremes of their research area; we pair these with ideas from a vanilla LLM generator. Across six judges, we find that small prompt design choices have large consequences; e.g., simply telling the judge that reviewers found one idea novel and the other not can change its verdict on more than half of the identical idea pairs it is shown, shifting pairwise accuracy by over 50 points and occasionally pushing it below chance. The same change helps one judge and hurts another. Retrieval and larger reasoning budgets help little, and two purpose-built novelty evaluators are outperformed by our cheapest prompted baseline. These results raise questions about reported novelty gains of automated ideation systems, and call for robust novelty evaluation methods.

</details>


### [269] [Typological Alignment of Stack-Based Language Models on Mildly Context-Sensitive Artificial Languages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02040)
*Nadine El-Naggar,Tatsuki Kuribayashi,Ted Briscoe*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文在数据与模型两侧拓展了LM学习偏置与语言类型学共性关系的分析，聚焦交叉序列依存与栈式语言模型，发现SLM难以习得交叉序列依存，但受限工作记忆可提升泛化，为词序共性的归纳偏置提供依据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自然语言中SOV等语序远比其他语序常见，这种类型学共性常被归因于学习偏置；近期语言模型被用于检验该假说，但已有分析尚未覆盖交叉序列依存（已证句法复杂度的上限）以及可能更利于层级结构学习的栈式语言模型。

Method: 在数据侧引入交叉序列依存这一句法复杂度上界构造；在模型侧采用具有栈结构的语言模型（SLM）作为被试；在多种人工语言上评估SLM对交叉序列依赖结构的泛化能力，并进一步操纵其工作记忆容量进行对比。

Result: SLM在各类人工语言上均难以泛化到交叉序列依存结构；但工作记忆受限的SLM泛化表现更好。

Conclusion: 工作记忆受限带来的归纳偏置可能是交叉序列依存结构稀有、某些词序配置具有类型学共性的成因之一，支持学习偏置解释语言类型学共性的理论。

Abstract: Some properties of languages, e.g., subject-object-verb (SOV) word order, are more prevalent than others among the thousands of attested natural languages (NLs). Such typological commonality is often attributed to learning biases. Computational simulations, recently with language models (LMs), have facilitated the exploration of this theory. In this paper, we extend existing analyses of the relationship between LMs' learning biases and typological commonality on both data and model sides, focusing on: (i) cross-serial dependencies, the upper limit of attested syntactic complexity, and (ii) stack-based LMs (SLMs), potentially facilitating learning of hierarchical patterns. We first evaluate generalization of SLMs on cross-serial dependencies across diverse artificial languages and confirm that they struggle with such constructions. However, SLMs with limited working memory generalize better suggesting a possible basis for such inductive bias and thus the typological commonality of some word order configurations.

</details>


### [270] [LLM2Jev: LLMs Are Already Jev-Style Decision Models -- When and How to Fine-Tune Them](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02076)
*Yinheng Li,Justin Wagle*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: LLM2Jev框架从LLM下一token概率中直接提取校准的类别决策，发现无需训练即可达到Jev式决策模型水平，微调仅在弱模型和特定任务上有增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Jev式决策模型输出预设选项上的类别概率分布而非自由文本，便于软件系统直接使用。作者想探究通用LLM是否开箱即具备该能力，以及何时真正需要微调。

Method: 提出LLM2Jev保持架构不变的框架：从方括号数字标识符上的下一token概率直接提取校准决策，提供免训练推理方案，以及微调目标——通过树因子化listwise损失优化候选选择，并用KL散度惩罚将辅助预测锚定到基础模型以避免行为退化。

Result: 在Qwen3.5-4B和Qwen3-0.6B上评估：无需训练时4B模型即匹配同骨干的社区Jev式模型，优于letter-logit读出，支持任意选项数并原生处理图像多模态决策。微调收益是定向的而非普适的——显著提升弱模型和特定任务（如多选项意图路由），但对强骨干收益递减。LoRA在强模型上表现最佳。

Conclusion: 现代LLM本身已是有效的决策模型；KL锚点可防止对话文本生成的行为退化，微调应视模型强度与任务需求选择性使用。

Abstract: Jev-style decision models return categorical probability distributions over predefined options without generating free-form text, enabling software systems to act on their outputs directly. In this work, we investigate the extent to which general-purpose LLMs already possess this capability out of the box, and when fine-tuning is actually necessary. We present LLM2Jev, an architecture-preserving framework that extracts calibrated decisions directly from next-token probabilities over bracketed numeric identifiers. LLM2Jev provides both a training-free inference recipe and a fine-tuning objective that optimizes candidate selection via a tree-factorized listwise loss while anchoring auxiliary predictions to the base model using KL divergence penalties. Evaluating on Qwen3.5-4B and Qwen3-0.6B, we find that modern LLMs are inherently effective decision models: without training, the 4B model matches community Jev-style models built on the same backbone, outperforms letter-logit readouts, supports arbitrary option counts, and natively handles multimodal decisions over images. Fine-tuning provides targeted rather than universal benefits -- substantially improving weaker models and specific tasks (such as many-option intent routing), but offering diminishing returns for strong backbones. Crucially, our KL anchors prevent behavioral degradation in conversational text generation, with LoRA delivering the strongest performance on capable models.

</details>


### [271] [Scalable, Transferable Meta-network for Data Selection Requires a Different Loss (and Why the Obvious Choice is Problematic)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02092)
*Zilin Du,Bowen Yang,Boyang Albert Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出TESS框架，用点式价值匹配（PVM）目标替代逐样本权重，实现可迁移的LLM训练数据选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模异构语料上训练LLM时，数据选择至关重要。元学习式训练数据选择（MTS）虽比启发式打分更有原则，但现有方法在细粒度估值与对未见数据的可迁移性之间存在权衡；用选择网络替代逐样本权重时，直接套用现有MTS目标会导致权重抑制和对易学特征的持续依赖，从而优化不稳定、泛化差。

Method: 提出TESS（Transferable Example Scoring and Selection），一个可扩展的数据选择框架，核心是点式价值匹配目标（Pointwise Value Matching, PVM），用以训练可迁移的选择网络，取代逐样本权重。

Result: 在LLM安全性和定向指令微调任务上，表现出强迁移性：从子集到全语料、从较小模型到较大模型均能有效迁移。

Conclusion: TESS通过PVM目标缓解了权重抑制与易学特征依赖问题，为跨数据集、跨规模的数据选择提供了可扩展且可迁移的解决方案。

Abstract: Data selection is critical for training large language models on massive and heterogeneous corpora. Meta-learning for Training-data Selection offers a principled alternative to heuristic scoring by learning data weights from a target validation objective, but existing methods face a trade-off between fine-grained valuation and transferability to unseen data. A natural solution is to replace per-sample weights with a selection network. However, we find that directly incorporating such a network into existing MTS objectives leads to unstable optimization and poor generalization, caused by weight suppression and persistent reliance on easy-to-learn features. To address these issues, we propose Transferable Example Scoring and Selection (TESS), a scalable data-selection framework built on a Pointwise Value Matching objective (PVM). Experiments on LLM safety and targeted instruction tuning demonstrate strong transfer across datasets, from subsets to full corpora, and from smaller to larger models.

</details>


### [272] [Argo-Bench: Evaluating Data Agents on Enterprise-Scale Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02122)
*Gabriel Tomitsuka,Arman Raayatsanati,Emma Xing,Duke Gand,Joseph J Ma*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Argo-Bench是一个面向企业级数据科学与分析工作流的评测框架，包含210个任务，模拟纽约市外卖平台并导出235张表、75亿行的ERP数据仓库，要求智能体在仓库中重建事实后再执行动作，且由模拟器后果评分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实企业数据科学工作流需要在数十张表间推理、做统计分析并据结果行动，但既有text-to-SQL基准只评测查询生成，且答案键常被审计发现错误；同时真实企业仓库过于敏感无法公开，公开数据集又多为单表业务事件，难以刻画真实环境。

Method: 构建Argo-Bench评测框架，含210个数据科学与分析任务。基于公开数据、同行评议行业文献与监管申报文件，模拟纽约市外卖平台（2024年8100万订单，含经济学设定、欺诈模式与市场激励机制），并导出为仿Oracle E-Business Suite模式的ERP仓库（235张表、75亿行）。模拟器真值状态对智能体可见仓库隐藏，任务需先导航仓库重建事实再行动；评分依据智能体在模拟器中动作（如封禁欺诈账户、分配骑手激励预算、补发工资）的后果。每个任务均有可执行参考解，证明仅用仓库即可求解。

Result: 在14个前沿与开源权重模型中，最强模型仅在34.8%的任务上达到95分及以上，平均得分59.5分。

Conclusion: Argo-Bench超越text-to-SQL，推动面向能理解、导航并在真实数据环境中行动的智能体的研究进展。

Abstract: Real-world enterprise data science and analytics workflows require reasoning across dozens of tables, performing statistical analyses, and acting on the results. Established text-to-SQL benchmarks evaluate query generation alone, and audits have found their answer keys frequently wrong. Because real enterprise warehouses are too sensitive to release, these benchmarks are built on public datasets where a business event fits in a single table. We introduce Argo-Bench, an evaluation framework comprising 210 data science and analytics tasks. Drawing on public data, peer-reviewed industry literature, and regulatory filings, we simulate a food delivery platform in New York City at true scale, with 81 million orders in 2024, grounded economics, fraud patterns, and marketplace incentives. We export this world to an ERP warehouse of 235 tables and 7.5 billion rows, modeled on the Oracle E-Business Suite schema. The simulator's ground-truth state is withheld from the warehouse the agent sees, so tasks require reconstructing facts by navigating the warehouse before acting on them. Argo-Bench goes beyond text-to-SQL: the agent files actions such as banning fraudulent accounts, allocating courier incentive budgets, or issuing back pay, and the grader scores each by its consequences in the simulator. Every task has an executable reference solution that demonstrates solvability using only the warehouse. The strongest of 14 frontier and open-weight models scores 95 or higher on only 34.8% of tasks and averages 59.5 points. We hope Argo-Bench drives progress toward agents that understand, navigate, and act within real data environments.

</details>


### [273] [Keyword Harnesses Fail Open: A Cheap Diagnostic Ladder for Tool-Use Claims in Small Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02142)
*Juan S. Santillana*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文记录了关键词匹配式工具使用评测中的假阳性现象：一个在宽松指标上与600M模型几乎持平的1B模型实际上从不发出有效工具调用，并提出了低成本的严格诊断梯与针对性SFT修复方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工具使用基准多基于关键词匹配，可能给小模型"记功"，使其获得其从未真正执行的工具使用能力评分。作者希望用一个受控架构对（同一解码器、分词器、特殊token的西班牙语安全模型）揭示这种假阳性，并提供可落地的严格诊断手段。

Method: 1) 匹配架构对照：661.6M模型（约65%代码/技术文本，无专门SFT）与1,109M模型（网页为主的多阶段课程，含6B token工具SFT），二者在宽松工具使用指标上得分接近（B4：0.660 vs 0.650）。2) 逐字复现检查：在训练样本上检验是否发出有效工具调用。3) 首token探针：定位失败原因为<|tool_call|>先验概率缺失（10^-4–10^-5），系网页为主训练阶段抹除。4) 针对性SFT修复：多样化语料、5倍学习率、2,202步、约3.3 GPU小时，token量比失败阶段少三个数量级。5) 嵌入漂移检查：验证触发token绑定嵌入未变动。6) 因子分析检验各修复配置。

Result: 逐字复现检查完全区分两模型：600M在6/6样本上发出带泛化参数的有效工具调用，1B在所有检查点上为0/6。修复后1B在全269行语料上有效发出率由0.100升至0.959（600M为0.926）；在238条未见提示上修复1B通过率0.536，优于600M的0.428（p=0.004）。嵌入漂移检查显示触发token的绑定嵌入未被改动（97.7%的bf16表逐位相同），说明变化发生在周边网络。两模型均过度触发，很少在无调用情况下回答否定提示（600M为0.09，修复后1B为0.17）。因子分析确认所有修复配置均能安装该格式，但多样化语料对抑制过度调用的收益因种子敏感性仍属假设。

Conclusion: 关键词匹配基准会使小模型获得虚假的工具使用得分；作者提出的严格、廉价诊断梯（逐字复现、首token探针、嵌入漂移检查等）仅需数分钟CPU时间，应作为小模型工具使用声明的把关机制。针对性的小规模SFT即可用少三个数量级的token修复格式缺失，且修复改变的是周边网络而非触发token嵌入。

Abstract: Keyword-matching benchmarks can credit small models for tool use they never perform. We document such a false positive in a matched-architecture pair of Spanish security language models and propose a ladder of strict, cheap diagnostics. A 661.6M parameter model (approx. 65% code/technical text; no dedicated SFT) and a 1,109M model (web-heavy multi-phase curriculum; 6B-token tool-SFT) share decoder, tokenizer, and special tokens, scoring almost identically on lenient tool-use metrics (B4: 0.660 vs. 0.650).
  Verbatim-reproduction checks on training examples separate them completely: the 600M emits valid tool calls with generalized arguments on 6/6 examples; the 1B does so on 0/6 across checkpoints. A first-token probe localizes the 1B's failure to a missing prior (prob. $10^{-4}$--$10^{-5}$ on <|tool_call|>), which was erased by its web-heavy training phase. A targeted SFT recipe (diverse corpus, 5x higher learning rate, 2,202 steps, ~3.3 GPU-hours) repairs the 1B using three orders of magnitude fewer tokens than the failed phase. On all 269 corpus rows, valid emission rises from 0.100 to 0.959 (600M: 0.926). On 238 unseen prompts, the repaired 1B passes 0.536 vs. the 600M's 0.428 ($p = 0.004$). Embedding-drift checks show the repair did not move the trigger token's tied embedding (97.7% of the bf16 table remains bit-identical), meaning changes live in the surrounding network.
  Both models over-trigger, rarely answering negative prompts without a call (0.09 for 600M, 0.17 for repaired 1B). Factorial analyses confirm all repair configurations install the format, though suppression benefits from a diverse corpus remain a hypothesis due to seed sensitivity. This cheap diagnostic ladder costs minutes of CPU time and should gate tool-use claims on small models.

</details>


### [274] [From Knowledge Access to Source Learning: Developing Source-Specific Competence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02150)
*Lucheng Fu,Kejing Xia,Yiyang Wang,Yiqiao Jin,Jinjin He,Xiyuan Yang,Haoxin Liu,Ye Yu,Haibo Jin,Yijia Xiao,Wenke Lee,B. Aditya Prakash,Haohan Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出“源学习”（source learning）范式，将持久权威来源的重复使用转化为渐进式理解提升，并用 SourceLearn 构建可复用、持续精炼的源模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法侧重改进源内容的访问与组织，或通过代理记忆保留交互中的可复用知识，但对同一来源的重复使用仍主要被视为重复访问，而非逐步深化对该来源理解的机会。

Method: 提出 SourceLearn，包含两种互补机制：自导向源学习（识别尚未充分理解之处并自适应重访来源）与任务导向源学习（利用下游经验揭示局部表征缺口及知识组织的反复需求）；学习信号决定重新审视的内容，持久更新则从权威来源重建。

Result: 在五个基准、三个 LLM 后端上，SourceLearn 在 15 个设置中的 13 个取得最佳性能，相较 Hybrid RAG 最高提升 22.6 分，并较静态源表征与基于经验的记忆基线有显著整体提升。

Conclusion: 面向持久权威来源的源学习可形成可复用的源专属能力，通过自导向与任务导向双机制持续精炼源模型，在多项基准上验证了其有效性与泛化性。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on persistent external sources to solve sequences of knowledge-intensive tasks. Existing methods improve how source content is accessed and organized, while agent-memory systems preserve reusable knowledge from prior interactions, but repeated use of the same source is still largely treated as repeated access rather than an opportunity to progressively improve understanding of that source. We study source learning: developing reusable source-specific competence over a persistent authoritative source. We represent this competence with a persistent source model that captures reusable understanding of the source, including how its knowledge is structured, interpreted, and applied. To construct and progressively refine such models, we propose SourceLearn, which combines two complementary learning mechanisms. Self-Directed Source Learning identifies what remains incompletely understood and adaptively revisits the source, while Task-Guided Source Learning uses downstream experience to reveal local representational gaps and recurring needs in how source knowledge should be organized. In both cases, learning signals determine what should be reconsidered, while persistent updates are reconstructed from the authoritative source. Across five benchmarks and three LLM backends, SourceLearn achieves the best performance in 13 of 15 settings, with gains of up to 22.6 points over Hybrid RAG and substantial overall improvements over static source representations and experience-based memory baselines.

</details>


### [275] [AutoCompact: Learning When to Compact Context in Long-Horizon Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02163)
*Xuan Zhang,Longtao Zheng,Cunxiao Du,Bo An,Xin Dong*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: AutoCompact 训练编码智能体将上下文压缩决策（何时压缩、保留何种工作状态、如何续接）纳入策略本身，通过裁判修正数据+SFT+RL 联合优化，在 SWE-bench Verified 与 SWE-PolyBench Verified 上分别绝对提升 9.2% 和 5.0%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仓库级软件工程任务涉及长时间的代码检查、搜索、编辑与测试轨迹，早期探索信息会随任务推进而过时。此时管理上下文不仅是避免窗口溢出，更关键的是智能体需自主判断何时压缩、保留哪些工作状态、以及如何从压缩后状态继续，而现有方法缺乏对这种决策能力的训练。

Method: 1) 用基础智能体在编码任务上运行，收集轨迹；2) 由裁判（judge）审查其压缩决策、摘要及压缩后的动作，将有缺陷的输出替换为修正版本后再在环境中执行，使每条轨迹从修正后的决策继续；3) 用这些轨迹做监督微调（SFT）；4) 再通过以任务成功为奖励的强化学习联合优化编码与压缩能力。

Result: 在 SWE-bench Verified 和 SWE-PolyBench Verified 上，AutoCompact 相比基线模型的通过率分别绝对提升 9.2% 和 5.0%。提升在所有评估的推理预算下均保持稳定，包括 256K 上下文窗口（从不溢出）以及 16K 窗口（溢出时触发回退式压缩）。

Conclusion: 将上下文压缩决策作为智能体策略的组成部分进行训练是有效的，可显著提升仓库级编码任务的成功率，且在宽松与受限上下文预算下均具鲁棒性。

Abstract: Coding agents solve repository-level software engineering tasks through long trajectories of code inspection, search, editing, and testing. As a task progresses, earlier exploration becomes stale, so managing context is more than avoiding overflow: an agent must decide when to compact, what working state to preserve, and how to continue from it. We introduce AutoCompact, which trains a coding agent to make these decisions as part of its policy. To collect training data, we run the base agent on coding tasks and use a judge to review its compaction decisions, summaries, and actions after compaction. Flawed outputs are replaced with corrected ones before being executed in the environment, so each trajectory continues from the corrected decisions. We use these trajectories for supervised fine-tuning, then jointly optimize coding and compaction through reinforcement learning with task-success rewards. Experiments on SWE-bench Verified and SWE-PolyBench Verified show that AutoCompact improves pass rates over the base model by an absolute 9.2\% and 5.0\%, respectively. The improvements hold across all evaluated inference budgets, with a 256K context window that never overflows and with a 16K window whose overflow triggers fallback compaction.

</details>


### [276] [Hierarchical Continuous Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02193)
*Hui Ren,Zihan Li,Chang Liu,Huidong Liu,Alexander Schwing*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出分层连续扩散语言模型（HC-DLM），将离散词元生成与连续隐变量轨迹耦合于统一去噪过程，训练目标源自词元似然的变分下界，在结构化推理、数学规划与语言建模上优于离散及连续扩散基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离散扩散语言模型并行解码时各词元从边缘分布独立采样，破坏了同批解码词元间的统计依赖；连续扩散语言模型虽通过共享连续状态去噪保留依赖，但其去噪器仅见到该状态，在最终解码前与合法词元配置缺乏约束。因此需要一种兼顾两者优势的方案。

Method: HC-DLM 在单一、有原则的去噪过程中耦合离散词元生成与连续隐变量轨迹，训练目标由词元似然的变分下界推导得到。与将连续上下文附加到自包含离散链的近期方法不同，HC-DLM 令隐变量成为唯一持久的生成状态：每一步从隐变量读出词元，并将其作为下一轮隐变量更新的脚手架反馈回去，形成分层结构。

Result: 在结构化推理（Sudoku）、数学规划（Countdown）和语言建模（LM1B）任务上，在匹配模型规模条件下，HC-DLM 在 Sudoku 与 Countdown 的谜题准确率以及 LM1B 的生成困惑度上均优于离散扩散与连续扩散基线。

Conclusion: 将连续隐变量作为唯一持久生成状态、并让离散词元与其双向交互的分层去噪设计，可有效弥合离散并行解码的独立性缺陷与连续扩散缺乏词元合法性约束的不足，在推理、规划与语言建模多类任务上取得一致提升。

Abstract: Discrete diffusion language models offer a compelling alternative to autoregressive generation for tasks demanding bidirectional reasoning and global constraint satisfaction. Yet they share a structural bottleneck: when decoding in parallel, each token is sampled independently from its marginal, severing the statistical dependencies among the tokens decoded together. Continuous diffusion language models avoid this by denoising a shared continuous state, but their denoiser sees only that state, so nothing ties it to a valid token configuration until it is finally decoded. To address this, we propose Hierarchical Continuous Diffusion Language Models (HC-DLM), which couple discrete token generation with a continuous latent trajectory in a single, principled denoising process, whose training objective is derived from a variational bound on the token likelihood. In contrast to recent methods that attach continuous context to a self-contained discrete chain, HC-DLM makes the latent the only persistent generative state: tokens are read out from it at every step and feed back as a scaffold for the next latent update. On structured reasoning (Sudoku), mathematical planning (Countdown) and language modeling (LM1B), HC-DLM improves over discrete and continuous diffusion baselines at matched model size, in puzzle accuracy on Sudoku and Countdown and in generative perplexity on LM1B. Project page: https://hc-dlm.github.io/.

</details>


<div id='cs.RO'></div>

# cs.RO [[Back]](#toc)

### [277] [Bounded-Fidelity Sim-as-Demo-Stage: Mocap Handoff for Governance Benchmarks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00008)
*Xue Qin,Simin Luan,Cong Yang,Zhijun Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出"有界保真度的 sim-as-demo-stage"设计模式：在明确界定的交接包络内抑制接触物理、其余处保留完整动力学，使 LLM 驱动机器人治理基准的审计链在重放间实现字节级一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Sim-to-real 研究以物理保真度为首要目标，但在 LLM 驱动机器人的治理基准测试中，接触保真度反而成为负担：物体交接（抓取、搬运、放置）处的接触力积分噪声会引入与待测治理属性结构性无关的审计链分歧，干扰基准判定。

Method: 采用 MuJoCo 的 mocap-body 原语，由 220 行 Python 适配器驱动，治理桥通过结构化 intent 调用；在显式界定的交接包络内抑制接触物理，包络外保留完整动力学。将审计链稳定性形式化为哈希事件日志跨重放的字节相等，并给出两个蕴含该性质的包络结构性条件。实验包括：每姿态 N=1000 次重放对比 mocap 变体与接触力基线；1/2/5/10 ms 时间步扫描；包络边缘时序抖动（±10 仿真步，1400 次重放）；K∈{1,2,3} 顺序交接物体（1500 次重放）。

Result: mocap 变体每姿态产生 1 个唯一审计链哈希（1000/1000 字节一致，Wilson 95% CI [0.997, 1.000]）；接触力基线产生 584 个唯一哈希（993/1000 分歧，CI [0.987, 0.998]）。时间步扫描显示分歧率在 1/2/5/10 ms 均为 0.985，表明属结构性问题而非调参产物。包络边缘时序抖动产生 0 分歧；K∈{1,2,3} 顺序交接时审计链保持字节相等，且每次抓放开销呈次线性增长。

Conclusion: 该设计模式以近乎零的工程成本为基准设计者提供审计链可复现性；作者同时界定了其不适用场景（sim-to-real 验证、策略训练、接触丰富任务），以避免误用。

Abstract: Sim-to-real research pursues physics fidelity as a primary objective: simulators are judged by how closely they reproduce real-world contact dynamics. For governance benchmarking of LLM-driven robots, where the simulator demonstrates that an admission/policy/contract/audit pipeline behaves correctly, contact fidelity at object handoffs (grasp, carry, place) becomes a liability: contact-force integration noise injects audit-chain divergence that is structurally unrelated to the governance property under test. We propose bounded-fidelity sim-as-demo-stage, a design pattern that suppresses contact physics within explicitly bracketed handoff envelopes while preserving full dynamics elsewhere. The construction uses MuJoCo's mocap-body primitive driven by a 220-line Python adapter that the governance bridge invokes via structured intents. We formalise audit-chain stability as byte-equality of the hashed event log across replays and identify two structural envelope properties that imply it. Across N=1000 replays per posture, the mocap variant produces one distinct audit-chain hash (1000/1000 byte-identical; Wilson 95% CI [0.997, 1.000]); the contact-force baseline produces 584 distinct hashes (993/1000 diverged; CI [0.987, 0.998]). A timestep sweep (1, 2, 5, 10 ms) shows the divergence is structural, not a tuning artefact: it stays at 0.985 at every timestep. Envelope-edge timing jitter (+/-10 simulation steps, 1,400 replays) produces 0 divergence, and audit chains remain byte-equal across K in {1, 2, 3} sequentially handed-off objects (1,500 replays) with sub-linear per-pick-and-place overhead. The pattern gives benchmark designers audit-chain reproducibility at near-zero engineering cost; we also map where it is harmful (sim-to-real validation, policy training, contact-rich tasks) so it is not mis-deployed.

</details>


### [278] [Multi-Reference Path Tracking Control for an Agricultural Tractor with Nonlinear Model Predictive Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00057)
*Marcel Moll,Timo Oksanen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本研究提出一种基于非线性模型预测控制（NMPC）的拖拉机路径跟踪控制器，将分段线性参考路径的多段直接纳入目标函数，并给出可行参考段选取方法，经田间试验验证跟踪精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 引导拖拉机沿预定参考路径行驶是精准农业的关键环节。传统路径跟踪方法在处理分段线性路径时，难以兼顾多段路径信息与转向控制优化，因此需要一个能够直接利用分段路径的控制器。

Method: 构建基于非线性模型预测控制（NMPC）的路径跟踪控制器，在其目标函数中直接嵌入分段线性参考路径的多段信息；同时提出从完整路径中筛选可行参考段的方法。通过拖拉机实施管理（TIM）转向接口进行田间试验，对控制系统进行评估。

Result: NMPC求解器平均在3.45 ms内收敛；在曲线参考路径上的平均绝对横向跟踪误差为6.1 cm。

Conclusion: 该NMPC路径跟踪控制器能够快速收敛并实现厘米级横向跟踪精度，适用于精准农业中拖拉机的沿预定路径导航。

Abstract: Guiding a tractor along a predefined reference path is a key component of precision agriculture. This study develops a path tracking controller based on Nonlinear Model Predictive Control, which incorporates multiple segments of a piecewise-linear reference path directly into the objective function. In addition, methods for selecting viable reference segments from the full path are presented. The control system is evaluated during a field test with a tractor controlled via the Tractor Implement Management steering interface. The NMPC solver converged on average after 3.45 ms and tracked the curved reference path with a mean absolute cross-track error of 6.1 cm.

</details>


### [279] [Probabilistic Plan Legibility with Off-the-shelf Planners](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00065)
*Michele Persiani,Thomas Hellström*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出面向任意PDDL领域的可读性规划方法，通过二阶心智理论估计观察者视角，无需定制规划器即可将可读性扩展到经典规划，并给出权衡可读性与效率的基准结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可读性规划旨在让观察者从多个候选目标中辨认出规划的真实目标，但以往可读性研究难以直接应用于经典规划，且通常需要构建专用规划器。作者希望在任意PDDL领域中以通用方式实现可读性规划，并将其用于人机协作场景中的隐式目标沟通。

Method: 在经典规划框架下扩展既有可读性研究，面向任意PDDL领域生成可读性规划，不依赖临时定制的规划器；同时通过连接规划者与观察者任务空间的二阶心智理论来估计观察者视角；引入正则化因子以平衡可读性与效率。

Result: 在若干PDDL规划领域上进行基准测试，结果表明可读性与规划效率通常存在权衡关系；不同规划领域提升可读性的方式并不一致，且经验证正则化因子对于平衡可读性与效率是必要的。

Conclusion: 该工作将可读性规划推广到任意PDDL经典规划领域，并借助二阶心智理论建模观察者视角，验证了可读性与效率之间的权衡及正则化因子的必要性，可应用于人机团队中机器人通过可读性规划隐式传达目标。

Abstract: Legible planning is the creation of plans that best disambiguate their goals from a set of other candidates from an observer's perspective. In this paper we propose a method for legible planning for arbitrary PDDL domains, by extending previous research on legibility to classical planning without requiring to construct ad-hoc planners. We also discuss how the observer perspective may be estimated through a second order theory of mind that connects the planner's and the observer's task spaces. Our solution can for example be deployed in human-robot teaming scenarios, where an autonomous robot in a team can implicitly communicate its goal by producing legible plans. We present benchmark results on several PDDL planning domains. Our results generally show that plan legibility is a trade-off with plan efficiency, however, not all planning domains allows to increase legibility in the same way and a regularizing factor to balance legibility and efficiency was proved necessary.

</details>


### [280] [HumanoidTTT: Test-Time Capability Reuse for Efficient Humanoid Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00198)
*Jingtai Yang,Yining Wu,Yanjun Li,Zeyu Zhang,Hao Tang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 HumanoidTTT 框架，用于持续人形控制中的测试时能力复用：通过选择性全动作复用与测试时能力整合，在零不安全接受的前提下实现 16.4 倍端到端加速，并提升在线整合效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人形机器人在持续部署中可能反复请求相同动作，但中间发生的其他动作会改变机器人进入状态，使已成功验证的动作无法被盲目重放；同时已验证能力不断累积，而存储空间有限，需要决定保留哪些能力。因此需要兼顾可靠复用与有界存储的能力管理机制。

Method: 提出 HumanoidTTT 框架。其一为选择性全动作复用：仅从经认证的适用进入状态出发，授权直接复用已验证的完整动作，使被接受复用绕过新生成过程。其二为测试时能力整合：以后续部署中的复用情况作为反馈，在有界的全动作存储中自适应决定哪些合格能力持续保留。

Result: 实验显示零次不安全接受，端到端相对全新生成取得 16.4 倍加速；在线能力整合相较于冻结版本，在每 200 次请求中额外减少 13.2 次生成器调用。

Conclusion: HumanoidTTT 能在持续部署中实现已验证动作能力的可靠高效复用，并自适应地保留有用能力。

Abstract: Recent advances in motion generation and whole-body tracking have enabled humanoid robots to execute increasingly diverse motions, yet the same motion capabilities may be requested repeatedly during continual deployment. Reliable reuse is challenging because intervening motions can change the robot's entry state, making previously successful motions unsafe to replay blindly. Meanwhile, validated capabilities accumulate during deployment, while bounded storage requires deciding which ones are worth retaining. To address these challenges, we present HumanoidTTT, a framework for test-time capability reuse in continual humanoid control. Specifically, we introduce Selective Full-Motion Reuse, which authorizes direct reuse of validated complete motions only from certified applicable entry states, allowing accepted reuse to bypass fresh generation. We further introduce Test-Time Capability Consolidation, which adapts which qualified capabilities persist in a bounded Full-Motion Store using subsequent deployment reuse as feedback. Experiments demonstrate zero unsafe accepts and a 16.4$\times$ end-to-end speedup over fresh generation, while online consolidation improves avoided generator calls by 13.2 per 200 requests over its frozen counterpart. Overall, HumanoidTTT enables reliable and efficient reuse of validated motion capabilities while adaptively retaining useful capabilities throughout continual deployment. Code: https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/HumanoidTTT. Website: https://aigeeksgroup.github.io/HumanoidTTT.

</details>


### [281] [Real-Time Whole-Body Safe Motion Generation for Multi-Segment Tendon-Driven Continuum Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00220)
*Fangju Yang,Siyi Ma,Tonghao Guan,Tingcong Liu,Hang Yang,Zhengqiang Zhang,Jian S. Dai,Ke Wu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向平面多段腱驱动连续体机器人的统一驱动空间框架，结合能量型变曲率模型与多点CBF-QP，实现实时全身避障运动生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 腱驱动连续体机器人的实时运动生成依赖对非均匀弯曲的精确建模与全身碰撞避免，现有方法难以同时兼顾二者。

Method: 采用能量型变曲率模型刻画空间变化的腱间距与弯曲刚度，并给出解析雅可比用于微分逆运动学与安全监测；设计多点CBF-QP在障碍运动与驱动速度约束下保证主干间隙，其决策维数仅取决于独立驱动段数。

Result: 模型与GVS参考吻合，最大曲率误差5.223×10⁻² m⁻¹；100次MuJoCo试验中静态与动态场景碰撞-free成功率分别为96%与100%，无CBF约束时约为60%与80%；穿洞测试验证受限环境下安全性；600个主干监测点下平均控制步耗时6.66 ms。

Conclusion: 该框架在保证全身安全的同时实现实时运动生成，适用于受限环境下的腱驱动连续体机器人。

Abstract: Real-time motion generation for tendon-driven continuum robots requires accurate modeling of nonuniform bending and whole-body collision avoidance. This paper presents a unified actuation-space framework for planar multi-segment tendon-driven continuum robots. An energy-based variable-curvature model captures spatially varying tendon spacing and bending stiffness and provides analytical Jacobians for differential inverse kinematics and safety monitoring. A multipoint CBF-QP enforces backbone clearance under obstacle motion and actuation-velocity bounds, while its decision dimension depends only on the number of independently actuated segments. The model closely agrees with GVS references, with a maximum curvature error of $5.223 \times 10^{-2}\,\mathrm{m}^{-1}$. Over 100 MuJoCo trials, the proposed method achieves collision-free success rates of 96% and 100% in static and dynamic scenarios, respectively, compared with approximately 60% and 80% without CBF constraints. Hole-traversal tests further demonstrate safe motion in constrained environments. With 600 backbone monitoring points, the mean control-step time is 6.66 ms, demonstrating real-time whole-body safe motion generation.

</details>


### [282] [DriftOPD: Sequence-Level Reverse-KL Distillation for One-Step VLA Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00317)
*Youngjun Jun,Kyumin Choi,Youngmin Kim,Seonghyun Jin,Sunwoo Park,Jangho Park,Jong Chul Ye*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出DriftOPD——一种无需教师、无需在线rollout的连续VLA动作专家序列级on-policy蒸馏框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA模型的动作专家在滚动时域控制下生成短动作块，块级训练虽方便跨具身迁移，但仅优化局部动作似然，未显式考虑长时域任务成功；序列级强化学习虽可弥补，却需要策略rollout与闭环交互，在真实机器人操作中代价高昂。

Method: 将序列级反向KL散度分解为块级反向KL项与刻画当前动作长时域影响的未来势能项；前者用一步drifting目标优化，后者用从离线示范学习的Q函数critic优化，从而仅依赖离线数据与一步动作生成实现序列级优化。

Result: 在仿真与真实世界操作中的多种VLA架构上，DriftOPD普遍优于现有一步蒸馏基线，任务成功率与多步教师策略相当。

Conclusion: 长时域行为可被有效蒸馏进一步VLA动作专家，无需在线交互或独立教师模型。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models increasingly rely on action experts that generate short action chunks under receding-horizon control. While chunk-level training is convenient across robot embodiments, it optimizes local action likelihood without explicitly accounting for long-horizon task success. Sequence-level reinforcement learning can address this limitation, but typically requires policy rollouts and closed-loop interaction, which are costly for real-robot manipulation. We introduce DriftOPD, a teacher-free, rollout-free framework for sequence-level on-policy distillation of continuous VLA action experts. We show that the sequence-level reverse Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence decomposes into a chunk-level reverse-KL term and a future-potential term that captures the long-horizon effect of the current action. DriftOPD optimizes these two terms using a one-step drifting objective and a Q-function critic learned from offline demonstrations, respectively, enabling sequence-level optimization with only offline data and one-step action generation. Across multiple VLA architectures in simulation and real-world manipulation, DriftOPD generally outperforms existing one-step distillation baselines while achieving task success performance comparable to multi-step teacher policies. These results demonstrate that long-horizon behavior can be effectively distilled into one-step VLA action experts without online interaction or a separate teacher.

</details>


### [283] [Retrospective Open-Vocabulary Memory for Long-Term Object Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00330)
*Jiaming Wang,Zhiwei Xue,Chen Jizhuo,Peng Shiqi,Harold Soh*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出将长期目标搜索中的记忆建模为对删失观测的概率推断，并提出ECROM方法，实现基于"每次观测机会"的证据更新机制，用于开放词汇的长期物体出现概率估计与主动搜索先验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长期目标搜索需要在环境反复但观测不均匀的情况下，学习物体通常出现的位置。现有方法未能正确处理观测机会不均（即未观测到某位置未必代表物体不存在）的问题，容易产生有偏的信念估计。

Method: 将回顾式开放词汇记忆形式化为来自删失观测的概率推断（probabilistic inference from censored observations），核心思想是按观测机会（per opportunity）加权证据：一次检测或未检测对信念的影响，应正比于机器人观测该位置的机会。基于此提出ECROM，用于估计仅在查询时指定的概念的长期出现概率（long-term prevalence），并将所得信念直接转化为主动搜索先验（active-search prior）。

Result: 在十个HM3D家庭中构建受控长期基准（独立变化物体放置与观测机会，跨重复遍历），ECROM在留出查询上的support-level AP提升4.5个点，搜索SPL提升4.2个点，均超过各指标下最强的对比记忆方法。

Conclusion: 按观测机会加权的概率推断能有效缓解观测不均匀带来的偏差，ECROM在开放词汇长期目标搜索中显著优于现有记忆方法，相关基准、数据集与代码将开源。

Abstract: Long-term object search requires learning where objects usually appear from repeated but uneven observations of a changing environment. We formulate retrospective open-vocabulary memory as probabilistic inference from censored observations, where the key idea is to reason with evidence per opportunity: a detection or non-detection should influence belief only in proportion to the robot's opportunity to observe the corresponding location. We introduce ECROM, which uses this principle to estimate long-term prevalence for concepts specified only at query time and converts the resulting belief directly into an active-search prior. To evaluate this problem, we introduce a controlled long-term benchmark in ten HM3D homes that independently varies object placement and observation opportunity across repeated traversals. ECROM improves support-level AP on held-out queries by 4.5 points and search SPL by 4.2 points over the strongest competing memory in each metric. The benchmark, dataset, and code will be open-sourced.

</details>


### [284] [ALFRED: Requirement-driven development of an open-source mobile manipulator for long-term plant monitoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01477)
*Ciarán Miceal Johnson,Christopher Quail,Garry Ellard,Alistair McConnell,Steve Tonneau,Fernando Auat Cheein*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: ALFRED：一款开源轮式移动操作机器人，历经四次迭代以满足六项户外重复部署需求，实现臂部可用位姿比例从34.0%提升至66.1%，并完成一年528次月度森林调查任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 追踪作物与森林的季节性变化需对同一植株重复观测，地面机器人可近距离作业，机械臂能提供更多视角。然而，支撑长期野外数据集的机器人极少公开设计文件，且机器人自身结构对机械臂可达范围与传感器遮挡的限制鲜有跨版本对比。

Method: 构建ALFRED：基于商用组件的开源移动操作平台，在阿克曼转向底盘上搭载六自由度机械臂、LiDAR、RGB-D相机、RTK GNSS与IMU，安装于可重构铝型材框架，运行容器化ROS软件。围绕六项重复户外部署需求（耐久性、模块化、可维修性、感知范围、续航、可复现性）迭代四次。

Result: 对后三代构型开展基于模型的分析：机械臂可达位姿的可用比例分别为34.0%、60.0%、66.1%；射线投射显示仅最终构型能保证框架安装式LiDAR前后水平视野均无遮挡。完成一年月度森林调查，共528次穿越，未漏一次计划采集；期间经历电池衰减、为其他研究者研究进行重构，以及并行开发ALFRED 2.0用于自主作物行作业，每次构型切换约需六小时。

Conclusion: 机械模块化的可靠性取决于与之同步维护的机器人描述文件；公开设计文件与跨构型的结构—感知权衡分析对长期野外机器人研究具有重要价值。

Abstract: Tracking seasonal change in crops and forests requires observing the same plants repeatedly. Ground robots can do this at close range, and a manipulator gives their sensors more viewpoints. Yet the robots behind long-term field datasets are rarely released with their design files, and how a robot's own structure limits arm reach and occludes its sensors is seldom compared between builds. We present ALFRED, an open-source mobile manipulator built from commercially available components. It carries a six-degree-of-freedom arm, LiDAR, RGB-D cameras, RTK GNSS and an IMU on an Ackermann-steered base, all mounted on a reconfigurable aluminium strut frame, and runs containerised ROS software. It was developed through four builds against six requirements for repeated outdoor deployment: durability, modularity, repairability, sensing reach, endurance and reproducibility. Model-based analysis of the last three builds shows the usable share of the arm's reachable poses rising from 34.0% to 60.0% and then 66.1%, and ray casting shows that only the final build keeps the frame-mounted LiDAR's horizontal view clear both forwards and backwards. ALFRED completed a year of monthly forest surveys (528 traversals) without missing a scheduled collection. This was despite battery degradation, reconfiguration for another researcher's study, and the parallel development of ALFRED 2.0 for autonomous crop-row operation, with each switch between builds taking about six hours. The deployment also showed that mechanical modularity is only as dependable as the robot description that tracks it.

</details>


### [285] [IndoorBEV: A Lightweight Real-Time LiDAR BEV Perception System for Indoor Mobile Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00355)
*Haichuan Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: IndoorBEV是一种轻量级室内LiDAR感知框架，通过高度感知BEV表示与几何条件特征融合，在精度、时延和内存之间取得良好平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 移动机器人在严格时延与内存约束下感知杂乱三维室内环境困难。现有点云/体素方法计算开销大，传统BEV虽高效却丢失垂直几何信息，存在效率与信息完整性的权衡。

Method: 采用高度感知BEV表示：用统计高度特征与多频高度编码总结每个BEV单元内的垂直点分布，使三维线索可由二维卷积高效处理；轻量编码器融合几何特征、多尺度局部表示与紧凑全局场景上下文；解耦稠密预测头联合输出语义BEV图与有向目标包围框。

Result: 模型仅0.6M参数、2.3 MB存储；NVIDIA AGX Orin上单次推理GPU内存21.52 MB，200 ms感知截止时间下平均时延169.6 ms，超时率1.8%。在仿真场景、真实机器人扫描及开源室内点云数据集上验证了精度、时延与内存的良好权衡。

Conclusion: 在紧凑BEV表示中显式编码垂直几何，是资源高效室内LiDAR感知的有效途径。

Abstract: Efficient indoor LiDAR perception is challenging because mobile robots must understand cluttered three-dimensional environments under strict latency and memory constraints. Existing point-based and voxel-based methods often incur substantial computational overhead, whereas conventional bird's-eye-view (BEV) representations improve efficiency at the cost of discarding vertical geometric information. We present IndoorBEV, a lightweight LiDAR perception framework that mitigates this tradeoff through a height-aware BEV representation and geometry-conditioned feature fusion. IndoorBEV summarizes the vertical point distribution in each BEV cell using statistical height features and multi-frequency height encoding, allowing informative three-dimensional cues to be processed efficiently by two-dimensional convolutions. A lightweight encoder then integrates complementary geometric features with multi-scale local representations and compact global scene context. Decoupled dense prediction heads jointly produce semantic BEV maps and oriented object bounding boxes. IndoorBEV contains only 0.6M parameters and requires 2.3 MB of model storage. On an NVIDIA AGX Orin, it uses 21.52 MB of GPU memory per inference and achieves a mean latency of 169.6 ms under a 200 ms perception deadline, with a deadline miss ratio of 1.8\%. Evaluations on simulated scenes, real-world robot scans, and an open-source indoor point-cloud dataset demonstrate a favorable tradeoff among perception accuracy, latency, and memory consumption. These results indicate that explicitly encoding vertical geometry within a compact BEV representation provides an effective approach to resource-efficient indoor LiDAR perception.

</details>


### [286] [DexPolicy: Scheduled Exploration for Trajectory-Guided Dexterous Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00360)
*Haoyu Wang,Siyuan Qian,Yanjun Li,Zeyu Zhang,Yandong Guo,Boxin Shi,Hao Tang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: DexPolicy 将 RL 探索噪声尺度显式设为训练步数的退火函数，在灵巧操作任务中显著提升确定性目标成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 灵巧操作 RL 需先发现手指-物体接触，再精确控制物体；服务前者的动作噪声会干扰后者。在 ViViDex 等轨迹引导设置中，PPO 基线训练 5M 步后噪声仍停留在初始水平，说明需要显式控制探索尺度。

Method: 把探索噪声尺度设为训练步数的显式函数，从宽探索退火到窄探索，同时固定损失、架构、奖励与优化器设置。研究三种策略优化设置：PPO、无 critic 的 GRPO 续训、以及流参数化 PPO 变体（FPO）。

Result: 五个 YCB 物体、三个种子下，平均确定性 Target 成功率：FPO 由 49.4% 升至 68.1%，GRPO 由 14.1% 升至 45.4%，PPO 由 32.0% 升至 35.7%。RealMan RM75 机械臂配 Inspire/RH56 手，三物体 360 次试验，平均 Target 成功率：FPO 由 25.0% 升至 85.0%，GRPO 由 10.0% 升至 63.3%，PPO 由 8.3% 升至 43.3%，每个物体-方法条件一个训练模型。PPO 组件筛选显示噪声控制优于所测优化器收缩；所选调度在三个测试物体上平均 Target 成功率高于相同端点的线性衰减。

Conclusion: 训练回报、确定性目标成功率与执行噪声容忍度彼此解离；调度应以目标执行条件下的最终任务成功率来评判，并需按任务和策略优化设置分别评估。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) for dexterous manipulation must discover finger-object contacts and then control the object precisely; the action noise that serves the first goal can interfere with the second. In trajectory-guided settings such as ViViDex, where RL refine hand-object trajectories from human video, our baseline PPO runs end near their initial action noise after 5M steps, motivating explicit control of exploration scale. DexPolicy makes that scale an explicit function of training steps, annealing from broad to narrow exploration while holding loss, architecture, reward, and optimizer settings fixed. We study three policy-optimization settings: PPO, critic-free GRPO continuation, and a flow-parameterized PPO variant (FPO). Across five YCB objects and three training seeds, mean deterministic Target success rises from 49.4% to 68.1% (FPO), 14.1% to 45.4% (GRPO), and 32.0% to 35.7% (PPO). On a RealMan RM75 arm with an Inspire/RH56 hand, 360 trials over three objects raise mean Target success from 25.0% to 85.0% (FPO), 10.0% to 63.3% (GRPO), and 8.3% to 43.3% (PPO), with one trained model per object-method condition. PPO component screening favors noise control over the tested optimizer contraction; the selected PPO schedule yields higher mean Target success than linear decay with the same endpoints on three tested objects. Training return, deterministic Target success, and tolerance to execution noise dissociate; schedules should therefore be judged by terminal task success under the intended execution conditions, per task and policy-optimization setting. Code: https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/DexPolicy. Website: https://aigeeksgroup.github.io/DexPolicy.

</details>


### [287] [DeepJEPA: Scaling World Models from Within](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00368)
*Zijian Jin,Yunbei Zhang,Yuanzhe Liu,Ming Liu,Baian Chen,Weirui Ye,Shilong Liu,Marco Pavone*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: DeepJEPA将世界模型中的状态转移深度作为测试时的内部缩放轴，通过权重共享的联合嵌入预测模型自适应决定每个候选轨迹与每个推演步是否需要更多循环更新，从而在决策关键事件处分配更多计算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界模型规划器主要通过推演更远、采样更多轨迹或延长优化来扩展计算，但对每一次想象的状态转移都分配相同计算量。这种均匀加深转移深度的做法既浪费算力，又可能因有用细化仅集中在少数决策关键事件而损害规划性能。

Method: 提出DeepJEPA，一种权重共享（weight-tied）的联合嵌入预测式世界模型，将转移深度视为测试时内部缩放轴，并学习对每个候选与每个推演步判断是否需要再执行一次循环更新。额外计算集中于接触起始与持续物体交互等关键阶段，从而影响进入精英候选集的动作选择。

Result: 在五个视觉控制设置中，DeepJEPA优于或匹配最强固定深度规划器，平均每次转移仅需1.00–1.26次更新；额外计算集中于接触起始与持续物体交互处。表征探针显示，规划性能提升并不要求物体状态可解码性整体一致提高。

Conclusion: DeepJEPA将世界模型缩放重新表述为内部计算分配问题：应在能改变规划器决策的决策关键转移处思考更深，而非将每次推演均匀加深或延长。

Abstract: World-model planners typically scale outward by rolling farther, sampling more trajectories, or optimizing longer, while assigning the same computation to every imagined transition. We show that making every transition uniformly deeper wastes computation and can degrade planning because useful refinement is concentrated at a small set of decision-critical events. We introduce DeepJEPA, a weight-tied joint-embedding predictive world model that treats transition depth as an inner test-time scaling axis and learns when another recurrent update is worth computing for each candidate and rollout step. Across five visual-control settings, DeepJEPA improves or matches the strongest fixed-depth planner while averaging only 1.00-1.26 updates per transition. Its additional computation concentrates at contact onset and sustained object interaction, where latent corrections can change which candidates enter the planner's elite set and which action is selected. Representation probes further show that improved planning does not require uniformly better object-state decodability. DeepJEPA therefore reframes world-model scaling as a problem of allocating internal computation where it can change the planner's decision: think deeper at decision-critical transitions instead of making every rollout uniformly deeper or longer.

</details>


### [288] [Whole-Body Aerial Grasping and Lifting via Partial Visual Observations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00404)
*Jiaye Jin,Rui Jin,Xinhang Xu,Haotian Jin,Ruiyang Liu,Yi Wang,Jiayan Zhao,Kun Cao,Lihua Xie*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出循环教师-学生框架，用单一策略在仿真中联合控制飞行、机械臂与夹爪，实现空中抓取-提升任务，无需显式任务阶段输入。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 空中抓取-提升需整体协调，但部分可观测下早期接近阶段失败会减少后续阶段训练暴露，且可见性变化使对齐与闭合时机难以把握。

Method: 特权教师通过强化学习与临界状态课程训练，先暴露抓取与提升状态再接入正常接近轨迹；将其行为蒸馏为循环视觉学生，用双视角点云与本体感知替代特权目标状态，整合观测历史实现闭环；并设计独立闭合目标，基于持续的就绪序列监督闭合时机。

Result: 在条件触发锁存、虚拟附着与基于力旋量的负载加载仿真模型下完成8,996个回合，冻结学生全任务成功率分别为标称99.97%、物理/控制随机化97.14%、附加相机随机化95.84%；标称下按锁存计数加权的每种子90百分位对齐误差均值为8.12 mm。

Conclusion: 所提循环教师-学生框架可在无任务阶段输入下实现高鲁棒性的空中抓取-提升策略，并在多种随机化条件下保持较高成功率与对齐精度。

Abstract: Aerial grasp-and-lift tasks require whole-body coordination across approach, acquisition, and lifting under partial target observations. Early approach failures can limit exposure to later task stages during training, while changing visibility complicates alignment and closure timing during execution. We present a recurrent teacher-student framework that learns a single policy in simulation to jointly command flight, arm motion, and gripper closure without an explicit task-phase input. A privileged teacher learns through reinforcement learning with a critical-state curriculum that exposes acquisition and lifting states before connecting them to normal approach trajectories. Its behavior is distilled into a recurrent visual student that replaces privileged target states with dual-view point clouds and proprioception, integrating observation history for closed-loop control. A dedicated closure objective supervises closure timing from sustained model-defined readiness sequences. Training and primary evaluation use a simulated acquisition-and-payload model with condition-triggered latching, virtual attachment, and wrench-based payload loading for short-distance lifting. Across 8,996 completed simulation episodes under this model, the frozen student achieves full-task success rates of 99.97%, 97.14%, and 95.84% under nominal, physics/control-randomized, and additional camera-randomized conditions, respectively. The nominal latch-count-weighted mean of per-seed 90th-percentile alignment errors at acquisition is 8.12 mm.

</details>


### [289] [Towards a General Humanoid Loco-Manipulation Model via Egocentric Whole-Body Human Data Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00438)
*Chongyang Xu,Zhao Wu,Jin Chen,Yiming Jiang,Jinhui Ye,Yuming Jiang,Shifeng Zhang,Ziliang Feng,Mu Xu,Yilun Chen,Li Lu,Steven C. H. Hoi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出HumanVerse-500（500小时人体移动-操作数据集）与λ₀全身人形视觉-语言-动作策略，通过三阶段训练实现人体经验向人形机器人全身控制的迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人形全身操作策略发展迅速，但监督信号不足：自我中心人类视频对全身运动与手-物交互协调的覆盖有限，而人形遥操作采集成本高、难扩展。核心问题是：如何利用人类经验支持可扩展的人形移动-操作学习。

Method: 1) 构建HumanVerse-500：用轻量可穿戴系统同步自我中心视频与身体、手部运动，采集500小时开放世界人体移动-操作行为。2) 提出λ₀全身人形VLA策略，三阶段训练：先从多样自我中心数据集学习交互，再用HumanVerse-500协调身体与手部运动，最后适配下游任务与机器人本体。3) 学习共享表示空间用于人体经验迁移，用域特定接口处理人-机器人状态与动作差异。

Result: 在SIMPLE基准和4个真实世界移动-操作任务上取得最先进性能；并分析了扩展行为、泛化能力以及各训练阶段的贡献。

Conclusion: 验证了人类数据可有效支持下游人形全身控制，代码、模型与数据将开源以促进后续研究。

Abstract: Humanoid whole-body manipulation has advanced rapidly, enabling policies to coordinate locomotion, posture, bimanual interaction, and dexterous hand movements. Meanwhile, egocentric human videos provide diverse examples of everyday interactions across objects and scenes, offering scalable supervision without robot operation. However, existing supervision from these videos provides limited coverage of whole-body movement and coordination with hand-object interaction, while obtaining such supervision through humanoid teleoperation is also costly and difficult to scale. We therefore explore how human experience can support scalable learning of humanoid loco-manipulation. To support this study, we introduce HumanVerse-500, a 500-hour dataset of diverse human loco-manipulation behaviors in open-world environments, collected with a lightweight wearable system that synchronizes egocentric video with body and hand motion. Building on this dataset, we develop $λ_0$, a whole-body humanoid vision-language-action policy, through three-stage training that first learns interaction from diverse egocentric datasets, then coordinates body and hand motion using HumanVerse-500, and finally adapts the policy to downstream tasks and robot embodiments. Across these stages, $λ_0$ learns a shared representation space for human experience transfer, while domain-specific interfaces handle differences between human and robot states and actions. We evaluate $λ_0$ on SIMPLE and 4 real-world loco-manipulation tasks, achieving state-of-the-art performance, and further analyze its scaling behavior, generalization, and training-stage contributions to understand how human data support downstream whole-body humanoid control. We will release our code, models, and data to support further research.

</details>


### [290] [ScaffoldM3C: A Multimodal Sequential Monte Carlo Framework for Generative Stable Construction Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00487)
*Gadiel Sznaier Camps,Chengyang He,Guillaume Sartoretti,Eduardo Montijano,Mac Schwager*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出ScaffoldM3C，将积木式3D结构构建建模为多模态条件下的概率化下一块生成任务，引入脚手架辅助token，并结合顺序蒙特卡洛(SMC)维护多条装配序列。模型规模仅为基线1/4，推理加速5-20倍，构建质量相当且整体稳定性更高，并通过仿真与真实机器人装配验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主构建物理可实现的3D结构面临组合动作空间大、组件可互换、装配序列多解(equifinal)、以及构建过程严格的稳定性要求等挑战。现有基于微调大语言模型的文本生成式构建方法存在三方面不足：不支持多模态(文本、图像、草图)条件控制；忽略脚手架在稳定中间结构中的实际作用；推理速度慢。

Method: 将构建问题形式化为具有多种潜在装配动作和多种任务条件模态的概率化下一块生成任务；引入辅助脚手架块token以显式建模脚手架作用；提出ScaffoldM3C——一种多模态、轻量级、自回归的块式构建模型，输出一组下一步候选块；利用这些候选项，采用顺序蒙特卡洛(SMC)维护可能装配序列的种群，从而同时考虑多个可能不同的装配方向；通过扩展StableText2Brick数据集，加入图像条件提示与脚手架稳定的构建序列进行训练。

Result: ScaffoldM3C比竞争基线小4倍，推理速度提升5-20倍，同时达到与最先进方法相当的构建质量，并实现更高的整体稳定性；通过仿真与真实世界机器人装配演示验证了方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 多模态、轻量级自回归建模结合SMC序列搜索与显式脚手架机制，可在保证构建质量的同时显著提升效率与稳定性，并成功应用于真实机器人装配，为物理可实现的3D结构自主构建提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Autonomously constructing physically realizable 3D structures remains a significant challenge due to combinatorial action spaces, interchangeable components, equifinal assembly sequences, and strict stability requirements during construction. State-of-the-art methods fine-tune large language models for text-based generative construction. However, these approaches do not allow for Multimodal (text, image, sketch) conditioning, overlook the practical role of scaffolding for stabilizing intermediate structures, and suffer from slow inference speeds. Therefore, we formulate construction as a probabilistic next-block generation task with multiple potential assembly actions and multiple potential task conditioning modalities. Concurrently, we explicitly consider the utility of scaffolding by introducing an auxiliary scaffold block token. We present Scaffold Multimodal Monte Carlo (ScaffoldM3C), a multimodal, lightweight, auto-regressive model for stable block-based construction, that proposes a set of next-step candidate blocks. Leveraging these candidates, we utilize Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) to maintain a population of possible assembly sequences, allowing us to consider multiple, potentially different, assembly directions simultaneously. We train our multimodal architecture by extending the StableText2Brick dataset to contain image conditioning prompts and scaffold-stabilized build sequences. ScaffoldM3C is 4x smaller than competing baselines, yielding a 5x to 20x speedup during inference, while achieving comparable construction quality to state-of-the-art methods and higher overall stability. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach through simulations and real-world robot assembly demonstrations.

</details>


### [291] [Same Scene, Different Task: Skill Alignment for Compositional Generalization in VLAs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00524)
*Taegeun Yang,Youngju Na,Yoonki Cho,Sung-Eui Yoon*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出 CRAFT，针对 VLA 模型中的视觉捷径失效模式，利用反事实对与跨执行可复用的技能表征，将已示范技能的执行监督迁移到未示范组合，从而提升组合泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA 模型难以泛化到微调示范中未出现的技能组合，即使每个组成技能都已被示范。其一种失败模式是视觉捷径：微调时视觉观测可能成为指令的代理，使策略根据相似观测执行已示范的组合，而非执行指令指定的组合。因此需要针对这一问题设计训练方法。

Method: 构造反事实对：保持示范观测固定，将指令改为未示范的技能组合。但这类对缺少对应示范动作目标。关键观察是所需技能已被示范，然而同一技能在不同观测下可能需不同动作，故不能直接以那些执行的动作作为目标。为此提出 CRAFT，利用可在同一技能不同执行间复用的技能表征，将已示范执行的监督迁移到反事实对。

Result: 在三个 VLA 模型和两个仿真基准上，CRAFT 提升了未示范组合的成功率，同时保持已示范组合的高成功率；在真实机器人上也提升了组合泛化能力。

Conclusion: CRAFT 通过反事实对与可复用技能表征实现监督迁移，有效缓解视觉捷径导致的组合泛化失败，并在多模型、多基准及真实机器人上验证了有效性。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models often struggle to generalize to skill combinations absent from their fine-tuning demonstrations, even when every constituent skill has been demonstrated. We focus on a vision shortcut as one failure mode: during fine-tuning, visual observations can serve as a proxy for the instruction, so a policy may execute a demonstrated combination associated with similar observations rather than the instructed combination. This motivates training with counterfactual pairs formed by holding a demonstration observation fixed while changing the instruction to specify an undemonstrated combination. These pairs, however, lack corresponding demonstrated action targets. Crucially, the currently required skill has already been demonstrated, but actions from those executions cannot serve as direct targets because the same skill can require different actions across observations. We propose CRAFT, which transfers supervision from demonstrated executions of the required skill to counterfactual pairs using skill representations that can be reused across executions of the same skill. Across three VLA models and two simulation benchmarks, CRAFT improves success on undemonstrated combinations while maintaining high success on demonstrated ones; it also improves compositional generalization on a real robot. Project website: https://taegeunyang.github.io/craft/

</details>


### [292] [Does Continual Imitation Learning Remain Grounded? A Language-Perturbed Benchmark for Robotic Task Retention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00542)
*Siddeshwar Raghavan,Ziqin Yuan,Fengqing Zhu,Byung-Cheol Min*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一个基准协议，用于评估持续模仿学习中机器人策略的语言接地能力，发现强大的持续学习性能并不总意味着可靠的语言接地。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 持续模仿学习通常只关注是否忘记旧技能，但保留任务性能并不保证行为真正依据语言，因为策略可能依赖场景线索、物体关联或记忆的任务结构，因此需要研究语言引导行为在持续学习过程中的变化。

Method: 为LIBERO的Goal、Spatial、Object和Long套件构建保持语义与改变语义的指令变体；策略实验聚焦LIBERO-Goal，在每个持续学习阶段后评估原始指令与改写指令；在原有假设下比较代表性持续模仿学习方法，并将任务能力与语言敏感性分离；提出诊断指标测量语义鲁棒性、目标适应和语言敏感性。

Result: 结果表明，强大的持续学习性能并不总能转化为可靠的语言接地，所提出的诊断方法有助于判断保留下来的技能是否仍由指令正确引导。

Conclusion: 语言接地应作为持续模仿学习的独立评估维度；所提诊断指标补充了标准学习与遗忘指标，可揭示策略是否真正依据语言而非场景或记忆线索执行任务。

Abstract: Continual imitation learning evaluates whether a robot can learn new knowledge without forgetting previously learned skills. However, retaining task performance does not ensure the behavior remains grounded in language because policies may rely on scene cues, object associations, or memorized task structure. We introduce a benchmark protocol to study how language-guided behavior changes as robotic policies learn successive tasks. We construct meaning-preserving and meaning-changing instruction variants for the Goal, Spatial, Object, and Long suites of LIBERO. Policy experiments focus on LIBERO-Goal, evaluating Original and Paraphrase instructions after each continual-learning stage. We compare representative continual imitation learning methods under their original assumptions while separating task competence from language sensitivity. The proposed diagnostics complement standard learning and forgetting metrics by measuring semantic robustness, goal adaptation, and language sensitivity. Results show that strong continual-learning performance does not always translate to reliable language grounding, and our diagnostics help determine whether retained skills remain correctly guided by their instructions. Additional materials are available at https://sites.google.com/view/stillgrounded

</details>


### [293] [Token-World: World Modeling in Vision-Language Model Token Space for Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00575)
*Chuyao Fu,Xiaowei Chi,Yuhan Rui,Yu-kai Wang,Zezhong Qian,Xiaojie Zhang,Yunfan Lou,Kevin Zhang,Kuangzhi Ge,Chak Wing Mak,Zhiyang Chen,Athena Zhuoming Zhong,Hongyang Chen,Haoran Li,Yike Guo,Sirui Han,Shanghang Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: Token-World 提出一种动作条件世界模型，将 VLM 视觉 token 压缩为紧凑 token 状态并在该低维空间中建模未来动力学，再映射回策略面向的原始表示，从而提升世界模型模拟的保真度、策略一致性与闭环策略性能相关性，同时降低模拟延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 面向 VLA 系统的常见世界模型模拟方法是预测未来 RGB 观测并重新编码为策略输入，这使模拟与下游策略执行之间存在间接接口。本文旨在探究能否在源自 VLM 视觉 token 的紧凑、面向策略的状态中建模世界动力学。核心挑战在于原始 VLM 视觉 token 维度高，难以进行高效且准确的自回归动力学建模。

Method: 提出 Token-World：一种动作条件世界模型。它将 VLM 特征压缩为紧凑 token 状态，在该降维空间中学习未来动力学，并将预测状态映射回面向策略的原始表示以供下游使用。

Result: 在操作基准上，Token-World 相比近期世界模型模拟器提升了开环特征保真度与策略-动作一致性，且在长 rollout 时域上退化更慢。闭环评估中，其模拟策略性能与参考策略性能的相关性强于 Ctrl-World（r=0.794 对 0.583），同时模拟延迟更低。消融实验进一步表明，紧凑表示设计与维度对预测未来状态有显著影响。

Conclusion: 在紧凑、面向策略的 VLM 视觉 token 状态中建模世界动力学可行且有效，可兼顾模拟保真度、下游策略对齐、长时域稳定性与低延迟，紧凑表示的设计与维度是关键影响因素。

Abstract: A common approach to world-model simulation for vision-language-action (VLA) systems is to predict future RGB observations and then re-encode them into policy inputs, introducing an indirect interface between simulation and downstream policy execution. We instead investigate whether world dynamics can be modeled in a compact, policy-oriented state derived from VLM visual tokens. A key challenge is that raw VLM visual tokens are high-dimensional, making efficient and accurate autoregressive dynamics modeling challenging. To address this, we introduce Token-World, an action-conditioned world model that compresses VLM features into a compact token state, learns future dynamics in this reduced space, and maps predicted states back to the original policy-facing representation for downstream use. Across manipulation benchmarks, Token-World improves open-loop feature fidelity and policy-action consistency over recent world-model simulators, with slower degradation over long rollout horizons. In closed-loop evaluation, its simulated policy performance correlates more strongly with reference policy performance than Ctrl-World ($r=0.794$ vs.\ $0.583$), while requiring lower simulation latency. Ablations further show that compact-representation design and dimensionality substantially affect future-state prediction. Code will be available at https://chuyaofu.github.io/Token-World/.

</details>


### [294] [When Reasoning Helps Action: Monitoring and Steering Chain-of-Thought in Vision-Language-Action Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00601)
*Sathwik Karnik,Joseph JR. Lee,Aryaman Gupta,Somil Bansal*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出评估推理型VLA策略中CoT作为运行时安全接口的两个维度——可纠正性与可行动性，并设计TRUST（基于前缀预测推理正确性的离线价值模型）来监控与选择性引导推理生成；实验表明推理正确性提升并不必然带来具身任务性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推理型VLA策略会输出CoT痕迹，看似能解释并引导动作，从而为通过推理监控与纠正实现运行时安全提供了潜在接口。但该接口能否真正改善具身行为尚不明确，需要建立评估框架来判断推理纠正是否可检测、是否有效。

Method: 定义并操作化两个评估维度：可纠正性（能否在生成过程中检测并改进不可靠推理）与可行动性（推理纠正能否产生朝预期方向的行为变化）。为此提出TRUST：一个离线训练的价值模型，从部分前缀预测最终推理正确性，并用该估计对冻结VLA策略的推理生成进行监控与选择性引导。

Result: 在Alpamayo 1.5驾驶VLA上，TRUST监控正确性达88.9%准确率，推理正确性从75.9%提升至90.0%；在AlpaSim困难子集上，碰撞率降低30.4%，最大轨迹误差降低11.5%，优于算力匹配的Best-of-4基线。在DeepThinkVLA操作VLA上，抓取状态断言正确性从69.3%升至90.2%，动作选择断言从68.8%升至85.9%，但LIBERO-Plus闭环任务性能基本不变。实证分析显示Alpamayo 1.5存在意图一致的行为效应，而DeepThinkVLA效果有限，可解释任务层面差异。

Conclusion: 推理正确性的提升并不自动意味着具身性能提升，因此在使用CoT作为运行时安全接口时，应同时评估可纠正性与可行动性。

Abstract: Reasoning-enabled VLA policies expose chain-of-thought (CoT) traces that appear to explain and guide their actions, creating a potential interface for runtime safety through reasoning monitoring and correction. In this work, we define and operationalize two evaluation axes for assessing when this interface can improve embodied behavior: correctability, which measures whether unreliable reasoning can be detected and improved during generation, and actionability, which measures whether reasoning corrections produce behaviorally meaningful changes in the intended direction. To enable correctability, we introduce Token-level Reward for Utility-Steered Chain-of-Thought (TRUST), an offline-trained value model that predicts eventual reasoning correctness from partial prefixes and uses these estimates to monitor and selectively steer reasoning generation in frozen VLA policies. On the Alpamayo 1.5 driving VLA, TRUST monitors correctness with 88.9% accuracy and improves reasoning correctness from 75.9% to 90.0%. On a baseline-defined challenging subset in AlpaSim, TRUST reduces collision rate by 30.4% and maximum trajectory error by 11.5% relative to the unsteered policy, outperforming a compute-matched Best-of-4 baseline. On the DeepThinkVLA manipulation VLA, TRUST improves the correctness of grasp-state claims from 69.3% to 90.2% and action-choice claims from 68.8% to 85.9%, yet closed-loop task performance on LIBERO-Plus remains largely unchanged. Empirical analysis reveals intent-consistent behavioral effects in Alpamayo 1.5 but limited effects in DeepThinkVLA, helping interpret these different task-level outcomes. Together, our results show that gains in reasoning correctness do not automatically imply gains in embodied performance, motivating evaluation of correctability and actionability when using CoT as a runtime safety interface.

</details>


### [295] [TacDyn-WAM: Learning Implicit Tactile Dynamics in a Heterogeneous Visuo-Tactile World Action Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00638)
*Enyi Wang,Mingxin Wang,Quan Shi,Hetian Guo,Hongyu Wang,Xi Wang,Bin Qian,Yupeng Zheng,Wenxuan Song,Houde Liu,Yong Xu,Cheng Chi,Wenchao Ding,Yilun Chen,Yan Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: TacDyn-WAM：一种异构视触觉世界动作模型，通过预测隐式触觉动力学（而非重建未来触觉图像）提升机器人在部署漂移下的操作鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有触觉世界动作模型多沿用视频生成式流水线，以迭代去噪重建未来触觉观测。该方式在部署漂移下不可靠：接触位置或力的小变化会使触觉像素显著改变，即使底层接触演化本身是可预测的。因此需要一种不依赖触觉像素重建的预测范式。

Method: 提出 TacDyn-WAM，包含视觉专家与隐式触觉动力学专家，在各自目标空间预测未来视觉与触觉表征，并通过联合注意力交互。设计 TacRep——动力学感知触觉目标空间，通过触觉片段的掩码时空预测训练，并以关系结构蒸馏正则化。触觉专家单次前向即可预测多时间尺度的未来表征及其变化；只读触觉记忆提供当前触觉状态。

Result: 在 UniVTAC 上仅用给定示范即达 81.5% 平均成功率，达到 SOTA 水平，并与大规模视触觉轨迹预训练模型相当。消融实验验证两条触觉通路与 TacRep 相较像素重建和静态方案的优势。在五项真机任务上平均成功率 71.0%，适度规模预训练提升至 85.0%。

Conclusion: 以隐式触觉动力学表征替代触觉像素重建，是提升触觉世界动作模型在部署漂移下鲁棒性与数据效率的有效路径，且具备良好的真机迁移与预训练扩展性。

Abstract: World action models improve robotic manipulation by conditioning actions on predicted futures, yet existing tactile variants largely inherit video-generation pipelines that reconstruct future tactile observations through iterative denoising. Such prediction can become unreliable under deployment drift: small changes in contact position or force may substantially alter tactile pixels even when the underlying contact evolution remains predictable. We introduce TacDyn-WAM, a heterogeneous visuo-tactile world action model that predicts implicit tactile dynamics rather than reconstructing future tactile observations. It learns TacRep, a dynamics-aware tactile target space trained through masked spatio-temporal prediction on tactile clips and regularized by relational structure distillation. A visual expert and an Implicit Tactile Dynamics Expert predict future visual and tactile representations in separate target spaces while interacting through joint attention; the tactile expert predicts future representations and their changes at multiple horizons in a single forward pass, and a read-only tactile memory supplies the current tactile state. On UniVTAC, TacDyn-WAM achieves an average success rate of 81.5% using only the provided demonstrations, reaching state-of-the-art-level performance and remaining competitive with models pretrained on large-scale visuo-tactile trajectories. Ablations confirm the benefits of both tactile pathways and TacRep over pixel-reconstruction and static alternatives. On five real-robot tasks, TacDyn-WAM reaches 71.0% average success, and modest-scale pretraining raises it to 85.0%, further validating our method.

</details>


### [296] [Toward Humanoid Robots in Construction: A Teleoperation Feasibility Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00718)
*Parastoo Ali Pour,David R. Martin,Chang Min Hur,Bo Zhang,Tommy Zhou,Brandon Thomas Lichter,Shane Stanfield,Pramod Khargonekar,Mohammad Abdullah Al Faruque*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种面向Unitree G1人形机器人的遥操作系统，结合XR上半身控制与踏板式移动，实现单人同时操作与行走，并在两项建筑任务上验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 建筑行业长期存在劳动力短缺与危险作业条件，而人形机器人自主性仍不足，因此遥操作被视为近期可行方案，既能减轻工人身体负担，又能采集高质量示范数据。

Method: 系统由两部分组成：基于扩展现实（XR）的上半身控制，以及踏板驱动的移动控制，二者结合使单个操作者可同时进行操作与行走。任务选自O*NET职业数据库中的两项代表性建筑任务，以手工作业为基线，评估任务成功率与完成时间。

Result: 工具搬运任务成功率为100%，表面喷漆任务成功率为80%；与人工基线相比，遥操作完成时间显著更长。

Conclusion: 遥操作可在建筑任务中达到较高成功率，具备作为近期实用方案的潜力，但效率仍明显低于人工，未来需优化以缩小时间差距并提升复杂任务表现。

Abstract: We present a teleoperation system that enables a single operator to perform construction tasks on a Unitree G1 humanoid, combining extended reality (XR) based upper body control with pedal-based locomotion to enable simultaneous manipulation and locomotion. Motivated by persistent labor shortages, hazardous working conditions, and challenges in humanoid autonomy, we investigate teleoperation as a practical near-term approach for reducing physical strain on workers while generating high quality demonstration data. We evaluate the system on two representative construction tasks drawn from O*NET occupational database, and report task success and completion time relative to a manual baseline. The system achieved 100% success on tool transport and 80% success on surface painting, with teleoperation requiring substantially more time compared to manual execution.

</details>


### [297] [CF-JEPA: Improving Robustness of JEPA World Models via Controllability Factorization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00727)
*Morgan Byrd,Robert Wright,Sehoon Ha*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出可控性因子化JEPA（CF-JEPA）世界模型，将潜空间分为可控与不可控子空间，把干扰信息隔离到不可控区域，从而在干扰环境下实现稳定控制并避免潜空间坍塌。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于视觉控制智能体需从无关背景信息中分离有用信息。JEPA式潜世界模型因不做像素级重建而看似适合该任务，但实际上仍对干扰信号敏感，并会出现潜空间坍塌（latent collapse）问题。

Method: CF-JEPA：一种JEPA式世界模型，将潜空间显式拆分为可控子空间与不可控子空间。把全部干扰信息捕获进不可控区域，仅用与控制相关的潜信息完成任务。

Result: 在2D与3D控制任务中，标称条件下性能与基线相当；在受干扰条件下性能更优，且CF-JEPA是唯一未出现潜空间坍塌的模型。并在受干扰条件下的仿真机器人任务中得到验证，体现其实用性。

Conclusion: 通过可控性因子化的潜空间划分，可有效隔离干扰信息、提升干扰鲁棒性并避免潜空间坍塌，适用于2D/3D控制及仿真机器人任务。

Abstract: Controlling an agent with vision requires being able to separate useful information from irrelevant background information. JEPA-style latent world models seem like a natural approach for this, as they do not perform pixel-level reconstruction; however, they are still sensitive to these distractor signals and experience latent collapse. In this work, we introduce Controllability Factorized JEPA (CF-JEPA), a JEPA-style world model which splits the latent space into controllable and uncontrollable subspaces. This factorization allows us to capture all the distractor information into the uncontrollable region, while we use the control-relevant latent information for our task. With this, we show comparable performance across 2D and 3D control tasks under nominal conditions and improved performance under distracted conditions, where CF-JEPA is the only model that does not experience latent collapse. We also validate our model under distracted conditions for a simulated robot task, highlighting the practical application of such a scheme.

</details>


### [298] [Measuring Asset and Scene Reconstruction Effects in Real-to-Sim Robot Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00731)
*Sanya Verma,Luca Cilio,Velissarios Christodoulou*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文通过构建同一双臂机器人单元的两套仿真重建（作者重建 vs 开源默认重建），验证高质量重建能否提升仿真与真实机器人评价的一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仿真评价因成本低、易重复而广泛用于机器人策略评估，但其价值取决于仿真结果与真实机器人结果的一致性，即sim-to-real gap。作者希望检验重建质量（视觉保真度、物理参数、度量尺度）是否能缩小这一差距。

Method: 构建同一双臂机器人单元的两套仿真版本：作者重建（度量尺度的物体几何、投影纹理、自编物理参数、自建场景splat）与默认重建（开源配方：单图生成式mesh、引擎默认物理、高斯splat场景）。两者使用相同的物体照片与场景视频。两个策略各跑五个任务，共十个task-policy组合（cells），每个cell在每种重建中各运行20次，其他设置固定。使用第三方评估者对相同真实试验打分，比较仿真与真实分数的相关性及误差。

Result: 作者重建的仿真与真实cell均值Pearson相关系数r=0.90，默认重建为r=0.51；平均分数误差分别为6.97个百分点与17.54个百分点，降低10.56个百分点。

Conclusion: 通过提升环境重建质量（更高视觉保真度、自编物理、度量尺度），可显著提高仿真对真实世界的忠实度并缩小sim-to-real gap。作者开源了测试框架、逐次试验分数、每次运行的配置以及两套重建的资产与场景。

Abstract: Simulated evaluation is increasingly used alongside real-world evaluation of robot policies because it is cheaper and easier to repeat; however, its value depends on how closely its outcomes track the real robot's. We test whether our reconstruction pipeline, combining metrically scaled object geometry, authored physical parameters and scene reconstruction, reduces disagreement between simulated and real robot scores relative to a default open-source recipe. We constructed two simulated versions of one bimanual robot cell: an authored reconstruction, using object geometry at estimated metric scale, projected textures, authored physics and our own scene splat; and a baseline, referred to as the default reconstruction, using the open-source recipe of a generative single-image mesh, engine-default physics and a Gaussian-splat scene. Both reconstructions use the same object photographs and scene video. Two policies ran five tasks each, giving ten task-policy pairs, which we call cells; each cell was run twenty times in each reconstruction with all other settings held fixed. Both reconstructions were scored against the same real trials, graded by a third-party evaluator. Pearson correlation between the ten simulated and real cell means is r = 0.90 for the authored reconstruction and 0.51 for the default. Mean score error is 6.97 percentage points for the authored reconstruction and 17.54 for the default, a reduction of 10.56 percentage points. These results show that improving the quality of the environment reconstruction through higher visual fidelity, authored physics and metric scale makes the simulation more faithful to the real world and narrows the sim-to-real gap. We release the harness, the per-trial scores, every reported run's configuration, and the assets and scenes of both reconstructions.

</details>


### [299] [DITTO-X: Forward and Reverse Teleoperation for Dexterous Manipulation and Human Intervention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00781)
*Zhanpeng He,Joaquin Palacios,Zhangyu Wang,Chenhao Li,Katelyn Lee,Matei Ciocarlie,C. Karen Liu,Jiajun Wu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: DITTO-X 是一种与手部硬件无关的灵巧遥操作系统，通过关节级力反馈与指尖接触事件驱动多种商用灵巧手，并支持"反向遥操作"使操作者在接管前已与机器人手姿态匹配，从而提升演示质量与吞吐量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有遥操作系统多数仅依靠视觉闭环且围绕平行夹爪构建，限制了机器人可执行的动作与操作者可表达的意图。这一问题在共享自主中尤为严重：操作者只能通过被遮挡的相机观察场景，还需在中途、往往已抓取物体的情况下接管灵巧手。

Method: 提出 DITTO-X：一种手部无关的灵巧遥操作接口。它利用机器人手上已有的传感器，渲染关节级力反馈与指尖接触事件，并驱动三款商用灵巧手（Sharpa、Wuji、Inspire），无需针对每种手重新设计。由于外骨骼是主动驱动的，系统还支持反向遥操作（reverse teleoperation）：在控制权转移前，由机器人反向驱动操作者手指至其自身构型，使人类进入回路时已与即将接管的机器人状态匹配。

Result: 实验表明，无论是在常规数据采集，还是在策略部署过程中对接触密集型操作任务进行人工干预时，DITTO-X 相比商用光学手部追踪手套均能提升演示质量与吞吐量。

Conclusion: DITTO-X 通过力/接触反馈的灵巧遥操作与反向遥操作机制，改善了灵巧操作演示采集与部署中的人工干预体验，为共享自主下的接触密集型任务提供了更具表达力且可跨硬件复用的遥操作方案。

Abstract: Teleoperated demonstrations are a primary source of data for robot manipulation, and teleoperated interventions are a primary mechanism for correcting policies at deployment. Yet most teleoperation systems close the loop through vision alone and are built around parallel-jaw grippers, limiting both what the robot can execute and what the operator can express through it. This is most damaging in shared autonomy, where the operator sees the scene only through occluded cameras and must take over a dexterous hand mid-task, often with an object already grasped. We present DITTO-X, a hand-agnostic dexterous teleoperation interface that renders joint-level force and fingertip contact events from sensing already on the robot hand, and drives three commercial dexterous hands (Sharpa, Wuji, and Inspire) without per-hand redesign. Because the exoskeleton is actuated, DITTO-X also supports reverse teleoperation, in which the robot back-drives the operator's fingers into its own configuration before control is transferred, so the human enters the loop already matched to the state they inherit. Our results show that DITTO-X improves demonstration quality and throughput over a commercial hand-tracking glove, both in regular data collection and in human intervention during policy deployment for contact-rich manipulation tasks. More information can be found from our website: https://tml.stanford.edu/ditto-x/.

</details>


### [300] [ECoMEM: Explicit Concept Memory for Memory-Dependent Robot Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00801)
*Yize Liu,Ke Wang,Mac Schwager,Yiqing Xu,Jiajun Wu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出显式概念记忆（ECoMEM），用可复用、有证据支撑的概念库表征任务相关历史，由Writer更新、Reader转成记忆token条件化VLA，在16个RoboMME任务中15项领先，真机两任务达86.1%成功率（无记忆VLA为8.6%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人常需回忆已不可见的目标、先前演示或已完成的任务步骤，而现有VLA策略一旦所需信息离开当前观测便失效，因此记忆对长时程机器人行为至关重要。已有方法多依赖更长历史或从观测-动作轨迹中隐式学习记忆，但动作监督只告诉策略"怎么动"，并不指明"该记住什么"——它既不规定哪些过去事实应持续保留，也不规定这些事实如何随新证据变化。

Method: 作者将"维护有证据支撑的过去记录"与"学习如何据此行动"分离，提出ECoMEM：以可复用的、有依据的概念库表示任务相关历史；由基于证据的Writer负责选择与更新这些记录，再由学习得到的Reader将其转化为记忆token，直接条件化VLA策略。

Result: 在16个RoboMME任务中，ECoMEM在15个任务上优于所评估的机器人策略；在两个新的真机任务上，同一记忆库或可直接迁移、或仅需新增一个概念，取得86.1%成功率，而无记忆VLA仅为8.6%。

Conclusion: 显式概念为机器人控制提供了可复用、可扩展的记忆接口。

Abstract: A robot may lose sight of an object it must later retrieve, need to recall what a person demonstrated earlier, or track which steps of a task it has already completed. Current vision-language-action (VLA) policies often fail once the information needed for action disappears from the current observation, making memory critical for long-horizon robot behavior. Existing approaches typically provide longer histories or learn implicit memory from observation-action trajectories. But action supervision tells a policy how to act, not what to remember: it does not specify which past facts should persist or how they should change as new evidence arrives. We therefore separate maintaining an evidence-grounded account of the past from learning how to act on it. This insight motivates Explicit Concept Memory (ECoMEM), which represents task-relevant history with a reusable library of grounded concepts. An evidence-based Writer selects and updates these records, while a learned Reader turns them into memory tokens that directly condition the VLA. Across 16 RoboMME tasks, ECoMEM leads the evaluated robot policies on 15 tasks. On two new real-robot tasks, the same memory library either transfers directly or requires only one new concept, achieving 86.1% success versus 8.6% for a no-memory VLA. These results show that explicit concepts provide a reusable and extensible memory interface for robot control. Project website: https://ecomem.github.io/

</details>


### [301] [Getting Out and Getting Back: World and Behavior Grounding in Real2Sim2Real Co-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00821)
*Samuel Liu,Youngsun Kim,Martin Matak,Gilwoo Lee*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 在动态灵巧抓取分拣任务中，世界锚定（world grounding）使协同训练平均成功率提升18个百分点，行为锚定（behavior grounding）提升10个百分点，完全锚定可使成功率从52%升至86%；二者作用互补。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仿真是缓解真实示教稀缺的重要手段，但仿真世界的保真度与仿真行为与人类行为的相似度各自如何影响策略性能尚不清楚，缺乏对两类"锚定"作用的解耦分析。

Method: 区分"世界锚定"（使仿真与真实系统对齐）与"行为锚定"（使仿真轨迹与人类运动对齐），构建real2sim2real流水线，独立地在这两个维度上变化以生成协同训练数据；并通过潜空间分析考察部署策略的行为来源。

Result: 在动态灵巧抓取分拣任务上，完全锚定的协同训练将成功率从52%提升至86%；跨配置平均，世界锚定带来18个百分点提升，行为锚定带来10个百分点。潜空间分析显示，部署策略行为类似真实派生与仿真派生策略的混合：在有真实数据覆盖的状态上模仿真实示教，其余状态依赖仿真行为。

Conclusion: 世界锚定与行为锚定具有互补作用：世界锚定让策略能在真实数据覆盖范围之外利用仿真经验，行为锚定则主要在世界锚定不完美时发挥作用；对协同训练基础模型而言，带锚定的仿真依然有益。

Abstract: Simulation can expand scarce real demonstrations for co-training, yet how world fidelity and similarity to human behavior affect policy performance remains unclear. We distinguish world grounding, which aligns simulation with the real system, and behavior grounding, which aligns simulated trajectories with human motion. We build a real2sim2real pipeline that varies these axes independently to generate data for co-training. On a dynamic dexterous pick-and-sort task, fully grounded co-training raises success from 52% to 86%; averaged across configurations, world grounding improves success by 18 percentage points and behavior grounding by 10. Deployed policies behave like a mixture of real-derived and simulation-derived policies, imitating real demonstrations in covered states and relying on simulated behavior elsewhere, which we examine through latent-space analysis. Together, these results suggest complementary roles: world grounding lets policies use simulated experience beyond real-data coverage, while behavior grounding matters mainly when world grounding is imperfect. Grounded simulation remains beneficial when co-training foundation models.

</details>


### [302] [TRACE: Privacy-Preserving Next-Best-View Selection over Distributed 3D Gaussian-Splat Maps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00822)
*Amirhossein Mollaei Khass,Athanasios Cosse,Qiyu Sun,Nader Motee*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出TRACE协议，让多机器人各自维护私有3DGS地图，仅通过交换两条光线量的深度分箱聚合与位姿导数，实现去中心化的下一最佳视角选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多机器人团队各自维护私有的3D Gaussian Splatting地图，视角选择的期望信息增益（EIG）依赖其他机器人的地图（遮挡与背景辐射），但没有任何单个机器人拥有全局"池化地图"，因此需要一种不共享地图的去中心化方案。

Method: 证明增益耦合仅通过两个光线量传递：splat前方的透射率与其后方的辐射度，且二者都是光线命中点的求和，可跨机器人分解。各机器人在自身地图中沿候选视角光线按深度分箱求和，并附上对位姿的导数发送；规划视角的机器人据此在SO(3)上还原EIG及其梯度。消息大小不随地图规模增长。

Result: 证明重建是精确的，除非某splat后方的深度分箱混入了两个机器人的命中点，并给出了相应误差界。在Habitat-Sim上超过100次下一最佳视角决策中，TRACE有83.3%的朝向落在集中式决策的15度以内，其视角达到集中式EIG的97.9%。

Conclusion: TRACE在不共享任何splat、通信量恒定的前提下，以可证的精确性与有界误差近似集中式的下一最佳视角选择性能，验证了"共享光而非地图"的去中心化协作范式。

Abstract: Share the light, not the map. We study next-best-view selection for a team of robots, each of which builds its own 3D Gaussian Splatting map and keeps it private. A robot picks the view with the largest expected information gain (EIG) about the splats along its own path. This gain depends on the other maps. Their splats occlude its own and shine behind them, so the gain has to be evaluated against the pooled map. No robot has this map. We show that the coupling passes through only two ray quantities, the transmittance in front of a splat and the radiance behind it, and that both are sums over the hits of the ray. Hence, they decompose across the robots, and each robot sums them over depth bins in its own map, along the rays of a candidate view, and sends the sums with their pose derivatives. The robot planning the view turns them into its EIG and gradient on SO(3). Transmittance and Radiance Aggregates, communicated for the EIG, give the protocol its name: TRACE. No robot shares its splats, and the message size does not grow with a map.
