### [370] [Authorization for Self-Modifying AI Agent Populations: Conserving Authority across Replacement, Forking, and Rollback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00347)
*Genliang Zhu,Chu Wang*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出"授权继承"（authorization succession），用清单绑定、谱系记账、阶段性预留、分区式分叉与原子交接，在自我修改AI智能体世代森林中守恒权威，实现群体安全继承、分叉守恒、撤销闭包、原子交接与回滚不重铸。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自我修改的AI智能体可以替换、分叉和回滚携带身份的软件，而其后代仍可执行。逐后继授权无法约束由此产生的整体群体：兄弟智能体可能重复配额、合并权限、在祖先被切断后存活，或在晋升期间与前任重叠。因此需要一种在单一父代世代森林的活跃前沿上守恒权威的授权机制。

Method: 提出授权继承机制。外部协议将每一代绑定到清单、根、唯一父代、完整谱系和全新群体序列；以独立不变量约束根生命周期消耗与当前群体暴露；采用阶段性预留在替换时冻结前任残余权威；采用分区式分叉验证完整子代家族；每次提交原子性地围栏前任并激活后继。祖先切断使依赖后代失效；回滚生成新世代而不恢复已消耗权威；新根需要独立授权。

Result: 在完全中介、认证记录、可靠效应抽象、持久单调状态和完整谱系记账假设下，证明了群体安全继承、分叉守恒、撤销闭包、原子交接、回滚不重铸以及排除自认证。可执行评估覆盖32项注册决策（直接调用与邮箱映射，64/64重放，28允许/36拒绝）；独立检查器接受全部64条原始轨迹并拒绝28/28语义变异体；12/12配置文件不变量、16/16崩溃切断和32/32竞争者调度通过；两个外部适配器在OurArk和Darwin Gödel Machine变异上复现全部32项决策。

Conclusion: 结果确立了面向已注册受保护效应的授权继承机制的有效性。

Abstract: Self-modifying AI agents can replace, fork, and roll back identity-bearing software while descendants remain executable. Per-successor authorization does not constrain the resulting population: siblings may duplicate quotas, combine permissions, survive ancestor cuts, or overlap predecessors during promotion. We define authorization succession, which conserves authority across the active frontier of a single-parent generation forest.
  Our external protocol binds each generation to a manifest, root, unique parent, complete lineage, and fresh population sequence. Separate invariants bound root-lifetime consumption and current population exposure. A staged reservation freezes predecessor residual authority during replacement, while a partitioning fork validates the complete child family. Each commit atomically fences the predecessor and activates successors. Ancestor cuts invalidate dependent descendants; rollback creates a fresh generation without restoring spent authority; and a new root requires an independent grant. Under complete mediation, authenticated records, sound effect abstraction, durable monotone state, and complete lineage accounting, we prove population-safe succession, fork conservation, revocation closure, atomic handoff, rollback non-reminting, and exclusion of self-certification.
  An executable evaluation covers 32 registered decisions through direct-call and mailbox mappings (64/64 replays; 28 allows, 36 denies). An independent checker accepts all 64 original traces and rejects 28/28 semantic mutants; 12/12 profile invariants, 16/16 crash cuts, and 32/32 contender schedules pass. Two external adapters reproduce all 32 decisions around measured OurArk and Darwin Godel Machine mutations, including fresh-process restart, atomic succession, and predecessor rejection. The results establish authorization succession for registered protected effects.

</details>


### [371] [Removing the NEEDLE in the Haystack: Backdoor Removal in LLMs via Weight Orthogonalisation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00348)
*Minoo Kim,Vasileios Lampos,George Drayson*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: NEEDLE：一种无需训练的定向后门移除方法，通过估计后门方向与拒绝子空间并施加顺序权重正交化，在保持能力与安全性的同时显著降低攻击成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有针对LLM的后门防御在移除后门时，会无意中将模型输出分布偏移到良性提示上，导致模型性能与安全性下降。因此需要一种能够定向移除后门、同时不损害拒绝相关表示与整体能力的防御方法。

Method: 提出NEEDLE，一种training-free的后门移除方法。在识别出trigger后，通过激活向量估计后门方向（backdoor direction）与拒绝子空间（refusal subspace），进而施加顺序权重正交化（sequential weight orthogonalisation），在抑制后门的同时防止拒绝相关表示发生改变。该方法无需干净参考模型，也不需要原始投毒训练数据。

Result: 在多个模型家族与多种攻击类型上进行评估。NEEDLE在所评估的防御方法中取得最低的平均攻击成功率（ASR），在具有挑战性的代码注入攻击上达到0%；同时KL散度最低，能力与安全性变化最小。

Conclusion: NEEDLE通过权重正交化实现无训练、无需参考模型与投毒数据的定向后门移除，在保持模型能力与安全性的前提下有效抑制后门，优于现有防御方法。

Abstract: Backdoor attacks can be implanted in Large Language Models (LLMs) during training, causing unwanted behaviour when a trigger appears in the input. Existing backdoor defences for LLMs attempt to remove the backdoor but inadvertently shift the model's output distribution to benign prompts, which can result in degraded model performance and safety. We propose NEEDLE, a training-free method for targeted backdoor removal. Once a trigger has been identified, our method estimates a backdoor direction and a refusal subspace through activation vectors, then applies sequential weight orthogonalisation to suppress the backdoor while preventing changes in refusal-related representations. NEEDLE requires neither a clean reference model nor the original poisoned training data. Evaluation is conducted across multiple model families and attack types. NEEDLE achieves the lowest mean Attack Success Rate (ASR) among the evaluated defences, including 0% on challenging code injection attacks, while resulting in the lowest KL divergence and minimal changes in capability and safety.

</details>


### [372] [Proof-Gated Signing: Solver-Checked Transaction Guards that Hold Under State Drift for Onchain AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00354)
*Bravish Ghosh*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 针对AI钱包代理的签名前检查存在“状态漂移”盲区，本文提出Proof-Gated Signing（PGS）：仿真交易、在预言机不确定区间内用SMT求解器验证声明式价值-权限策略，并编译链上后置条件由智能合约钱包原子强制执行，从而在任意漂移下保证执行交易满足策略。260场景测试中，PGS阻止93.6%有害场景、通过97.5%良性场景，50个漂移场景无一产生攻击者收益，开销约41k gas、0.1–0.2秒/次。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI代理控制钱包时会读取攻击者可触及的内容，因而可能被诱导提出有害交易。现有签名前防线（静态白名单、LLM审查、交易仿真）共享同一缺陷：检查描述的是检查时刻的链上状态，而交易却在稍后、可由对手通过抢跑、合约升级或代币参数变更塑造的状态中执行——即“状态漂移”，导致检查结论失效。

Method: 提出Proof-Gated Signing：先仿真拟议交易并抽取其效果；在预言机不确定区间内，对每一个价格用SMT求解器核查声明式的价值-权限策略；随后编译链上后置条件（钱包余额界限、收款方到账、授权额度上限、所有权），并证明任何满足这些后置条件的执行也满足策略；由代理的智能合约钱包原子化强制执行这些后置条件。

Result: 在260个场景的开放测试台（14类攻击家族，含5类漂移与2类自适应家族，以及12类良性家族）上，以攻击者余额而非策略判定危害：PGS阻止了140个有害场景中的93.6%，通过97.5%的良性场景；仅仿真检查为57.9%，静态白名单为71.4%；50个漂移场景在PGS下均未产生攻击者收益。唯一未被阻止的家族是“策略内抽干”，其损失由每会话预算约束。此外发现，向LLM审查者提供干净的漂移前仿真反而使其更易批准漂移攻击。开销约41k gas、0.1–0.2秒/次检查。

Conclusion: 通过将策略验证与链上原子执行的后置条件相绑定，PGS把签名前检查的保证从“检查时刻状态”扩展到“任意状态漂移下的实际执行交易”，显著优于仅仿真检查与静态白名单，并覆盖全部漂移场景；残余风险可由会话预算限制。研究还提示，给LLM审查者提供漂移前仿真存在反效果，需谨慎设计审查输入的时态一致性。

Abstract: AI agents that control wallets read attacker-reachable content, so they can be steered into proposing harmful transactions. The usual last line of defense is a pre-signing check: a static allowlist, an LLM reviewer, or a transaction simulation. All three share a gap: the check describes the chain state at check time, but the transaction executes in a later state that an adversary can shape through front-running, contract upgrades or token-parameter changes. We call this state drift. We present Proof-Gated Signing (PGS), which simulates a proposed transaction, extracts its effects, and uses an SMT solver to check a declarative value-and-permission policy for every price in an oracle-uncertainty band. It then compiles on-chain post-conditions (wallet balance bounds, payee receipts, allowance caps and ownership) and proves that every execution satisfying them also satisfies the policy. The agent's smart-contract wallet enforces them atomically, so the guarantee applies to the executed transaction under arbitrary drift. On an open testbed of 260 scenarios (14 attack families including five drift and two adaptive families, and 12 benign families), with harm measured from attacker balances rather than from any policy, PGS prevented 93.6% of the 140 harmful scenarios and passed 97.5% of the benign ones. Simulation-only checking prevented 57.9% and a static allowlist 71.4%. None of the 50 drift scenarios produced attacker gain under PGS. The only unprevented family, an in-policy drain, was bounded by the per-session budget. We also find that giving an LLM reviewer a clean pre-drift simulation made it more likely to approve a drift attack. Overhead is about 41k gas and 0.1-0.2 s per check.

</details>


### [373] [On the Relationship between Model Quantization and Model Inversion Attacks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00382)
*Rongke Liu,Youwen Zhu*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 该论文研究模型量化对模型反演攻击的影响机制，并提出一种隐私感知的后训练量化方法，在恢复精度的同时提升反演抵抗能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量化会改变模型输出与中间特征，从而可能影响模型反演攻击的效果，但量化如何影响反演、以及数据特性如何调节这种关系尚不明确。论文旨在厘清这两个问题，并据此设计兼顾效用与隐私的量化方案。

Method: 理论层面，界定量化引起的输入与分类变量（由预测概率定义）之间互信息的变化，区分信息效应与攻击优化障碍；数据层面，分析特征分布与反演结果的数据依赖性变化，发现4比特处量化敏感性差异显著。据此提出隐私感知后训练量化：采用Fisher型任务敏感度代理进行预算感知比特分配，校准激活范围，并以任务恢复与几何保持为目标联合优化权重/激活尺度与权重舍入决策，并加入尺度与舍入正则化。

Result: 在多种指标、网络架构及人脸、掌纹、虹膜识别任务上验证。ResNet-50上掌纹4比特使RL-MIA严格成功率从54%降至26%，精度相对FP32从99.01%降至96.55%；在虹膜4.5比特上叠加SSD（ε=0.1）使BREP-MI严格成功率从63.33%降至37.33%，精度相对仅量化从92.8%降至87.6%。

Conclusion: 量化对模型反演的影响可由信息效应与优化障碍共同解释，且具有显著的数据依赖性和比特位敏感性；所提隐私感知后训练量化能在有限精度损失下有效提升反演抵抗，并可与输出级防御（如SSD）协同。

Abstract: Model quantization reduces the numerical precision of neural network weights and activations to lower storage and computational costs. Model inversion attacks recover or reconstruct sensitive training data or inference inputs from model outputs or intermediate features, so quantization may also alter their effectiveness. However, two questions remain unresolved: How does model quantization affect model inversion? How do data characteristics influence this relationship? To address the first, we bound quantization-induced changes in mutual information between inputs and a categorical variable defined by prediction probabilities, distinguishing informational effects from attack optimization obstacles. To address the second, we identify data-dependent changes in feature distributions and inversion outcomes, with pronounced quantization sensitivity differences at 4 bits. These insights guide a privacy-aware post-training quantization method that improves inversion resistance while recovering utility. It uses a Fisher-type task-sensitivity proxy for budget-aware bit allocation, calibrates activation ranges, and jointly optimizes weight and activation scales and weight-rounding decisions with task-recovery and geometry-retention objectives and scale and rounding regularization. Experiments cover multiple metrics, neural network architectures, and face, palmprint, and iris recognition tasks. On ResNet-50, Palm at 4 bits reduces RL-MIA's strict success from 54% to 26%, while accuracy decreases from 99.01% to 96.55% relative to FP32. Our method also supports output-level defenses: adding Stealthy Shield Defense (SSD, epsilon = 0.1) to Iris at 4.5 bits reduces BREP-MI's strict success from 63.33% to 37.33%, while accuracy decreases from 92.8% to 87.6% relative to quantization alone.

</details>


### [374] [From A2A Attacks to Envelope-Layer Defense: Red-Teaming Evaluation of LLM Agents and a Three-Layer Isomorphic Attack-Defense Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00392)
*Yuelin Han*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 该文针对智能体交互协议（如 ACP、A2A）引入的多智能体协作安全威胁，提出攻击原则 A2A-TIBA、评测方法 GDA Measurement 及同构攻防模型 ELA-ITL，并验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于 LLM 的智能体通过 A2A 等协议开展多智能体协作时，来自远程对等方的任务被视为合法请求，形成间接提示注入的天然通道。现有评测多依赖单一指标攻击成功率（ASR），无法区分攻击失败是源于 LLM 识别了恶意内容，还是智能体层机制拦截了执行，导致防御效果刻画粗糙。

Method: 提出 A2A-TIBA 攻击原则，将间接提示注入与绕过规避结合，通过植入—命令—窃取步骤诱导目标智能体部署回调交互程序，再绕过智能体直接下发命令；设计 GDA Measurement 红队测试床方法，包含经 LLM 网关的原始上下文捕获、双份数据保留与基于智能体的自主评判；提出 Class A/B/C/D 四类攻击结果，将 ASR 细化为语义拒绝率、语义突破率、拦截率与穿透率；进一步提出三层同构攻防模型 ELA-ITL，将防御划分为信封打包、LLM 识别与智能体拦截，将攻击划分为植入通道、提示优化与执行机制。

Result: 在 15 种智能体前端 × LLM 后端组合上进行测试，并构建 1000 条样本数据集，验证了 A2A-TIBA 的攻击有效性与 GDA Measurement 的评测有效性；同时确认在 A2A、工具、记忆等通道的信封打包中增加恶意提示标签，可显著提升 LLM 对恶意内容的识别能力。研究还揭示了信封层作为恶意内容进入智能体的通道，是一种新的防御维度。

Conclusion: 该工作将智能体安全评测从单一 ASR 拓展为多维结果度量，明确了信封层这一新防御维度，并以 ELA-ITL 同构模型统一刻画攻防层次；后续可通过信封打包中引入恶意提示标签等方式增强 LLM 识别，提升智能体系统的整体安全性。

Abstract: Agent interaction protocols such as ACP and A2A have moved LLM-based agents toward multi-agent collaboration, introducing new security threats. A task sent by a remote peer over A2A is treated as a legitimate request, providing a natural channel for indirect prompt injection. Existing agent security evaluations mostly rely on a single metric, the attack success rate (ASR), and cannot distinguish whether an attack failed because the LLM recognized the malicious content or because a mechanism at the agent layer blocked execution. To address this, we propose A2A-TIBA, an attack principle combining indirect prompt injection with bypass circumvention. Through implant-command-exfiltration steps, it induces the target agent to deploy a callback interaction program, after which the attacker issues commands bypassing the agent. To evaluate defenses finer, we design GDA Measurement, a red-team testbed method using raw context capture via an LLM gateway, dual data preservation, and agent-based autonomous judging. We propose four attack outcomes, Class A/B/C/D, extending ASR into semantic refusal rate, semantic breach rate, interception rate, and penetration rate. Experiments reveal the envelope layer -- the channel through which malicious content enters an agent -- as a new defense dimension. We accordingly propose ELA-ITL, a three-layer isomorphic attack-defense model, dividing defense into envelope packaging, LLM recognition, and agent interception, and attack into implant channel, prompt optimization, and execution mechanism. Testing on 15 agent front-end x LLM back-end combinations and building a 1,000-case dataset verifies the attack effectiveness of A2A-TIBA, the evaluation validity of GDA Measurement, and confirms that adding malicious prompt labels to envelope packaging such as A2A, tool, and memory channels significantly improves LLM recognition of malicious content.

</details>


### [375] [ZoneClaw: Mitigating Persistent Memory Attacks by Establishing Memory-Zoning in OpenClaw-Style Computer-Use Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00450)
*Haokai Ma,Chieh Lin,Yupeng Qiu,Ee-Chien Chang*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 论文提出 ZoneClaw，通过将扁平的工作区记忆替换为带显式权限等级的层级信任区，把"持久化"与"权限"解耦，从而防御持久化记忆攻击（PM 攻击），将 ASR 从 372/480 降至 6/480，同时保持效用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: OpenClaw 风格的计算机使用代理（CUA）以自动重载文件形式实现持久工作区记忆，用户指令、系统摘要与外部声明处于同一权限等级，使得"记住某声明"即赋予其支配后续行为的权威。攻击者仅控制看似无害的外部内容，即可在合法任务中诱导 CUA 写入有利于攻击者的声明，这些声明随后会支配攻击者从未接触过的良性任务，形成"恶意上下文 → 记忆注入 → 恶意执行"的跨环境威胁链。现有防御要么作用于内容进入记忆之前，要么作用于其后续诱发的具体动作，均未审视已存储内容是否有权指导行为。

Method: ZoneClaw 将持久化与权限分离：用携带显式权限等级的层级信任区替代扁平工作区记忆；外部声明仅持久化于低信任区，只有跨越显式权限边界才能获得指导行动的权威；升级时需与攻击者无法直接写入的信任区进行交叉校验；并通过非对称权限的角色专用进程强制执行该边界，确保没有任何进程同时具备"摄入外部内容"和"向外行动"两种能力。

Result: 在四个攻击场景、两种注入设置和四种骨干模型下，ZoneClaw 将 ASR 从 372/480 降至 6/480，同时在 458/480 次试验中保持效用，并对部分具备防御意识的攻击者依然有效。攻击者声明仍存于低信任记忆，但极少跨越权限边界，表明 ZoneClaw 是"不予授权"而非"拒绝从环境学习"。

Conclusion: ZoneClaw 通过信任分区与权限边界机制，有效缓解了 CUA 持久化记忆攻击，在几乎不损失任务效用的前提下大幅压低攻击成功率，且对部分规避型攻击者仍具鲁棒性，证明"分离持久化与权威"是一种可行且可推广的防御范式。

Abstract: Computer-use agents increasingly operate as long-running assistants through persistent workspace memory, which OpenClaw-style CUAs realize as automatically reloaded files that hold user instructions, system summaries, and external claims at the same privilege level. Here, remembering a claim confers authority over later behavior. This enables a persistent memory attack, in which an attacker who controls only benign-looking external content induces the CUA to record attacker-favored claims during a legitimate task, and those claims later govern benign tasks the attacker never touches. The attack chain extends "malicious context -> malicious response" into "malicious context -> memory injection -> malicious execution", making this a cross-environment threat. Existing defenses studied intervene either before content enters memory or at the action it later induces, not whether stored content may guide action. We propose ZoneClaw, which separates persistence from authority by replacing flat workspace memory with hierarchical trust zones carrying explicit authority levels. External claims persist in a low-trust zone and acquire action-guiding authority only by crossing an explicit authority boundary, at which promotion is cross-checked against zones the attacker cannot directly write. Role-specific processes of asymmetric privilege enforce this boundary, ensuring that no process both ingests external content and acts outward. Across four attack scenarios, two injection settings, and four backbones, ZoneClaw drives ASR from 372/480 to 6/480 while retaining utility in 458/480 trials, and remains effective against some defense-aware attackers. Attacker claims still persist in low-trust memory yet rarely cross the authority boundary, showing that ZoneClaw withholds authority rather than refusing to learn from the environment. Our code is available at: https://github.com/euph00/ZoneClaw-code.

</details>


### [376] [Harbormaster: Evidence-Gated, Replay-Safe Maritime Anomaly Detection on AWS](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00519)
*Arun Sharma*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出并实现了面向 AIS 异常检测的生产型系统 Harbormaster，遵循物理校验优先、幂等投影、模型分级发布三条规则，并给出变更日志重放的幂等性证明与有界 AWS 实测数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AIS 上报的船舶位置可能虚假或缺失；运营人员在处理异常告警时，需要告警可归因、可复核，且能在故障后可恢复，因此系统设计必须保证可验证性与可恢复性。

Method: Harbormaster 在 AWS 上实现三条规则：1）每条上报先做物理校验再运行学习模型；2）DynamoDB 读存储是 PostgreSQL 的幂等投影，每次写入以变更日志序列号（LSN）守卫；3）候选模型须通过留出集门槛与影子对比后才能进入金丝雀发布，每步用燃烧率检查守卫。论文证明了变更日志任意前缀或后缀重放后，每个投影键仍保持其最高已应用 LSN 对应的值。

Result: 有界 AWS 窗口内，1 小时浸泡测试 36,000 次请求返回 35,999 个 HTTP 200，客户端 p95 延迟 142.751 ms；另一次 900 s 运行中流路径承受 400 条/秒突发，消费者滞后最终归零。

Conclusion: 该设计在不覆盖的效应（如重复缓存失效、重复审计行）之外保证了投影幂等性；论文为每个数值标注测量位置，并列出从未构建的设计部分，强调结果边界与工程诚实性。

Abstract: Ships broadcast their positions through the Automatic Identification System (AIS), and those reports can be false or missing. An operator who acts on an anomaly alert needs that alert to be attributable, reviewable, and recoverable after a failure. This paper describes Harbormaster, a production-shaped system on AWS that follows three rules. Physics checks run on every report before any learned model runs. The DynamoDB read store is an idempotent projection of PostgreSQL, and a guard on the log sequence number (LSN) of each change protects every write to it. A candidate model must pass a holdout gate and a shadow comparison before a canary gives it traffic, and a burn-rate check guards each canary step. The paper proves that replaying any prefix or suffix of the change log leaves each projected key at the value of its highest applied LSN. It also notes effects this result does not cover, such as repeated cache invalidations and repeated audit rows. In a bounded AWS window, a one-hour soak returned 35,999 HTTP 200 responses to 36,000 requests, with a 95th-percentile (p95) client latency of 142.751 ms. In a separate bounded AWS run of 900 s, the stream path received a burst of 400 records/s, and its consumer lag later drained to zero. Every number in the paper carries a label that says where it was measured, and the paper lists the parts of the design that were never built.

</details>


### [377] [No One Architecture Fits All: A Cross-Environment Evaluation of Hierarchical Red Team Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00557)
*Ayan Javeed Shaikh,Arunesh Sinha,Nathaniel D. Bastian,Ankit Shah*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 在CybORG CAGE-4与两种规模的Cyberwheel环境中，对纯RL（RL+RL）与纯LLM（LLM+LLM）分层红队架构进行受控跨环境比较，发现性能出现环境依赖的"反转"，其根源是各架构特有的杀伤链瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主红队智能体需要规划与执行两种能力，RL与LLM各有所长，已有研究将其组合为混合分层架构。但这类架构通常只在单一环境中开发与评估，因此无法判断所观察到的优势源于普遍更强的决策机制，还是仅仅适配了特定环境。本文旨在填补这一泛化性验证的空白。

Method: 构建两种"同质"分层红队架构作对照：RL规划器+RL执行器（RL+RL）与LLM规划器+LLM执行器（LLM+LLM）；在CybORG CAGE-4和Cyberwheel（两种网络规模）中，对战专家级自主防御方，覆盖18种配置，并采用统一的破坏（disruption）指标进行横向比较；辅以杀伤链（kill-chain）分析定位各阶段瓶颈。

Result: 出现显著的环境依赖反转：在紧凑、奖励密集的CAGE-4中RL+RL占优，破坏成功率78.5%，最强LLM配置仅18.0%；在100主机Cyberwheel中RL+RL亦领先（81.0% vs 50.5%）；而在更大、需逐级升级（escalation-gated）的1010主机Cyberwheel中，经预训练的网络安全LLM智能体反超（55.0% vs RL的0.0%）。杀伤链分析显示：1010主机网络中RL能发现并攻陷主机却卡在权限提升阶段；CAGE-4中LLM智能体虽获得特权访问，却极少转化为实际作战影响。

Conclusion: 单一环境得出的结论不具泛化性；架构优劣取决于具体失效模式。混合规划器-执行器设计应由明确的失败模式驱动，而非预设某种架构普遍更优。

Abstract: Autonomous red team agents increasingly stress-test AI-enabled cyber defenses by planning strategy and executing multistage attacks. Reinforcement learning (RL) and large language models (LLMs) offer complementary mechanisms for the planning and execution such agents require, and prior work has combined them in hybrid hierarchies. Yet a given architecture is typically developed and evaluated within a single environment, leaving open whether an observed advantage reflects a generally stronger decision mechanism or merely alignment with a particular setting. We address this gap with a controlled cross-environment comparison of two homogeneous hierarchical red team architectures: an RL planner with an RL executor (RL+RL) and an LLM planner with an LLM executor (LLM+LLM). We evaluate both against expert autonomous defenders in CybORG CAGE-4 and in Cyberwheel at two network scales, across 18 configurations under one unified disruption metric. We find a pronounced environment-dependent inversion. RL+RL wins the compact, densely rewarded CAGE-4 (78.5% disruption success versus 18.0% for the strongest LLM configuration) and the 100-host Cyberwheel network (81.0% versus 50.5%), while a pretrained cybersecurity LLM agent wins the larger, escalation-gated 1010-host Cyberwheel network (55.0% versus 0.0% for RL). A kill-chain analysis explains the inversion through architecture-specific bottlenecks that aggregate success rates conceal.In the 1010-host Cyberwheel network, RL discovers and compromises hosts but stalls at privilege escalation, whereas in CAGE-4, LLM agents obtain privileged access but rarely convert it into operational impact. These results indicate that conclusions drawn in a single environment may not generalize, and that hybrid planner-executor designs should be motivated by specific failure modes rather than the assumption that one architecture is universally preferable.

</details>


### [378] [Progressive-Resolution Secure Aggregation for Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00695)
*Seyed Mohammad Azimi-Abarghouyi*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出并形式化了一种"渐进分辨率安全聚合"新功能：客户端只需上传一次，服务器便可在后续逐步获得同一聚合结果的更精细分辨率，而无需客户端重新参与；并给出实现方案PSA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统安全聚合协议在客户端上传时即固定了聚合精度，无法在客户端不再参与的情况下提升精度。作者希望打破这一限制，使聚合结果能够按需、分层次地释放更细精度。

Method: 提出渐进分辨率安全聚合（PSA）：将每个经过裁剪与抖动（clipped, dithered）的更新表示为兼容的嵌套格数字（nested-lattice digits）；将可分别释放的层通过安全聚合保护，并引入额外的聚合填充（aggregate pad），该填充在非串通的释放控制器（release controller）授权该层之前对服务器不可见。

Result: 实现了所提出的渐进分辨率安全聚合功能：客户端单次上传后，各精细层可由释放控制器逐层授权解密，服务器在未获授权时无法获得对应层的聚合信息。

Conclusion: 该工作为安全聚合引入了渐进分辨率这一新维度，通过嵌套格数字表示与分层可释放的聚合填充机制，在不增加客户端参与次数的前提下支持聚合精度按需逐级提升。

Abstract: Secure aggregation lets a server recover an aggregate of client updates without observing any individual update, but conventional protocols fix the aggregate precision when clients upload. We introduce and formulate a new progressive-resolution secure-aggregation functionality in which clients upload once and successively finer resolutions of the same aggregate can later be authorized without renewed client participation. To realize this functionality, we propose progressive-resolution secure aggregation (PSA): each clipped, dithered update is represented by compatible nested-lattice digits; separately releasable layers are protected by secure aggregation and an additional aggregate pad that remains unavailable to the server until a non-colluding release controller authorizes that layer.

</details>


### [379] [Towards Hierarchical Cyber Defense with Large Language Models: From Planning to Execution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00590)
*Harshith Doppalapudi,Nathaniel D. Bastian,Ankit Shah*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文研究冻结的零样本大语言模型（LLM）能否在分层网络防御中实现免重训练的控制，以及将 LLM 控制从规划扩展到执行时性能如何变化。在 Cyberwheel 环境中的实验表明，仅用 LLM 替换规划器收益有限，而将 LLM 控制扩展到执行层可显著提升性能；一个冻结的通用 70B 模型在三种网络规模下均将成功横向移动控制在约 1% 的步数内、攻击者影响接近零。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于强化学习的自主网络防御器通常与训练时所用网络绑定，当网络规模变化时泛化能力受限；分层强化学习虽通过分离战略目标选择与战术执行降低了决策复杂度，但并未消除重复训练依赖。因此作者希望探究冻结的零样本 LLM 能否提供免重训练的分层网络防御控制。

Method: 作者提出一个与控制器无关的"规划器-执行器"分层框架：规划器在固定时间范围内选择要防御的子网，执行器在该子网内选择防御动作。基于高保真 Cyberwheel 环境（内置映射到 MITRE ATT&CK 的自动红队智能体），对比 RL+RL、LLM+RL 和 LLM+LLM 三种配置，使用 6 个 3B 到 70B 参数的模型（含两个网络安全专用模型），并在小型、中型、大型网络上进行评估。

Result: 随着网络规模增大，仅将规划器替换为 LLM 带来的收益有限。相比之下，将 LLM 控制扩展到执行层，对能力足够强的模型可产生显著改进。例如，一个冻结的通用 70B 模型在三种网络规模下使用相同权重，将成功横向移动控制在约 1% 的步数内、攻击者影响接近零，而 RL 基线需针对每种规模重新训练。

Conclusion: 结果表明，能力足够强的冻结 LLM 无需任务特定的重训练即可在所评估的网络规模上保持较强防御性能，同时也说明强大的战术执行能力对于实现基于 LLM 的控制优势至关重要。

Abstract: An autonomous cyber defender trained with reinforcement learning (RL) is typically tied to the network on which it was trained, limiting its ability to generalize as network scale changes. Hierarchical RL reduces decision complexity by separating strategic targeting from tactical execution, but it does not eliminate this retraining dependence. We investigate whether frozen, zero-shot large language models (LLMs) can provide retraining-free control in hierarchical cyber defense and how performance changes as LLM control is extended from planning to execution. We formulate a controller-agnostic planner-executor hierarchy in which the planner selects a subnet to defend over a fixed horizon and the executor selects defensive actions within that subnet. Using the high fidelity Cyberwheel environment, with its built-in automated red team agent mapped to the MITRE ATT&CK framework, we compare RL+RL, LLM+RL, and LLM+LLM configurations using six models ranging from 3B to 70B parameters, including two cybersecurity-specialized models, across small, medium, and large networks. Replacing only the planner with an LLM yields limited gains as network size increases. In contrast, extending LLM control to execution produces notable improvements for sufficiently capable models. For instance, a frozen general purpose 70B model holds successful lateral movement to approximately 1% of steps and attacker impact near zero across all three network scales using the same model weights, while the RL baseline is retrained for each scale. Our results show that sufficiently capable frozen LLMs can maintain strong defensive performance across the evaluated network scales without task-specific retraining, while also indicating that strong tactical execution is important to realizing the benefits of LLM-based control.

</details>


### [380] [Crossing the Cyber Divide: Sim-to-Sim and Sim-to-Real Transfer for RL Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00759)
*Sabrina Saika,Yinuo Du,Aritran Piplai*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 该论文研究跨网络攻防仿真环境的策略迁移问题，提出将状态对齐与动作转换分离的框架，实现策略零样本迁移，并在四个平台上验证可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 网络攻击智能体通常在单一仿真器中训练与评估，由于各网络仿真器在状态表示、观测模型和动作空间上差异显著，导致策略能否跨环境迁移不明确，既妨碍部署也影响公平比较。作者认为仿真器到仿真器、仿真器到真实的迁移本质上是相同的对齐问题。

Method: 提出一个将状态对齐（state alignment）与动作转换（action translation）解耦的迁移框架，使在某一环境中训练的策略无需重训练即可在另一环境运行。在CyberBattleSim、NetSecGame、CyberWheel和NASim四个网络平台（含NASim中的仿真部署）上评估迁移效果。

Result: 零样本迁移可行：在高度对齐的环境中完全保持源策略性能；源性能为60.5%的策略迁移后胜率达45.2%；在仿真虚拟机环境中，迁移策略与原生策略的Jensen-Shannon散度为0.085，表明行为高度相似。

Conclusion: 仿真器间与仿真器到真实的策略迁移可统一为对齐问题，通过状态对齐与动作转换分离的框架可实现有效的零样本跨环境策略迁移，为网络攻防智能体的部署与公平比较提供支持。代码与基准已开源。

Abstract: Cyber attack agents are typically trained and evaluated within a single simulator, making it unclear whether learned policies transfer beyond the environments in which they were developed. This limitation hinders both deployment and fair comparison, as cyber simulators differ substantially in their state representations, observation models, and action spaces. In this paper, we study policy transfer across cyber environments and argue that simulator-to-simulator and simulator-to-real transfer can be viewed as instances of the same underlying alignment problem. We propose a framework that separates state alignment from action translation, enabling a policy trained in one environment to operate in another without retraining. We evaluate transfer across four cyber platforms, CyberBattleSim, NetSecGame, CyberWheel, and NASim, including emulated deployments in NASim. Our experiments show that zero-shot transfer is feasible, fully preserving source-policy performance in closely aligned environments and achieving 45.2% win rates when transferring policies whose source performance is 60.5%. In emulated virtual machine environments, transferred policies exhibit a Jensen-Shannon divergence of 0.085 from native policies, indicating strong behavioral similarity. Code and benchmarks are available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/RL-Transfer-between-env-4F47/.

</details>


### [381] [Made to Measure: Designing Image Watermarks to Specification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00780)
*Mingzhe Li,Yuefeng Peng,Kejing Xia,Pranav Jeyakumar,Ruolan Leslie Famularo,Shiqing Ma*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出TAILOR，一种请求条件化的水印组合框架，通过离线刻画、联合配置选择与在线校准三阶段，在满足误报率约束下联合优化片段、强度、顺序与几何恢复，实现低失真、高鲁棒的水印组合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实际部署图像水印需同时满足抗攻击性、误报率(FPR)、图像质量和延迟等要求。单一水印方法难以兼顾所有变换类型，而组合互补方法虽能扩大保护范围，却会因片段增多而加剧失真与解码开销，并需共享同一FPR预算，因此如何有效组合成为核心挑战。

Method: TAILOR包含三阶段：(1)离线刻画：以响应曲线形式测量各片段在嵌入强度下的恢复率、失真与运行时间；(2)联合配置选择：将请求编码为基于这些曲线的SMT模型，求解失真最低的片段、强度、顺序及几何恢复组合；(3)在线校准：在用户图像上验证所选配置并修正预测偏差。

Result: 在覆盖5种场景、20种攻击设置的7,321个不同请求上评估，TAILOR达到96.21%的场景平均请求满足率，平均PSNR为41.02 dB，在鲁棒性上优于现有方法，并保持更优图像质量。

Conclusion: TAILOR通过请求条件化的组合优化，在统一FPR预算下有效平衡了鲁棒性、图像质量与解码开销，验证了多水印互补组合在复杂攻击场景下的实用价值。代码已开源。

Abstract: Image watermarking supports provenance and attribution by embedding verifiable identity information into images. Practical deployments, however, must jointly satisfy requirements for attack resistance, false-positive rate (FPR), image quality, and latency. Existing watermarking methods are robust to different classes of transformations, so combining complementary methods can provide broader protection than any single watermark. Such composition is challenging, as additional fragments increase distortion and decoding cost and must share the same FPR budget. Therefore, we propose **TAILOR**, a request-conditioned watermark composition framework with three stages: (1) *offline characterization* measures fragment recovery, distortion, and runtime as response curves over embedding strength; (2) *joint configuration selection* encodes the request as an SMT model over these curves and solves for the lowest-distortion composition of fragments, strengths, order, and geometric recovery; and (3) *live calibration* validates the selected configuration on the user's images and refines predictions that fail to transfer. Experimental results across 7,321 distinct requests spanning five scenarios and 20 attack settings show that **TAILOR** achieves **96.21%** scenario-averaged request satisfaction with a mean PSNR of **41.02 dB**, outperforming existing methods in robustness while achieving consistently better image quality. Code is available at [https://github.com/aaFrostnova/Tailor](https://github.com/aaFrostnova/Tailor).

</details>


### [382] [Identity-Bound Governance Under Execution Uncertainty: An Accountability Proof Block for LLM Agent Persistent Halts, with Cryptographic Implementation and Cross-Model Calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00787)
*Marcelo Fernandez*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 论文提出"身份绑定治理事件"概念及"问责证明块"(APB)机制：由系统构造证据块、人类提供决策块，并以ed25519签名将二者绑定至注册主体，配合四项定理与实验验证，实现可问责的权威转移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当LLM智能体处于既不能继续执行、也不能自动停机的情形（可观测性或漂移检测层持续失效）时，系统自身无权决定由谁恢复、否决或重校准部署，现有治理机制缺乏对此类"权威空缺"状态的形式化与解决手段。

Method: 提出APB结构：系统构造的证据块 + 人类提供的决策块 + ed25519签名将两者绑定至注册主体，保证系统无法伪造签名、主体无法不被察觉地篡改证据；实现上采用RFC 8785 JSON规范化与基于UUID4的重放谓词；并设计k-of-n多主体变体。

Result: 证明四条定理（协议有界治理完备性、不可否认性、匿名重授权不可能性、APB构造有限时间终止）；实证上3,812次停机事件治理完备性零未决，验证器对9类对抗向量的1,800次攻击检出率100%，k-of-n变体在2,000次单密钥捕获中零误接受；六个开源LLM的漂移阈值T*在模型内稳定（sigma/T*<2%）但跨模型变化，推翻规模单调性假设。

Conclusion: T*必须按部署逐一测量，而APB正是将阈值转化为可问责权威转移的载体；该机制为LLM智能体的治理边界提供了密码学保障与形式化基础。

Abstract: A correctly governed LLM agent can reach a state in which neither continuing execution nor automatically halting is admissible: the system has detected a persistent failure of its observability or drift-detection layer, but cannot itself decide who has the authority to resume, deny, or recalibrate the deployment. We call this an identity-bound governance event and formalise the mechanism that resolves it. We introduce the Accountability Proof Block (APB): a system-constructed evidence block, a human-supplied decision block, and an ed25519 signature binding both to a registered principal. The system cannot forge the signature, and the principal cannot alter the evidence undetected. We prove four theorems: Protocol-Bounded Governance Completeness, Non-Repudiability, Impossibility of Anonymous Re-Authorization, and Finite-Time APB Construction Termination. The implementation uses RFC 8785 JSON canonicalization and a UUID4-based replay predicate. Empirically, governance completeness holds over 3,812 halt events with zero unresolved cases; the verifier detects 100% of 1,800 attacks across 9 adversarial vectors; a k-of-n multi-principal variant shows 0 false acceptances in 2,000 single-key capture attempts. A study of six open LLMs finds the drift threshold T* stable within model (sigma/T* < 2%) but varying across models, refuting size-monotonicity: the largest model did not drift. T* must therefore be measured per deployment, and the APB is the vehicle by which that threshold yields accountable authority transfer.

</details>


### [383] [SafeDepth: Safety-Aware Token-Level Adaptive Computation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00815)
*Nizhang Li,Ian G. Harris*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: SafeDepth：一种轻量级插件式框架，通过选择性层执行在提升安全性的同时提高推理效率，冻结骨干网络无需额外预训练，在Llama-3-8B-Instruct上显著降低有害回复率与误拒率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究表明并非每个token都需经过所有Transformer层，由此催生了token级自适应模型以跳过部分层来减少计算。然而实验发现这些执行选择也会影响安全性：现有token级自适应推理模型相比其参考骨干网络，会产生更高的有害回复率。安全性影响取决于跳过哪些层、以及跳过发生在提示处理阶段还是答案生成阶段。此外，识别有害请求与生成拒绝回复依赖不同的逐层计算。因此需要一种既能提升安全性又能保持效率的方案。

Method: 提出SafeDepth，一个轻量级插件式框架，利用选择性层执行同时提升安全性与效率。SafeDepth学习保留支持安全回复的计算、绕过导致不安全生成的计算。路由器根据token表示、层位置和推理阶段选择层执行，适配器支持被跳过的路径。联合训练这些模块以减少计算量和有害回复，同时保持良性任务性能，追求更优的安全-效率权衡。预训练骨干网络全程冻结，无需额外预训练。

Result: 在Llama-3-8B-Instruct上的实验表明，SafeDepth相对全深度推理降低了计算量，同时基本保持任务性能。与FlexiDepth相比，在全部五个有害请求基准上均降低了不安全回复率，其中在HarmBench-HJ上绝对降幅最大（从55.44%降至25.25%），并将XSTest误拒率从12.0%降至4.0%。

Conclusion: SafeDepth通过选择性层执行有效实现了安全性与效率的联合优化，在冻结骨干网络、无需额外预训练的前提下，既减少了计算开销，又显著降低了有害回复率和误拒率，为token级自适应模型的安全性提供了可行的插件式解决方案。

Abstract: Recent studies suggest that not every token needs to pass through all Transformer layers, motivating token-level adaptive models that selectively skip layers to reduce computation. Our experiments show that these execution choices also affect safety: existing token-level adaptive reasoning models exhibit higher harmful-response rates than their reference backbones. The safety effects depend on which layers are skipped and whether skipping occurs during prompt processing or answer generation. We further find that recognizing harmful requests and producing refusals depend on different layer-wise computations. We introduce SafeDepth, a lightweight, plug-in framework that uses selective layer execution to improve both safety and efficiency. SafeDepth learns to retain computations that support safe responses and bypass those that contribute to unsafe generation. A router selects layer execution based on token representations, layer position, and inference phase, while an adapter supports the skipped paths. We jointly train these modules to reduce computation and harmful responses while preserving performance on benign tasks, targeting a better safety-efficiency trade-off. The pretrained backbone remains frozen throughout, requiring no additional pretraining. Experimental results on Llama-3-8B-Instruct show that SafeDepth reduces computation relative to full-depth inference while largely preserving task performance. Compared with FlexiDepth, it lowers unsafe-response rates across all five harmful-request benchmarks, with the largest absolute decrease on HarmBench-HJ (from 55.44% to 25.25%), while reducing the XSTest false-refusal rate from 12.0% to 4.0%.

</details>


### [384] [Do Defenses Against LLM Extraction Work Across Attacks? A Lifecycle Benchmark of Black-Box Model Extraction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00839)
*Shuze Liu,Kaixiang Zhao,Runyang Xu,Jingzhi Chen,Nathan Wu,Yu Wang,Yushun Dong*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出统一基准MEA-Bench，覆盖6种模型抽取攻击、10种防御及2种自适应攻击，在受控条件下可复现地比较抽取方法与防御的交互。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通过纯文本API部署的大模型面临模型抽取风险，攻击者可收集其响应训练代理模型以复制其能力。已有攻击与防御繁多，但评估在访问假设、模型配置、查询预算和安全目标上各自为政，缺乏可比性。本文旨在填补这一评测碎片化空白。

Method: 构建统一基准，涵盖6种抽取攻击、10种防御、2种自适应攻击（对受保护响应进行改写或回译后再训练代理）。在每次比较内控制模型配置、查询数据、预算与留出评估条件，同时保留攻击特有的查询与训练流程。

Result: 测量代理能力、对受害模型的保真度、用Rep-4衡量的输出质量及查询预算敏感性；防御使用各自安全指标并配对代理性能；对自适应攻击，联合测量溯源检测器得分与在改写响应上训练所得代理的能力和保真度。

Conclusion: 该基准为在纯文本访问条件下比较抽取方法及其与防御的交互提供了可复现的基础，代码与工件已开源。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) deployed through text-only APIs face model extraction risks, as adversaries can collect their responses to train surrogates that reproduce their capabilities. While prior work has developed diverse attacks and defenses, evaluations remain fragmented across access assumptions, model configurations, query budgets, and security objectives, limiting comparability across methods. To address this gap, we introduce a unified benchmark covering six extraction attacks, ten defenses, and two adaptive attacks that paraphrase or back-translate protected responses before surrogate training. The benchmark controls model configurations, query data, budgets, and held-out evaluation conditions within each comparison while preserving attack-specific querying and training procedures. We measure surrogate capability, fidelity to the victim, output quality using Rep-4, and query-budget sensitivity; defenses use their own security metrics paired with surrogate performance. For the adaptive attacks, we jointly measure provenance-detector scores and the capability and fidelity of surrogates trained on rewritten responses. The benchmark thus provides a reproducible basis for comparing extraction methods and their interactions with defenses under text-only access. Code and artifacts are available at https://github.com/sliu11-byte/MEA-Bench.

</details>


### [385] [AuraForge: Scaling Security Supervision for Training Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00850)
*Danqing Wang,Songwen Zhao,Harsh Sharma,Jierui Wang,Andre Vicente Duarte,Ivan Bercovich,Lei Li*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出 AuraForge 框架，通过攻击导向的测试合成、语言可扩展的任务构建与奖励黑客防护，为安全编码智能体生成并验证可执行安全测试，并构建多语言多 CWE 训练集 AuraGym。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编码智能体能力增强后，人类监督从逐行代码审查转向结果导向评估，但功能正确性无法保证实现安全；同时从真实仓库大规模获取可靠的安全监督信号十分困难，训练更安全的编码智能体面临瓶颈。

Method: AuraForge 结合三部分：攻击导向的安全测试合成、语言可扩展的任务构建、以及针对奖励黑客的防护机制。基于该框架构建 AuraGym 可执行训练集，覆盖 Python、JavaScript、TypeScript 三种语言、344 个真实仓库的 679 个功能实现任务、177 个 CWE 类别。

Result: 在含人工编写安全测试的子集上，AuraForge 平均生成约 3 倍测试用例，误报率降低 83.23%，使替代性安全实现也能获得正确监督。用合成安全测试训练 Qwen3.5-4B 时，三种语言上的平均提升优于人工编写测试（19.7 FuncPass 与 6.2 SecPass 对比 14.9 FuncPass 与 4.4 SecPass）。

Conclusion: AuraForge 能提供更丰富、更可靠的安全监督信号，有效训练安全编码智能体。

Abstract: Coding agents are now proficient enough to generate complex software applications from a single prompt. As their capabilities have grown, human oversight has increasingly shifted from line-by-line code review toward hands-off evaluation of outcomes. However, recent studies have shown that such a transition exposes a critical risk: functional correctness alone does not guarantee a secure implementation. Despite growing attention to code security, training safer coding agents remains challenging because reliable security supervision is difficult to obtain at scale from real-world repositories. We introduce AuraForge to synthesize and validate executable security tests for training secure coding agents. Our approach combines attack-oriented test synthesis, language-extensible task construction, and safeguards against reward hacking. Using AuraForge, we construct AuraGym, a multi-language and multi-CWE executable training gym: 679 executable feature-implementation tasks from 344 real-world repositories across Python, JavaScript, and TypeScript, covering 177 CWE categories. On the subset with human-written security tests, AuraForge produces about 3 times as many test cases on average and reduces the false-positive rate by 83.23%, allowing alternative secure implementations to receive correct supervision. Training Qwen3.5-4B with synthesized security tests gains larger improvements than human-written security tests (average 19.7 FuncPass and 6.2 SecPass vs. 14.9 FuncPass and 4.4 SecPass) on three languages. These results demonstrate that AuraForge provides more diverse and reliable security supervision to train secure coding agents.

</details>


### [386] [ABSENTIA: Detecting Broken Access Control Vulnerabilities in Web Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00977)
*André V. Duarte,Aditya Oke,Rui Melo,Shubham Gandhi,Nachiket Kotalwar,Charmi Khandor,Danqing Wang,Arlindo L. Oliveira,Carolyn Rosé,Lei Li*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: ABSENTIA 是一个安全脚手架，将通用 LLM 代理转化为系统化的 Web 应用后端漏洞检测器，通过构建路由到代码的映射图并逐路由进行不变量伪造来发现访问控制缺陷；同时发布 BAC-Bench 基准，其召回率显著优于 CodeQL、Semgrep 及无结构代理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 访问控制缺陷（broken access control）是最普遍的 Web 安全风险之一。与注入类漏洞不同，授权是一种"谁可以对什么执行操作"的关系，而非数据流，每个应用自行决定该关系，因此没有预先写好的规则可以通用。LLM 代理虽能从代码推断该关系，但缺乏系统化覆盖应用并优先检查的手段，导致搜索无方向、访问控制缺陷难以被检测。

Method: 提出 ABSENTIA，一个安全脚手架，把通用 LLM 代理转变为面向 Web 应用后端、以开发者与安全工程师审计方式运行的系统化漏洞检测器。在指导下，代理构建一张将应用路由映射到其后端代码的图，然后逐路由进行"不变量伪造"：推断代码应满足的属性，在属性未被强制执行之处报告该路由供维护者审查。

Result: 发布 BAC-Bench 基准，涵盖 25 个仓库、3 种语言、9 个框架的 30 条访问控制漏洞公告，均于 2025 年及以后发布，经人工审计员验证并配有修复提交，因此得分要求在易受攻击版本而非已修复版本上标记。ABSENTIA 召回其中 19 条，成对计分下 17 条，LLM 验证器确认其 51% 的发现。CodeQL 与 Semgrep 均无召回，同一模型上的无结构代理仅召回 3 条。在 OWASP Benchmark 注入类目中，ABSENTIA 在 Python 上领先专用分析器，在 Java 上仅次于 CodeQL 和 IRIS。

Conclusion: ABSENTIA 通过"路由-代码图 + 不变量伪造"将 LLM 代理系统化，实现对访问控制缺陷的有效检测，并在 BAC-Bench 与 OWASP Benchmark 上展现出优于传统分析器和无结构代理的性能。

Abstract: Broken access control, the failure of authorization, is one of the most prevalent web security risks. Unlike injection, a flow of untrusted input into a dangerous operation, authorization is a relation: who may act on what, not how data moves. Each application decides that relation for itself, so no rule written in advance carries to the next. An LLM agent can infer it from the code, but with no systematic way to cover the application and prioritize what to inspect, its search stays undirected and access-control flaws go undetected.
  We present ABSENTIA, a security scaffolding that turns general LLM agents into systematic vulnerability detectors for the backend of web applications, run as an audit by the developers and security engineers who maintain the code. Under its direction, the agents build a graph that maps the application's routes to the code behind them. ABSENTIA then works route by route, applying invariant falsification: it infers the properties the code is meant to satisfy, and where one is not enforced, reports the route for maintainer review.
  We also release BAC-Bench, a benchmark of 30 broken access control advisories across 25 repositories, 3 languages, and 9 frameworks, each published in 2025 or later, verified by a human auditor, and paired with its fixing commit, so credit requires flagging the vulnerable version and not the fixed one. ABSENTIA recalls 19 of them, 17 under paired credit, and an LLM verifier confirms 51% of its findings. CodeQL and Semgrep recall none, and an unstructured agent on the same model recalls 3. In the OWASP Benchmark injection categories, ABSENTIA leads the dedicated analyzers in Python and trails only CodeQL and IRIS in Java.

</details>


### [387] [Helol Tunnel: Covert Channel Exploitation of TLS Extensibility & Privacy Features](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01009)
*Reza Soosahabi,Rakesh Seal*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出 Helol 隐蔽隧道，利用 TLS Client Hello 包中密码学信息元素的可重排组合特性嵌入信息，并借助反僵化合规措施与隐私化参数配置趋势规避 NGFW 检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 隐蔽信道常被用于数据外泄与命令控制（C2），是现代网络攻击的关键组成。作者希望寻找互联网基础架构中具有显著容量的隐蔽信道，因而关注普及度极高的 TLS 协议中 Client Hello 包的可组合特性。

Method: 提出 Helol 隧道：策略性重排 TLS Client Hello 包中的密码学信息元素以承载隐蔽信息。其可行性依托两点——反僵化（anti-ossification）合规措施促使交互式中间盒与下一代防火墙（NGFW）保留 CHLO 参数配置；同时流行应用为抗 TLS 指纹识别而不断变化 CHLO 参数配置，为隧道提供掩护。

Result: 实验表明 Helol 隧道能够规避具备交互式代理与全面威胁防护能力的 NGFW；并基于真实流量抓包与公开 TLS 指纹数据，数值化证明其在效能上优于当前最先进的基于 TLS 的隐蔽信道方案。

Conclusion: Helol 隧道利用 TLS 协议演进中的反僵化与隐私化特性，为隐蔽通信提供了既高效又具规避能力的方案，对 NGFW 构成实际威胁，也提示需重新审视现有 TLS 检测与合规机制的安全性。

Abstract: Covert channels exploiting network protocols for data exfiltration and command-and-control (C2) are integral parts of modern cyberattacks. In search of a significant covert channel within the fabric of the Internet, we targeted the combinatorial properties of the Client Hello (CHLO) packets in the ubiquitous Transport Layer Security (TLS) protocol. The proposed Helol tunnel is a novel covert approach to embedding information in TLS Client Hello packets, which involves the strategic rearrangement of their cryptographic information elements. To sustain TLS protocol extensibility, the recent anti-ossification TLS compliance measures encourage the interactive middleboxes and next-generation firewalls (NGFWs) to preserve the parameter configuration in the Client Hello packets. Furthermore, to improve user privacy, popular Internet applications are varying their TLS CHLO parameter configurations to resist TLS fingerprinting by third-party network entities. We demonstrate the strength of the Helol tunnel to exploit these recent developments to evade NGFWs with interactive proxy and comprehensive threat protection. We also numerically show the efficacy of Helol tunneling over state-of-the-art covert channels that exploit TLS through the use of real traffic captures and public TLS fingerprinting data.

</details>


### [388] [MOMAT: Mixture of Multiple Atlases for Low-Power Jailbreak Defense of Quantized LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01058)
*Boyang Li,Bingyu Shen,Weihao Hong,Zhiyuan Jiang,Xinlei Guan,Yan Ma,Miles Q. Li,Yi Sheng,Ruiyang Qin*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: MOMAT是一个硬件增强的安全框架，通过多图集混合检索与CiM加速，在边缘qLLM上实现高效低功耗的越狱防御。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量化大语言模型（qLLM）因低延迟和能效优势被广泛部署于边缘设备，但量化会削弱对齐安全机制，使其极易遭受越狱攻击，亟需兼顾安全性与能效的防御方案。

Method: 提出MOMAT（Mixture of Multiple Atlases）：将有害/良性样本集与策略模板组织为多个语义图集（atlas），实现域局部化的检索增强生成防护，缓解大规模异构安全数据库中的维度灾难与语义稀疏问题；对每个提示从所有图集中检索top-k相似特征，由轻量MoE检测器评估，并用CiM（存算一体）加速的相似度引擎完成快速低功耗的图集局部检索。

Result: CiM检索将100查询批次从15,052.44 ms加速至3,207.21 ns（约4.69×10^6倍加速），能耗从8.1×10^7 μJ降至3.32 μJ（相对DRAM（树莓派）基线约2.5×10^5倍能耗降低）。红队评测显示，MOMAT在标准基准上达到SOTA防御性能，同时避免对良性输入的过度拦截，并带来显著能效提升。

Conclusion: 基于CiM的模块化防御可使边缘部署的qLLM兼具更高安全性与能效；作者将公开223.2k样本数据集以促进后续研究。

Abstract: Quantized large language models are increasingly deployed on edge devices for their low latency and energy efficiency. However, model quantization weakens alignment safeguards, leaving qLLMs (quantized large language models) highly vulnerable to jailbreak attacks. To address this challenge, we present MOMAT (Mixture of Multiple Atlases), a hardware-enhanced safety framework that combines structured knowledge retrieval with low-power defense acceleration. Each atlas represents a semantic cluster of harmful or benign sample sets and policy templates, enabling domain-localized Retrieval-Augmented Generation guarding that mitigates the curse of dimensionality and the resulting semantic sparsity problem in large, heterogeneous safety databases. MOMAT retrieves top-$k$ similarity features from all atlases for each prompt and evaluates them using a lightweight MoE (Mixture of Experts) detector, while a CiM (Compute-in-Memory)-accelerated similarity engine performs fast, low-power atlas-local retrieval. MOMAT's CiM-based retrieval accelerates a 100-query batch from 15,052.44 ms to 3,207.21 ns (a $4.69 \times 10^6\times$ speedup) and reduces energy from $8.1 \times 10^7$ $μ$J to 3.32 $μ$J, yielding an approximately $2.5 \times 10^5\times$ energy reduction over DRAM-based (Raspberry Pi) baselines. Red-team evaluations across standard benchmarks show that MOMAT matches the defense performance of state-of-the-art methods while avoiding benign overkill and providing substantial efficiency gains, demonstrating that CiM-based modular defenses can make edge-deployed qLLMs both safer and more energy-efficient. We will release the full 223.2k-sample dataset to foster future research.

</details>


### [389] [Jev-IDS: System One Models for Network Intrusion Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01079)
*Paulo Severo,Silvio E. Quincozes,Amanda Dias*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出 JEV-IDS：基于 Jev SOM 的开放实验性通用网络入侵检测系统，在标签稀缺下直接分析流记录以检测零日攻击。单流单请求、两次提问（二分类攻击概率+有限类别选择）的串行化提示方案。在 300 流 NSL-KDD 试点上 5400 次决策，F1 0.859、精确率 0.941、召回 0.790、新攻击召回 0.838；k=1 时比 GPT-5.6 Luna 快 4.8 倍、便宜 3.8 倍、新攻击召回高 1.5 倍，误报比低数据随机森林少 15 倍；k=2 时 F1 降至 0.839。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习型 NIDS 依赖大量标注数据与任务特定训练，难以应对标签稀缺；LLM 方案可直接分析流记录但推理成本与延迟高、输出约束不足。因此需要一种兼顾零日检测能力、低数据依赖与低成本高效率的通用 NIDS。

Method: 提出 JEV-IDS，基于 Jev System One Model（SOM）的开放实验性通用 NIDS。对每条流单独串行化为一次请求，向 JEV 提出两个问题：二元攻击概率与有限选项的流量类别，从而约束输出空间并支持在标签稀缺条件下直接分析流记录。

Result: 在 300 流 NSL-KDD 试点划分上完成 5,400 次决策：JEV 取得 F1 0.859、精确率 0.941、召回 0.790、新攻击召回 0.838。k=1 时相对 GPT-5.6 Luna 快 4.8 倍、成本低 3.8 倍、新攻击召回高 1.5 倍；相比低数据随机森林误报减少 15 倍。将 k 提升至 2 后 F1 降至 0.839。

Conclusion: JEV-IDS 表明基于 SOM 的通用 NIDS 可在标签稀缺场景下有效检测零日入侵，并在效率、成本、新攻击召回与误报控制上优于对比 LLM 与低数据基线；增大 k（如 k=2）未带来收益反而降低 F1，单请求设置 k=1 更优。

Abstract: Machine-learning Network Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS) depend on substantial labeled datasets and task-specific training, whereas Large Language Models (LLMs) detection can analyze flow records directly but incurs higher inference cost and latency, with less constrained outputs. This paper presents JEV-IDS, an open experimental general NIDS based on the Jev System One Model (SOM) to detect zero day intrusions Under label scarcity. JEV-IDS serializes one flow per request and asks JEV two questions: a binary attack probability and a finite-choice traffic category. Our results show that, at k=1, JEV was 4.8 times faster and 3.8 times cheaper than GPT-5.6 Luna, with 1.5 times higher novel-attack recall; it also produced 15 times fewer false alarms than a low-data Random Forest. Across 5,400 decisions on a 300-flow NSL-KDD pilot split, JEV achieved F1-Score 0.859, precision 0.941, recall 0.790, and novel-attack recall 0.838. Increasing k to 2 reduced its F1-Score to 0.839.

</details>


### [390] [ReCast: Contract-Preserving Protection for Fixed-Interface Multimodal Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01184)
*Bingchen Pei,Lichong Chen,Bingxi Zhao,Ziang Wu,Sirui Wang,Min Zhang,Yanhao Chen,Qingxu Liu,Qiang Gao,Chang-Tien Lu,Bo Gao*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: ReCast是一个智能体插件框架，通过本地将输入转为文本证据-查询记录、重写实体与主题、基于可逆角色感知数值映射替换数值，并由重建智能体生成合规媒体，实现远程多模态模型的隐私保护推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 远程多模态模型在图表与语音上具备强数值推理能力，但上传私有输入会泄露敏感内容。纯文本脱敏无法满足固定媒体接口要求，而身份匿名化又无法隐藏底层任务内容，因此需要一种既保留输入模态与任务关系、又能降低源内容暴露的方案。

Method: ReCast包含：1）本地把输入转换为共享的文本证据-查询记录；2）用蒸馏的4B模型联合重写实体与主题；3）通过本地可逆、角色感知的数值映射替换数值；4）重建智能体依据受保护记录生成并验证所需媒体；5）远程求解器返回程序，其受保护操作数在本地恢复后再执行。

Result: 在4,000个留出的ChartQA与NMSQA样本上，ReCast达到75.10%准确率，保留未保护远程准确率的92.43%；基于模型的审计显示7.95%发往求解器的请求存在源内容泄露。性能优于所有评估的本地基线。

Conclusion: ReCast在现有媒体接口下，既保留了远程推理的收益，又降低了源内容暴露，为远程多模态推理提供了一种兼顾任务效用的隐私保护方案。

Abstract: Remote multimodal models offer strong numerical reasoning capabilities over charts and speech, but sending private inputs risks exposing sensitive content. Text-only sanitization cannot directly satisfy fixed media interfaces, while identity anonymization leaves the underlying task content exposed. We introduce ReCast, an agentic plug-in framework that replaces source-specific content while preserving task-relevant relations and the required input modality. ReCast locally converts inputs into a shared textual evidence-query record, jointly rewrites entities and topics with a distilled 4B model, and substitutes values through a locally invertible, role-aware numerical map. A reconstruction agent generates and validates the required media from the protected record. The remote solver returns a program whose protected operands are restored locally before execution. On 4,000 held-out ChartQA and NMSQA examples, ReCast achieves 75.10% accuracy, retaining 92.43% of unprotected remote accuracy, while a model-based audit flags source-content leakage in 7.95% of solver-bound requests. It outperforms all evaluated local baselines, preserving the benefit of remote reasoning while reducing source-content exposure under existing media interfaces.

</details>


### [391] [A Resource-Aware Behavior Reconstruction and Hierarchical Semantic Learning Framework for Host Intrusion Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01250)
*Youli Tao,Rui Tang,Hao Ren,Chengsheng Zhou,Dengzhe Wang,Shuyu Jiang,Xingshu Chen*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出 ReSHID，一种面向主机入侵检测的资源感知行为重构与层次语义学习框架，通过系统调用语义重建连续序列并构建主体行为图，显著提升检测性能并大幅降低特征规模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于系统调用的主机入侵检测方法按原始执行顺序建模，不同进程的调用序列相互交织，导致有效模式难以提取，且复杂攻击模式难以学习。因此需要解决两个问题：原始系统调用序列能否被重组以获得更具判别性的表示，以及如何从重组序列中有效学习复杂攻击模式。

Method: ReSHID 利用系统调用语义不变性，将跨 PID 命名空间的主体身份与关系解析建模为二分匹配问题，并通过跟踪文件描述符（FD）生命周期关联指向同一资源的描述符，从而重构语义连续的序列。随后将提取的特征组织为轻量级主体行为图，包含主体间关系，并使用 GATv2 捕捉关键协同模式以建模涉及多主体的复杂攻击。

Result: 实验表明，序列重构与检测方法结合可提升 HIDS 性能。即使使用轻量级线性分类器，该方法在 F1（98.64%）、ROC-AUC（99.80%）和 PR-AUC（98.10%）上均优于所有对比方法，同时相比原始序列和 MGFE 分别减少约 75.2% 和 44.1% 的 n-gram 特征数量。

Conclusion: 通过系统调用序列的语义重构与层次化图语义学习，ReSHID 在保持轻量特征的同时实现了更优的主机入侵检测性能，验证了重构序列表示在建模复杂多主体攻击方面的有效性。

Abstract: System calls (syscalls) record key interactions between running programs and the operating system kernel, providing fine-grained and minimally intrusive data for host-based intrusion detection systems (HIDS) deployed in cloud and other modern computing environments. However, existing methods often model syscalls in their original execution order, where sequences from different processes are interleaved, making informative patterns difficult to extract and raising two questions: whether raw syscall sequences can be reorganized in a way that yields more discriminative representations, and how complex attack patterns can be effectively learned from the reorganized sequences. We propose ReSHID, a resource-aware behavior reconstruction and hierarchical semantic learning framework for host intrusion detection. It reconstructs semantically continuous sequences by leveraging syscall semantic invariants to cast subject identity and relationship resolution across PID namespaces as a bipartite matching problem and tracking file descriptor (FD) lifecycles to associate descriptors referring to the same resource. Additionally, features extracted from these sequences are organized into a lightweight subject behavior graph incorporating inter-subject relationships, where GATv2 captures key coordination patterns to model complex attacks involving multiple subjects. Experimental results show that sequence reconstruction combined with the detection method can improve HIDS performance. Even with a lightweight linear classifier, the proposed method achieves the best results among all compared methods in terms of F1-score (98.64%), ROC-AUC (99.80%), and PR-AUC (98.10%), while reducing the number of n-gram features by approximately 75.2% and 44.1% compared with the raw sequences and MGFE, respectively.

</details>


### [392] [Autonomous OSS Threat Detection via Taxonomy-Aligned LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01263)
*Md. Robiul Islam Niloy*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出分类体系对齐的大语言模型框架（基于GPT-4），用于开源软件供应链威胁的自动检测与分类，在999起真实事件的五类威胁分类上达到97.0%准确率与宏F1，并发现分类体系对齐提示而非模型规模或微调才是高准确率的关键。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: OSS生态面临日益复杂的供应链攻击（域名抢注、依赖混淆、Trojan Source混淆、恶意构建注入、CI/CD流水线投毒等）。现有基于签名和规则的方法难以跨攻击变体泛化，也无法应对新兴威胁模式，因此需要具备泛化能力的自动化检测与分类手段。

Method: 构建结构化AV-xxx威胁分类体系，覆盖五类攻击；从GitHub Security Advisories、CISA警报及2018–2026年安全研究报告整理999起经核验的真实OSS供应链事件数据集；采用分类体系对齐的提示工程驱动GPT-4进行分类。与5个传统机器学习基线、1个零样本开源LLM、2个微调神经模型进行对比评估。

Result: 分类体系对齐的GPT-4框架在五类威胁上取得97.0%多分类准确率与97.0%宏F1。微调Llama 3.1 8B（70.5%）与SecRoBERTa（77.5%）均低于简单TF-IDF分类器（82.3%）；未做分类体系对齐的Mistral 7B仅65.7%。

Conclusion: 分类体系对齐的提示（taxonomy-aligned prompting）而非模型规模、领域预训练或微调，是实现高分类准确率的关键因素；数据集与代码已公开以支持可复现的供应链安全研究。

Abstract: Open source software (OSS) ecosystems face growing threats from sophisticated supply chain attacks including typosquatting, dependency confusion, Trojan Source obfuscation, malicious build injection, and CI/CD pipeline poisoning. Existing detection approaches rely on signature-based tools and rule-based systems that struggle to generalize across attack variants and emerging threat patterns. In this paper we propose a taxonomy-aligned large language model framework for automated detection and classification of OSS supply chain threats. We introduce a structured AV-xxx threat taxonomy covering five attack categories and construct a curated dataset of 999 verified real-world OSS supply chain incidents sourced from GitHub Security Advisories, CISA alerts, and security research reports spanning 2018 to 2026. Using taxonomy-aligned prompt engineering with GPT-4, our framework achieves 97.0\% multi-class classification accuracy and 97.0\% macro F1 score across all five threat categories. Comparative evaluation against five traditional machine learning baselines, one zero-shot open source LLM, and two fine-tuned neural models reveals a surprising finding: fine-tuned Llama 3.1 8B (70.5%) and SecRoBERTa (77.5%) both underperform simple TF-IDF classifiers (82.3%), while Mistral 7B without taxonomy alignment achieves only 65.7%. These results confirm that taxonomy-aligned prompting rather than model scale, domain pretraining, or fine-tuning is the critical factor enabling high classification accuracy. Our dataset and code are publicly available to support reproducible supply chain security research.

</details>


### [393] [GNSS Spoofing in Mobile Devices: A Survey on Impact and Countermeasures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01294)
*Robert Argo,Andrea Nardin,Alex Minetto,Pau Closas*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文是一篇综述文章，聚焦于智能手机架构约束下可行的GNSS欺骗攻击检测与对抗技术。作者建立了攻击效果与对策的分类体系，回顾了智能手机脆弱性表征的历史，并对比分析了各类检测与反制技术方案的优缺点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能手机依赖GNSS定位，但其GNSS接收机因信号低功率和开放架构而极易受到人为射频干扰（干扰与欺骗）。欺骗攻击通过伪造卫星信号使接收机输出错误的位置、速度与时间（PVT）解，威胁更为隐蔽。智能手机的普及性及其承载的敏感地理位置数据使其成为主要攻击目标。然而，现有综述虽全面探讨了通用欺骗对策，却未涉及智能手机特有的硬件限制与接收机处理链缺乏深度可见性等移动端制约因素。

Method: 本文采用综述方法，针对智能手机架构独特约束，系统梳理可行的反欺骗技术：1）建立用于界定GNSS欺骗攻击效果与对策的分类体系（taxonomy）；2）对智能手机脆弱性表征进行历史性回顾；3）概述用于检测与对抗智能手机欺骗威胁的技术，并提供跨方案对比框架以权衡其在移动平台上的优缺点。

Result: 本文填补了现有综述未覆盖移动端特有约束的空白，形成了一篇聚焦于智能手机架构约束内可行技术的综述，提供了攻击效果与对策的分类标准、脆弱性研究的历史脉络梳理，以及各类检测与反制技术的比较分析框架。

Conclusion: 针对智能手机GNSS欺骗问题，需在硬件受限与接收机处理链可见性不足的约束下发展专门的反制技术。本文通过分类体系、历史回顾与对比框架，为移动平台上的反欺骗研究提供了结构化参考，弥补了现有通用综述的不足。

Abstract: Smartphones rely on Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS)-based positioning for many of the functions they execute everyday. The GNSS receivers embedded in smartphones are susceptible to anthropogenic radio frequency interference attacks in the forms of jamming and spoofing due to the low-power and open-architecture signals they receive from the satellite constellations. While jamming is a practice that denies a GNSS receiver the ability to form a position, velocity, and time (PVT) solution, spoofing represents a more insidious threat by using forged satellite signals that aim at causing the victim receiver to compute a false PVT solution. The ubiquity of smartphones and the sensitive geolocation data they hold make them a primary target for malicious spoofing. However, their hardware constraints and the lack of deep visibility into the GNSS receiver processing chain create significant hurdles for effective countermeasures. Existing surveys comprehensively explore general spoofing countermeasures but fail to address these mobile-specific limitations. This article fills that gap with a novel survey focused on techniques viable within the unique constraints of smartphone architectures. Specifically, we establish a taxonomy for defining GNSS spoofing attack effects and countermeasures, provide a historical review of smartphone vulnerability characterization, and provide an overview of techniques proposed to detect and counteract smartphone spoofing threats, offering a comparative framework to weigh their respective pros and cons on mobile platforms.

</details>


### [394] [A Systematization of Knowledge on DeFi Vaults: Architectures, Curation Mechanisms, and Strategy Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01300)
*Davide Mancino,Luca Pennella*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文系统化了DeFi金库架构与策展人（curation）控制层，提出统一系统模型与三套分类法，并映射代表性生产协议，以支持严谨分析与更安全设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DeFi金库已从早期收益聚合器演变为模块化、主动管理系统，新出现的策展控制层负责策略选择、风险参数配置与运营协调，引入了委托-代理动态与新的失效模式，亟需系统化框架来刻画其架构与风险。

Method: （i）提出统一的系统模型与形式化定义，覆盖份额记账、角色与运营依赖；（ii）构建三套互补分类法，分别针对金库敞口与目标、策展人治理与问责机制、策略执行模式及其失效模式；（iii）将一组代表性生产协议映射到上述维度。

Result: 形成统一系统模型与形式化定义，并建立覆盖金库敞口/目标、策展治理/问责、策略执行/失效模式的三维分类体系，同时完成代表性生产协议的维度映射。

Conclusion: 该框架为区块链金融应用的严谨分析与更安全设计提供支撑，有助于识别策展控制层带来的委托-代理风险与失效模式。

Abstract: Decentralized finance (DeFi) vaults are smart-contract-based asset management systems that pool deposits, execute programmable strategies, and mint tokenized shares representing claims on underlying assets and strategy performance. As vault designs have evolved from early yield aggregators to modular, actively managed systems, a new control layer, curation, has emerged to select strategies, configure risk parameters, and coordinate operational execution, introducing principal-agent dynamics and new failure modes.
  This paper systematizes DeFi vault architectures and curator-mediated control planes through (i) a unified system model and formal definitions for share accounting, roles, and operational dependencies, and (ii) three complementary taxonomies covering vault exposures and objectives, curator governance and accountability mechanisms, and strategy execution patterns together with their failure modes. We further map a representative set of production protocols to the proposed dimensions. The frameworks in this work aim to support rigorous analysis and safer design of blockchain-based financial applications.

</details>


### [395] [PACE: Provenance-Aware Capability Enforcement for Tool-Using LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01349)
*Fengpeng Li,Qizhou Wang,Yuke Hu,Kemou Li,Jun Liu,Haiwei Wu,Jiantao Zhou,Di Wang*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出PACE（Provenance-Aware Capability Enforcement），在工具调用执行前进行中介，通过路径限制、能力与效果验证以及边界适配，在不显著损失原生效用的情况下将攻击成功率降至最低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工具型LLM智能体将生成文本转化为真实副作用，被投毒的工具元数据、检索页面、记忆与可复用技能可操纵后续调用；而入站前的审查无法解决同一准入证据对应安全与泄露两种变体的问题，因此需要作用于部署仍可控的最后边界。

Method: PACE在每个工具调用执行前即时中介：路径限制（path confinement）给出表征影响路径的可执行切割；能力与效果验证依据认证请求编译的权限，检查模式定义的效果；区分经认证的执行契约与可评估配置，后者可在拟阻止后恢复授权调用或施加声明式修复；限制要求最终动作保持经认证的切割。

Result: 在8个可执行智能体安全基准与3个目标模型族上，可评估配置在79个有效攻击列中有62个取得严格最低攻击成功率、14个持平；全基准原生效用相对无防御智能体最多下降3分；1167对配对案例的完整消融显示安全增益主要来自效果验证，拒绝控制来自边界适配；缩减规模的自适应搜索对防御在30个越权目标上成功0/30。

Conclusion: 在工具调用执行前进行来源感知的能力强制，可有效遏制被污染工件导致的越权副作用，且以可忽略的效用代价实现稳健防御，并具备对自适应攻击的抵抗力。

Abstract: Tool-using large language model (LLM) agents turn generated text into real side effects, so poisoned tool metadata, retrieved pages, memory, and reusable skills can steer the next call. Vetting an artifact before admission does not settle this. A safe variant and a leaking variant can produce the same admission evidence, and a sound gate then cannot relax that site for either. We make that condition precise, which leaves the last boundary a deployment can still act on. We present Provenance-Aware Capability Enforcement (PACE), which mediates every tool call immediately before it executes. Path confinement proposes an executable cut of represented influence paths, while capability and effect verification checks schema-defined effects against authority compiled from the authenticated request. We distinguish the certified execution contract from the evaluated configuration, which can restore an authorized call after a proposed block or apply a declared repair. Confinement requires the final action to preserve the certified cut. On eight executable agent-security benchmarks with three target-model families, the evaluated configuration gives strictly lowest attack success in 62 of 79 eligible attack columns and ties in 14; full-benchmark native utility loses at most three points relative to the undefended agent. A complete ablation over 1167 paired cases attributes most security gains to effect verification and refusal control to boundary adaptation. A reduced-scale adaptive search succeeds on 0/30 out-of-authority targets against the defense.

</details>


### [396] [Sleeping Secrets: How Fine-Tuning Reawakens Privacy Risks in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01365)
*Jianhong Li,Jiahao Chen,Yuwen Pu,Chunyi Zhou,Oubo Ma,Zhou Feng,Hangtao Zhang,Jichao Bi,Chunqiang Hu*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出 ReGap——一种无需真实私有监督的微调恢复攻击，利用 LLM 自身生成的候选答案作为监督信号，可重新唤醒模型中的隐私人际关联。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 此前的微调恢复攻击依赖来自同一分布的"真实"私有监督（即原始训练数据），这一前提在实际场景中难以满足。作者主张，即使不具备这类不切实际的先验知识，私有信息仍可能被恢复，因此有必要研究更现实的攻击设定。

Method: ReGap 是一种 data-free 攻击：不依赖目标答案，也不依赖辅助的真实私有监督。其流程为：(1) 利用任务结构生成候选内容（由 LLM 自行生成）；(2) 依据答案 token 的似然度对候选进行筛选；(3) 通过低秩适配（LoRA）更新目标模型。

Result: 在 GPT-2、OPT、Qwen3 等六个模型上，ReGap 相较后训练目标模型的关联恢复率提升 6–21 个百分点。即便适配所用的身份与所有已记忆身份及评估身份不相交，且生成/筛选出的监督中不含任何精确目标答案，恢复效果依然显著。同一批训练好的适配器将先前已暴露检查点的恢复率从 42% 提升至 63%，但对从未接触过目标的匹配检查点毫无增益。

Conclusion: 适配本身不足以解释所观察到的恢复现象，先前的目标暴露显著影响适配后的可恢复性。该对比表明，常规的模型定制即可重新唤醒潜在的隐私风险，亟需学术界与工业界高度重视。

Abstract: Beyond adapting Large Language Models (LLMs) to specialized applications, fine-tuning has recently been shown to recover private information that is no longer accessible through direct queries. Previous fine-tuning recovery attacks, however, require genuine private supervision drawn from the same distribution, i.e., the previous training dataset. We argue that such recovery remains possible without such impractical knowledge. We show that LLM-generated candidates can provide sufficient supervision to recover previously learned private associations. Based on this, we propose ReGap, a data-free attack that recovers private associations using task structure, filters them by answer-token likelihood, and updates the target model via low-rank adaptation. Specifically, ReGap requires neither target answers nor auxiliary genuine private supervision. Across six GPT-2, OPT, and Qwen3 models, ReGap improves target-association recovery by 6-21 percentage points over the post-training target model. Recovery remains substantial even when the adaptation identities are disjoint from all memorized and evaluation identities, with no exact target answers appearing in the generated or selected supervision. Moreover, the same trained adapters increase recovery from 42\% to 63\% on a previously exposed checkpoint, but produce no gain on a matched checkpoint that never encountered the targets. This contrast shows that adaptation alone is insufficient to explain the observed recovery and that prior target exposure strongly affects post-adaptation recoverability. Our findings highlight that routine model customization can reawaken latent privacy risks, warranting urgent attention from the academic and industrial communities.

</details>


### [397] [High-quality Data Do not Mean Safe! Poisoning LLMs after Data Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01367)
*Kaiyang Li,Jiahao Chen,Yuwen Pu,Chunyi Zhou,Tong Zhang,Bin Cai,Chunqiang Hu,Haibo Hu*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文系统评估了基于质量的数据筛选对投毒攻击的防御效果，发现筛选虽能移除大量明显有害样本，但部分高质量保留样本仍可在层级梯度层面产生类似有害样本的训练更新模式，从而削弱安全对齐。作者据此提出Bi-QSTO方法，在显式质量约束下优化投毒样本，使其在通过筛选的同时保持安全退化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有研究通常假设投毒样本会直接进入下游微调，忽略了实际训练流程中基于质量的数据筛选环节。本文旨在填补这一空白，考察质量筛选对投毒的实际防御效果及保留数据的下游安全影响。

Method: 首先系统地评估质量筛选对投毒样本的过滤效果及被保留数据的安全影响；随后基于发现的脆弱性，提出Bi-Stage Quality-Constrained Safety-Degradation Text Optimization（Bi-QSTO）方法，在显式质量约束下分阶段优化投毒样本，使其能够通过筛选并保留安全退化影响。

Result: 实验表明，筛选能移除许多明显有害样本，但部分高质量保留样本仍会削弱模型安全对齐，其在层级梯度层面呈现类似有害样本的训练更新模式。Bi-QSTO在多种投毒设置、目标模型和过滤率下均保持攻击有效性；即使在90%过滤率下，有害种子样本的投毒保留率仍超过90%，有害分数达3.30--4.01，且攻击有效性可跨模型强迁移，保留优势也能泛化到其他筛选方法。

Conclusion: 基于质量的数据筛选无法可靠防御安全退化攻击：安全退化影响可通过被保留的高质量样本穿透筛选机制。Bi-QSTO证明了该脆弱性具有系统性可利用性，揭示了实际训练流程中一个值得重视的安全隐患。

Abstract: Safety-aligned Large Language Models remain vulnerable to fine-tuning on small sets of harmful or benign-looking samples. However, prior studies typically assume that poisoned samples directly enter downstream fine-tuning, overlooking quality-based selection in practical training pipelines. To fill this gap, we systematically evaluate both the filtering effects against poisoning and the downstream safety impact of retained data. The results reveal that selection removes many overtly harmful samples, yet some retained high-quality samples can still degrade model safety alignment possibly due to their harmful-like training-update patterns at the layer-wise gradient level. Together, these findings expose a practical vulnerability: safety-degrading influence can pass through quality-based selection via retained high-quality samples. To examine its systematic exploitability, we propose Bi-Stage Quality-Constrained Safety-Degradation Text Optimization (Bi-QSTO), which optimizes poisoned samples under an explicit quality constraint to survive selection while preserving their safety-degrading influence. Across poisoning settings, target models, and filtering rates, Bi-QSTO maintains attack effectiveness before and after selection. Even at 90% filtering, harmful-seeded samples achieve a Poisoning Retention Rate above 90% and Harmful Score of 3.30--4.01. Their attack effectiveness strongly transfers across models and their retention advantage generalizes to additional selection methods.

</details>


### [398] [Is it Possible to Generate Irreversible PolyProtected Templates from Face Embeddings using System-Specific Keys?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01385)
*Vedrana Krivokuća Hahn,Jérémy Maceiras,Sébastien Marcel*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 该研究证明在系统级密钥（所有受试者共用同一 C、E 参数）场景下，PolyProtect 仍能生成不可逆的人脸保护模板，从而支持在保护域中实现人脸身份去重。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统 PolyProtect 采用受试者专属密钥，虽满足不可链接性，但导致同一身份可生成多个无法关联的模板，使得人脸身份去重无法进行。作者希望验证：改用系统级密钥（共用 C、E 参数）是否能保持不可逆性，从而兼顾模板保护与去重能力。

Method: 将 PolyProtect 应用于人脸嵌入，并系统性地比较系统级密钥与受试者专属密钥两种场景；提出并验证三种系统级密钥选取方式：(i) 从预选的受试者专属密钥中提取，(ii) 对随机向量应用既有密钥选择算法，(iii) 近似"优质"C/E 对的分布来构造系统级密钥。实验代码开源，保证可复现。

Result: 实验表明，上述三种系统性选取系统级密钥的方式均能生成不可逆的 PolyProtected 模板，即系统级密钥可在不牺牲模板保护潜力的前提下安全使用。

Conclusion: 在系统级密钥场景下安全运行 PolyProtect 是可行的，不会降低模板保护效果，这为在 PolyProtected 域中开展身份去重打开了可能。

Abstract: This work aims to answer the question of whether it is possible to generate irreversible protected templates when the PolyProtect biometric template protection method is applied to face embeddings using system-specific keys (i.e., the same C and E parameters, which define the transform, are applied to all subjects' face embeddings), instead of the traditional subject-specific keys (i.e., each subject has their own C and E parameters). This is important for determining whether we can perform de-duplication of face identities in the PolyProtected domain, which is not possible in the subject-specific key scenario due to the clash with PolyProtect's unlinkability property (i.e., one could generate multiple protected templates belonging to the same identity, using different C and E parameters, such that those templates cannot be linked to each other). We present experiments (reproducible using our open-source code) to prove that there exist at least three ways of systematically selecting system-specific keys that produce irreversible PolyProtected templates: (i) from pre-selected subject-specific keys, (ii) by applying a previously proposed key selection algorithm to random vectors, and (iii) by approximating a "good" C/E pair distribution from which system-specific keys can be constructed. Our findings thus point to the conclusion that it is, indeed, possible to safely operate PolyProtect in the system-specific key scenario without degrading the template protection potential. This opens up the possibility for identity de-duplication in the PolyProtected domain.

</details>


### [399] [Evidence Coverage for Intent-Bound Execution: Scope, Obligations, and Cutoff Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01386)
*Mengting Wu,Lin Wang,Yong Zhang,Jiang Deng*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出一个用于“执行证据义务回顾性覆盖”的分析模型，区分义务清单闭合与验证者视角闭合，并给出 COMPLETE_WITHIN_SCOPE、INCOMPLETE、UNKNOWN 三种报告结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 验证者即便能认证所有可得记录，仍缺乏判断某个执行账户是否“完整”的依据；要作出完整性断言，必须说明哪些记录本应属于被评估的执行。因此需要一个可辩护的、面向执行证据义务的回顾性覆盖模型。

Method: 模型限定了一个范围，绑定以下要素：结构化 Intent、精确 Candidate、选定的分析尝试、执行与证据边界、阶段视界、固定记录义务画像、具名验证者以及评估截止点。通过分支与触发前提确定义务实例；通过来源能力、内容、完整性以及对象与阶段绑定确定可采性。进而区分义务清单闭合与相关验证者视角的闭合，并定义三种报告结果。

Result: 构造的服务主体禁用案例展示了完整分派与拒绝分支、已到期但缺失的最终结果记录、延迟交付后的后续覆盖，以及将某个选定尝试的覆盖扩展到所有尝试的局限。

Conclusion: 其贡献在于将范围、分支、视界、义务、可采性、视角与截止点进行执行特定的组合；完整性始终以所声明的画像与评估前提为条件。

Abstract: A verifier may authenticate every available record and still lack grounds to call an execution account complete. Such a claim requires a justified account of which records were due for the execution being assessed. We present an analytical model for retrospective coverage of declared execution-evidence obligations. Its scope binds a structured Intent, an exact Candidate, a selected analytical attempt, an execution and evidence boundary, a stage horizon, a fixed record-obligation profile, a named verifier, and an assessment cutoff. Branch and trigger premises determine obligation instances; source competence, content, integrity, and object and stage bindings determine admissibility. We distinguish closure of the obligation inventory from closure of the relevant verifier view, and define three reporting results: COMPLETE_WITHIN_SCOPE, INCOMPLETE, and UNKNOWN. These results concern current coverage of obligations due at the cutoff. Execution progress, external outcome knowledge, and historical delivery timeliness are reported separately. Constructed service-principal-disablement cases demonstrate complete dispatch and refusal branches, a due but missing final-result record, subsequent coverage after late delivery, and the limits of extending one selected attempt's coverage to all attempts. The contribution is an execution-specific composition of scope, branch, horizon, obligations, admissibility, view, and cutoff. Completeness remains conditional on the declared profile and assessment premises.

</details>


### [400] [Key-Reuse Vulnerability of Phase-Keyed Fourier-Curve Modulation: Relation Leakage and Key-Refresh Cost on Coded Links](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01484)
*Bin Han,Muxia Sun,H. Vincent Poor,Hans D. Schotten*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 针对密钥调制在密钥重用与谐波耦合下安全性论证失效的问题，提出模关系格刻画泄露特征，并用非数据辅助关系矩估计器实现无需枚举密钥空间的攻击。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统密钥调制安全性通常以密钥空间大小和无密钥接收机误码率为依据，但当密钥被重用且波形存在谐波耦合时，该证据不再成立：相位键控傅里叶曲线星座中多个音调共享同一数据参数，谐波索引间的整数关系会产生抵消数据的混合矩，从而暴露密钥特征。

Method: 对相位键控傅里叶曲线星座建立模关系格以刻画可暴露的密钥字符；对连续谐波利用三阶矩恢复相对相位，并用四阶矩在其系数非零时完成密钥恢复（至多相差循环重标号）；构造非数据辅助的关系矩估计器，将泄露转化为不枚举密钥空间的攻击。评估在规则(3,6) LDPC编码链路上进行，比较切向人工噪声与四阶以下无关系谐波集的影响，并给出密钥刷新速率要求。

Result: 在规则(3,6) LDPC编码链路上，每个168符号码字使用一个密钥时，中间噪声水平下窃听者块错误率低于0.04；攻击在12个工作点中的11个满足预设0.1妥协判据。切向人工噪声与四阶以下无关系谐波集在中等重用长度下提高其测得错误率，但无法消除单码字脆弱性。在中间噪声水平、2^128协议密钥网格下，使窃听者块错误率95%置信下界高于0.9的等长刷新调度至少需每个信息比特1.52个新密钥比特，为数据一次一密熵率的1.52倍。

Conclusion: 仅凭密钥空间大小与无密钥接收机误码率不足以论证密钥调制安全性；谐波耦合与密钥重用会导致可被关系矩攻击利用的结构性泄露，需按泄露分析结果设定密钥刷新速率并要求更高的新鲜密钥比特开销。

Abstract: The security of keyed modulation is often argued from the key-space size and the error rate of a key-less receiver. This evidence fails when the key is reused and the waveform is harmonically coupled. For a phase-keyed Fourier-curve constellation, whose $k$ tones share one data parameter, integer relations among the harmonic indices yield data-cancelling mixed moments of the received tones that expose key characters. A modular relation lattice characterizes the exposed characters; for consecutive harmonics, third-order moments recover the relative phases and a fourth-order moment completes the key up to cyclic relabeling whenever its coefficient is nonzero, as in all evaluated settings. A non-data-aided relation-moment estimator turns this leakage into an attack that never enumerates the key space. On a regular $(3,6)$ LDPC-coded link, one key per 168-symbol codeword leaves the eavesdropper a block error rate below $0.04$ at the middle noise level, and the attack meets a predeclared $0.1$ compromise criterion in eleven of twelve operating points. Tangent artificial noise and a harmonic set without relations below order four raise her measured error rate at intermediate reuse lengths but do not remove the one-codeword vulnerability. For a grid of $2^{128}$ protocol keys at the middle noise level, equal-length refresh schedules that keep a $95\%$ lower confidence bound of her block error rate above $0.9$ consume at least $1.52$ fresh key bits per information bit, $1.52$ times the entropy rate of a one-time pad on the data.

</details>


### [401] [OverAct: Measuring and Mitigating Proactive Over-Authorization in LLM Tool-Calling Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01508)
*Taolin Zhang,Jiuheng Wan,Hanyu Wang,Tingyuan Hu,Chengyu Wang*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 该论文提出并研究结构化工具调用智能体中的"主动式过度授权"行为,构建了基准OverAct与决策论框架,发现过度授权源于结构性决策倾向而非解码随机性,并提出零样本推理时方法SelfAudit将隐私导向的越界访问降低43%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 具备工具调用能力的LLM智能体可访问外部服务与用户私有数据,但可能检索超出用户请求明确所需的信息。作者将这一行为在结构化工具调用智能体中的表现命名为"主动式过度授权"(proactive over-authorization)。该设定与文件系统层面的编码智能体不同,其主要风险在于对私有数据的不必要访问,因此需要一个针对性的控制基准与理论解释。

Method: 构建OverAct基准:覆盖八个隐私敏感领域,采用确定性、无需人工评判(judge-free)的评分方式;配套一个可解释的决策论框架,导出三个可检验预测。在来自四个模型家族的七个模型上进行评估。此外提出SelfAudit——一种零样本、推理时的方法,通过生成基于请求的正当性理由,在执行前过滤缺乏正当依据的调用;并进行消融分析。

Result: 所有被测模型均显著超出授权范围。请求具体性是严重程度的最强预测因子;过度授权随工具池规模呈次线性增长;解码温度影响甚微。这些模式与"成本不对称"解释一致。消融显示,显式过滤是缩减访问范围的主要驱动因素;SelfAudit在无oracle知识条件下将隐私导向的越界访问减少43%。

Conclusion: 过度授权更多源于结构性决策倾向,而非解码随机性。SelfAudit作为一种无需训练、推理时即插即用的缓解手段,在无先验知识下有效降低隐私越界,其中显式过滤机制是效果的核心来源。

Abstract: LLM agents with tool-calling capabilities can access external services and private user data, but they may retrieve more information than a user's request explicitly requires. We study this behavior in structured tool-calling agents and term it proactive over-authorization. This setting differs from filesystem-level coding agents because the main risk is unnecessary access to private data. We introduce OverAct, a controlled benchmark spanning eight privacy-sensitive domains with deterministic, judge-free scoring, together with an interpretive decision-theoretic framework that yields three testable predictions. Across seven models from four families, all models significantly exceed authorized scope. Request specificity is the strongest predictor of severity, over-authorization grows sublinearly with tool-pool size, and decoding temperature has little effect. These patterns are consistent with a cost-asymmetry account, suggesting that over-authorization arises more from structural decision tendencies than from decoding randomness. We also propose SelfAudit, a zero-shot inference-time method that generates request-grounded justifications and filters unjustified calls before execution. Ablation shows that explicit filtering is the main driver of scope reduction. SelfAudit reduces privacy-oriented excess by 43% without oracle knowledge.

</details>


### [402] [False Floors: LLM Safety Routing Evaluations Break Under Distribution Shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01535)
*Amit Singh Bhatti,Vishal Vaddina*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文指出安全路由基准以"评测数据上选出的最佳单模型"作对比基准会引入选择偏差，作者量化了该偏差在分布偏移下的规模，并揭示基于"识别"的防御可被攻击者操控。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 路由基准通常用评测集上表现最好的单模型作为基准对照，在自身同分布设定下无害，但在分布偏移下会系统性高估路由收益。作者希望量化该偏差大小，并检验路由在真实偏移条件下的实际价值。

Method: 在HELM Safety随机划分与留出类别划分下测量选择成本；在AgentDojo留出套件上测规模增长；用预先固定的规则选取七个安全语料，其中三个通过注册的区间检验、四个优于事后置换零假设；将偏差上界分解为乐观偏差加偏移相关后悔；另在留出重跑中构造了解自身所面对模型的攻击者，并做离线反事实控制器合成。
