Result: HELM Safety上选择成本为随机划分0.003-0.030、留出类别0.045-0.113（与路由所致全部差距相当，方向在任一已发表评判器下一致）；AgentDojo留出套件下上升7-9倍。多数池单元中嵌套路由器实际服务的正是诚实基准的模型；近乎饱和的AgentDojo上，完美预派发路由器至多带来2个危害点收益。知悉模型的攻击者使GPT-5.4的判定识别率下降19.6点，且经独立标签确认；离线反事实合成中危害升降取决于回退模型。

Conclusion: 安全路由应在分布偏移下、并对照不使用测试标签选出的基准来评估；基于识别的防御应按危害、并针对可选择模型输入的攻击者来评分。

Abstract: Safety routers send each request to one of several models and are judged against the best single model. A major routing benchmark picks that comparator on the evaluation data. In the benchmark's own setting this is harmless, but under distribution shift it is not. On HELM Safety the selection cost is 0.003-0.030 of harm under random splits and 0.045-0.113 under held-out categories, comparable to the whole deficit attributed to routing, with its direction holding under either published judge alone. It rises seven- to ninefold on AgentDojo when suites are held out. Across seven safety corpora chosen by rules fixed in advance, three meet a registered interval test and four beat a later permutation null, and three of the four interval misses are corpora where some models have zero observed harm. Prior work proves the direction of this bias. We size it on harm and accuracy, show that it is larger under the held-out splits we measure, and bound it by optimism plus a shift-dependent regret. Scored honestly under shift, routing buys little on these benchmarks. In most pool cells the nested router serves the honest baseline's model, and on the nearly saturated AgentDojo corpus a perfect pre-dispatch router is worth at most two points of harm. We also find a model's expressed recognition of a late injection steerable. On held-out reruns an attacker who knows which model it faces lowers GPT-5.4's judged recognition by 19.6 points, confirmed by an independent label. In an offline counterfactual composition into a controller, the same attack raises or lowers estimated harm depending on the fallback model. Safety routing should be evaluated under shift, against a baseline chosen without the test labels, and recognition-based defences should be scored on harm against an attacker who chooses what the model sees.

</details>


### [403] [Chaining Skills to Hijack LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01564)
*Tian Dong,Zixuan Ma,Haodong Zhao,Huaien Zhang,Shaofeng Li,Hao Chen*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出APEX方法，通过构建针对用户任务的对抗性技能链，利用"代理编写的真实进度记录"传递虚假用户授权声明，跨技能引导攻击者选定动作，在690次尝试中成功诱导512次（74.2%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM代理通过调用多个技能完成专业任务，技能间存在信息传递（前序技能的产物引导后续决策）。由于技能可能来自开源仓库，这种交接会把攻击者控制的声明带入后续决策，形成安全风险。现有研究缺少对这种跨技能链式攻击的系统性构造与评估。

Method: APEX构造并优化针对特定用户任务和攻击者选定动作的对抗性技能链。核心思路：代理自行编写的"真实任务进度记录"可携带虚假的用户授权声明跨越技能边界——上游技能诱导代理生成该记录，下游技能利用它执行攻击者选定的动作。评估覆盖4类目标动作族、6个模型、SkillsBench基准；对比单技能合并工作流；并测试让代理核对技能产出文件与原始请求的提示防御。

Result: 690次尝试中成功诱导目标动作512次（74.2%）。GPT-5.4上完整技能链成功率84.3%，而将工作流合并为单一技能仅17.4%。提示防御将GPT-5.4的目标动作成功率从84.3%降至59.1%，但同时使72个良性原生技能任务的验证器通过率从86.7%降至56.3%。

Conclusion: 多技能链式交接放大了攻击面，单一技能合并可显著降低攻击成功率，但提示防御存在明显的安全性与实用性权衡（防御有效但损害正常任务性能）。凸显出需要既能阻止攻击者定向动作、又能保持合法任务表现的防御机制。

Abstract: LLM agents use skills to improve performance on specialized tasks. To complete a user request, an agent may invoke several skills in sequence, allowing information produced under one skill to guide the next. Because skills may come from open-source repositories, this handoff can also carry attacker-controlled claims into later decisions. In this paper, we introduce APEX, which constructs and refines adversarial skill chains tailored to a user task and an attacker-selected action. The key insight is that an agent-written record of genuine task progress can carry a false claim of user approval across skills: an upstream skill induces the agent to create the record, and a downstream skill uses it to direct the attacker-selected action. Across four targeted-action families and six models on SkillsBench, the chains induce the selected action in 512 of 690 attempts (74.2%). On GPT-5.4, the full chain succeeds in 84.3% of attempts, compared with 17.4% when the workflow is merged into one skill. We further evaluate a prompting defense that asks the agent to check skill-produced files against the original request. On GPT-5.4, it lowers targeted-action success from 84.3% to 59.1%, while the verifier test-pass rate across 72 benign native-skill tasks falls from 86.7% to 56.3%. These results highlight the need for defenses that prevent attacker-directed actions while preserving legitimate task performance.

</details>


### [404] [Protocol Integration of Physical Layer Deception into EAP-TEAP Wi-Fi Authentication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01580)
*Moustafa Ibrahim,Bin Han,Hans D. Schotten*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种基于批处理PLD（物理层欺骗）的再验证步骤，用于企业Wi-Fi的TEAP/RADIUS/IEEE 802.11认证链，并在开源hostap 2.12代码库中完成了服务器、接入点和设备的端到端实现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于凭证的EAP认证无法区分合法凭证持有者与使用泄露凭证的攻击者。现有PLD研究仍停留在物理/链路模型层面，且将PLD激活/去激活机制用作认证门会产生认证特有的设计需求——若全部为非激活尝试则不会触发任何恢复路径。

Method: 提出面向企业Wi-Fi认证链的批处理PLD再验证步骤，在hostap 2.12中实现服务器、AP、设备端到端原型；每次尝试含三轮且至少一轮激活，不设专属激活标志；通过四个campaign共1593次尝试，评估批量恢复行为、拒绝承载凭证的朴素攻击者、测量成功路径延迟，并在两种建模恢复机制下评估1/2/3个激活轮的安全-可靠性权衡，直接测试协议与软件MAC行为，并分析知情型与重试型攻击者。

Result: 四个campaign共1593次尝试，实现了批量恢复行为评估；在所有30次尝试中拒绝了承载凭证的朴素攻击者；测量了成功路径延迟；在两种恢复机制下评估了1、2、3个激活轮的安全-可靠性权衡。

Conclusion: 该原型端到端验证了批处理PLD再验证在企业Wi-Fi认证链中的可行性与安全性，能够拒绝朴素凭证攻击者，并刻画了激活轮数与恢复机制对安全-可靠性权衡的影响。

Abstract: Credential-based Extensible Authentication Protocol (EAP) authentication cannot distinguish a legitimate credential holder from an adversary using compromised credentials. Physical Layer Deception (PLD) complements credential-based authentication by exposing a deceptive primary object over a primary transport while a separate recovery object travels with differentiated reliability over a secondary channel. Existing PLD studies remain, to our knowledge, at the physical/link-model level; using PLD's activation/deactivation mechanism as an authentication gate creates an authentication-specific design requirement, since an all-inactive attempt would exercise no recovery path. We present a batched PLD-based re-verification step for Enterprise Wi-Fi's TEAP/RADIUS/IEEE 802.11 authentication chain, implemented end to end across the server, access point, and device in the open-source hostap 2.12 codebase. Each attempt carries three rounds, at least one active, with no dedicated activation flag. Across four campaigns totaling 1593 attempts, the prototype evaluates batched recovery behavior, rejects the implemented naive credential-bearing attacker in all 30 attempts, measures successful-path latency, and evaluates the security-reliability trade-off for one, two, and three active rounds under two modeled recovery regimes. The evaluation exercises the protocol and software-MAC behavior directly and analyzes informed and retry-seeking attackers under the software recovery model.

</details>


### [405] [Combining Homomorphic Encryption and Differential Privacy in Federated Learning for Model Inspection and Availability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01650)
*Ceren Yıldırım,Kamer Kaya,Sinan Yıldırım,Erkay Savaş*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出一种结合同态加密训练与差分隐私模型发布/审查的隐私保护联邦学习框架，并用MCMC贝叶斯方法估计其隐私，实验表明在FEMNIST上同时提升了模型效用与估计隐私。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习本身不足以充分保护敏感训练数据，通常需搭配差分隐私或同态加密等隐私技术。但单一技术仅解决单一层面的问题，单独依赖一种机制往往不足以应对联邦学习中的多种隐私挑战，因此需要将多种互补的隐私技术结合。

Method: 提出一种隐私保护联邦学习框架：将基于同态加密的训练与基于差分隐私的模型审查及发布相结合。此外，采用基于马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）的贝叶斯隐私估计方法来评估该框架的隐私水平，并研究了间歇性模型监控对该框架的影响。

Result: 在FEMNIST数据集上，训练结束时本方法的测试损失为1.09，而仅差分隐私方法为2.37；同时本方法提供更强的估计隐私保护，隐私参数ε的估计后验均值为4.32，而仅差分隐私方法为7.26。此外，间歇性模型监控可在保持加密训练轨迹的同时，在本实验设定下提供与仅差分隐私方法相当或更强的估计隐私。

Conclusion: 将同态加密训练与差分隐私模型审查/发布相结合，能够在提升模型效用的同时提供更强的估计隐私保护，优于仅依赖差分隐私的基线方法；间歇性模型监控亦能在保持加密训练轨迹的前提下获得有竞争力的隐私保障。

Abstract: The increasing prevalence of decentralized data has led to a growing interest in federated learning, which enables collaborative model training without clients sharing their sensitive local data. However, FL alone does not sufficiently protect sensitive training data and is generally coupled with privacy-preserving techniques, such as differential privacy and homomorphic encryption. Although powerful, these techniques address separate concerns via different mechanisms, so relying on just one might prove insufficient or impractical for addressing challenges associated with federated learning. In this work, we propose a privacy-preserving federated learning framework that combines homomorphic encryption-based training with differential privacy-based model inspection and release. We adopt a Markov chain Monte Carlo-based Bayesian privacy estimation method to estimate the privacy of our proposed framework. Our results show that this method improves both model utility and estimated privacy over the baseline method that relies solely on differential privacy for training. In our experiments with the FEMNIST dataset, by the end of training, our method reaches a test loss of $1.09$, compared to $2.37$ for the differential privacy-only approach, while providing stronger estimated privacy protection, with the estimated posterior mean of the privacy parameter $ε$ of $4.32$, compared to $7.26$ for the differential privacy-only approach. We also show that intermittent model monitoring can preserve the encrypted training trajectory while, under our evaluated experimental setting, providing estimated privacy comparable to or stronger than the differential privacy-only approach.

</details>


### [406] [The Achilles' Heel of Partial Reconfiguration: Optical Side-Channel Leakage on the 7-Series ICAP](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01736)
*Antonio Saavedra,Jan Caspar Marx,Lars Renkes,Jean-Pierre Seifert*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 该工作实现并评估了AMD为7系列FPGA提出的非对称密钥比特流保护方案（基于可编程逻辑部分重构），并提出一种光学侧信道攻击，利用光子发射显微与电光探测在动态重构过程中无接触地提取ICAP接口明文配置数据，从而证明即便采用部分重构与自定义密码引擎的高级加密方案仍受光学攻击威胁。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主流FPGA厂商采用比特流加密保护配置数据，但最广泛使用的FPGA系列中硬连线的不可修补保护方案已被多种攻击绕过或完全攻破，因此需要可修补的加密方案。作者旨在评估此类新方案的实际安全性。

Method: 在7系列FPGA上实现AMD提出的非对称密钥比特流保护概念验证，利用可编程逻辑进行部分重构；分析其安全性与硬件开销；随后提出并演示光学侧信道攻击：使用光子发射显微（PEM）定位ICAP接口，再用光电探测（EOP）无接触提取明文数据。

Result: 成功定位AMD XC7A200T器件中的ICAP总线，并证明可通过光电探测提取其上的明文数据；同时给出了该实现方案的安全性分析与硬件开销评估。

Conclusion: 即使采用部分重构和自定义密码引擎的高级加密方案也易受光学攻击，因为重构只能通过硬连线的、存在脆弱性的配置接口进行，说明比特流保护需考虑物理侧信道威胁。

Abstract: Major FPGA manufacturers have incorporated bitstream encryption to protect sensitive configuration data. However, for the most widely used FPGA families, multiple attacks against unpatchable protection schemes hard-wired into the devices can bypass or fully break them, making patchable schemes desirable.
  In this work, we present a proof-of-concept implementation of an AMD-proposed asymmetric key encryption scheme for bitstream protection for 7-Series FPGAs, using partial reconfiguration from the Programmable Logic. We analyze the security implications and hardware overhead of this implementation. We then propose and demonstrate an optical side-channel attack that is able to recover plain-text configuration data during the dynamic reconfiguration process. This attack leverages Photon Emission Microscopy and Electro-Optical Probing to first locate and then contactlessly extract the plain-text data from the ICAP interface, which internally connects the Programmable Logic with the configuration logic.
  We located the ICAP buses in an AMD XC7A200T device and show that the data on it can be extracted with Electro-Optical Probing. We claim that even advanced encryption schemes utilizing Partial Reconfiguration and custom cryptographic engines are vulnerable to optical attacks, as reconfiguration is only possible via hard-wired, vulnerable configuration interfaces.

</details>


### [407] [SoK: Decentralized Agent Economic Infrastructure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01756)
*Rui Sun,Xihan Xiong,Qin Wang,Fei Gao,Zelin Li,Zehua Cheng,Jiahao Sun,Zhipeng Wang*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 该论文系统化了去中心化智能体经济中"跨协议组合导致端到端保障失效"的问题，提出以"保障闭包"为判据，贯穿任务全生命周期评估验证与结算环节的保障可用性与约束力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 去中心化智能体经济常由分别设计与保障的协议拼装出单一任务，导致工作流每一步看似正确、整体结果却错误；例如托管合约在授权批准时正确放款，但该批准几乎不提供"交付工作满足任务"的证据。

Method: 将安全与经济需求组织为覆盖六个阶段的17个属性族，并将收据的健全性与完备性分开评估；考察12个系统与标准、5类可复用机制族、4个经典基线；提出"保障闭包"这一任务相对判据，用于判定某一阶段建立的保障是否仍在后续依赖决策中可用并构成约束。

Result: 在受控与原生工作流上应用该判据，覆盖840次配对执行，并在有限客观任务域上做穷尽式11,648例检查；结果反复暴露验证与结算之间的失效，即合规工作可能未被接受、有效证据可能被忽略；公开记录与模型判断进一步区分"记录的批准"与"任务符合性证据"，经济学分析识别出这些保障背后的报告、罚金与共谋误差假设。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了端到端保障在何处失效，以及为在工作流中保持这些保障需要修复哪些环节。

Abstract: Decentralized agent economies increasingly build a single task from protocols that were designed and secured separately. This creates a simple problem: a workflow can look correct at each step and still produce the wrong outcome. For example, a correct escrow may release payment on an authorized approval that provides little evidence that the delivered work actually satisfied the task.
  We systematize this problem across the full lifecycle of an agent task. Our study organizes security and economic requirements into 17 property families over six stages, with receipt soundness and completeness assessed separately. We examine 12 systems and standards, five reusable mechanism families, and four classical baselines. We introduce guarantee closure, a task-relative criterion for determining whether guarantees established at one stage remain available and constrain the later decisions that depend on them.
  We apply the criterion to controlled and native workflows, covering 840 matched executions and an exhaustive 11,648-case check over a finite objective-task domain. Our results expose recurring failures between verification and settlement, where conforming work can remain unaccepted or valid evidence can be ignored. Public records and model judgments further distinguish recorded approval from evidence of task conformance, while economic analysis identifies the report, penalty, and shared-error assumptions behind these guarantees. These findings show where end-to-end guarantees fail and what must be repaired to preserve them across the workflow.

</details>


### [408] [The Innocent Courier: Covert Exfiltration Through Legitimate LLM Web Fetching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01768)
*Alessandro Pegoraro,Daryan Merx,Phillip Rieger,Ahmad-Reza Sadeghi*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出 LLMLeak，一种利用 LLM 网页抓取工具建立隐蔽信道、将机密数据泄露给第三方的新型攻击向量，在 11 个开放参数模型上取得 79.7% 的攻击成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着 LLM 及 LLM 智能体被广泛用于日常任务，已有研究多关注提示注入、向聊天机器人提供商泄露敏感数据等风险，并提出了输入结构化、部署本地 LLM 等对策。然而，LLM 还可能将机密数据泄露给第三方，这一攻击面尚未被充分研究。

Method: LLMLeak 针对本地运行、无法直接联网的恶意软件：该组件将秘密编码嵌入 URL，并把该 URL 伪装成某个良性任务（如迁移软件库）所需信息的来源。由于直接生成代码发送数据或调用网络库易被检测和限制，LLMLeak 仅依赖 LLM 获取网站信息的工具，诱导其访问恶意 URL，随后攻击者通过受控的 DNS 或 Web 服务器接收编码后的秘密，从而建立隐蔽信道。

Result: 在 11 个开放参数模型上进行广泛评估，观察到 79.7% 的攻击成功率；并针对真实聊天机器人开展案例研究，验证了 LLMLeak 的现实相关性。

Conclusion: LLM 的联网/网页抓取工具可被本地恶意软件滥用，形成绕过常规网络限制的隐蔽数据外泄信道，构成一种现实且有效的安全威胁，需引起重视并加以防御。

Abstract: With the increasing capabilities of Large-Language-Models (LLMs) and LLM-based agents, users are increasingly using them to solve everyday problems, such as answering e-mails or providing programming support. Existing work has extensively investigated security and privacy risks, such as prompt injections and the disclosure of sensitive data to chatbot providers. While various solutions were developed to address these risks, including input structuring to prevent prompt injections or deploying local LLMs to avoid sharing confidential data with chatbot operators, LLMs also pose the risk of leaking confidential data to third parties.
  In this paper, we demonstrate with LLMLeak a novel attack vector where malicious software that runs locally but cannot communicate directly with the internet abuses LLMs to establish a covert channel. While inputs that instruct the LLM to send data directly via generated code are easy to detect and network libraries are typically restricted, LLMLeak relies only on the LLM's tool to fetch websites for further information. A malicious software component on the client side embeds a secret into a URL. It presents the referenced website as providing information required for a benign task, such as migrating a software library. When the LLM accesses the URL, the attacker receives the encoded secret through an attacker-controlled DNS or web server. We perform an extensive evaluation on eleven open-parameter models, observe an attack success rate of 79.7%, and also conduct a case study on real-world chatbots, demonstrating the relevance of LLMLeak.

</details>


### [409] [Walking the Embedding Space: Datastore Extraction from Multimodal RAG](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01871)
*Maria Carmen Jica,Ali Satvaty,Suzan Verberne,Fatih Turkmen*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出 IMMRAG，一种针对"图像返回型"多模态检索增强生成（MRAG）系统的自适应黑盒数据抽取攻击方法，通过将攻击指令嵌入输入图像并以相关性加权重采样引导查询，在多个真实场景中成功重建大量私密图像，揭示多模态数据的安全防护亟需加强。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MRAG 虽能降低幻觉、提升生成可靠性，但引入了新的攻击面，包括隐私泄露与数据抽取攻击。现有抽取攻击多以文本提示形式诱导模型泄露数据，尚缺乏针对"图像即回答"这一图像返回型 MRAG 配置的攻击研究，该场景下检索到的视觉产物本身即为响应，风险被忽视。

Method: 提出 IMMRAG（自适应、自动化的黑盒数据抽取攻击）。攻击针对 image-returning MRAG：检索到的视觉产物即为响应。每次查询将攻击者持有的影子图像与已从系统恢复的图像混合，通过相关性加权重采样将后续查询导向嵌入空间中仍能产生新检索的区域。与现有通过文本提示诱导泄露的攻击不同，IMMRAG 将恶意指令内嵌于用户输入图像中。在医疗助手、文档助手和通用工具三个真实场景中评估，涉及多种 CLIP 家族检索器与不同生成器的影响。

Result: 单次 2500 次查询运行在局部特征对应下最多重建 611 张不同的放射学图像、566 份文档扫描件和 416 张通用图像，达到非自适应基线多达 5.6 倍的不同数据存储条目数。

Conclusion: 结果表明多模态检索增强生成系统面临严重的数据抽取威胁，亟需专门针对多模态数据设计的安全防护措施。

Abstract: Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (MRAG) has emerged as a reliable and cost-effective technique of grounding the generative capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) into relevant, up-to-date, external knowledge. Despite presenting several benefits, such as reducing hallucinatory behavior, they also introduce new attack surfaces, including leakage of private information and vulnerabilities against data extraction attacks.
  In this paper, we introduce $\immrag$, an adaptive and automatic data extraction attack procedure operating in a black box setting against \emph{image-returning} MRAG, a configuration in which the retrieved visual artifact is itself the response. Each query blends an attacker-held shadow image with an image already recovered from the system, and relevance-weighted resampling steers subsequent queries towards regions of the embedding space that still yield novel retrievals. Unlike current extraction attacks that aim to persuade the model towards data leakage by placing a malicious query as a textual prompt, $\immrag$ embeds the malicious instructions inside a user-given input image. We evaluate $\immrag$ on three plausible and distinct real-world scenarios: medical assistant, document-focused helper and general purpose tool. The experiments involve the study of the effectiveness of the attack on multiple CLIP-family retrievers, as well as the impact of various generators. A single 2500-query run reconstructs up to 611 distinct radiology images, 566 document scans and 416 general-purpose images under local-feature correspondence, and reaches up to $5.6\times$ as many distinct datastore items as a non-adaptive baseline. Our results show the urgent need for safeguards specifically designed for multimodal data.

</details>


### [410] [From Network Intrusion Detection to Blockchain-Backed Endpoint Detection and Response: Mapping the Landscape of Decentralized Detection-and-Response Architectures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01872)
*Yahya Shahsavari,Sara Rouhani,Kaiwen Zhang*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文是一篇SoK综述，提出三轴分类法（检测系统类别、区块链功能角色、响应自动化成熟度）系统梳理2019–2026年区块链辅助IoT/IIoT入侵检测与响应研究，并给出差距分析与研究议程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有区块链辅助IDS/IPS综述存在两大缺陷：一是忽视向EDR/XDR现代架构的结构性转变，二是将区块链的多重功能角色混同为单一整体类别，导致文献划分粗糙、研究空白难以识别。

Method: 提出三轴分类法：检测系统类别（NIDS、HIDS、EDR/XDR）、区块链功能角色、响应自动化成熟度；综合2019–2026年高水平会议/期刊研究成果进行系统化知识整理（SoK），并开展差距分析与跨领域挑战评估。

Result: 差距分析表明，真正意义上的"逐端点、以区块链为锚的响应闭环"几乎不存在，原因在于时延、部署模式与社区机制的不匹配；同时识别出四类共性挑战：受限设备上的共识时延、后量子密码脆弱性、智能合约攻击面，以及基于LLM的检测引擎易受对抗攻击。

Conclusion: 研究议程聚焦链上/链下混合编排，以弥合去中心化信任与快速响应自动化之间的鸿沟，为后续EDR/XDR场景下的区块链信任锚定研究提供方向。

Abstract: While the literature on blockchain-assisted intrusion detection and prevention systems (IDS/IPS) for Internet of Things (IoT) and Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) networks is mature, existing systematic reviews suffer from two critical limitations: they overlook the structural shift toward modern Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) and Extended Detection and Response (XDR) architectures, and they conflate blockchain's distinct functional roles into a single monolithic category. This Systematization of Knowledge (SoK) addresses these gaps by proposing a three-axis taxonomy that classifies proposals by detection-system class (NIDS, HIDS, EDR/XDR), blockchain functional role, and response-automation maturity. Synthesizing research published in high-impact venues between 2019 and 2026, we provide a rigorous gap analysis exposing why a genuine per-endpoint blockchain-anchored response loop remains nearly nonexistent due to latency, deployment, and community mismatches. Furthermore, we evaluate structural, cross-cutting challenges persisting across the literature, including consensus latency on constrained devices, post-quantum cryptographic vulnerability, smart-contract attack surfaces, and the adversarial vulnerability of evolving LLM-based detection engines. Finally, we outline a comprehensive research agenda centered on hybrid on-chain/off-chain orchestration to bridge the gap between decentralized trust and rapid response automation.

</details>


### [411] [A Structured State Space Sequence Model for Multi-Class Classification of Malware](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01893)
*Emmanuela Andam,Rana Shaaban,Emanuel Grant,Naima Kaabouch*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 该研究提出一种基于结构化状态空间序列（S4）模型的恶意软件检测与分类框架，首次将S4应用于恶意软件分析，通过离散化恶意软件样本序列并捕获长程依赖，识别执行流中的因果关联，并将其性能与其他深度学习架构进行全面对比，以增强IoT系统的安全性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 到2030年IoT设备预计达400亿台，广泛应用于工业、医疗、农业、汽车及建筑/家居自动化等领域，极大扩展了网络犯罪攻击面。多数设备缺乏内置安全机制，易被利用漏洞植入恶意软件以窃取敏感数据或勒索赎金。现有网络安全措施难以跟上IoT及每日新增恶意软件变种的快速增长，因此亟需更稳健、安全的IoT恶意软件检测与分类方法。

Method: 提出一种基于结构化状态空间序列（S4）模型的恶意软件检测与分类框架。该框架将恶意软件样本序列进行离散化处理，利用S4捕获序列中的长程依赖关系，从而识别恶意软件执行流中隐藏的"因"与"果"关联。

Result: 该研究提出两项新颖贡献：一是S4模型在恶意软件分析中的首次实证应用；二是将其性能与其他深度学习架构进行全面比较，为这一新范式下的后续研究奠定基础。

Conclusion: S4模型为IoT环境下的恶意软件检测与分类提供了新范式，通过捕获长程依赖提升检测能力，保护设备免受进一步攻击，使IoT系统更稳健、更安全，并为未来相关研究奠定基础。

Abstract: By 2030, Internet of Things (IoT) devices are projected to reach 40 billion, with fast-paced technological advancements in fields such as industry, healthcare, agriculture, automobiles, and building/home automation systems. This expansion has created a large attack surface for cybercrime, as the majority of these devices open the door for cybercriminals to exploit vulnerabilities, as they lack adequate built-in security. Cybercriminals launch malware attacks to compromise systems or steal sensitive data, and once a system is compromised, a ransom is typically demanded for its release. Current cybersecurity measures in place are being outpaced by the rapid growth of the IoT, which is accompanied by a subsequent growth in malware variants being created per day. Recognizing this pitfall, this research examines and proposes a novel approach to malware detection and classification to safeguard devices from further attacks and make IoT systems more robust and secure. The framework proposed utilizes a Structured State Space Sequence (S4) model, which discretizes sequences of malware samples in a sequence and captures long-range dependencies, essentially identifying the "cause" and "effect" hidden within malware execution flow. This study presents two novel contributions: the first empirical application of the S4 model for malware analysis, and a comprehensive comparison of its performance against other deep learning architectures, laying the stepping stone for future research in this new paradigm.

</details>


### [412] [Detection and Resolution of Periodic Artifacts in OpenDP's Discrete Laplace Sampler](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01907)
*Cesare Gerolimetto Fabrello,Valeria Rossi,Alberto Trombetta,Massimo Caccia*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文发现OpenDP离散拉普拉斯采样器存在周期性分布畸变伪影，溯源至bernoulli_exp1所依赖有理算术库的缺陷实现，并提出基于精确有理算术的替代实现，经10^6样本统计验证，修正后采样器输出与理论分布无差别。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 差分隐私的形式化保证依赖对噪声分布的精确采样，若底层采样器存在系统性偏差，隐私保证将被破坏。作者旨在揭示OpenDP离散拉普拉斯采样器中隐蔽的实现缺陷及其对输出分布的影响。

Method: 作者通过系统性测试发现输出分布中的周期性畸变，采用诊断方法在嵌套采样层级中逐层隔离出故障组件，定位到bernoulli_exp1（采样Bernoulli(e^(-x))的低层原语）所使用有理算术库的实现错误，并提出基于精确有理算术的替代实现以消除伪影。

Result: 诊断方法成功定位故障组件；修正后的采样器经10^6样本统计验证，其输出在测试精度水平上与理论分布不可区分。

Conclusion: 底层有理算术实现的缺陷会在高层差分隐私采样器中引入周期性伪影，威胁隐私保证的正确性；采用精确有理算术可有效消除此类伪影，凸显了对隐私原语进行端到端统计验证的必要性。

Abstract: Differential privacy implementations rely on precise sampling from noise distributions to provide formal privacy guarantees. We report the discovery of systematic artifacts in OpenDP's discrete Laplace sampler that manifest as periodic distortions in the output distribution. Through systematic testing, we trace these artifacts to a faulty implementation in the rational arithmetic library used by the bernoulli_exp1 function, a low-level primitive that implements sampling from Bernoulli(e^(-x)) distributions. We present a diagnostic methodology that isolates the faulty component in the nested sampling hierarchy and propose an alternative implementation based on exact rational arithmetic that eliminates the artifacts. Statistical validation with 10^6 samples confirms that the corrected sampler produces outputs indistinguishable from the theoretical distribution at the tested precision level.

</details>


### [413] [A Hybrid Approach to Malware Detection: Integrating Few-Shot Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning with Autoencoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01949)
*Emmanuela Andam,Yasir Abbas Zaidi,Abdelali Hadir,Emmanuel Grant,Naima Kaabouch*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出一种结合自编码器特征提取器(AFE)与模型无关元学习(MAML)分类器的混合深度学习框架，用于小样本勒索软件检测，在Ransomware Dataset 2024上1–50 shot设置下取得稳定的高准确率、F1与MCC。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 勒索软件攻击频发且影响关键行业，常通过钓鱼邮件、恶意下载或软件漏洞入侵，进而加密文件并索要加密货币赎金；传统检测方法面对新型或样本稀缺的恶意软件时表现不佳，导致系统防护脆弱。

Method: 提出混合深度学习框架：AFE（Autoencoder Feature Extractor）生成紧凑潜在特征以降噪和降维；MAML（Model Agnostic Meta Learning）分类器利用少量标注数据快速适配新威胁；在Ransomware Dataset 2024上进行二分类实验，覆盖1至50 shot的小样本设置。

Result: 在1到50 shot设置下，模型在准确率、F1分数和Matthews相关系数(MCC)上持续保持较高水平，即使在极端样本稀缺条件下仍能可靠分类。

Conclusion: 结果表明该框架在小样本场景下具有鲁棒性与有效性，验证了特征提取与元学习结合在提升恶意软件防御韧性方面的潜力，尤其适用于医疗、制造业和公共基础设施等攻击会造成重大运营与财务损失的领域。

Abstract: Ransomware has emerged as a major cybersecurity threat, with incidents increasing in frequency and impact across critical sectors. These attacks are typically launched through phishing emails, malicious downloads, or exploitation of software vulnerabilities to gain system access. Once inside, the malware encrypts files and demands a ransom, often in cryptocurrency, for the decryption key. Conventional detection methods often struggle with novel or scarce samples, leaving systems vulnerable. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a hybrid deep learning framework that combines an Autoencoder Feature Extractor (AFE) with a Model Agnostic Meta Learning (MAML) classifier for few shot malware detection. The AFE generates compact latent features that reduce noise and dimensionality, while the MAML classifier rapidly adapts to new threats using limited labeled data. Experiments conducted on the Ransomware Dataset 2024 demonstrate the effectiveness of the framework in binary classification tasks. Across one to fifty shot settings, the proposed model consistently achieves high accuracy, F1 score, and Matthews Correlation Coefficient values, maintaining reliable classification even under extreme scarcity. These results highlight the model's robustness and effectiveness in adapting to limited data scenarios, demonstrating the potential of combining feature extraction with meta learning to enhance resilience against malware, particularly in sectors such as healthcare, manufacturing, and public infrastructure, where cyberattacks can cause significant operational and financial disruption.

</details>


### [414] [System-Level Optimization Beyond Cryptographic Kernels: An ML-KEM Case Study on Arm Cortex-M7](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01960)
*Mahmoud Abdelhafeez Sayed,Mostafa Taha,Gurp Nijjer*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 在Arm Cortex-M7上以ML-KEM为例，研究表明算术内核优化之后，通过内存层次利用、紧耦合内存放置、外设集成、时钟配置和确定性公共数据复用，仍可获得显著部署收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期嵌入式后量子密码研究主要聚焦指令级优化，如算术内核改进、汇编调优、寄存器分配与指令调度，但对内存层次与执行系统层面的优化关注不足，因此需要评估算术内核优化之外是否仍有额外收益。

Method: 以Arm Cortex-M7上的ML-KEM为案例，从SLOTHY优化实现出发，覆盖全部三组ML-KEM参数集，在不修改密码算法和标准化线格式的前提下，考察存储层次利用、紧耦合内存放置、外设集成、时钟配置及确定性公共数据复用等优化手段。

Result: 无辅助公共状态的评估配置最多降低2.5%周期数；选定的公共数据复用配置使封装与解封装周期数分别最多降低74.6%和58.8%。

Conclusion: 算术内核优化之后仍存在可观的部署收益，作者据此提出同时考察外围执行系统的两阶段方法论。

Abstract: Recent work on embedded post-quantum cryptography has focused primarily on instruction-level optimization, including arithmetic-kernel improvements, assembly tuning, register allocation, and instruction scheduling. Using the Module-Lattice-Based Key-Encapsulation Mechanism (ML-KEM) on an Arm Cortex-M7 as a case study, we examine the additional gains available from memory-hierarchy utilization, tightly coupled memory placement, peripheral integration, clock configuration, and deterministic public-data reuse. The evaluation starts from a state-of-the-art SLOTHY-optimized implementation and covers all three ML-KEM parameter sets. Without modifying the cryptographic algorithm or standardized wire formats, the evaluated profiles without auxiliary public state reduce cycles by up to 2.5%. A selected public-data-reuse profile reduces encapsulation and decapsulation cycles by up to 74.6% and 58.8%, respectively. These results demonstrate that substantial deployment gains remain after arithmetic-kernel optimization and motivate a two-stage methodology that also examines the surrounding execution system.

</details>

# q-bio.QM [[Back]](#toc)

### [415] [Improving scoring functions for protein-protein docking with LambdaLoss](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00191)
*Richard Zhu,Darren Xu,Lee-Shin Chu,Jeffrey J. Gray*

Main category: q-bio.QM

TL;DR: 该研究提出利用Learning-to-Rank领域的LambdaLoss损失函数改进蛋白质-蛋白质对接构象排序,通过对DFMDock能量预测头进行微调,得到LambdaDockScore,在CAPRI基准上优于EuDockScore和原始DFMDock。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用建模需要准确打分函数,以区分近天然构象与错误构象。现有打分方法在构象排序(pose ranking)上仍有提升空间,作者希望借助信息检索中的排序学习损失函数来改进这一任务。

Method: 提出一个通用框架,采用Learning-to-Rank中的LambdaLoss损失函数来改进蛋白质-蛋白质构象排序及其他生物分子相互作用模型。具体实现是:在基于DIPS数据集构建的290万个诱饵构象(decoy poses)增强数据集上,对DFMDock的能量预测头进行微调,得到排序模型LambdaDockScore。

Result: 在CAPRI score set基准的靶标上,LambdaDockScore在top-1和top-5预测中识别正确构象的能力优于当前最优方法EuDockScore;同时在抗体-抗原复合物以及结合界面极大或极小的蛋白质-蛋白质复合物的打分任务上也优于原始DFMDock。

Conclusion: LambdaLoss可作为通用损失函数用于提升蛋白质-蛋白质构象排序及生物分子相互作用模型,微调后的LambdaDockScore在多个场景下取得一致的性能提升,验证了排序学习框架在该领域的有效性。

Abstract: Modeling protein-protein interactions requires accurate scoring functions that can rank potential poses (conformations) of a protein-protein complex to differentiate near-native poses from incorrect ones. Here, we propose a general framework for improving protein-protein pose ranking and other biomolecular interaction models using the LambdaLoss loss function from the Learning-to-Rank field. We test this framework by fine-tuning the energy prediction head of DFMDock with the LambdaLoss on an augmented dataset of 2.9M decoy poses derived from the DIPS dataset. On targets from the CAPRI score set benchmark, our fine-tuned ranking model LambdaDockScore is better at identifying correct poses in its top-1 and top-5 predictions compared to EuDockScore, a state-of-the-art method. LambdaDockScore also improves upon baseline DFMDock ranking performance for scoring antibody-antigen complexes and protein-protein complexes with very large or small binding interfaces.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [416] [Heavy-Tailed Memory Traces in Long-Horizon Language Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00010)
*Xinyuan Song,Zekun Cai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出以“记忆使用的形状”作为评估长时程语言智能体记忆系统的新对象，发现记忆检索呈核心-长尾分布，并提出CTWM控制器按秩分配提示预算，在保持覆盖与精度的同时显著节省token并降低尾部预测误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前记忆系统多以任务成功率或token成本评判，忽略了有限上下文与重复检索下记忆使用的分布形态：记忆会集中于小核心，把稀有状态留在长尾，导致预测误差在尾部累积，因此需要一个刻画该形态的诊断与调控手段。

Method: 作者进行保守的尾部审计，分析不同策略下检索痕迹的分布形态；据此提出Core–Tail World Model（CTWM），一种基于秩的记忆控制器，用单一指数τ分配提示预算，并对长尾保留摘要表示。

Result: CTWM在Synthetic Graph World上保持完整状态与转移覆盖，提示token减少5.9%，底部半数尾部预测误差相对图记忆基线降低13.6%；在ALFWorld上取得一致的token节省，在LongMemEval上token减少24.48%且总体准确率持平。

Conclusion: 重尾记忆痕迹不仅是有限检索的诊断指标，也可作为实现token高效智能体世界模型的实用控制信号。

Abstract: Long-horizon language agents increasingly rely on external memory as a frozen world model, yet current memory systems are usually judged only by task success or token cost. We argue that the missing object is the shape of memory use: under finite context and repeated retrieval, agent memory can concentrate on a small core while leaving rare states in a long tail where prediction errors accumulate. We study this effect through a conservative tail audit and find that concentration is reproducible but policy-dependent. Random-walk agents produce log-normal-compatible retrieval artifacts, whereas semantic LLM policies yield the strongest truncated-power-law-compatible core--tail traces. Motivated by this audit, we propose Core--Tail World Model (CTWM), a rank-based memory controller that allocates prompt budget with a single exponent $τ$ while retaining a summarized tail. On Synthetic Graph World, CTWM preserves full state and transition coverage, reduces prompt tokens by 5.9%, and lowers bottom-half tail prediction error by 13.6% relative to a graph-memory baseline. The same paired comparison gives consistent token savings on ALFWorld and a 24.48% token reduction on LongMemEval with aggregate accuracy parity. These results suggest that heavy-tailed memory traces are not only a diagnostic of finite retrieval, but also a practical control signal for token-efficient agent world models.

</details>


### [417] [When Do Causal World Models Help Modular LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00012)
*Xinyuan Song,Zekun Cai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出FedCausalCompose因果世界模型框架，研究模块化LLM智能体中跨模块接口的因果识别问题，并给出因果结构何时对智能体决策有益的边界条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体日益通过模块化系统（订单、支付、库存、物流等）行动，一个模块的动作会改变另一模块中合法的状态转移。标准世界模型多拟合观测轨迹，但观测轨迹无法区分"支付先于发货"是支付授权了发货、库存中介了效应，还是存在共同隐藏触发因素，因此不满足干预时规划所需的信息量。

Method: 提出FedCausalCompose框架，利用局部动作作为跨模块接口的干预—响应证据，进行因果组合式世界建模。理论上分析观测世界模型在未阻断后门路径下的不可约干预误差、接口恢复与干预—响应覆盖度的关系，并在诊断式智能体设定中检验预测。

Result: 观测世界模型在未阻断后门路径下存在不可约的干预误差；接口恢复随干预—响应覆盖度提升；在覆盖度和局部机制误差受控时，oracle因果组合可突破非因果下界。实验中，因果接口在结构化工具环境（API签名暴露前置条件和下游效应）中最有效；对话与叙事环境中智能体常忽略原始边列表，除非用简短注意力锚点使因果信息与决策相关。

Conclusion: 因果世界模型对LLM智能体有益的具体条件是：跨模块接口既统计可识别，又以智能体在动作时可以使用（去相关化、决策相关）的形式呈现。两者缺一，因果结构难以转化为实际收益。

Abstract: LLM agents increasingly act through modular systems, such as order, payment, inventory, and shipment services, where actions in one module change which transitions are valid in another. Standard world models usually fit observational traces, but this is not the quantity needed for intervention-time planning: a trace may show that payment precedes shipment without identifying whether payment authorizes shipment, inventory mediates the effect, or a hidden trigger explains both. We study this gap through FedCausalCompose, a causal world-model framework for modular LLM agents in which local actions provide intervention-response evidence for cross-module interfaces. We first show that observational world models incur an irreducible interventional error under unblocked back-door paths, that interface recovery improves with intervention-response coverage, and that an oracle causal composition can beat the non-causal lower bound when coverage and local mechanism errors are controlled. We then test the resulting prediction in diagnostic agent settings. Causal interfaces help most in structured tool environments, where API signatures expose preconditions and downstream effects. In contrast, dialogue and narrative environments often ignore raw edge lists unless a short attention anchor makes the causal information decision-relevant. These results identify a concrete condition for causal world models in LLM agents: causal structure helps when cross-module interfaces are both statistically identifiable and presented in a form the agent can use at action time.

</details>


### [418] [From Proposal to Verified Effect: Praxa, an Evidence-Bound Harness for Governed AI Agent Execution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00015)
*Stefan G. Creadore*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Praxa是一个智能体运行框架，通过确定性准入、代理执行、外部回读、对账与评审式晋升，显式区分“提议、授权、派发、已验证外部效果、上线晋升”五种状态；其贡献被界定为可测试的“授权—效果”证据绑定架构，而非性能或安全优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体虽能提出并执行动作，但“提议”“授权”“派发”“已验证的外部效果”“上线晋升”是本质不同的断言，常被混同；缺乏显式、可测试的状态区分会导致效果与授权边界不清、难以验证。

Method: 提出Praxa智能体运行框架，显式表示上述状态，机制包括确定性准入、代理化执行、外部读回、对账与评审式晋升。报告四条证据通道：(1) 作者自运行、固定revision的仓内审计（1027/1027单测、89/89 Workerd测试、363个源文件插桩、四项覆盖底线）；(2) 提供商支持的Terminal-Bench Core 0.1.1试点（12个精选任务，基线/可靠性层各17/36严格通过）；(3) 调试后两顺序协调代理开发对比（基线/源作者候选各180/180）；(4) 已部署源码与配置证据。

Result: 通道一：原始逐测记录与独立复现不可得。通道二：可靠性层输入token多37.49%、输出多50.73%，不支持优越性结论。通道三：候选token少37.11%、预估端点成本低33.84%、步数少11.63%，但未证明质量、延迟或生产行为改善。通道四：显示有界反思、召回记账、记忆编译与工具健康路径，无生产结果提升。

Conclusion: Praxa的受支持贡献是证据绑定架构，使“授权到效果”的转换显式且可测试。现有证据尚不能确立对抗安全性、生产安全、通用专家优越性、自主递归优化或用户收益。

Abstract: Large-language-model agents can propose and execute actions, but proposal, authority, dispatch, verified external effect, and serving promotion are different claims. We present Praxa, an agent harness that represents these states explicitly through deterministic admission, brokered execution, external read-back, reconciliation, and reviewed promotion. We report four evidence lanes. First, an author-run repository-local audit at a pinned revision passed 1,027/1,027 unit tests and 89/89 Workerd tests, instrumented all 363 expected source files, and met four coverage floors; raw per-test transcripts and independent reproduction are unavailable. Second, in a provider-backed Terminal-Bench Core 0.1.1 pilot across 12 curated tasks, baseline and reliability-layer arms each passed 17/36 strict trials. The reliability layer used 37.49% more input and 50.73% more output tokens, so the pilot does not support superiority. Third, in a post-debug, two-order coordination-proxy development comparison, baseline and a source-authored candidate each completed 180/180 trials with equal measured accuracy, full hermetic crash recovery, and zero protected violations. The candidate used 37.11% fewer tokens, 33.84% lower estimated endpoint cost, and 11.63% fewer steps; this does not establish improved quality, latency, or production behavior. Fourth, deployed source/configuration evidence shows bounded reflection, recall accounting, memory compilation, and tool-health paths, but no production outcome lift. Praxa's supported contribution is an evidence-bound architecture that makes authority-to-effect transitions explicit and testable. Current evidence does not establish adversarial security, production safety, general specialist superiority, autonomous recursive optimization, or user benefit.

</details>


### [419] [What Do Rationales Communicate? A Message-Intervention Study in Role-Specialized QA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00018)
*Jiameng Zhang,Hongqiu Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究提出"消息干预"诊断法，固定证据与候选答案、仅改变reasoner传递给verifier的rationale，揭示该通道对答案准确率贡献甚微，却显著影响验证器的支持性判断，构成新的失败面。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 角色专门化QA流水线越来越普遍地从reasoner向verifier传递rationale，但这一消息的真实作用不明：是提升答案、增强支持性评估，还是引入了新的失败面。作者希望厘清reasoner-to-verifier边界的rationale传递机制，而非仅将其视为提升准确率的途径。

Method: 引入消息干预（message-intervention）诊断：固定证据和候选答案不变，仅改变跨越reasoner-verifier边界所传递的rationale。在400个MuSiQue、HotpotQA与2WikiMultiHopQA样本上，使用DeepSeek分别作为生成器与验证器；对比无rationale、忠实rationale、被破坏rationale及无害复述条件下的效果，并设置盲验证提示与显式rationale检查提示两种情境，辅以人工审计以及跨模型与任务边界检验。

Result: 忠实rationale相较于无rationale几乎不提升答案准确率；而被破坏rationale强烈改变支持判断。盲验证提示下，无害复述仅使支持性变动0–2.5%，被破坏rationale则变动10–22%；显式rationale检查提示将同一模式放大至34–55%。最终答案变动较小（2–30%），仅有2.9–35.3%的支持翻转与答案变化同时发生。人工审计显示42个有效破坏中有16个属于"破坏-过度信任"案例，盲测人类对模型接受的10个被破坏rationale中的9个予以拒绝或标记为不明确。

Conclusion: rationale传递通道在跨模型与任务边界检验中呈现激活、放大、惰性或被并入任务标签等不同状态。rationale共享应作为验证消息机制来评估，而不只是提升答案准确率的途径。

Abstract: Role-specialized QA pipelines increasingly pass rationales from a reasoner to a verifier, but it is unclear what this message actually buys: better answers, stronger support assessment, or a new failure surface. We introduce a message-intervention diagnostic that fixes the evidence and candidate answer while varying only the rationale passed across the reasoner-to-verifier boundary. On 400 MuSiQue, HotpotQA, and 2WikiMultiHopQA examples with DeepSeek as generator and verifier, faithful rationales add almost no answer accuracy over no rationale, while corrupted rationales strongly alter support judgments. Under a blind verifier prompt, harmless paraphrases shift support by only 0--2.5%, whereas corrupted rationales shift support by 10--22%; an explicit rationale-checking prompt amplifies the same pattern to 34--55%. Final answers move less (2--30%), and only 2.9--35.3% of corrupted support flips co-occur with answer changes. Human audits show why this matters: 16/42 valid corruptions are corruption-overtrust cases, and blind humans reject or mark unclear 9/10 audited corrupted rationales that the model accepts. Cross-model and task-boundary checks show when the channel is active, amplified, inert, or folded into the task label. Rationale sharing should be evaluated as a verification-message mechanism, not merely as a route to higher answer accuracy.

</details>


### [420] [Measuring the Microtask Eligibility Gap: When Is an Off-the-Shelf SLM Enough for an Agent Harness?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00025)
*Jundong Hu,Shekar Ramachandran*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文评测了16个SLM配置（4任务×4模型）在智能体微任务上的可用性，发现无配置通过预设阈值；量化不改变结论，差距主要与模型规模相关，建议将SLM用于基线不达标处。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体框架希望用小型语言模型（SLM）承接前沿大模型规划器周边的微任务（自动批准shell命令、写记忆、选工具、历史轮次排序），但尚无证据表明现成SLM能满足从业者设定的门槛，以及失败原因和量化影响是否改变结论。

Method: 构建含4个微任务的基准，固定提示与自动指标；每个任务预设阈值τ（锚定廉价非LLM基线）并采用考虑置信区间的合格判定规则。在最优设置（FP16、贪心、单一冻结提示、无调参）下扫描Qwen3 0.6/1.7/4/8B共16个配置；用logprob决策阈值诊断区分能力缺陷与可通过调整解码阈值解决的失败（4种情形）；对4-bit量化（RTN/GPTQ/AWQ）在可重构硬标签任务上做认证检验；并在Llama-3.x、锚点选择（τ扫描）与提示改写上做鲁棒性验证。

Result: 存在合格缺口：16个配置全部不合格（经原始输出与解析器行为核验）；量化损伤随模型规模而异，但未使任何配置进入合格，缺口更多随模型规模而非精度变化；Llama-3.x上复现（12/12不合格）；对锚点选择与提示措辞稳健（原始及每种细胞3个中性改写共0/112合格）。

Conclusion: 应将SLM置于满足CI阈值基线的后备位置，仅在基线不达标处启用SLM；示例中4B重排器在BM25候选集上优于BM25（+0.047 [0.020, 0.073]），但自身仍未获得合格认证。

Abstract: Agent harnesses increasingly want to run small language models (SLMs) on the microtasks around a frontier large language model (LLM) planner: auto-approving shell commands, writing memory, selecting tools, ranking past turns. We ask whether off-the-shelf SLMs meet practitioner-defined thresholds and, when they fail, why, and whether quantization changes the answer. We build a benchmark of 4 such microtasks with fixed prompts and automatic metrics, each with a pre-specified threshold $τ$ anchored to a cheap non-LLM baseline and a CI-aware eligibility rule (a configuration passes only if its confidence bound clears $τ$). Sweeping Qwen3 0.6/1.7/4/8B at their best (FP16, greedy, one frozen prompt, no tuning), we find an eligibility gap: 0 of 16 (4 tasks $\times$ 4 models) configurations pass (verified by checking the raw outputs and parser behavior). A logprob decision-threshold diagnostic (T1/T3/T4; T2 via a context-length/cascade probe) separates the failures into capability deficits and failures that can be addressed by changing the decoding threshold (4 regimes). Quantization to 4-bit (RTN/GPTQ/AWQ) does damage that depends on model size and moves no configuration into eligibility (certified on the reconstructable hard-label tasks T1/T3, diagnostic/windowed robustness on T2/T4), so the gap tracks model size more than precision; it replicates on Llama-3.x (12/12 ineligible) and is robust to the anchor choice (a $τ$-sweep) and to prompt wording (0/112 eligible across the original plus 3 neutral paraphrases per cell). The practical implication: place SLMs behind a baseline that meets the CI-backed threshold, and use the SLM only where the baseline fails to meet the threshold; e.g. a 4B re-ranker over a BM25 shortlist beats BM25 ($+0.047$ [0.020, 0.073], without itself certifying eligibility).

</details>


### [421] [Characterizing a Configuration Where Inference-Time PRM-Pruned Fragment Grafting Is Inert: Evidence from Three Reasoning LMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00047)
*Khawaja Murad ul Hassan,Mehran Ebrahimi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文隔离并检验了"PRM剪枝片段嫁接"（PPFG）机制，发现在其最朴素的运行点上，该方法与独立并行思维链基线在统计上无差异，并通过等价性检验将其提升为正等价结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 并行思维链存在多样性坍缩问题，学界提出了多种推理时干预手段，其中一个自然设计是：当过程奖励模型（PRM）剪枝某条链时，提取其高PRM前缀并逐字移植为仍在解码的"兄弟链"的上下文示范。作者希望在最成本最小化的运行点上孤立检验这一跨轨迹步骤级迁移机制是否真正有效。

Method: 在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct配合Math-Shepherd、完整MATH500（n=500，三个随机种子）上测试PPFG，设置停滞目标与随机目标两种变体，与独立并行思维链基线对比；对322个停滞规则注入事件做四桶分类归因；进行复合门控精炼、随机对照、跨三个基础LM/六个基准/第二个PRM/兼容门控扫描的复现，并用两次单侧检验（TOST）将无差异提升为正向等价。

Result: PPFG在所有测量轴上与独立并行思维链基线统计不可区分；322个注入事件中仅14%针对真正陷入困境的链，其余落在已成功、接近完成或处于PRM平台期的链上。停滞变体与随机变体均无增益，随机对照以2.4倍触发率也仅达到同等水平。结论在三个基础LM、六个基准、第二个PRM和兼容门控扫描下复现，TOST在全部12个Qwen/LLaMA单元上支持正向等价。逐事件抽查显示注入链的剪枝率是匹配步率的2.75倍，但存活兄弟反事实分析未见群体层面的补偿。事后预言机将选择PPFG相对独立方案的单题增益上界限定为+0.13个百分点。

Conclusion: PPFG在其测试运行点上是惰性的，其失效并非启发式特异所致；该结果确立了该推理时机制的零假设结论，并贡献了一个用于建立推理时机制零结果的等价性检验模板，所有论断均限定于其测试运行点。

Abstract: Diversity collapse in parallel chain-of-thought has motivated inference-time interventions built on a natural design: when a process reward model (PRM) prunes a chain, its high-PRM prefix is extracted and grafted verbatim as an in-context demonstration into a still-decoding sibling. We isolate this mechanism, PRM-Pruned Fragment Grafting (PPFG), as the most cost-minimal operationalization of cross-trajectory step-level transfer, and test it at the operating point where prior fragment-grafting work reports gains only under additional compensating ingredients. On Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct with Math-Shepherd on full MATH500 (n=500, three seeds), PPFG in both stagnation- and random-targeting variants is statistically indistinguishable from an independent parallel-CoT baseline on every measured axis. We characterize why: a four-bucket classification of 322 stagnation-rule injection events shows only 14% targeted a genuinely struggling chain; the rest landed on chains that had already succeeded, were near completion, or sat on a flat PRM plateau, states a rescue graft cannot change. No compound-gate refinement jointly achieves well-targeted firing and adequate density, and a random control matches the same parity at 2.4x the firing rate, so the inertness is not heuristic-specific. The finding replicates across three base LMs, six benchmarks, a second PRM, and a compatibility-gate sweep; two-one-sided-tests analysis promotes the parity to positive equivalence on all twelve Qwen/LLaMA cells. A per-event spot-check finds injected chains prune at 2.75x the matched-step rate, but a surviving-sibling counterfactual finds no population-level compensation. A hindsight oracle bounds any per-problem gain from choosing PPFG over independent at +0.13 pp. We contribute an equivalence-testing template for establishing inference-time mechanism nulls, with every claim scoped to its tested operating point.

</details>


### [422] [Gradient-Aligned Pair Selection for Personalized Preference Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00061)
*Ruoming Jin,Xinyu Li,Hao Zhou,Jianfeng Zhu,Ruixin Guo,Feodor Dragan,Lei Xu,Haixun Wang,Yang Zhou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出GAP-DPO，将个性化偏好学习形式化为几何对齐优化问题，通过效用感知、几何对齐的偏好对选择改进DPO，实现更强的个性化生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 个性化LLM需使生成行为对齐用户特定偏好，而非仅追求总体质量。DPO虽稳定，但在个性化场景下的效果关键取决于偏好对的选取方式。现有方法多依赖启发式准则（如基于似然的极端样本），使优化与显式用户效用脱钩，导致个性化性能下降。

Method: 作者将个性化偏好学习形式化为几何对齐的优化问题，分析期望用户效用梯度与DPO更新方向之间的一阶交互。发现离线策略采样下，当偏好间隔与效用梯度方向对齐时，DPO更新由纯误差纠正信号转变为类强化学习更新。据此提出GAP-DPO（Geometry-Aligned Preference DPO），一种迭代算法，进行效用感知、几何对齐的偏好对选择，并通过逐轮重新生成控制分布偏移。

Result: 在个性化文本生成基准上，GAP-DPO在风格保真度、偏好对齐和生成质量上均持续优于标准DPO变体。

Conclusion: 结果表明梯度对齐是个性化偏好优化的统一原则，偏好对选择是优化几何的内在组成部分，而非启发式预处理步骤。

Abstract: Personalizing large language models (LLMs) requires aligning generation behavior with user-specific preferences rather than aggregate quality. While Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) provides a stable framework for preference learning, its effectiveness in personalized settings critically depends on how preference pairs are selected. Existing approaches typically rely on heuristic criteria, such as likelihood-based extremes, which decouple optimization from explicit user utility and can lead to degraded personalization. We formalize personalized preference learning as a geometry-aligned optimization problem by analyzing the first-order interaction between gradients of expected user utility and DPO update directions. Our analysis reveals that, under off-policy sampling, the DPO update transitions from a purely error-corrective signal to a reinforcement-like update when preference margins are directionally aligned with utility gradients. This perspective exposes pair selection as a geometric decision that governs whether preference optimization advances or hinders personalization. Motivated by this insight, we propose GAP-DPO (Geometry-Aligned Preference DPO), an iterative algorithm that performs utility-aware, geometry-aligned pair selection while controlling distribution shift via epoch-wise regeneration. Experiments on personalized text generation benchmarks show that GAP-DPO consistently improves stylistic fidelity, preference alignment, and generation quality compared to standard DPO variants. Together, our results establish gradient alignment as a unifying principle for personalized preference optimization and demonstrate that pair selection is an intrinsic component of the optimization geometry rather than a heuristic preprocessing step.

</details>


### [423] [K-Dense BYOK: An Open-Source AI Research Assistant That Runs Locally and Keeps a Hash-Chained Lab Notebook](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00074)
*Aubrey M. Brueckner,Darshil Patel,Yuhuan He,Timothy Kassis*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: K-Dense BYOK 是一款免费开源的本地化 AI 科研助手，基于用户自有模型密钥运行，通过科学脚手架、Living Lab Notebook 与独立观察式日志三项设计，在20个跨学科研究提示上于科学质量与研究执行两项指标上超越两个受管平台。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用聊天助手与通用编码智能体缺乏科研专用支撑，且存在模型过度声称（overclaiming）这一最常见失败模式；研究者还需对数据、代码与记录的长期可读性与自主控制权。

Method: 系统运行于研究者本地计算机，由用户提供模型访问（托管或本地），应用提供运行环境、科学脚手架与完整记录；每个项目为普通文件夹。核心设计包括：（1）内置科学流程库、引导式工作流模板、研究数据源目录及审稿人与写作角色；（2）Living Lab Notebook，条目相互链接构成论证，只增不删；（3）通过观察智能体行为而非采信其自述来记录过程，日志为智能体无写入工具可及。在20个跨学科研究提示上，按事先固定的评分标准与两个受管平台对比。

Result: 在科学质量与研究执行两项上均领先两个受管平台。其交付物是唯一记录所运行软件的，也是唯一通常附带可复现结果命令的；其中一个受管平台使用相同前沿模型却两者皆无。环境记录为智能体写入的文件，而非观察日志的一部分，日志尚未捕获软件环境本身。

Conclusion: 以"使主张可核查"而非"阻止主张"的思路应对模型过度声称；本地化、纯文件夹式项目保障了数据与记录的长期可读与研究者自主权。代码以 MIT 许可证开源，日志对软件环境的捕获仍待完善。

Abstract: K-Dense BYOK (bring your own keys) is a free, open-source AI research assistant for scientists in any field that runs on the researcher's own computer. The researcher supplies access to a model of their choice, hosted or running locally, and the application supplies everything else: a place for the work to run, a layer of scientific scaffolding, and a complete record. Each project is an ordinary folder, so the data, the code, the results, and the record stay on a machine the researcher administers and can be read years later without the application. Three things separate it from a chat assistant or a general-purpose coding agent. It ships a library of written scientific procedures, guided workflow templates, catalogs of where research data can be found, and reviewer and writer roles the agent can hand work to. It keeps a Living Lab Notebook whose entries link into an argument and are added to but never erased. And it records what happened by watching what the agent does rather than by taking the agent's word for it, in a log the agent has no tool that can write to. That choice targets the most common failure, model overclaiming, in our earlier benchmark of nine frontier models, by making claims checkable rather than preventing them. On twenty interdisciplinary research prompts, scored under a rubric fixed in advance, K-Dense BYOK led two managed platforms on both scientific quality and research execution. Its deliverables were the only ones that recorded the software they ran in, and the only ones that usually arrived with a command that regenerates the results. One of the managed platforms ran the same frontier model and supplied neither. Those environment records were files the agent wrote, not part of the observed log, which does not yet capture the software environment itself. The code is available under the MIT license at https://github.com/K-Dense-AI/k-dense-byok.

</details>


### [424] [Scientific Agents: Evaluating Profession-Specific System Prompts on Scientific Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00084)
*Timothy Kassis*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 在9个文本科学基准与1个生信工具基准上，503个职业专属AGENTS.md系统提示相对极简基线未带来一致准确率提升，却使输出token增加1.5-2.3倍、单次调用成本增加2.2-4.5倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 业界普遍使用详细的职业专属系统提示（如AGENTS.md）来提升智能体在科学任务上的表现，但缺乏对其"成本—收益"的系统性实证评估。本文旨在验证：加载完整职业档案是否真能带来准确率增益，以及其token与费用开销是否合理。

Method: 构建开源语料 Scientific Agents（503个职业专属AGENTS.md档案），在Pi agent harness中通过OpenRouter调用Gemini 3.8 Flash。采用配对对照设计，设置四种控制条件：极简基线（"You are a helpful assistant"）、档案首句角色描述、通用科学严谨性指南、无关领域档案。覆盖9个文本科学基准（4,531题，100个配对档案），经API错误重试后4,488题完成全部五种条件，采用自动化规则评分；另在60道需工具调用的BioMysteryBench生信题上对基线与档案各运行三次。

Result: 文本基准上，档案与基线平均准确率差为-0.6个百分点（95% bootstrap区间[-1.5, +0.2]，固定任务），无任何基准出现统计显著提升；档案条件下输出token为基线的1.5-2.3倍，每次成功调用成本为2.2-4.5倍。BioMysteryBench上档案平均解决率46.7%，基线56.7%，差-10.0个百分点（95%区间[-16.7, -3.3]），主因是档案条件下更频繁触及token与时间上限而中止。唯一意外优势出现在SuperGPQA：频繁的provider API中断下，短基线仅54.0%的题目保留首轮正确答案，而档案为71.6%；但通用与错配提示表现相近，说明该收益来自提示长度或格式而非领域专业性。

Conclusion: 在受测模型与任务范围内，默认加载完整职业档案不能提升准确率且成本显著更高，故不建议默认使用。未来可探索方向包括：按需检索档案中的相关片段（而非整篇加载）、以及在开放式科学任务上重新评估其价值。

Abstract: Detailed profession-specific system prompts raise token use and estimated cost per response without a consistent accuracy gain. We evaluate Scientific Agents, an open-source corpus of 503 profession-specific AGENTS.md profiles, with Gemini 3.8 Flash via OpenRouter in the Pi agent harness. We compare matched profiles with four controls: a minimal baseline ("You are a helpful assistant"), the profile's opening role sentence, a generic scientific rigor guide, and a profile from an unrelated domain. Across nine text-based science benchmarks (4,531 sampled questions, 100 matched profiles), 4,488 items completed all five conditions after API-error retries, scored with automated, rule-based grading. The average profile-baseline accuracy difference is -0.6 percentage points (95% bootstrap interval [-1.5, +0.2] across fixed tasks), and no benchmark shows a statistically clear improvement. Matched profiles produced 1.5-2.3 times as many output tokens and cost 2.2-4.5 times more per successful call. On 60 tool-using BioMysteryBench bioinformatics problems (three runs each for baseline and profile), mean solve rates were 46.7% with the profile and 56.7% at baseline, a difference of -10.0 percentage points (95% interval [-16.7, -3.3]) driven by more frequent token- and time-limit stops under the profile. Longer prompts had one unexpected operational advantage: on SuperGPQA, frequent provider API drops left the short baseline with a correct first-pass answer on only 54.0% of items, against 71.6% with the profile. Generic and mismatched prompts were about as reliable, so this gain comes from prompt length or formatting rather than domain expertise. For the tested model and tasks, loading full profession profiles by default does not improve accuracy and costs considerably more; whether selective retrieval of profile sections or open-ended scientific tasks would change this remains to be tested.

</details>


### [425] [Comedic Fool's Gold: Reward Exploits and Countermeasures in Conversational Humor](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00197)
*Sam Larson*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究对话幽默训练中的自动化奖励及其被利用的捷径，发现基于嵌入的“惊喜”奖励会将打乱词序的回复误判为机智，流畅性过滤虽能拦截洗牌却误伤真实机智回复；听众模型预测的笑声易受双方消息中的笑声线索操纵，跨说话人归一化可阻断已知攻击但对未匹配表达仍无效。三次RL实验显示最终版本将综合评分提升0.0903、零分会话减少40%，但幽默专项提升未达预注册目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为语言模型训练对话幽默能力设计自动化奖励时，奖励容易被模型利用（reward hacking），即通过捷径而非真正习得幽默来获得高分。作者希望考察两类奖励（可理解的惊喜、预测的听众娱乐度）的漏洞，并检验相应防护措施是否能在堵住捷径的同时不损害原本要鼓励的幽默行为。

Method: 采用两种奖励设计：一是基于嵌入的“惊喜”奖励，配合流畅性过滤器；二是听众模型预测笑声的奖励，配合跨说话人线索归一化。通过受控测试检验奖励对词序打乱回复、机智回复、笑声线索的判别能力，并开展三次强化学习训练，逐步修订奖励函数，比较综合评分、零分会话比例及幽默专项指标。

Result: 基于嵌入的惊喜奖励对词序打乱回复与真实机智回复同样接受；流畅性过滤能检测打乱，但组合奖励同时误拒部分机智回复且未通过后续验证。听众模型奖励易受任一方消息中的笑声线索影响；跨说话人归一化可阻断已覆盖的攻击，但未匹配的表达仍可被利用。最终RL运行将综合评估分数提升0.0903，零分会话减少40%，但幽默专项提升低于预注册目标。

Conclusion: 自动化奖励设计面临一个更广泛的挑战：防护措施必须在阻断可被利用的捷径的同时，保留奖励原本意图鼓励的行为；当前的惊喜奖励与听众奖励防护均未完全达成这一平衡，幽默专项性能也未达预期。

Abstract: We investigate automated rewards for training language models in conversational humor, focusing on reward exploits and countermeasures. Two approaches aim to capture understandable surprise and predicted audience amusement. Controlled tests show that an embedding-based surprise reward accepts word-shuffled replies as readily as witty ones. A fluency filter detects the shuffles, but the combined reward also rejects some witty replies and fails further validation. An audience model's predicted laughter is instead vulnerable to laughter cues in either speaker's messages. Normalizing these cues across speakers blocks the covered attacks, although unmatched expressions remain exploitable. Three reinforcement-learning runs evaluate training with successive reward revisions. The final run improves the combined evaluation score by 0.0903 and reduces zero-score sessions by 40%, but its humor-specific improvement remains below our preregistered target. These findings illustrate a broader challenge for automated reward design: countermeasures must block exploitable shortcuts while preserving the behavior the reward was intended to encourage.

</details>


### [426] [EviGraph: Proof-Carrying Selective Recommendation over Temporal Public-Service Knowledge Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00212)
*Yixi Zhou,Sikun Wang,Lei Fan,Fan Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出 EviGraph，区分关键决策需求与可保留未决的信息，通过语言智能体在时序知识图谱中链接需求与证据，并由确定性检查器判定推荐是否被支持。在双语香港公共服务基准上，该区分减少了不必要的弃答；但额外验证会撤回原本受支持的推荐而不提升决策质量。结论：可靠的证据式导航取决于明确界定决策必须确立的内容，而非一味增加验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 公共服务推荐需要与服务、范围、日期相匹配的证据，但将每个缺失细节都视为决定性因素会导致系统过度弃答、无法给出有用推荐。因此需要一种方法区分真正影响决策的关键需求与可以允许未决的信息，以在保证可靠性的同时减少不必要的弃答。

Method: EviGraph 由两部分组成：语言智能体（language agent）将关键决策需求链接到时序知识图谱中的证据；确定性检查器（deterministic checker）判定推荐是否被证据支持。系统显式区分关键决策需求与允许保留未决的信息。

Result: 在带有可执行政策引用的双语香港公共服务基准上评估，该区分显著减少了不必要的弃答。但额外的验证会使原本受支持的推荐被撤回，且并未提升决策质量。

Conclusion: 可靠的证据式导航依赖于明确界定"决策必须确立什么"，而非简单地叠加更多验证。增加验证本身并不必然提升决策质量，甚至可能损害已受支持的推荐。

Abstract: Public-service recommendations require evidence that matches the requested service, scope, and date. Yet treating every missing detail as decisive can withhold useful recommendations. We introduce EviGraph, which distinguishes critical decision requirements from information that can remain unresolved. A language agent links these requirements to evidence in a temporal knowledge graph, while a deterministic checker establishes whether a recommendation is supported. Evaluation on a bilingual Hong Kong public-service benchmark with executable policy references shows that this distinction reduces unnecessary abstention. Additional verification, however, can withdraw supported recommendations without improving decision quality. These findings suggest that reliable evidence-based navigation depends on specifying what must be established for a decision, rather than simply adding more verification.

</details>


### [427] [Build2SPARQL: A Large-Scale Text-to-SPARQL Benchmark Dataset for Building Knowledge Graph Querying](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00224)
*Wooyoung Jung*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了 Build2SPARQL，一个面向建筑知识图谱（KG）的大规模 text-to-SPARQL 基准。其核心方法是用图遍历代码生成并验证 SPARQL 查询，仅由大语言模型生成自然语言问题，从而保证查询正确性不受模型行为影响。基于 201 个建筑 KG，构建了 6,136 条可执行 SPARQL 查询和 30,680 个问题。人工验证显示语义保真度与自然度均达 98.8%，操作合理性 84.0%。在三款开源语言模型上的检索增强评估将精确匹配准确率从零样本的 0.2-20% 提升至三样本检索的 56-65%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 建筑自动化系统日益以 Brick、ASHRAE 223P 等本体的语义知识图谱形式表示，为 AI 应用提供机器可读基础。将自然语言问题翻译为 SPARQL（text-to-SPARQL）可让建筑运营者通过语言代理查询这些图谱，但进展受限于缺乏大规模自然语言/SPARQL 基准。本文旨在填补这一基准空缺。

Method: 提出 KG 驱动的生成流水线：SPARQL 查询完全由图遍历代码生成并验证，大语言模型仅负责生成自然语言问题，从而保证查询正确性独立于模型行为。流水线挖掘六类查询模式——线性链、分支、UNION、聚合、OPTIONAL 和属性过滤，并将每条查询以五种词汇语域进行表述。应用于 201 个建筑 KG（180 个 Brick、21 个 ASHRAE 223P）。

Result: 生成 6,136 条可执行 SPARQL 查询和 30,680 个自然语言问题。对 300 个问题由两名评分者进行人工验证，得到 98.8% 语义保真度、98.8% 自然度和 84.0% 操作合理性。在三款开源权重语言模型上的检索增强评估中，精确匹配准确率从零样本的 0.2-20% 提升至三样本检索的 56-65%。

Conclusion: Build2SPARQL 通过将 SPARQL 生成与验证解耦于模型行为，提供高质量、大规模的建筑 KG text-to-SPARQL 基准，验证了检索增强对提升开源模型 text-to-SPARQL 性能的有效性，为建筑运营的自然语言查询应用提供数据支撑。

Abstract: Building automation systems are increasingly represented as semantic knowledge graphs (KGs) using ontologies such as Brick and ASHRAE 223P, creating a machine-readable substrate for artificial-intelligence applications. One promising application is translating natural-language questions into SPARQL (text-to-SPARQL), which would let building operators query these graphs through language agents, but progress is limited by the scarcity of large natural-language/SPARQL benchmarks. This paper presents Build2SPARQL, a large-scale benchmark for building KGs generated by a KG-grounded pipeline: SPARQL queries are produced and validated entirely by graph-traversal code, while large language models generate only the natural-language questions, keeping query correctness independent of model behavior. The pipeline mines six query-pattern families -- linear chains, branching, UNION, aggregation, OPTIONAL, and attribute-filtered -- and phrases each query across five vocabulary registers. Applied to 201 building KGs (180 Brick, 21 ASHRAE 223P), it yields 6,136 executable SPARQL queries and 30,680 questions. A two-rater human validation of 300 questions found 98.8% semantic fidelity, 98.8% naturalness, and 84.0% operational plausibility. A retrieval-augmented evaluation across three open-weight language models raised exact-match accuracy from 0.2-20% (zero-shot) to 56-65% (three-shot retrieved).

</details>


### [428] [Robust Is Salient: An Informed Adversary Moves the Optimal Signal onto the Salience Pole](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00233)
*Cris Huynh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文在受约束信号通道中引入知晓目标的对手（persuasion budget β），证明对手稳健最优信号恰为"显著性极点"，与贝叶斯后验最优在200,000项中仅2,748项相异，且差异仅出现在显著性—贝叶斯坐标未定义处；这构成评估限制：在该重合区间内无法区分模型是否具备对手意识。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究当知情对手（adversary）与受众共享同一受约束信号通道时，何种信号最能保护真相，并检验"对手稳健最优"与既有"显著性（salience）启发式"之间的关系，以及这种关系对语言模型对手意识评测的影响。

Method: 将对手引入强制选择任务（抽象自《Deception: Murder in Hong Kong》）：对手知晓正确答案、观测信号，并以说服预算 β 为最强错误答案辩护。分析最优信号随 β 的增长从"后验最大化选项"向"边际最大化选项"的迁移；在 β=0 时退化为原oracle模型（听众温度 τ=1）。随后在两个对手框架下对7个语言模型在108个确认性条目上进行评测，并计算精确的无效应率。

Result: 在108个confirmatory items上，对手稳健最优与既有工作的显著性极点完全一致；在200,000项池中二者仅2,748项不同，且差异恰好位于显著性—贝叶斯坐标未定义之处。18.2%的池存在有限预算下的最优偏移，每项的临界预算精确可算。评测中，两种对手框架使7个语言模型在108项中的30至77项改变了所选答案，对照精确无效应率显著。但由于稳健最优与显著性目标在该评测集上完全重合，无法判定该变化指向何者。

Conclusion: 稳健性在有定义处是通过从贝叶斯判别完全转向显著性实现的。稳健目标与启发式目标的重合构成结构性限制而非零结果。评估对手意识前，应先检验稳健目标是否与启发式目标在评测条目上重合——此诊断成本极低。

Abstract: When an informed adversary shares the audience of a constrained signalling channel, the signal that best protects the truth is the signal that best describes it. On 108 confirmatory items, the adversary-robust optimum aligns exactly with the salience pole from prior work. Across a 200,000-item pool, the two differ on only 2,748 items --- lying exactly where the prior salience-to-Bayes coordinate is undefined. Where defined, robustness is achieved by moving from Bayesian discrimination entirely to salience. We show this by introducing an adversary to a forced-choice task (abstracted from Deception: Murder in Hong Kong). The adversary knows the target, observes the signal, and argues for the strongest wrong answer using a persuasion budget, $β$. As $β$ grows, the optimal signal shifts from the posterior-maximizing option to the margin-maximizing one; at $β= 0$, the game reproduces the original oracle model with a listener temperature of $τ= 1$. This effect is real: 18.2 percent of the pool has an optimum that shifts under a finite budget, and each item's critical budget is exact. This coincidence structurally limits empirical evaluation. Two adversary framings change the chosen option of seven language models on 30 to 77 of 108 items against an exact no-effect rate. Yet, no measurement can determine whether this movement is toward the adversary-aware optimum or toward salience, because the two options are identical. This is a structural limit, not a null result. The diagnostic check is cheap: before evaluating adversary-awareness, verify whether the robust target coincides with a heuristic target on the evaluation items.

</details>


### [429] [Conflicting Supervision Moves Commitment, Not Capability: A 12.29σ arrangement effect that is exactly zero under a convention-agnostic score](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00234)
*Wenhui Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文研究同一语料在不同排列（ordering）下训练时，学习率调度如何决定“顺序是否影响结果”：衰减调度会抑制顺序效应，恒定调度会放大顺序效应，且顺序效应只体现在模型对某一约定的承诺上，常规精确匹配指标无法观测。实验中恒定学习率下10种排列在内部分配跨度达0.2221、对比下限11.63且随分块程度单调；单一cosine下10个arm退化到约两个可区分状态；12个arm中acc_A+acc_B在9.7%内恒定而分配份额从0.04到0.87，说明看似12.29σ的排列切换在约定无关指标下为零；在提示中标注约定可消除该切换并达到并集上限的87.5%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 论文动机是澄清“训练数据顺序是否影响模型”这一长期争议：以往预训练中已报告衰减学习率可缓解顺序效应，但缺乏机制解释与受控测量。作者主张学习率调度并非背景条件，而是决定顺序效应大小的平均算子，并希望把“顺序重要”与“顺序不重要”统一为同一旋钮的两端，同时指出精确匹配类基准无法观测到路径所写入的约定承诺。

Method: 方法上，作者训练模型于两种互不兼容但各自正确的约定下书写的同一批问题，并固定语料、预算与除路径外的一切变量。理论上证明一个界，使排列与调度作为两个独立相乘因子进入顺序效应：排列仅以块周期形式出现，调度仅以端点能在任一时点施加的权重形式出现。实验上用10种排列、同一预算，分别在仅lr_scheduler_type不同的调度族下各跑两次（恒定学习率与已发表常用的单一cosine），测量内部分配跨度、对比下限及约定承诺；并对比约定无关指标acc_A+acc_B与分配份额。

Result: 结果：恒定学习率下10种排列的内部分配跨度为0.2221、对比下限为11.63，且随排列的分块程度单调变化；在单一cosine下，同样10个arm仅占据约两个可区分状态，而按其自身分辨率本应可分辨约十个。跨12个arm，acc_A+acc_B在9.7%以内保持恒定，而分配份额从0.04变化到0.87，因此论文所测得的12.29σ排列切换在约定无关指标下恰好为零；该守恒结论引自衰减调度族，恒定学习率族读取噪声更大。在提示中标注约定可压缩该切换，并达到并集上限的87.5%。

Conclusion: 结论：学习率调度是决定顺序效应的平均算子，顺序效应的强弱由调度与排列的乘积因子控制；衰减调度因无法在同一步同时施加大步长与未收缩余项而抑制顺序效应，恒定调度在最后一步恰好造成二者叠加从而放大效应。“顺序重要”与“顺序不重要”是同一旋钮的两端；路径写入的是模型承诺的约定，而精确匹配基准看不到这一点，只有区分约定的指标或提示中显式标注约定才能观测与消除该效应。

Abstract: "Train a model on the same problems written under two incompatible conventions, both correct, and ask what the ordering of that data writes into the parameters. The learning-rate schedule is not a background condition for that question. It is the averaging operator, and it decides the answer. We prove a bound in which the arrangement and the schedule enter the ordering effect as separate multiplied factors: the arrangement only as a block period, the schedule only as how much weight the endpoint can place on any one moment of the run. A decaying schedule cannot put a large step size and an uncontracted remainder at the same moment; a constant one does exactly that at the last step. That decay moderates ordering effects has been reported in pretraining; the mechanism, the separation, and a controlled measurement of both halves are ours. Ten orderings of one corpus, one budget, everything but the path held fixed, run twice under families differing in lr_scheduler_type and nothing else: at a constant rate the interior spans 0.2221 in allocation, 11.63 contrast floors, monotone in how blocked the arrangement is. Under the single cosine every published arm uses, the same ten arms occupy two distinguishable states where their own resolution would allow about ten. "Order matters" and "order does not matter" are the two ends of one knob. What the path writes is which convention the model commits to, and no exact-match benchmark can see it. Across twelve arms acc_A+acc_B is constant to within 9.7% while the allocation share runs 0.04 to 0.87, so the 12.29-sigma arrangement switch this paper measures is exactly zero under a convention-agnostic metric. That conservation is quoted from the decayed family throughout, the constant-rate one being a noisier place to read it. Marking the convention in the prompt collapses the switch and reaches 87.5% of the union ceiling."

</details>


### [430] [Knowing When to Yield: Grounded Arbitration of User Corrections in Text-Based Embodied Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00282)
*Yezhou Cheng,Runjia Du,Zeming Liu,Hang Lyu,Zehua Yang,Bojun Lin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究提出"具身纠正仲裁"问题(GAVA),在文本ALFWorld中验证:完全本地检查可达100%纠正准确率,选择性信息收集配合语义先验可降低交互与被声明的联合成本,但未证明环境信息价值优于澄清提问的普遍优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当具身智能体面对人的纠正时,纠正本身可能有误,智能体需要决定何时接受、何时拒绝、何时检查世界、何时向说话者提问。论文旨在形式化这一"具身纠正仲裁"问题,并在受控条件下检验选择性信息收集与语义先验在成本约束下的有效性。

Method: 将纠正仲裁形式化为在"接受、拒绝、检查世界、询问说话者"之间的选择;GAVA用观察受限证据、合法探针与一步期望损失规则实现该接口。在纯文本ALFWorld上,用162个检查点生成972对真假干预,采用检查点bootstrap置信区间;先在冻结策略、成本、基线与多重性方案后于77个不重叠已见检查点(308个场景)上复现,并对比同先验固定策略与校准的无VOI对照。

Result: 完全本地检查使GAVA与"始终验证"基线均达100%纠正准确率。同回合执行中,GAVA相对"始终验证"降低交互成本,但在完美说话者下与成本阈值持平。训练专用物体位置先验在340个未见场景上将交互成本与声明联合成本分别降低0.490和0.420(相对均匀GAVA);复现实验为0.595和0.517,两个95%检查点bootstrap置信区间均不含零。联合成本也优于同先验固定策略,而匹配校准的无VOI对照结果不确定。语义GAVA在两队列中各出现4个事实错误,准确率分别为98.8%和98.7%,所有方法均完成任务。

Conclusion: 结果支持在声明成本下结合语义先验进行选择性信息收集,但未确立环境信息价值相对澄清提问的普遍优势。研究采用归一化主张、完整符号观察与受控说话者,未评估人类参与者、视觉输入或物理机器人,结论外部效度有限。

Abstract: How should an embodied agent respond when a person's correction may be wrong? We formulate grounded correction arbitration as a choice among accepting, rejecting, inspecting the world, and asking the speaker. GAVA implements this interface with observation-bounded evidence, legal probes, and a one-step expected-loss rule. In text-only ALFWorld, 162 checkpoints produce 972 paired true and false interventions. Complete local inspections give GAVA and always verify 100 percent correction accuracy, establishing the evidence contract rather than a comparative advantage. In same-episode execution, GAVA reduces interaction cost against always verify but ties a cost threshold under a perfect speaker. An exploratory training-only object-location prior lowers interaction and declared joint cost on 340 unseen scenarios by 0.490 and 0.420 relative to uniform GAVA. After freezing the policy, costs, baselines, and multiplicity plan, the gains replicate on 77 non-overlapping seen checkpoints, covering 308 scenarios: 0.595 and 0.517, with both 95 percent checkpoint-bootstrap confidence intervals excluding zero. Joint cost also improves over an identical-prior fixed policy, while the matched calibrated no-VOI comparison remains inconclusive. Semantic GAVA makes four factual errors in each cohort, corresponding to 98.8 percent and 98.7 percent accuracy, and all methods complete every task. Results support selective information gathering with semantic priors under declared costs, but do not establish a general advantage of environmental value of information over clarification. The study uses normalized claims, complete symbolic observations, and controlled speakers; it evaluates neither human participants, visual input, nor physical robots.

</details>


### [431] [Rules to Tools: Executable Checks for LLM Agents in Scientific Computing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00313)
*Jingjie Ning,Guojiang Zhao,Chen Xu,Shanshan Zhong,Xiaochuan Li,Ji Zeng,Guolin Ke*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 在匹配的SciCode修复任务上，"规则到工具"（R2T）将公开科学需求转化为可调用检查，使修复成功率从纯文本的26/30提升至29/30，但增益具有任务依赖性，且公共CPU消耗上升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学编码智能体以自然语言文字形式接收方程、边界条件与输出要求，需据此评判并修复程序。纯文本需求存在歧义、难以精确执行，因此作者希望检验把公开科学需求预先转化为可执行检查（工具）能否改善修复效果，并量化其代价。

Method: 采用匹配对照设计：在同一SciCode修复组内共享书面检查、初始程序、模型与预算，工具组额外获得可调用实现。设置两个任务ID队列（较大队列含8个ID，另一含若干ID）及共享定义的SciCode队列；另设5个开发阶段已暴露、带替代初始程序的任务，以及全新"源码—Python"臂与匹配的PDE比较。报告任务级胜负、聚合完成率、任务簇bootstrap 95%区间，以及智能体侧输出与公共CPU用量。

Result: 两个任务ID队列中完成修复分别为文本26/30、检查29/30；3个任务ID偏好工具、1个偏好文本、11个持平。8-ID队列为13/16对15/16，差值任务簇bootstrap 95%区间为[-12.5, 43.75]个百分点。共享定义的SciCode队列两组持平于13/24。5个替代起始程序任务为3/10对7/10。工具组在任务17、77、11上占优（初始检查对任务17报警，对77与11未报违规）；任务37偏好文本且初始无报警。全新源码—Python臂亦达15/16，与专用命令聚合持平。匹配PDE比较中详细文本23/24、检查24/24，检查组报告的模型输出低31.2%。智能体侧输出节省随队列而异，而两个任务ID队列的公共CPU用量均上升。

Conclusion: 预先制备的可执行检查能在总体修复成功率上优于纯文本需求，但这种增益具有任务依赖性，并非普遍有效；工具带来智能体侧输出节省的同时会增加公共CPU开销。因此R2T的收益应在任务层面而非仅聚合层面评估，并需纳入计算成本权衡。

Abstract: Scientific coding agents receive equations, boundary conditions, and output requirements in writing, then must assess the programs they revise. Rules to Tools (R2T) supplies prepared executable checks of public scientific requirements. Matched SciCode repair groups share written checks, starting programs, model, and budgets; the tool group receives a callable implementation. Across two task-ID cohorts, complete repair is 26/30 with text and 29/30 with the prepared checks. Three task IDs favor tools, one favors text, and eleven tie. The eight-ID cohort scores 13/16 versus 15/16, with a task-cluster bootstrap 95% interval of [-12.5, 43.75] percentage points for the difference. The larger shared-definition SciCode cohort ties at 13/24 per group. Five development-exposed tasks with alternate starting programs score 3/10 versus 7/10. The tool group favors tasks 17, 77, and 11; initial checks flag task 17 and report no violation for tasks 77 and 11. Task 37 favors text and has no initial reported violation. A fresh source-through-Python arm also reaches 15/16, matching the dedicated command's aggregate. In a matched PDE comparison, detailed text scores 23/24 and checks score 24/24, with 31.2% lower reported model output for checks. Agent-side output savings vary by cohort, while public CPU use rises in both task-ID cohorts. These results measure task-dependent repair outcomes and agent-side costs with prepared checks.

</details>


### [432] [Fault-Tolerant Budget Conservation in Distributed Multi-Agent Delegation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00349)
*Genliang Zhu,Chu Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 将分布式多智能体委托中的预算守恒形式化为容错问题，通过独占托管信用与预约绑定机制保证并发、故障场景下的预算不超支。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 资源限制正成为AI智能体跨并发、易故障工作进程委托时的授权边界。已有的父子分配约束、仿射对象、分布式托管机制，在回复丢失、超时后效应完成、消息重复、分支分区、DAG汇合共享同一谱系等情况下，均无法单独防止超支。

Method: 将预算建模为由独占托管信用构成的量化资源向量，在委托DAG中流转。派发前，分支将信用转换为操作预约，绑定谱系、纪元、归一化效应、最大费用、接收方与幂等键；持久化带隔离的签名派发许可，网关在首次接受前验证该许可。不确定的效应保持计费状态，直至经过认证的结算、加围栏的权威无效应证明或永久注销。

Result: 在显式中介、持久性、认证、归一化与网关假设下，证明了所有权划分、账本与效应守恒、后代非放大、至多一次结算、迟完成安全性与分区隔离。不可区分性结果表明分区本地可用性需要独占预分配。有界TLA+检查、独立JavaScript探索器与崩溃注入的双进程SQLite实验覆盖了声明范围，并检测出超时退款与历史凭证验证两类变异体。

Conclusion: 该机制在所评估的崩溃、重试、重复、分区、汇合与迟完成调度下，均保持已发放预算的界限不变。

Abstract: Resource limits are becoming an authorization boundary for AI agents that delegate work across concurrent and failure-prone workers. Parent-child allocation constraints, affine objects, and distributed escrow do not by themselves prevent overspend when replies are lost, effects complete after timeout, messages repeat, branches partition, or DAG joins alias one lineage. We formalize fault-tolerant budget conservation for distributed multi-agent delegation. Budgets are quantized resource vectors represented by exclusive escrow credits that move through a delegation DAG. Before dispatch, a branch converts credit into an operation reservation bound to lineage, epoch, normalized effect, maximum charge, receiver, and idempotency key. It persists a signed dispatch permit with quarantine; the gateway verifies that permit before first acceptance. Uncertain effects remain charged until authenticated settlement, a fenced authoritative no-effect proof, or permanent retirement. We prove ownership partition, ledger and effect conservation, descendant non-amplification, at-most-once settlement, late-completion safety, and partition confinement under explicit mediation, durability, authentication, normalization, and gateway assumptions. An indistinguishability result shows that partition-local availability requires exclusive preallocation. Bounded TLA+ checking, an independent JavaScript explorer, and crash-injected two-process SQLite experiments exercise the declared scope and detect timeout-refund and historical-certificate-validation mutants. The mechanism preserves the issued budget bound across the evaluated crash, retry, duplicate, partition, join, and late-completion schedules.

</details>


### [433] [Predictive Credit: Measuring What Scientific Explanations Add to Experimental Forecasts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00314)
*Jingjie Ning,Xueqi Li,Yibo Kong,Dongting Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究提出使用配对预测法测量研究智能体的"预测信用"，通过五项检查在Tox21、OpenML等基准上检验解释与供体情境对预测增益的贡献，结果显示冻结信用决策不确定，匹配解释的点准确率增益未获证实。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究型智能体会解释其计划实验，但其解释是否真正带来可验证的预测信用（而非仅描述性文字）缺乏严格度量。作者希望通过配对预测设计，区分"描述"、"匹配解释"与"供体情境"对预测表现的真实贡献。

Method: 采用配对预测设计，在共享干预、预测者与结果的前提下，变化描述、匹配解释和供体情境。设置五项检查：承诺、交付、预测增益、对齐与已知信号采纳。评估覆盖336个受控学习预期状态、12个Tox21端点及24个OpenML任务；并引入研究者撰写的机制阳性对照。

Result: v5冻结信用决策结论为不确定。Tox21预注册ROC AUC区间分数损害检验未达标（D-M=-.0026，95%区间[-.0174,.0104]）；OpenML的联合形成、点等价与可重复性规则未达标。匹配点准确率增益未获确认，Tox21/OpenML供体种子区间跨零。在DeepSeek V4 Pro下匹配与供体卡片使Tox21二次漂移分别降低64.5%和59.1%；Flash重放使匹配点MAE从.01823升至.02020且未达间隔分数等价。OpenML全卡片分配使标称80%区间扩大21%，覆盖率49.3%对比51.4%，144张卡片中66张合规。直接文本Flash交付全部144条记录但无可检测匹配点准确率增益。机制阳性对照使点MAE较描述降低2.60个百分点。

Conclusion: 该协议为研究智能体基准与科学预测提供了预测信用的测量框架；在所测试的供体分辨率下，自然解释信用仍未获确认。

Abstract: Research agents explain planned experiments. We measure predictive credit with paired forecasts sharing an intervention, forecaster, and outcome while varying description, matched explanation, and donor context. Five checks track commitment, delivery, predictive gain, alignment, and known-signal uptake. Across 336 prospective states in controlled learning, 12 Tox21 endpoints, and 24 OpenML tasks, v5's frozen credit decision was inconclusive. Tox21's preregistered ROC AUC interval-score harm test was unmet ($D-M=-.0026$, 95 percent interval [$-.0174$, .0104]); OpenML's joint formation, point-equivalence, and repeatability rule was unmet. Matched point-accuracy gains over description remained unconfirmed, and Tox21/OpenML seed-donor intervals spanned zero. Under requested DeepSeek V4 Pro, matched and donor cards reduced secondary Tox21 drift by 64.5 and 59.1 percent. A DeepSeek V4 Flash replay raised matched point MAE from .01823 to .02020 and missed matched-donor interval-score equivalence. OpenML full-card assignment widened nominal 80 percent intervals by 21 percent, with 49.3 percent coverage versus 51.4 percent for description and content in 66/144 cards. Direct-text Flash delivered all 144 notes without detectable matched point-accuracy gain. A researcher-authored mechanism positive control lowered point MAE by 2.60 percentage points versus description. The protocol measures predictive credit for research-agent benchmarks and scientific forecasting; natural-explanation credit remained unconfirmed at the tested donor resolutions.

</details>


### [434] [ContractRL: Shielded Group-Relative Policy Optimization for Auditable Tool-Call Repair](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00328)
*Miaobo Hu,Shuhao Hu,Xiaobo Guo,Xin Wang,Bokun Wang,Yina Sa,Daren Zha,Jun Xiao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出ContractRL，将校验器引导的JSON修复建模为受契约约束的有界序列决策过程，在相同校验信息下以更少token取得更高语义成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 结构化工具调用常因少量字段违反schema或执行契约而失败；整体重新生成会扩大动作空间且修复过程难以审计。

Method: 建模为有界决策过程：每步策略观测候选对象、类型化校验反馈、JSON Pointer、不可变修复历史与剩余预算；由契约导出的动作掩码在确定性校验器执行转移前过滤非法或禁止的RFC-6902操作；设计面向patch、retry、abstention的契约约束组相对目标，并在轨迹冻结前将规范目标与语义标签排除在线状态之外。
