### [566] [Molecular architecture of TE-seeded chromosome-naive initiation networks of protein-protein interactions delineates the Human Protein Map of the assembly of multiprotein complexes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01078)
*Gennadi Glinsky*

Main category: q-bio.BM

TL;DR: 基于HPA中154种人类细胞类型的胞内蛋白单体库，解析PPI级联组分的分子特征与生物学功能，揭示其在EMC装配与谱系结构重建中的作用，并提出突触蛋白被隔离导致神经退行性病变的机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 阐明起始转录因子结合转座子来源DNA后，如何经蛋白-蛋白相互作用级联驱动内源性多蛋白复合物的杂合装配通路，并在细胞类型特异性蛋白库背景下界定PPI级联组分的分子结构与功能意义。

Method: 以Human Protein Atlas中154种人类细胞类型的胞内蛋白单体库为背景，解析4个PPI级联组分家族的分子结构特征；进行细胞类型分辨的多蛋白复合物装配分析；统计可生成的蛋白二聚体数量；评估蛋白病变蛋白对突触蛋白的隔离效应及突触结构蛋白补充后的恢复情况。

Result: PPI级联组分在胞内蛋白组中呈现广泛表达与均衡代表性、普遍可用性与参与性，以及组成型（不变）与细胞类型特异的EMC装配谱；无监督分析可忠实重建EMC的固有谱系结构及谱系特异主调控多蛋白装配；在154种细胞蛋白组可用性背景下可生成51,830种蛋白二聚体；蛋白病变蛋白隔离44种突触蛋白，损害PPI级联功能；补充特定突触结构蛋白可恢复化学计量并重建丢失的突触蛋白二聚体装配。

Conclusion: PPI级联是多蛋白复合物谱系特异性装配的核心机制，其性能受损（如突触蛋白被隔离）可导致突触结构-功能组分缺失，从而参与神经退行性病变的发生；恢复关键突触结构蛋白的可用性可逆转装配缺陷，提示潜在干预方向。

Abstract: Upon binding to transposable elements seeded DNA, initiator transcription factors are poised to activate the hybrid assembly pathways (HAP) of endogenous multiprotein complexes (EMC) by iteratively engaging protein-protein interaction (PPI) cascade and creating cell type-specific pools of protein dimers. Here, molecular features and inferred biological functions of PPI cascade constituents were elucidated within the context of cell type-specific intracellular protein monomer pools documented in the Human Protein Atlas (HPA) of 154 human cell types. The following key features of the molecular architecture and functional performance of the 4 families of PPI cascade constituents were documented within the HPA contexts of intracellular proteomes: a) the ubiquitous expression and balanced representation; c) the universal availability and engagements; d) constitutive {invariant) and cell type-specific assembly profiles of EMCs. The biological relevance of the PPI cascades is demonstrated by cell-type-resolved multiprotein complex-engagement analysis across the HPA of human body, which faithfully recovers without supervision the intrinsic lineage structures of EMCs and lineage-specific master-regulator multiprotein assemblies. PPI cascade constituents have the capacity to generate 51,830 protein dimers within the proteome availability contexts of 154 types of human cells. Present analyses revealed critical impacts of the persistence of proteinopathy proteins that may cause the damage to the PPI cascade performance by sequestering 44 synaptic proteins. The sequestration of synaptic proteins withdraws structural-functional components of synapses suggesting a mechanism contributing to the pathogenesis of neurodegeneration. Conversely, reconstitution of availability of defined synaptic structural proteins appears to restore stoichiometry and recovers the lost assembly of synaptic protein dimers.

</details>


### [567] [Multi-Scale Temporal Flows for Peptide Trajectory Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01086)
*Xichen Sun,Wentao Wei,Xiaoxi Zhang,Yuedong Yang,Jiahua Rao*

Main category: q-bio.BM

TL;DR: 提出 PepTIDE，一种多尺度时间框架用于肽段轨迹生成。训练窗口步长从连续区间采样，并用自适应物理时间嵌入编码窗口相对间隔与帧绝对时间，使共享速度场具备间隔感知能力；配合随机插值流与配对不变点注意力，在 PepMD 与 50 个环肽基准上取得最优分布一致性与结构有效性，并更可靠地还原稀疏跃迁帧与态间通量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 肽段是生物分子动力学的难点体系：短肽缺乏稳定折叠核心、构象系综宽泛，环化还引入闭环约束、非局域残基耦合与立体化学多样性。现有深度生成模型虽能模拟分子动力学轨迹，但均基于固定间隔切分窗口，只能以单一时间分辨率观察过程；更关键的是，模型不把该间隔作为输入，窗口所代表的物理时间从未被表示，导致肽段跨越亚稳态的稀疏跃迁帧难以学习。

Method: PepTIDE 为多尺度时间框架：每个训练窗口的步长从连续范围中采样，使单一模型在多种时间分辨率下观察同一动力学过程；引入自适应物理时间嵌入（Adaptive Physical-Time Embedding），同时编码窗口的相对间隔与每帧的绝对时间，使共享速度场成为间隔感知的；所有帧通过随机插值流（stochastic-interpolant flow）联合生成；采用配对感知不变点注意力（pair-aware invariant point attention）刻画线性肽与环肽的几何与拓扑。

Result: 在 PepMD 数据集与一个包含 50 个体系的环肽基准上，PepTIDE 在分布一致性（distribution agreement）与结构有效性（structural validity）方面均达到当前最优水平。

Conclusion: 按时间顺序读取时，PepTIDE 生成的轨迹能够恢复稀疏的跃迁帧，并更忠实地再现态间通量，表明对多时间尺度的建模正是使这些稀有事件变得可学习的关键。

Abstract: Peptides occupy a particularly challenging regime of biomolecular dynamics. Short peptides lack a stable folded core and populate broad conformational ensembles, while cyclization adds ring closure, non-local residue coupling, and stereochemical diversity. Deep generative models have made remarkable progress in emulating molecular-dynamics trajectories directly, yet each is trained on windows cut at a fixed interval and therefore observes the process at a fixed temporal resolution. More fundamentally, none takes that interval as an input, so the physical time a window spans is never represented, leaving the sparse frames on which a peptide crosses between metastable states difficult to learn. Here, we introduce PepTIDE, a multi-scale temporal framework for peptide trajectory generation. The stride of each training window is drawn from a continuous range, so one model observes the same dynamics at many temporal resolutions, and an Adaptive Physical-Time Embedding encodes the relative interval of a window together with the absolute time of each frame, making the shared velocity field interval-aware. All frames are generated jointly through a stochastic-interpolant flow, and pair-aware invariant point attention captures the geometry and topology of both linear and cyclic peptides. On PepMD and a 50-system cyclic-peptide benchmark, PepTIDE reaches state-of-the-art distribution agreement and structural validity. Read in temporal order, its trajectories recover these sparse transition frames and reproduce inter-state fluxes more faithfully, confirming that modeling multiple temporal scales is what makes these rare events accessible.

</details>


### [568] [Fold'EM: Direct atomic structure inference from Cryo-EM particles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01358)
*Advaith Maddipatla,Märt-Erik Mäeots,Marco Pegoraro,Nikolaus Dräger,Roberto Covino,Sanketh Vedula,Martin Pacesa,Alex M. Bronstein*

Main category: q-bio.BM

TL;DR: Fold'EM：一种直接结合蛋白质生成模型先验与冷冻电镜粒子图像的推理期框架，绕过密度重建和原子模型拟合，在低样本条件下确定原子结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统冷冻电镜流程先重建电势密度图再拟合原子模型，密度重建样本复杂度高、成本高、通量低，尤其对异质样品；且密度图分辨率下降会使后续建模愈发困难。蛋白质结构预测模型提供强序列先验，但这类先验通常仅在密度重建之后的原子模型拟合阶段被利用。

Method: 提出 Fold'EM 推理期框架，将蛋白质生成模型的先验直接与冷冻电镜粒子图像结合，从小规模单粒子图像直接推断原子模型，跳过中间密度重建与基于重建图的模型构建；支持已知粒子取向及取向与结构联合推断的从头（ab-initio）设置。

Result: 在合成与实验冷冻电镜数据集上，Fold'EM 在已知取向和从头推断取向两种情形下均能恢复准确的原子结构；在异质数据集中，无需分别重建密度图和为每个状态建原子模型，即可从混合粒子群中解析不同构象态。

Conclusion: 结果为低样本条件下的结构确定及直接从冷冻电镜粒子表征低丰度构象态开辟了新途径。

Abstract: Single-particle cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) has become a widely adopted technique for biomolecular structure determination. The conventional cryo-EM computational pipeline first combines many particle images to reconstruct an electrostatic potential (ESP) map and then fits an atomic model to the recovered map. Density reconstruction has high sample complexity, requiring large numbers of particle images and making structure determination high-cost and low-throughput, particularly for heterogeneous samples. Downstream atomic model building, in turn, becomes increasingly difficult as the resolution of the reconstructed map deteriorates. Protein structure prediction models provide strong sequence-derived priors on atomic structure, and experiment-guided approaches can use these priors to recover structures consistent with experimental measurements. Yet, in cryo-EM, such priors are typically integrated only after density reconstruction during atomic model fitting. We introduce Fold'EM, an inference-time framework that combines priors from protein generative models directly with cryo-EM particle images to determine atomic models from a small number of single particle images, bypassing both intermediate density reconstruction and downstream model building against the reconstructed map. Across synthetic and experimental cryo-EM datasets, Fold'EM recovers accurate atomic structures both with known particle orientations and in an ab-initio setting where orientations are inferred jointly with structure. In heterogeneous datasets, Fold'EM further resolves distinct conformational states from mixed particle populations without separately reconstructing a density map and building an atomic model for each state. We believe these results open new avenues for structure determination in the low-sample regime and for characterizing low-population conformational states directly from cryo-EM particles.

</details>

### [569] [Reverse Item Response Theory for Sparsity-Robust Ranking in Fragmented Cancer Drug-Response Matrices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00002)
*Jung Min Kang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将反向项目反应理论（reverse IRT）引入药物基因组学药物反应分析，把癌症类型视为具"耐药能力"的潜在被试、药物视为具"规避难度"的项目，在GDSC2的242,036条药物敏感性测量上估计癌症类型层面的体外耐药性与药物层面的广谱活性，并在缺失机制、预测与跨平台复制中验证其稳健性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 药物基因组学药物反应数据高度碎片化，缺失模式复杂（随机缺失、癌症偏向、药物偏向），简单的均值汇总难以稳健恢复潜在排序；需要一种能在共享潜在尺度上同时估计癌症类型耐药性与药物活性的方法。

Method: 反向IRT建模：癌症类型作为潜在"被试"（耐药能力），药物作为"项目"（规避难度）；在GDSC2的242,036条药物敏感性测量上估计共享潜在尺度上的参数；在四种缺失机制下与简单平均法对比，进行留出预测（五种方法比较Brier分数），并使用Bootstrap置信区间评估分类稳定性，最后用PRISM跨平台数据做复制检验。

Result: 在60%缺失率下，MCAR、癌症偏向与药物偏向稀疏场景中，reverse IRT对全数据潜在排序的恢复优于简单平均，Delta-rho = +0.089 至 +0.095；留出预测中IRT在五种方法中取得最佳Brier分数；Bootstrap显示28种癌症类型中19种具有稳定的耐药/敏感分类；PRISM跨平台复制的方向一致率为82%，但排序相关性弱（rho = 0.25）。

Conclusion: 该工作的贡献在于碎片化评估条件下的方法学稳健性，而非提供一个普适的临床耐药排行榜；跨平台弱排序一致性表明其不适用于直接推广为临床结论。

Abstract: We introduce reverse Item Response Theory (IRT) to pharmacogenomic drug-response analysis by treating cancer types as latent "subjects" with resistance ability and drugs as "items" with evasion difficulty. Applied to 242,036 drug sensitivity measurements from the Genomics of Drug Sensitivity in Cancer (GDSC2) database, the model estimates cancer-type-level in-vitro resistance and drug-level broad activity on a shared latent scale. Validation across four missingness regimes demonstrates that reverse IRT better recovers the full-data latent ranking than simple averaging, with advantages of Delta-rho = +0.089 to +0.095 at 60% missingness under MCAR, cancer-biased, and drug-biased sparsity. Held-out prediction confirms IRT achieves the best Brier score among five evaluated methods. Bootstrap confidence intervals show 19 of 28 cancer types have stable resistant/sensitive classifications. Cross-platform PRISM replication shows 82% directional agreement but weak rank-order correlation (rho = 0.25), indicating the contribution is methodological robustness under fragmented evaluation, not a universal clinical resistance leaderboard.

</details>


### [570] [Analysis of Quantized and Efficiently Adapted Protein Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00665)
*Ilan Yaniv Zeisler,Sebastian Clancy,Pouriya Bayat,Saaim Raad,Ivan Kraskov,Matthew Xie,Vivian White,Spencer Perkins,Serena Singh,Sepehr Bayat,Keith Pardee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究系统评估了4-bit量化与QLoRA在7个蛋白质语言模型上的效果：多数任务保留超90%全量微调性能，峰值显存节省近90%，但生成模型存在token级分布漂移，需模型与任务特定验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 蛋白质语言模型（PLM）虽广泛用于序列生成与性质预测，但其参数量巨大导致微调与部署成本高昂。量化与参数高效微调对模型性能、表征及生成质量的影响尚缺乏充分刻画，本研究旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 在ESM-2、ESMC、ProtBERT、ProtT5、Ankh、Ankh3、Profluent-E1上评估4-bit量化与低秩适配器微调（QLoRA）；预测任务中对比全量微调性能与GPU显存、训练速度、功耗，并分析各层表征变化；生成任务中对ProLLaMA、ProtGPT2、ProGen2、ProteinGLM、ESM3做序列级、结构级及token级自回归分布分析。

Result: 预测任务中许多模型-任务组合保留超90%全量微调性能；最大模型峰值GPU显存节省接近90%，但性能与效率随模型、数据集和训练配置而异。QLoRA常保留浅层表征，在中后层产生任务特定适配，类似全量微调但表征变化更小；训练速度与功耗影响差异较大。生成任务中4-bit量化基本保持预测的结构与序列级性质，但token级分析揭示自回归输出分布存在模型依赖性偏移。

Conclusion: QLoRA与4-bit量化可降低PLM计算需求，尤其是GPU显存占用；建议将QLoRA作为显存受限场景的首选适配策略，仅在困难任务、不稳定架构或验证恢复较低时使用全量微调。对生成式PLM，应在序列级和结构指标之外补充分布分析，以避免遗漏量化引起的偏移。该方法可扩展大规模蛋白质建模的可及性，但需模型与任务特定验证。

Abstract: Background: Protein language models (PLMs) are increasingly used for sequence generation and property prediction, but their size makes fine-tuning and deployment expensive. The effects of quantization and parameter efficient fine-tuning on performance, representations and generation remain insufficiently characterized. Results: We evaluated 4-bit quantization and low-rank adapter fine-tuning (QLoRA) across ESM-2, ESMC, ProtBERT, ProtT5, Ankh, Ankh3 and Profluent-E1. Across protein prediction tasks, many model-task pairs retained more than 90% of full fine-tuning performance. Peak GPU memory savings approached 90% for the largest models, although performance and efficiency varied by model, dataset and training configuration. QLoRA often preserved early-layer representations while inducing task-specific adaptations in middle and late layers, resembling full fine-tuning with smaller representational changes. Training speed and power effects were more varied. For unconditional generation with ProLLaMA, ProtGPT2, ProGen2, ProteinGLM and ESM3, 4-bit quantization largely preserved predicted structural and sequence-level properties, but token-level analysis revealed model-dependent shifts in autoregressive output distributions. Conclusion: QLoRA and 4-bit quantization reduce PLM computational requirements, particularly GPU memory usage. Our results support QLoRA as a first-pass strategy for memory limited adaptation, reserving full fine-tuning for challenging tasks, unstable architectures or low validation recovery. For generative PLMs, sequence-level and structural metrics should be complemented with distributional analysis, since downstream predictions alone may miss quantization-induced shifts. These approaches can broaden access to large-scale protein modelling while requiring model- and task-specific validation.

</details>


### [571] [How Far is Adam from Natural Gradient Descent?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00004)
*Vihaan Paka-Hegde*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过尺度不变度量γ(Δθ)研究Adam更新规则（含动量）与自然梯度下降(NGD)的几何关系，发现Adam的几何偏差具有情境依赖性，并提出其实用优化能力源于结构近似误差与动量平滑的平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Adam是深度学习的标准优化器，但其与自然梯度下降(NGD)之间的几何关系尚存未解问题。作者希望定量刻画Adam与真实NGD的几何偏差，并厘清这种偏差对优化行为的影响。

Method: 将Adam完整更新规则（含动量）建模为对角经验Fisher近似，并考虑对角截断、经验标签替换与时间滞后三种结构近似。使用尺度不变度量γ(Δθ)在四种损失景观上测量Adam与真实NGD的几何偏差：良态线性回归、病态线性回归、逻辑回归以及非凸小型神经网络，同时比较改进经验Fisher(iEF)与标准经验Fisher(EF)的路径稳定性。

Result: Adam的几何轨迹依赖具体情境：良态设定下偏差较低，病态条件下显著上升，在神经网络中错位达约10^3量级。更高的几何漂移与初期优化变慢相关，但不损害最终目标最小化，Adam始终能达到低损失。此外，iEF比标准EF路径更稳定，后者常出现振荡或发散。

Conclusion: Adam的实际优化能力可能源于结构近似误差与动量平滑之间的平衡，而非对自然梯度路径的紧密跟踪。

Abstract: Adam is the standard optimizer in deep learning, yet its geometric relationship to natural gradient descent (NGD) contains unresolved questions. We study Adam's full update rule, including momentum, as a diagonal empirical Fisher approximation subject to diagonal truncation, empirical label substitution, and temporal lag. Using the scale-invariant $γ(Δθ)$ metric, we measure Adam's geometric deviation from true NGD across four loss landscapes: well-conditioned linear regression, ill-conditioned linear regression, logistic regression, and a non-convex small neural network. Adam's geometric trajectory is context-dependent. Deviation remains low in well-conditioned settings but rises significantly under ill-conditioning, reaching misalignments of $\approx 10^3$ in the neural network. Higher geometric drift correlates with slower initial optimization but does not degrade final objective minimization; Adam consistently reaches low loss. Furthermore, the improved empirical Fisher (iEF) tracks more stable paths than the standard empirical Fisher (EF), which frequently oscillates or diverges. Our results suggest Adam's practical optimization power may stem from a balance of structural approximation errors and momentum smoothing rather than close tracking of the natural gradient path.

</details>


### [572] [ORBIT-FMIB: Tracking Order-Resolved Epistatic Information Through ESM-2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00672)
*Maryam Rahimimovassagh,Ivan Garibay,Niloofar Yousefi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 ORBIT-FMIB 诊断框架，结合 Walsh 交互分解与子集条件神经依赖估计，用于探测 ESM-2 表征层级中高阶上位性信息的保留情况；复制实验表明原有"高阶信息保留更差"的结论不稳健，方向性问题仍开放。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 蛋白质基础模型的预测性能本身无法揭示模型各层深度中保留了何种形式的生物交互信息。作者希望检验 ESM-2 在其表征层级中是否像保留一阶、二阶信息那样强地保留高阶上位性信息，从而理解模型内部编码的交互结构。

Method: 提出 ORBIT-FMIB 诊断框架，将 Walsh 函数交互分解与子集条件神经依赖估计相结合；先在具有已知交互结构的合成适应度景观上验证方法有效性，再应用于密集合成四位点 GB1 适应度景观，使用冻结的 ESM-2 表征进行测量，并在匹配 GPU 硬件与相同 critic 随机种子下进行完整测量网格的独立复制。

Result: 初次生产运行得到 Δ_HO-LO = -0.107，提示 ESM-2 对高阶上位性信息的保留弱于低阶信息；独立复制大幅缩小该差异（Δ_HO-LO = -0.017），且在同一组已训练 critic 上采用其他合理评估配对所得到的符号不稳定（-0.011 至 +0.015）。因此目前既无稳健证据表明 ESM-2 选择性丢失高阶上位性信息，也无法断言各阶保留程度相等。

Conclusion: 关于 ESM-2 是否选择性丢失高阶上位性信息的方向性问题仍然开放。测量协议本身（包括在池化 critic 中移除位置子集捷径的处理）仍然有效，不受该复制结果影响。ORBIT-FMIB 可作为一种探测蛋白质基础模型中交互结构的诊断框架；本研究自身的复制结果说明，此类探测在被当作生物学发现前需要具备足够统计功效的可复现性检验。

Abstract: Protein foundation models support mutation-effect and structural prediction, but predictive performance alone does not reveal which forms of biological interaction information remain accessible through model depth. We ask whether ESM-2 retains higher-order epistatic information as strongly as first- and second-order information across its representation hierarchy, introducing ORBIT-FMIB, a diagnostic framework combining Walsh-based interaction decomposition with subset-conditioned neural dependence estimation. The method is validated on synthetic landscapes with known interaction structure before being applied to the dense four-site GB1 fitness landscape using frozen ESM-2 representations.
  An initial production run suggested ESM-2 retains higher-order epistatic information less well than lower-order information ($Δ_{\mathrm{HO-LO}}=-0.107$). An independent replication of the complete measurement grid, under matched GPU hardware and identical critic seeds, substantially reduced this contrast ($Δ_{\mathrm{HO-LO}}=-0.017$), and its sign was unstable across otherwise-defensible evaluation-pairing choices applied to the same trained critics ($-0.011$ to $+0.015$). We therefore do not currently have robust evidence that ESM-2 selectively loses higher-order epistatic information, nor that retention is equal across orders; the directional question remains open. The measurement protocol itself, including its documented removal of a positional-subset shortcut in pooled critics, remains validated and is unaffected by this finding. ORBIT-FMIB is offered as a diagnostic framework for probing interaction structure in protein foundation models; this study's own replication result illustrates why such probing requires adequately-powered reproducibility checks before its output is treated as a biological finding.

</details>


### [573] [FourierQK: Filter Shape, Admissibility and the Leakage-Coverage Law](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00009)
*Athanasios Zeris*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统探究“频率坍缩注意力”中滤波器的性质，通过字符级语言建模的受控消融实验检验五个假设，得出直流/奈奎斯特成分有害、最优带宽约σ≈2、可容许滤波器（墨西哥帽DOG m=2）优于高斯、双边FFT泄漏随频谱覆盖单调增加，以及因果Morlet在字符尺度无法击败基线等结论，从而界定FourierQK适用于双向注意力（编码器式）场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 频率坍缩注意力以带通滤波内积替代Q/K点积并取得显著提升，但滤波器形状的最优选择及其原因尚不明确。本文旨在回答“何种滤波器形状最优、为何最优”，并厘清该方法适用的注意力范式。

Method: 在字符级语言模型（TinyShakespeare，6层GPT）上进行受控消融，围绕滤波器五个性质提出并检验五个假设：直流抑制、奈奎斯特抑制、带宽、中心频率、多尺度覆盖；以BASE-DOT为基线，比较可容许滤波器（零均值，墨西哥帽DOG m=2）与非可容许高斯，并分析双边FFT泄漏与频谱覆盖关系，另测试因果时域Morlet。

Result: （1）直流与奈奎斯特成分有害（验证损失≈2.0，等效相位随机化）；（2）最优单尺度带宽为σ≈2 bins、中心位于段落尺度（约70 token），较BASE-DOT获得Δ=+1.15 nats的净增益；（3）同尺度下可容许滤波器优于高斯，并部分抵御双边FFT泄漏；（4）双边FFT泄漏随频谱覆盖单调增加，窄带（gap>+4）干净、宽带（gap<+2）泄漏；（5）字符尺度因果时域Morlet无法击败BASE-DOT（K=128 taps仅覆盖T=256上下文的50%）。

Conclusion: FourierQK在双向注意力（编码器式，如BERT）中有效，因训练与推理时均可获得全序列上下文；自回归生成需采用因果频谱变体（如MorletQK，解码器式，如GPT）。

Abstract: Frequency-collapse attention [Zeris, 2026e] achieves large gains over standard dot-product attention by replacing the Q/K dot product with a bandpass-filtered inner product at a learned frequency. A natural follow-up question is: which filter shape works best, and why? We test five hypotheses about filter properties -- DC suppression, Nyquist suppression, bandwidth, centre frequency, and multi-scale coverage -- using a controlled ablation on character-level language modelling (TinyShakespeare, 6-layer GPT). Our main findings are: (1) DC and Nyquist components are actively harmful (val ~= 2.0, equivalent to phase randomisation), confirming that oscillatory bandpass structure is essential, not just any low-dimensional spectral summary; (2) the optimal single-scale bandwidth is sigma ~= 2 bins centred at paragraph scale (~70 tokens), giving a clean gain of Delta = +1.15 nats over BASE-DOT; (3) admissible filters (zero-mean, Mexican Hat DOG m = 2) outperform non-admissible Gaussians at the same scale and provide partial protection against bilateral FFT leakage; (4) bilateral FFT leakage scales monotonically with spectral coverage -- narrowband filters (gap > +4) are clean, wideband filters (gap < +2) are leaky; and (5) causal time-domain Morlet at character scale cannot beat BASE-DOT (K=128 taps covers 50% of T=256 context), motivating word-level experiments in the companion MorletQK paper [Zeris, 2026f]. Together, findings (1)-(5) characterise FourierQK as effective in bidirectional attention settings (encoder-style, e.g. BERT), where full-sequence context is available at both training and inference time; autoregressive generation requires a causal spectral variant such as MorletQK [Zeris, 2026f] (decoder-style, e.g. GPT). Code available at: https://github.com/AthanasiosZeris/energy-gated-attention

</details>


### [574] [Integrating Fairness and Explainability in a Multiple Instance Reinforcement Learning System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00035)
*Bente Hinkenhuis,Seyed Sahand Mohammadi Ziabari,Ali Mohammed Mansoor Alsahag*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出融合RL-MIL、对抗去偏与偏好条件超网络的框架，用于学生风险预测，发现基线性能强但超网络出现模式崩塌，偏好权重无法有效控制公平性-性能权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从教育交互数据预测学生表现需要兼具准确性与透明度的模型，以支持有效干预；同时人口统计信息可能带来不公平预测的风险，因此需要可控的多目标（性能与公平性）建模方法。

Method: 采用多目标框架：以强化学习式多示例学习（RL-MIL）将每个学生建模为弱标注交互的包，由RL智能体选择信息量大的实例供下游分类；结合对抗去偏，并评估两种偏好条件超网络变体，检验用户定义的偏好标量能否连续控制预测性能与Equalized Odds之间的权衡。

Result: RL-MIL基线取得较强的分类性能；但两种超网络扩展均出现模式崩塌，改变偏好权重几乎不能使模型沿预期的公平性-性能前沿发生系统性移动。失败原因与目标支配、条件机制中梯度传播微弱以及动态生成参数之间的交互有关。

Conclusion: 公平目标可被纳入可解释的RL-MIL流程，但仅靠偏好条件化并不能保证可控的多目标行为；稳健的公平RL-MIL需要显式的梯度平衡机制、目标分离以及稳定性分析。

Abstract: Predicting student performance from educational interaction data requires models that are both accurate and sufficiently transparent to support meaningful intervention, while demographic information introduces an additional risk of unfair predictions. This study investigates a multi-objective framework that combines reinforcement learning-based multiple instance learning (RL-MIL), adversarial debiasing, and preference-conditioned hypernetworks for student-at-risk prediction. MIL represents each student as a bag of weakly labeled interactions, while an RL agent selects informative instances for downstream classification. Two hypernetwork variants are evaluated to determine whether a user-defined preference scalar can continuously control the trade-off between predictive performance and Equalized Odds. The underlying RL-MIL baseline achieves strong classification performance, but both hypernetwork extensions exhibit mode collapse: changing the preference weight produces little systematic movement along the intended fairness-performance frontier. The failure is associated with objective dominance, weak gradient propagation through the conditioning mechanism, and interactions between dynamically generated parameters. The results show that fairness objectives can be incorporated into an interpretable RL-MIL pipeline, but preference conditioning alone does not guarantee controllable multi-objective behavior. Robust fair RL-MIL therefore requires explicit mechanisms for gradient balancing, objective separation, and stability analysis.

</details>


### [575] [Fast Polynomial Transcendentals for LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00049)
*Robert Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究用短多项式程序替代LLM中sigmoid、tanh、SiLU等SFU算子，在GB200上验证了从孤立微基准到四项集成任务的加速效果与模型行为影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GPU各代在矩阵、特殊功能单元（SFU）与内存管线的扩展速率不同，导致内核瓶颈随硬件演进而转移；FlashAttention-4已在Blackwell上暴露了注意力内部的这种不平衡，因此需要检验短多项式程序能否加速LLM中其他SFU操作。

Method: 先在孤立FP16扫描中对比原生PyTorch与打包融合乘加（FMA）程序，覆盖L2驻留与HBM驻留工作集；随后在四项GB200集成任务（稠密SiLU、tanh-softcapped注意力、sigmoid注意力、路由专家SwiGLU）中用3次或4次BF16多项式替换原生sigmoid、tanh、SiLU。程序结合解析对称性、目标格式舍入与消费内核内的打包算术。另做同检查点的开放权重消融与每任务一次配对预训练对比。

Result: 孤立路径在L2提升1.19–2.19x、在HBM提升1.00–1.70x。稠密SiLU、tanh-softcapped注意力与路由专家替换分别使完整训练步吞吐提升2.7%、2.9%和8.0%；sigmoid注意力替换使完整注意力前向提升7.4%、完整GPU步提升0.3%。在约1000亿token的常见训练视界下，四项任务的最终平滑训练损失差（多项式减原生）在−0.107至+0.079之间。

Conclusion: 短BF16多项式程序可有效缓解SFU瓶颈，在多项LLM训练任务中带来可观加速，且对训练损失影响较小，具备实用可行性。

Abstract: Graphics processing unit (GPU) generations scale matrix, special-function, and memory pipelines at different rates, so kernel bottlenecks move as hardware evolves. FlashAttention-4 exposed this imbalance inside attention on NVIDIA Blackwell. We test whether short polynomial programs can accelerate other special-function-unit (SFU) operations in large language models (LLMs). We first compare native PyTorch evaluation with packed fused multiply--add (FMA) programs in an isolated IEEE binary16 (FP16) sweep spanning L2-resident and high-bandwidth-memory (HBM)-resident working sets. We then replace native sigmoid, tanh, and sigmoid linear unit (SiLU) with degree-3 or degree-4 bfloat16 (BF16) programs in four GB200 integration tasks: dense SiLU, tanh-softcapped attention, sigmoid attention, and routed-expert Swish-gated linear unit (SwiGLU). The programs combine analytical symmetry, target-format rounding, and packed arithmetic inside consuming kernels. The isolated paths improve by 1.19--2.19x in L2 and 1.00--1.70x in HBM. The dense-SiLU, tanh-softcapped-attention, and routed-expert substitutions improve complete training-step throughput by 2.7\%, 2.9\%, and 8.0\%, respectively. The sigmoid-attention substitution improves complete-attention forward by 7.4\% and the complete GPU step by 0.3\%. Same-checkpoint open-weight ablations and one paired pre-training comparison per task extend the evaluation to model behavior. At common horizons near 100 billion tokens, the final smoothed training-loss differences (polynomial minus native) range from $-0.107$ to $+0.079$ across the four tasks.

</details>


### [576] [SW-KAN: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks with Stieltjes-Wigert q-Orthogonal Polynomials](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00050)
*Amirhosein Azarpour,Seyyed Moein Kazemi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SW-KAN，采用定义在半无限域上的Stieltjes-Wigert q-正交多项式构建KAN，并用指数-of-tanh映射桥接域不匹配、三分递推实现O(N)评估，在分类与函数逼近任务中实现更优精度-效率权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原始KAN依赖B样条，计算开销大；近期多项式KAN变体虽降低成本，却引入未充分研究的核心问题：无界实数输入与正交多项式有界/半无限支撑之间的域不匹配（domain mismatch），限制了其适用性与数值稳定性。

Method: 提出Stieltjes-Wigert Kolmogorov-Arnold Network（SW-KAN）：(1) 选用定义在半无限域(0, ∞)上的Stieltjes-Wigert q-正交多项式作为可学习一元函数基；(2) 设计平滑的exponential-of-tanh映射，稳定桥接无界输入与该半无限域，同时保持良态梯度；(3) 采用数值稳定的三项递推（three-term recurrence）在O(N)操作内完成多项式展开求值，无需调用特殊函数；引入对数正态权重结构与可学习q参数作为归纳偏置。

Result: 在图像分类与连续函数逼近的综合实验中，SW-KAN取得优于现有多项式KAN基线的精度-效率权衡；在降维特征与有限训练数据等资源受限条件下表现稳健，并能以极少参数逼近复杂多元函数，展现强表示能力。

Conclusion: SW-KAN通过将Stieltjes-Wigert q-正交多项式与域桥接映射、稳定递推相结合，有效解决多项式KAN的域不匹配问题，为资源受限场景下的高效函数逼近与分类提供了有竞争力的方案。

Abstract: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) represent a paradigmatic shift in deep learning by replacing fixed node activations with learnable univariate functions on edges, offering enhanced interpretability and parameter efficiency. While recent polynomial-based KAN variants have addressed the computational overhead of original B-spline implementations, they introduce a fundamental yet underexplored challenge: the domain mismatch between unbounded real-valued inputs and the bounded or semi-infinite support of orthogonal polynomial bases. To address this limitation, we propose the Stieltjes-Wigert Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (SW-KAN), a novel architecture that employs Stieltjes-Wigert q-orthogonal polynomials defined on the semi-infinite domain (0, infinity). We introduce a smooth exponential-of-tanh mapping that stably bridges the domain gap while preserving well-conditioned gradients, and leverage a numerically stable three-term recurrence that evaluates polynomial expansions in O(N) operations without special-function calls. Through comprehensive experiments spanning image classification and continuous function approximation, we demonstrate that SW-KAN achieves superior accuracy-efficiency trade-offs across diverse tasks. The log-normal weight structure and learnable q-parameter of Stieltjes-Wigert polynomials provide a distinct inductive bias that enables robust performance under resource-constrained conditions, including reduced feature dimensionality and limited training data. The proposed architecture not only outperforms established polynomial KAN baselines on standard benchmarks but also exhibits strong representational capacity for approximating complex multivariate functions with remarkably few parameters, making it a compelling alternative for efficient function approximation and classification in resource-constrained settings.

</details>


### [577] [Format-Aware Fusion for Fast FP4 Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00053)
*Robert Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出"格式感知融合"（format-aware fusion），将量化生产者与尺度域及消费者布局协同设计，以消除FP4 Tensor Core在矩阵乘法加速中被尺度计算、操作数打包、布局构造和反向状态保存所抵消的收益，并在Llama-3系列8B预训练上验证了其性能与精度表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 四比特浮点（FP4）Tensor Core虽可加速矩阵乘法，但尺度计算、操作数打包、布局构造以及反向传播中保存的状态会抵消这些加速收益，因此需要从根本上协同设计量化流程以释放FP4的实际性能。

Method: 提出格式感知融合（format-aware fusion），为原生mxfp、全局nvfp和协作线程阵列本地nvfp分别协同设计量化生产者、尺度域与消费者布局；使用bfloat16输出投影和编译版交叉熵，对Llama-3系列8B模型进行长达1600亿token的预训练评估；并采用行梯度随机舍入以及固定符号32值Hadamard权重梯度预处理等策略。

Result: 在同加速器对比实验中，bfloat16与Transformer Engine nvfp分别达到18.8K和27.6K tokens/s/GPU，而最快的自定义路径达到37.9K；采用行梯度随机舍入与固定符号32值Hadamard权重梯度预处理的mxfp达到37.2K tokens/s/GPU（86.3% bfloat16模型FLOP利用率），训练损失终点较原始bfloat16高2.11%；含四个末尾bfloat16块的Transformer Engine配方在27.1K tokens/s/GPU下较bfloat16高0.87%。

Conclusion: FP4的最终效果同时取决于尺度契约、操作数与执行路径三者，且下游任务排名与训练损失排名并不一致，表明仅凭训练损失无法完整评估FP4方案的实际质量。

Abstract: Four-bit floating-point (FP4) Tensor Cores accelerate matrix multiplication, but scale computation, operand packing, layout construction, and saved backward state can erase the gain. We present \emph{format-aware fusion}, which co-designs each quantization producer with its scale domain and consumer layout for native \mxfp{}, global \nvfp{}, and cooperative-thread-array-local \nvfp{}. We evaluate Llama-3-family 8B pretraining through 160 billion tokens using bfloat16 output projections and compiled cross entropy. In matched same-accelerator probes, bfloat16 and Transformer Engine \nvfp{} reach 18.8K and 27.6K tokens/s/GPU, while our fastest custom route reaches 37.9K. \mxfp{} with row-gradient stochastic rounding and fixed-sign 32-value Hadamard weight-gradient preconditioning reaches 37.2K tokens/s/GPU (86.3\% bfloat16 model FLOP utilization) and ends 2.11\% above the raw bfloat16 training-loss endpoint. A Transformer Engine recipe with four final bfloat16 blocks ends 0.87\% above bfloat16 at 27.1K tokens/s/GPU. Downstream rankings differ from training-loss rankings, showing that FP4 outcomes depend jointly on scale contract, operand, and execution path.

</details>


### [578] ["very likely" Means "uncertain"? How LLMs Diverge from Humans in Linguistic Uncertainty Quantification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00083)
*Jinhao Duan,Zicheng Liu,Zijie Liu,Kaidi Xu,Tianlong Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出METHODNAME，一种基于优化的算法，可直接从LLM输出中学习不确定性标记的最优不确定性画像，从而在标记层面比较人类与LLM的置信度语义。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类通过语言标记（如"possible""likely"）表达不确定性，这体现元认知监测与知识边界。然而多数LLM不确定性量化依赖基于似然或一致性的信号，忽视了语言标记这一认知视角，因此需探究LLM在言语不确定性量化上与人类的差异，以及言语标记能否可靠量化LLM不确定性。

Method: 从心理学与决策科学文献中整理人类不确定性标记语料，并以此对LLM进行基准测试；提出METHODNAME，一种基于优化的算法，通过拟合标记-不确定性映射以最好地解释经验正确性，直接学习覆盖各不确定性标记的最优不确定性画像，而非通过重复采样估计不确定性。

Result: LLM以与人类显著不同的数值水平编码言语不确定性；METHODNAME能够发现每个言语标记应传递的概率质量，实现人类与LLM置信语义的标记级直接比较，解耦不匹配并揭示言语表达中的系统性置信差异。

Conclusion: 言语标记可作为量化LLM不确定性的可靠途径，METHODNAME为人类与LLM置信语义的标记级比较提供了直接方法，揭示了系统性置信差异。

Abstract: Humans express uncertainty verbally via markers (e.g., "possible," "likely"), yet most LLM uncertainty quantification (UQ) relies on costing likelihood- or consistency-based signals. From a cognitive perspective, accurate verbal uncertainty reflects metacognitive monitoring, representing knowledge boundaries ("knowing that you don't know") to support regulation and information seeking. In this paper, we investigate how LLMs diverge from humans in verbal uncertainty quantification and whether verbal markers can reliably quantify LLM uncertainty. We curate a corpus of human uncertainty markers from psychology and decision-science literature and benchmark LLMs against it. We observe that LLMs encode verbal uncertainty with numerical levels that differ substantially from those of humans. We then introduce METHODNAME, a novel optimization-based algorithm that learns an optimal uncertainty profile over uncertainty markers directly from LLM outputs. By fitting a marker-uncertainty mapping to best explain empirical correctness, METHODNAME discovers how much probability mass each verbal marker should convey, rather than estimating uncertainty via repeated sampling. METHODNAME enables a direct, marker-level comparison of confidence semantics between humans and LLMs, disentangling mismatch and revealing systematic confidence disparities in verbal expressions.

</details>


### [579] [Increasing Width Allows Greedy Layer-wise Training to Rival End-to-End Backpropagation in Self-Supervised Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00753)
*Syon Mansur,Joel Zylberberg*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究网络宽度与深度如何影响贪心逐层自监督训练与端到端反向传播的效果，发现宽网络中两者差距缩小，甚至贪心训练更优，其机制在于表征几何更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端到端反向传播是深度学习主流训练方式，虽有研究探索更简单的替代机制（如局部优化、贪心逐层训练），但在何种网络架构条件下局部优化网络能学到与端到端训练相当的表征仍不明确，尤其在自监督学习（大规模预训练的重要框架）背景下尚未清晰。本文旨在回答这一问题。

Method: 在自监督学习框架下，以卷积网络为对象，系统考察网络宽度与深度对贪心逐层训练和端到端自监督训练效果的影响，并进行对比实验；随后对训练所得网络的表征进行分析，比较其表征几何特性。

Result: 网络越宽，端到端反向传播相对贪心逐层训练的优势越小；在相对较浅且非常宽的网络中，贪心逐层训练的模型甚至取得更高性能。表征分析显示，极宽的贪心训练网络比端到端反向传播网络具有更有利的表征几何。

Conclusion: 网络宽度可以补偿受限的信用分配（credit assignment），并识别出表征几何差异是其性能提升的潜在机制。

Abstract: End-to-end backpropagation has been the dominant mode of training in deep learning, allowing for the coordination of parameter updates across layers of a neural network. Prior studies have explored alternative -- and, in some cases, simpler -- training mechanisms, showing that they can sometimes achieve performance similar to backpropagation. However, the architectural conditions under which locally optimized networks, which avoid end-to-end backpropagation of error, can learn representations comparable to those learned through end-to-end training remain unclear. We aim to answer this question in the context of self-supervised learning, an important framework for large-scale pretraining in artificial intelligence. Here, we investigate how network width and depth affect the efficacy of greedy layer-wise and end-to-end self-supervised training in convolutional networks. We find that in wider networks, the benefits of end-to-end backpropagation over greedy layer-wise training shrink: in relatively shallow and very wide networks, we even observed higher performance in models trained with greedy layer-wise training. Subsequent analysis of the representations formed by these networks shows that very wide greedy-trained networks exhibit more favorable representational geometry than do networks trained end-to-end with backpropagation. This work shows that width can compensate for restricted credit assignment and identifies differences in representational geometry as a potential mechanism for their improved performance.

</details>


### [580] [Nous: Learning and Certifying Memory Decisions Before Source Calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00094)
*Pranav Singh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文区分了记忆系统中的"学习、校准与改进认证"，证明学习并认证有用的信念决策所需的样本量可比源校准少一个数量级的平方（Theta(l^-2) vs Theta(l^-4)），并在未知报告信道下给出有限样本证书与鲁棒性扩展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 信念型智能体记忆需要可靠的状态判断，但其证据常带噪声、复制或过期问题。核心疑问是：记忆是否必须先校准各信息源，才能改进决策？论文旨在厘清学习、校准与修订认证三者的统计关系，判定何时可以绕过源可靠性恢复而直接学习并证明决策改进。

Method: 在一个四模型隐马尔可夫族上分析学习未知贝叶斯决策、认证其相对信息性先验的改进、以及固定精度源估计各自的样本复杂度；将决策率与源下界推广到更广模型类。在未知"身份加背景"报告信道下刻画策略改进的紧识别区间，并基于可观测见证域构造有限样本证书，无需纯类锚点。进一步给出容忍有界历史依赖误设与条件复制的鲁棒扩展，并以分裂训练见证适配任意历史空间。

Result: 学习与认证有用决策所需样本量为Theta(l^-2)（认证改进为O(l^-2)同律新记录），而固定精度源估计为Theta(l^-4)，即决策可二次方地少于源校准。新证书在MiniGrid中接受9/9相对常量先验的改进、4/9相对last-write-wins的改进，而先前证书均无接受；但强基线推断方法仍具竞争力或更优。

Conclusion: 论文给出的是关于"何时可在不恢复源可靠性的前提下学习并证明记忆决策"的统计解释，而非通用更优的记忆算法；其价值在于将决策学习、校准与认证分离，并给出可观测的有限样本证书与鲁棒性保证。

Abstract: Belief-based agent memory needs reliable decisions about current state, yet its evidence may be noisy, copied, or stale. Must a memory calibrate its sources before it can improve its decisions? We separate learning, calibration, and revision certification. On one four-model hidden Markov family, learning an unknown Bayes decision requires Theta(l^-2) records and certifying its improvement over an informative incumbent takes O(l^-2) fresh records from the same observation law, while fixed-precision source estimation requires Theta(l^-4) as persistence l vanishes. Thus learning and certifying useful decisions can require quadratically fewer records than source calibration. A broader model class retains the decision rate and source lower bound. Under an unknown identity-plus-background report channel, we characterize the sharp identified interval for policy improvement and derive a finite-sample certificate using observable witness regions, without pure-class anchors. A robustness extension tolerates bounded history-dependent misspecification and conditional copying; split-trained witnesses apply to arbitrary history spaces with explicit power conditions. We integrate policy-bound receipts with Nous Dimensions and test 45,000 held-out mutable-state histories and 9,000 episodes in three external MiniGrid memory environments with an introduced noisy-report interface. The new certificate accepts 9/9 improvements over a constant incumbent and 4/9 over last-write-wins, versus none for the earlier certificate in MiniGrid. Strong established inference baselines remain competitive or better. The result is a statistical account of when memory decisions can be learned and justified without recovering source reliability, not a universally superior memory algorithm.

</details>


### [581] [Inferring Multi-Timescale Neural Dynamics with Switching Linear Dynamical Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01786)
*Lulu Gong,Yongxu Zhang,Shreya Saxena*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出多时间尺度切换线性动力系统（MTS-SLDS），从连续或脉冲神经观测中识别随行为状态变化的、具有状态特异性的潜在时间尺度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经活动常呈现多种时间尺度，并随行为状态和任务条件变化。识别这些时间尺度对理解神经计算与功能很重要，但基于自相关拟合的传统方法难以扩展到高维群体记录，且在神经动力学随行为变化时可靠性下降。状态空间模型虽能通过潜在动力系统建模高维神经群体活动，但标准形式与推断方法未显式考虑多时间尺度，无法保证准确恢复潜在时间结构。

Method: 提出 MTS-SLDS 框架，结合两项关键设计：（1）多滞后矩初始化，跨多个观测滞后捕获时间结构；（2）状态条件化（regime-conditioned）Laplace-EM 推断，减少不确定状态下动力学统计的混叠。随后直接从学习到的潜在转移矩阵特征值中提取特征时间尺度。

Result: 在高斯和泊松脉冲观测的合成实验与神经实验中，MTS-SLDS 在多个数据集上均能准确恢复时间尺度与切换结构。

Conclusion: MTS-SLDS 为从高维神经记录中识别状态特异的多时间尺度提供了有效框架，克服了传统自相关拟合的可扩展性与可靠性限制，并弥补了标准状态空间模型对多时间尺度建模的不足。

Abstract: Neural activity often exhibits multiple timescales that can vary with behavioral states and task conditions. Identifying these timescales from neural recordings is important for better understanding neural computation and function. However, traditional approaches based on autocorrelation fitting are difficult to scale to high-dimensional population recordings and can become unreliable when neural dynamics change with behavior. State-space models have been a powerful framework for modeling high-dimensional neural population activity through latent dynamical systems, but standard formulations and inference methods do not explicitly account for multiple timescales and therefore do not guarantee accurate recovery of the underlying temporal structure. Motivated by these questions, we introduce the Multi-Timescale Switching Linear Dynamical System (MTS-SLDS), a framework for identifying regime-specific latent timescales from continuous or spiking neural observations. MTS-SLDS combines a multi-lag moment initialization, which captures temporal structure across multiple observation lags, with \textit{regime-conditioned} Laplace-EM inference, which reduces mixing of dynamical statistics across uncertain regimes. Characteristic timescales can then be extracted directly from the eigenvalues of the learned latent transition matrices. In synthetic and neural experiments with Gaussian and Poisson spike observations, MTS-SLDS accurately recovers timescales and switching structure over multiple datasets.

</details>


### [582] [One Mastery Threshold Does Not Fit All Knowledge Tracing Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00095)
*Xianghui Meng,Yujing Zhang,Jionghao Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文考察六种知识追踪模型在四个公开数据集上的12个掌握阈值（0.50–0.99），从进阶后表现、进阶覆盖率、练习负担及先前表现组间差异等维度评估。BKT对阈值变化不敏感，神经模型随阈值升高明显更严格；最优平衡阈值因模型和教学情境而异，且严格阈值不能可靠缩小差距，反而可能加剧进阶不平等。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 辅导系统用掌握阈值决定学生何时停止练习并进阶，但同一数值阈值在不同知识追踪（KT）模型下会导致不同决策，因此需要系统检验阈值与模型、教学优先级的交互效应。

Method: 在四个公开教育数据集上比较六种KT模型，评估0.50至0.99共12个阈值，指标包括进阶后表现、进阶覆盖率、练习负担以及先前表现组间差异；并在30个预设教学情境下识别兼顾表现、额外练习与进阶的平衡阈值。

Result: BKT对阈值变化相对不敏感，神经模型随阈值升高变得更选择性；部分原因是BKT输出潜在掌握概率，而神经模型输出下一题答对的概率，同一截断值不代表相同掌握水平。最佳平衡阈值跨模型和情境差异显著，半数情境中神经模型与BKT所选阈值相差超过0.10，但在更重视减少额外练习、允许更多学生进阶时差距缩小。严格阈值不能可靠缩小表现差距，反而可能不成比例地限制进阶，先前表现强的学生进阶频率最高可达弱学生的3.26倍。

Conclusion: 当KT模型或教学优先级改变时，掌握阈值应重新校准，并从表现、练习、进阶和可及性四方面评估其效果。

Abstract: Tutoring systems use mastery thresholds to decide when students can stop practicing and advance, but the same numerical threshold can lead to very different decisions when the underlying knowledge tracing (KT) model changes. We examine six KT models across four public educational datasets and evaluate 12 thresholds from 0.50 to 0.99 using post-advancement performance, advancement coverage, practice burden, and disparities across prior-performance groups. We also identify thresholds that balance performance, extra practice, and advancement under 30 predefined instructional settings. Bayesian Knowledge Tracing (BKT) is relatively insensitive to threshold changes, while neural models become much more selective as thresholds increase. This partly reflects different model outputs: BKT estimates latent mastery probability, whereas neural models estimate the probability of a correct next response, so the same cutoff does not represent the same level of mastery. The best-balanced threshold varied substantially across models and settings. In half of the tested settings, neural models and BKT differed by more than 0.10 in their selected thresholds, although this gap became smaller when greater priority was placed on reducing extra practice and allowing more students to advance. Stricter thresholds also did not reliably reduce performance gaps and could disproportionately restrict advancement, with stronger-prior students advancing up to 3.26 times as often as weaker-prior students. These results show that mastery thresholds should be recalibrated when the KT model or instructional priorities change and evaluated by their effects on performance, practice, advancement, and access.

</details>


### [583] [A foundation for systematic analysis of transformers and RNNs for tractography](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01894)
*Emmanuelle Renauld,Philippe Poulin,Hugo Larochelle,Antoine Théberge,Maxime Descoteaux*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统评估RNN与Transformer在扩散磁共振成像(dMRI)纤维束成像中的应用，提出"生成-验证"训练阶段实现流线级监督，在ISMRM2015挑战数据集上取得迄今最高性能，并量化训练数据缺陷的影响，验证了模型在Tractoinferno在体数据上的适用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: dMRI纤维束成像存在局部扩散信息与全局解剖合理性之间的内在矛盾。现有ML方法多依赖局部损失函数，与全局流线质量不匹配，缺乏对训练策略、输入表示及超参数的系统评估，也缺乏对训练数据质量影响的量化分析。

Method: 系统评估RNN与Transformer用于迭代式纤维束成像，重点考察训练策略、输入表示（CNN嵌入与EOS token）及超参数选择；引入生成-验证阶段，在训练中实现流线级监督；在ISMRM2015挑战数据集上做受控实验，分析缺失纤维束、噪声或不完美训练流线、无效纤维的影响，并在Tractoinferno在体数据上测试最佳模型。

Result: 在ISMRM2015纤维束成像挑战数据集上取得迄今报告的最高性能；量化了缺失纤维束、训练流线噪声与无效纤维对模型性能的影响；最佳模型可推广至Tractoinferno在体数据。

Conclusion: 序列型深度学习模型（Transformer与RNN）用于纤维束成像兼具潜力与局限；在体验证仍需更优的仿真体模与评估方法；为后续研究者训练与验证基于序列的监督方法提供了经验总结与建议。

Abstract: Machine learning (ML) has emerged as a promising approach for improving diffusion MRI (dMRI) tractography, a task that remains limited by the intrinsic tension between local diffusion information and global anatomical plausibility. In this work, we systematically evaluate recurrent neural networks (RNNs) and Transformer models for iterative tractography, with particular attention to training strategies, input representations (including convolutional neural network (CNN)-based embeddings and end-of-sequence (EOS) tokens), and hyperparameter selection. We introduce a generation-validation phase enabling supervision at the streamline level during training, allowing supervision despite the mismatch between local loss functions and global streamline quality. Using the ISMRM2015 tractography challenge dataset, our models achieve the highest reported performance to date. Through controlled experiments, we quantify the impact of missing bundles, noisy or imperfect training streamlines, and invalid fibers in the training set. Finally, we demonstrate the applicability of our best-performing models for in vivo data from the Tractoinferno database. Overall, our results highlight both the potential and the limits of sequence-based deep learning models such as Transformers and RNNs for tractography, and emphasize the need for improved phantoms and evaluation methods for in vivo validation. We provide takeaways and recommendations for future researchers training and validating sequence-based supervised methods for tractography.

</details>


### [584] [Uncertainty-Aware Learning from Multi-Expert Interval Targets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00102)
*Samira Alkaee Taleghan,Younghyun Koo,Andrew P. Barrett,Farnoush Banaei-Kashani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种保留个体专家区间标签的方法，将标签内不精确与专家间差异分离并分别建模，同时将预测不确定性分解并验证其与标签侧来源的对应关系，在海冰浓度任务上MAE降低31%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多ML应用依赖专家标注，而合格专家可能对同一观测给出不同但合理的解释，这种标签差异反映真实分歧或模糊性而非标注错误。当专家报告区间而非精确值时，监督信号包含两类标签不确定性：标签内不精确（within-label imprecision）与专家间差异（between-expert variation）。现有方法将二者分开处理：多专家方法将标签坍缩为共识，区间目标方法常给出单一预测，预测不确定性方法很少将不确定性估计与观测到的专家分歧进行验证。

Method: 1) 将异构标签词表统一到公共概率标签空间，分离编码差异与专家判断；2) 保留个体标签区间，用Beta混合分布建模，并以proper Cramér-distance目标训练，保留各专家报告的独立标签；3) 将预测不确定性分解为within-component、between-component和model uncertainty，分别评估其是否对应标签内不确定性、标签间不确定性与模型误差；4) 因该对应关系并非必然成立，引入decomposition matching，将预测分量对齐到其预期的标签侧来源。

Result: 在海冰浓度（sea-ice concentration）任务上，该模型相较硬标签将MAE降低31%，并优于聚合（aggregation）、区间分布（interval-distribution）与区间回归（interval-regression）基线。

Conclusion: 通过保留个体专家区间、分离并建模两类标签不确定性，并对预测不确定性分量进行对齐验证，该方法在存在专家区间标注的场景下显著优于现有处理方式。

Abstract: Many machine learning (ML) applications rely on expert labels, and qualified experts may provide different but plausible interpretations of the same observation. Such variation across expert labels may reflect genuine disagreement or ambiguity rather than annotation error. When individual experts additionally report intervals rather than exact values, the supervision contains two distinct sources of label uncertainty: within-label imprecision and between-expert variation. Existing methods treat these forms separately: multi-expert approaches collapse labels to a consensus, interval-target methods often yield a single prediction, and predictive-uncertainty methods rarely validate their uncertainty estimates against observed expert disagreement. To address this problem, we propose an approach that preserves individual expert intervals, separates within-label imprecision from between-expert variation, and validates the corresponding predictive uncertainty components. First, heterogeneous label vocabularies are harmonized into a common probabilistic label space, separating encoding differences from expert judgement. Second, individual label intervals are retained and modeled with a mixture of Beta distributions trained using a proper Cramér-distance objective, preserving distinct expert-reported labels. Third, we decompose predictive uncertainty into within-component, between-component, and model uncertainty, and evaluate whether these components correspond to within-label uncertainty, between-label uncertainty, and model error, respectively. Because this correspondence is not guaranteed, we introduce decomposition matching, which aligns the predictive components to their intended label-side sources. On sea-ice concentration the model reduces MAE by 31\% over hard labels and outperforms aggregation, interval-distribution, and interval-regression baselines.

</details>


### [585] [The Hidden Costs of 99% Accuracy: A Trustworthiness Audit of the Telco Customer Churn Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00118)
*Soumyadeep Roy*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 对IBM Telco流失预测基准的审计发现四类可信度问题：SMOTE前置于划分导致F1虚高13.1个百分点；TotalCharges近似冗余却获高SHAP归因；校准方法选择依赖模型类型；成本最优阈值远低于F1最优阈值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 该基准（n=7,043）上广泛报道95%以上测试准确率、最高达99.01%，但这类以准确率/F1为中心的评估掩盖了基准与流程的可信度缺陷，作者旨在系统审计这些"准确率不可见"的失效模式。

Method: 四种审计：（1）十种分类器、十五个随机种子下对比划分前SMOTE与类权重管线，用Wilcoxon检验并测量合成点与测试集的最近邻插值比例；（2）用R²检验TotalCharges与tenure×MonthlyCharges的关系，并比较去除特征后准确率变化与TreeSHAP平均绝对归因排名，提出R²>0.95的建模前冗余诊断；（3）十五种子校准审计，比较isotonic回归与temperature scaling；（4）在50美元挽留成本与24个月CLV代理下比较成本最优与F1最优阈值。另在Iranian Telecom（同域）与Bank Customer Churn（跨域）上复制F1、F2结论。

Result: 划分前SMOTE使流失类F1膨胀13.1个百分点（Wilcoxon p<10⁻⁴），约36%合成训练点为测试实例的最近邻插值；类权重管线无此膨胀，证明效应源于SMOTE的几何构造。TotalCharges的R²=0.999，去除后准确率变化<0.2个百分点，但TreeSHAP仍将其列为第九重要特征。isotonic回归为最稳健默认校准，temperature scaling在概率分布双峰的类加权树集成上失效。成本最优阈值约为F1最优阈值的1/5–1/10，每千名客户节省约77,000美元。F1结论可跨域推广，F2仅在电信域内推广。

Conclusion: 提出四要素报告清单——管线披露、冗余诊断、校准审计、成本敏感阈值——并提供可复现实现，倡导以可信度导向的评估取代单一准确率/F1报告。

Abstract: Customer churn prediction on the IBM Telco Customer Churn benchmark (n = 7,043) routinely reports test accuracies above 95%, with the most cited published study reporting 99.01%. We audit this benchmark for four trustworthiness failures invisible to the accuracy- and F1-centred reporting that dominates the literature. First, pre-split SMOTE inflates churn-class F1 by 13.1 percentage points across ten classifiers and fifteen seeds (Wilcoxon p < 10^-4 per classifier); the same leaky pipeline ordering paired with class weighting yields no inflation, isolating the effect to SMOTE's geometric construction. We measure the mechanism directly: approximately 36% of synthetic training points are nearest-neighbour interpolations of test-set instances. Second, the TotalCharges field is approximately determined by tenure multiplied by MonthlyCharges (R2 = 0.999); removing it changes accuracy by less than 0.2 percentage points, yet TreeSHAP ranks it ninth in mean absolute attribution - a pattern that materially corrupts SHAP-based interpretation. We propose an R2 > 0.95 pre-modelling diagnostic. Third, in a 15-seed calibration audit, isotonic regression is the strongest default; temperature scaling fails on class-weighted tree ensembles whose predicted-probability distribution is bimodal. Fourth, the cost-optimal decision threshold (under a 50 USD retention offer and 24-month CLV proxy) is approximately 5-10 times lower than the F1-optimal threshold, saving approximately 77,000 USD per 1,000 customers. We replicate F1 and F2 on Iranian Telecom Churn (within domain) and Bank Customer Churn (across domain): F1 generalises; F2 generalises only within telecom. We synthesise these findings into a four-component reporting checklist - pipeline disclosure, redundancy diagnostic, calibration audit, and cost-sensitive thresholds - and release a reproducible implementation.

</details>


### [586] [Generalized Biomedicine Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00120)
*Luyao Tang,Yingkai Yang,Hanqi Chen,Jiewei Zheng,Chaoqi Chen,Cheng Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出广义生物医学发现（GBD）任务与统一基准，并设计认知启发的SCAN方法，以在长尾、异常和层级分类等开放世界医学影像场景中提升新概念发现能力，同时尽量保留已有临床知识。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实临床医学影像存在开放世界偏移：长尾罕见病、正常解剖主导的细微病灶以及层级分类体系。而多数开放世界范式假设标签空间是平坦且类别均衡的，难以满足生物医学需求。

Method: 核心洞察是主导性的已知模式构成视觉流形，会掩盖细微的新奇性。受专家诊断启发，提出SCAN（Surprise-evoked Complementary AccommodatioN），按认知启发的感知进程：先用预测抑制过滤预期常态，再以惊讶诱发显著性突出意外偏差，最后通过互补适应将这些偏移整合进全局表征。

Result: 大量实验表明，SCAN提升了新概念发现性能，同时总体上保留了既有临床知识，并可即插即用地接入现有架构以更好权衡医学影像中的已知-未知取舍。

Conclusion: SCAN为开放世界医学影像中的已知-未知权衡提供了可插拔的解决方案，并配合GBD基准推动长尾、异常与层级感知发现的统一研究。

Abstract: In real-world clinical practice, medical images face open-world shifts: (i) long-tailed rare diseases, (ii) subtle lesions dominated by normal anatomy, and (iii) hierarchical taxonomies. Yet most open-world paradigms assume flat, balanced label spaces, leaving these biomedical demands unresolved. We introduce Generalized Biomedicine Discovery (GBD) and a unified benchmark spanning long-tail, anomaly, and taxonomy-aware discovery. Our key insight is that dominant known patterns form a visual manifold that masks subtle novelty. Inspired by expert diagnosis, we propose SCAN (Surprise-evoked Complementary AccommodatioN), which follows a cognition-inspired perceptual progression: it applies predictive suppression to filter expected norms, triggers surprise-evoked salience to highlight unexpected deviations, and performs complementary accommodation to integrate these shifts into global representations. Extensive experiments show that SCAN improves novel concept discovery while generally preserving established clinical knowledge, and it plugs into existing architectures to better navigate the known-unknown trade-off in medical imaging. Code is available at https://github.com/lytang63/generalized-biomedicine-discovery.

</details>


### [587] [Classification Based on Association Rules Algorithm for Breast Cancer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00174)
*Ali Alsalama,Ahmed Kubba,Ghaith Jamjoum,Zaher Al Aghbari*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于加权分类的关联规则挖掘技术用于乳腺癌分类，包含规则生成、规则剪枝与规则预测三个核心算法，并在多个测试样本上验证了其可行性与性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 乳腺癌是全球女性死亡的重要原因，发病率在各类癌症中居前，早期检测需求迫切。关联规则挖掘因其结果易于被医学专业人员理解，成为研究者青睐的分类方法。

Method: 提出一种新的基于关联规则的乳腺癌分类数据挖掘技术，采用加权分类方法，实现三个核心算法：规则生成（发现频繁项集并生成关联规则）、规则剪枝（依据特定准则剔除规则并按对训练数据的影响分为主要和次要两组）、规则预测（将剪枝后的规则用于测试数据分类）。

Result: 最终预测算法在若干测试样本上进行了实验，展示了该方法的可行性与性能。

Conclusion: 基于加权分类的关联规则挖掘方法可用于乳腺癌分类，其规则形式便于医学专业人员理解，具有实际应用可行性。

Abstract: Breast cancer is a significant contributor to female mortality across the world, displaying one of the highest oc currence rates among the various cancer types. In response to the need for early breast cancer detection, researchers have increasingly turned to association rule-based classification as a favored method. Association Rule mining is a data mining approach which offers the benefit of yielding results that are readily understandable for medical professionals. This paper introduces a novel association rule-based data mining technique for breast cancer classification based on a weighted classification approach. This implementation employs three core algorithms: Rule Generation, Rule Pruning, and Rule Prediction. Rule Generation identifies frequent itemsets and creates association rules. Rule Pruning eliminates rules using specific criteria and separates them into major and minor groups based on their influence on training data. Rule Prediction applies the pruned rules to classify test data. The final prediction algorithm was tested on several testing samples to show the feasibility and performance of the approach.

</details>


### [588] [Four Ways to Grow a Classifier and Why One of Them Cannot Learn](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00180)
*Cagri Temel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在统一协议下考察四种构造式/树结构模型"增长决策"的实际收益，并对其中"零收益"的一种给出精确诊断与修复：将软决策树的每个叶子转为门、两子继承父类分布会使新门梯度恒为零，从而永远无法学习；用小随机扰动子节点即可修复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 构造式分类器在训练过程中不断加结构（树加一层、隐层加单元、叶节点加分裂），但这些增长决策究竟带来什么收益缺乏统一、可比的度量；尤其最自然的"加深软决策树"做法可能毫无收益，需要诊断根因并给出修复方案。

Method: 固定同一实验协议，在树结构与构造式模型上分别评测四类增长决策：(1)将软决策树每个叶子变为门、两子继承父类分布以加深；(2)安装前用残差拟合新隐单元；(3)分裂期望误差最大的叶子；(4)要求统计显著性才允许更表达性分裂。对决策(1)做梯度分析（含门在1/2时的子节点梯度），并用三随机种子五折交叉验证对比从零训练的同深度模型；修复为对子节点施加小幅随机扰动并测试扰动幅度敏感性。

Result: 决策(1)：新门梯度恒为零且两子梯度相同，无法学习；相比同深度从零训练，Iris 低19.6、Wine 低19.1、Digits 低55.6 个准确率点；小幅随机扰动修复有效且幅度影响甚微。决策(2)：每个数据集上都得到更小网络，但不更准，Digits 上显著掉点。决策(3)：获得稀疏性，3.7 次分裂达0.885，而完整深度六树需63次分裂，但在更难问题上掉4.3点。决策(4)：无收益，树更大且更不准。文中所有数值均由测量脚本插入。

Conclusion: 四类增长决策各自"收益"不同：残差拟合换更小网络、最大误差分裂换稀疏性、显著性门槛无收益；而最自然的加深软决策树因一阶信息缺失（非弱而是不存在）完全无效，必须用子节点随机扰动修复。实用规则：新增参数后断言其梯度非零。

Abstract: Constructive classifiers add structure while they train: a level to a tree, a unit to a hidden layer, a split at a leaf. This paper asks what each of four such growth decisions actually buys, measured under one fixed protocol in tree-structured and constructive models, and gives an exact diagnosis and a fix for the one that buys nothing.
  The diagnosis concerns the most natural way to deepen a soft decision tree: turn every leaf into a gate whose two children inherit the parent's class distribution, so that the function is unchanged. I prove that this leaves the gradient of every new gate identically zero and, with the gate at 1/2, gives the two children identical gradients, so the added level can never learn. Unlike the symmetry that Net2Net breaks with noise or the saddle point that splitting steepest descent escapes with second-order information, first-order information here is not weak but absent. Over three seeds of five-fold cross-validation the construction loses 19.6 accuracy points on Iris, 19.1 on Wine and 55.6 on Digits against the same depth trained from scratch. The fix is a small random perturbation of the children, whose size barely matters. The practical rule is one line in a test: after adding parameters, assert that their gradient is nonzero.
  The other three decisions each buy one thing. Fitting a new hidden unit to the residual error before installing it buys a smaller network on every dataset, though not a more accurate one, and on Digits it costs accuracy significantly. Splitting the leaf with the largest expected error buys sparsity, reaching 0.885 with 3.7 splits where a complete depth-six tree uses 63, but loses 4.3 points on a harder problem. Requiring statistical significance before a node receives a more expressive split buys nothing: the tree gets larger and less accurate.
  Every number in the paper is inserted from the measurement script.

</details>


### [589] [Uncertainty-Aware RL-Controlled Adaptive 3D Mapping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00188)
*Alpay Ozkan,Tunc Ozan Aydin,Marc Pollefeys,Jelena Trisovic,Daniel Barath*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出基于语义熵、几何曲率与纹理丰富度的自适应体素细分框架，并用强化学习代理在用户指定内存预算下学习细分策略，实现可控的精度-内存权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 固定分辨率的体素建图存在固有低效：均匀区域浪费内存，复杂区域丢失细节。现有自适应方法（如MAP-ADAPT）依赖几何与用户定义的语义类别列表等启发式规则，需要专家调参、难以泛化到未见物体，且无法显式控制内存使用。

Method: 1）以语义熵（刻画标签不确定性）作为细分依据，并结合几何曲率与纹理丰富度作为场景复杂度线索，实现不依赖语义分类体系的、有原则的分辨率分配；2）引入强化学习代理，在用户指定的目标内存预算下学习体素细分策略，用单一直观控制参数替代手工调参阈值；3）生成多分辨率TSDF表示。

Result: 在合成与真实数据集上，与MAP-ADAPT及固定分辨率基线相比，所提多分辨率TSDF取得更高的几何精度、更好的语义一致性以及更优的内存-精度权衡。

Conclusion: 基于语义熵与多线索的自适应细分结合强化学习内存预算控制，可在无需专家调参和语义分类体系的情况下显式、可控地实现精度与内存的权衡，代码与模型已开源。

Abstract: Voxel-based volumetric mapping is fundamental to 3D reconstruction, yet fixed-resolution grids remain inherently inefficient - wasting memory in uniform regions and losing detail in complex ones. Existing adaptive methods, such as MAP-ADAPT, partially address this by varying resolution based on geometry and user-defined semantic class lists, but these heuristics require expert tuning, lack generalization to unseen objects, and provide no explicit mechanism to control memory usage. We propose an adaptive framework that refines voxels based on semantic entropy, which captures label uncertainty, together with geometric curvature and texture richness as scene complexity cues, yielding principled resolution allocation without reliance on semantic taxonomies. To make the accuracy-memory trade-off explicit and user-controlled, we further introduce a reinforcement learning agent that learns voxel subdivision policies under a user-specified target memory budget, replacing hand-tuned thresholds with a single intuitive control parameter. The resulting multi-resolution TSDF achieves higher geometric accuracy, better semantic consistency, and improved memory-accuracy trade-offs compared to MAP-ADAPT and fixed-resolution baselines on both synthetic and real-world datasets. Our code and models are available at https://github.com/alpayozkan/UnRL.

</details>


### [590] [Energy Time-Series Imputation with Differentially Private Diffusion Models via Clipping-Aware Objective Conditioning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00209)
*Huizhen Huang,Yu Li,Tao Huang,Chen Hou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文针对DP-SGD训练的扩散模型在能源时间序列插补中因ε-预测导致晚期时间步梯度被裁剪的问题，提出时间步感知的目标条件化方法（采用v-预测、静态损失加权与扩散调度感知动态加权），在五个真实数据集多种缺失场景下稳定提升插补效用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 能源时间序列的精细测量含敏感时间信息，在监测与分析中可靠恢复缺失值十分重要。基于DP-SGD训练的扩散模型适合隐私敏感场景，但在余弦扩散调度下，晚期时间步处于低信噪比（SNR）状态，标准ε-预测会产生较大的裁剪前梯度，更容易被裁剪，从而损失有效优化信号。因此需要将"目标-裁剪"交互建模为固定阈值DP-SGD下的目标优化问题。

Method: 将目标-裁剪交互形式化为固定阈值DP-SGD下的目标优化问题，并提出时间步感知的目标条件化：采用v-预测缓解晚期时间步梯度放大；使用静态损失加权作为均匀缩放控制；引入扩散调度感知的动态加权以在裁剪前实现更强衰减。在五个真实能源时间序列数据集上，覆盖随机点缺失、连续块缺失、持续性中断及多种缺失严重程度进行评估。

Result: 在匹配的DP-SGD设置下，所提方法在插补效用上持续优于ε-预测基线。梯度诊断显示：裁剪前梯度范数上尾更低、裁剪比例下降，且在晚期低SNR时间步上衰减更强，验证了裁剪感知目标条件化的有效性。

Conclusion: 通过目标条件化（v-预测与调度感知加权）可有效缓解DP-SGD在低SNR晚期时间步的梯度裁剪问题，提升隐私敏感能源时间序列插补的效用，为扩散模型插补提供了裁剪感知的优化思路。

Abstract: Reliable recovery of missing measurements is important for monitoring and analysis in energy time-series systems, where fine-grained measurements may contain sensitive temporal information. Diffusion models trained with differentially private stochastic gradient descent (DP-SGD) provide a promising framework for privacy-sensitive energy time-series imputation. Under cosine diffusion schedules, late timesteps correspond to low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) conditions, where standard $\varepsilon$-prediction can induce large pre-clipping gradients. Such gradients are more likely to be clipped, reducing the retained optimization signal. The artificial intelligence (AI) contribution lies in formulating this objective--clipping interaction as an objective optimization problem under fixed-threshold DP-SGD and developing timestep-aware objective conditioning for diffusion-based energy time-series imputation. The method adopts $v$-prediction to mitigate late-timestep gradient amplification, uses static loss weighting as a uniform-scaling control, and introduces diffusion-schedule-aware dynamic weighting for stronger attenuation before clipping. For the engineering application, we evaluate the method on five real-world energy time-series datasets across random point missingness, contiguous block missingness, persistent outages, and multiple missing-data severities. Under matched DP-SGD settings, the proposed method consistently improves imputation utility over the $\varepsilon$-prediction baseline. Gradient diagnostics reveal lower upper-tail pre-clipping gradient norms, reduced clipping fractions, and stronger attenuation at late low-SNR timesteps, supporting the effectiveness of clipping-aware objective conditioning for energy time-series imputation.

</details>


### [591] [Redundancy Meets Synergy: Dependency-aware Expert Selection for MoE via Submodular Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00558)
*Zheng Lin,Shaoke Fang,Yuxin Zhang,Jinfeng Xu,Zihan Fang,Zhe Chen,Wei Ni,Jun Luo,Symeon Chatzinotas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出DS-MoE框架，用difference-of-submodular优化替代Top-k启发式，兼顾专家间的冗余与协同，通过定制MM算法选出最优专家子集，性能优于现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE模型通过稀疏激活扩展容量，但内存开销大。抽取紧凑专家子集是可行方案，然而现有选择启发式多依赖Top-k排序，孤立评估单个专家，忽略了MoE门控网络引入的专家间依赖关系。

Method: 作者提出DS-MoE，从损失退化的二阶泰勒展开出发，揭示专家组合中的功能二重性：冗余（表示重叠）与协同（互补误差抵消）。将选择目标建模为difference-of-submodular（DS）函数，从而在数学上解耦冗余削减与协同最大化，并设计带单调性保证的majorization-minimization（MM）算法高效求解最优子集。

Result: 大量实验表明，DS-MoE能有效保留不可或缺的专家组合，性能优于当前最先进的基线方法。

Conclusion: DS-MoE从理论上重新定义专家选择问题，通过DS优化与MM算法克服Top-k的局限，为MoE模型压缩与高效部署提供了有效途径。

Abstract: While Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models effectively scale model capacity through sparse activation, their deployment is often bottlenecked by prohibitive memory requirements. Extracting a compact subset of experts presents a promising solution. However, existing expert selection heuristics predominantly rely on Top-k ranking, which isolates the evaluation of individual experts and ignores the intricate inter-expert dependencies introduced by the MoE gating network. In this paper, we propose DS-MoE, a theoretically grounded framework that redefines expert selection via difference-of-submodular (DS) optimization. By analyzing the second-order Taylor expansion of the loss degradation, we reveal functional duality within expert combinations: redundancy (where experts encode overlapping representations) and synergy (where experts provide complementary error cancellation). To navigate this duality, we mathematically decouple redundancy reduction from synergy maximization by formulating the selection objective as a DS function. Furthermore, we devise a tailored majorization-minimization (MM) algorithm with provable monotonicity guarantees to efficiently identify the optimal expert subset. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DS-MoE effectively preserves indispensable expert combinations, achieving superior performance compared to the state-of-the-art baselines.

</details>


### [592] [Useful to Whom? Sample Value Is Defined Only Relative to the Learner](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00221)
*Yangze Liu,Xiao-Long Yin,Zhongyi Han*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文通过"冻结子集"干预实验证明：核心集选择中"易样本优先"与"几何覆盖"准则之间的交叉边界并非由数据固定决定，而是随目标学习器（容量、输入网格、步幅、架构）而变化，因此选择策略的适宜预算区间必须针对目标学习器进行评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 核心集选择需在预算约束下保留最有用的样本，"易样本优先"与"几何覆盖"在不同预算区间各有优势，二者由交叉边界分隔。作者追问：该边界究竟由数据属性固定，还是随目标学习器而变化。这一问题关系到选择策略能否跨学习器迁移。

Method: 采用受控实验：冻结已选定的样本子集，仅操纵训练学习器。在低分辨率 ImageNet-100 上改变 ResNet-18 宽度；扫描输入网格与模型容量的交互；通过步幅控制在不改变输入网格的前提下复现与反转网格效应；在原生 224px ImageNet-1k 协议下考察宽度效应与不同探针（LFrac、EL2N）；并将卷积学习系统替换为 ViT 进行对比。

Result: 低分辨率 ImageNet-100 上，ResNet-18 宽度翻倍使交叉点从每类 57 个样本移至 85 个样本；扩大输入网格（信息不变）使边界左移，且该左移随宽度增大而减弱；仅移除最后一个下采样步幅即可恢复左移。原生 224px ImageNet-1k 下宽度效应较小且依赖探针：LFrac 近乎持平，EL2N 略微右移。改用 ViT 后，在测量范围内覆盖准则始终占优，即使易样本子集来自卷积代理模型。

Conclusion: 结果通过冻结子集干预确立了核心集选择边界的"学习器依赖性"，并指出可移动该边界的网络结构因素（宽度、输入网格、步幅、架构）。研究未给出普适缩放律，其实际含义明确：选择策略偏好的预算区间必须针对目标学习器加以评估。

Abstract: What kind of data does a model need in order to learn? Coreset selection makes this question concrete: under a budget, keep the samples most useful for training. Easy-first and geometric coverage criteria can win in different budget regimes, separated by a crossover boundary. We ask whether this boundary is fixed by the data or changes with the target learner. Controlled experiments freeze the selected subsets and manipulate only the training learner. On low-resolution ImageNet-100, doubling ResNet-18's width moves the crossover from 57 to 85 samples per class: the learner changes the relative value of the same samples. A wider sweep reveals an interaction between input grid and capacity. Enlarging the grid while retaining the same image information shifts the boundary left, and this shift weakens as width increases. Stride controls reproduce and reverse the grid effect without changing the input grid; removing only the last downsampling stride is sufficient to recover the leftward shift. Under the native-224px ImageNet-1k protocol, width effects are smaller and depend on the probe: LFrac remains nearly flat, while EL2N shifts modestly right. Swapping the convolutional learning system for a ViT makes coverage win throughout the measured range, even when the easy subsets come from the convolutional proxy. These results establish learner dependence through frozen-subset interventions and identify network structure that can move the boundary. They do not yield a universal scaling law. Their practical implication is direct: a selection strategy's preferred budget regime must be evaluated with respect to the target learner.

</details>


### [593] [Constant-Memory Recall: Learned Associations in a Fixed Matrix State](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00232)
*Samuel Larson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究测试了一种小型DeltaNet变体（固定token特定key偏置）的记忆能力：在32 KiB循环矩阵状态下，对每条序列32个新键值对进行回忆，三训练种子平均准确率达99.95%，填充至1,798 token仍保持近乎完美；但参数匹配的向量与Transformer基线仍接近随机水平，导致无法进行内存效率对比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 固定容量循环记忆限制了推理阶段的存储增长，但其成功回忆依赖于具体任务与训练方式。作者希望探究在受控任务下，小规模循环模型能否在固定状态预算内实现高精度回忆，并评估其相对基线的内存效率。

Method: 使用带固定token特定key偏置的小型DeltaNet变体，训练其在每条序列中记住32个新的键值配对。模型循环矩阵状态为32 KiB。评估指标为在序列内候选值中选择正确答案的平均准确率，覆盖三个训练种子；通过在查询前添充填充内容将上下文扩展至1,798 token但不增加配对数进行测试；另进行48配对探索性测试；并将参数匹配的向量基线与Transformer基线纳入比较，后者还进行了额外训练搜索。

Result: 32 KiB循环矩阵状态下，三训练种子平均准确率为99.95%；填充使查询前上下文扩展到1,798 token时回忆仍近乎完美。将第一个记忆块置零后该回忆能力消失。48配对探索性测试在消耗主要训练预算四分之一后仍接近随机水平，未找到容量上限。参数匹配的向量与Transformer基线均接近随机水平，包括经过额外训练搜索的Transformer。

Conclusion: 小型DeltaNet变体在固定32 KiB循环状态下对32个键值配对展现出近乎完美的回忆能力，并具备对长填充上下文的鲁棒性，且该能力依赖第一个记忆块。然而，基线未解决的失败阻碍了内存效率比较，48配对结果也未定位容量边界，因此容量与效率结论仍待进一步研究。

Abstract: Fixed-size recurrent memory limits storage growth during inference, but successful recall depends on the task and training. We study a small DeltaNet variant with fixed token-specific key biases, trained to remember 32 new key-value pairings per sequence. With 32 KiB of recurrent matrix state, it achieves 99.95% mean accuracy across three training seeds when choosing among the sequence's values. Recall remains near perfect when filler extends the pre-query context to 1,798 tokens without adding pairings. Zeroing the first memory block removes this recall. An exploratory 48-pair test remains near chance after one quarter of the primary training budget and does not locate a capacity limit. Parameter-matched vector and Transformer baselines remain near chance, including the Transformer after additional training searches. This unresolved baseline failure prevents a memory-efficiency comparison.

</details>


### [594] [How Many Categories Are Enough? Distribution-Free Certification Limits for Few-Shot Anomaly Thresholds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00236)
*Gia Huy Thai,Nguyen Thai Anh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 少样本异常检测的部署需要受控误报率的报警阈值；本文证明仅用目标图像的LOIO校准受分辨率与分布漂移限制，并给出类别计数可行性下界，提出CRESS协议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有少样本异常检测器多以排序指标评价，但实际部署需要一个误报率受控的报警阈值。核心问题是：对未见类别，需要多少正常证据（图像单元或类别单元）才能认证这样一个阈值。

Method: 在15个MVTec与12个VisA类别、四类损坏下使用冻结DINOv2 + PCA残差排序器；先分析目标域留一图像(LOIO)校准，再推导类别计数可行性计算，最后提出CRESS协议，将源类别划分为参考、提议与认证三种互不相交角色。

Result: LOIO校准受分辨率限制（秩值不低于1/(k+1)）且对漂移脆弱：在α=0.20、k=4、高斯损坏MVTec上实测FAR达0.341，为标称值的1.7倍。理论下界表明，任意确定性、一致有效、无分布假设的95%上置信界在α=0.20/0.10/0.05时至少需14/29/59个iid类别抽样，且为必要非充分条件。CRESS在3–4个认证类别下，全部960个冻结配置均返回fail-closed阈值τ*=0，最小类别级UCB为0.950；图像单元分析在36.7%–60.3%的目标单元上选出正阈值。

Conclusion: 本文给出定量可行性边界与估计目标感知(estimand-aware)的协议，明确了源域证据在何种条件下能够、以及在何种条件下不能支撑可迁移的可靠性声明。

Abstract: Few-shot anomaly detectors are judged by ranking metrics, yet deployment requires an alarm threshold with a controlled false-alarm rate (FAR). We ask how much normal evidence, in images or category units, is needed to certify such a threshold for an unseen category. Using a frozen DINOv2 principal component analysis (PCA) residual ranker on 15 MVTec and 12 VisA categories under four corruption types, we show that target-only leave-one-image-out (LOIO) calibration is resolution-limited and shift-fragile: rank values cannot fall below $1/(k+1)$, and at the attainable level $α=0.20$, empirical FAR reaches 0.341 on Gaussian-corrupted MVTec at $k=4$, 1.7 times the nominal level. A category-count feasibility calculus is then derived: even with all-zero category losses and no multiplicity charged, any deterministic, uniformly valid, distribution-free 95% upper confidence bound (UCB) requires at least 14, 29, and 59 independent and identically distributed (iid) category draws at $α=0.20$, $0.10$, and $0.05$; these counts are necessary but not sufficient. The Cross-category Reliability Estimation with Source Support (CRESS) protocol splits source categories into disjoint reference, proposal, and certification roles. With only three or four certification categories, all 960 frozen configurations return the fail-closed threshold $τ^\star=0$, and the smallest category-level UCB is 0.950. Image-unit analyses of the same archive select positive thresholds in 36.7% to 60.3% of target cells; these bounds hold for the selected source mixture, not for the marginal risk of a new-category draw. The contribution is a quantitative feasibility boundary and an estimand-aware protocol specifying when source evidence can, and cannot, support a transferable reliability claim.

</details>


### [595] [Contingent Exposure Routing for Financial AI: Outage Risk and the Cost of Indivisible Decisions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00239)
*Shivam Gupta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文研究故障转移（failover）虽恢复可用性却改变金融机构间决策误差共享结构的问题，通过局部市场冲击响应矩阵建模"中断情境下的路由"，并以期望平方价格位移为风险度量。理论上给出对称构造下共享备份导致订单量级集中下界、平衡回退风险随幸存端点递减的结论；对不可分决策推导独立随机路由的精确二阶矩与有效暴露粒度。实验在60个合成组合网络、11340次情景评估中，交换式路由在单个/双端点移除下分别降低风险6.57%与10.53%；对1024条API响应的重放显示3.30%的留出下降（bootstrap区间2.07–4.57%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 故障转移机制在恢复系统可用性的同时，会重新分配哪些金融机构共担决策误差，从而改变相关性风险。现有工作多关注可用性，缺乏对"故障情境下路由"所引致的集中度与分散化收益的可审计刻画。

Method: 以局部市场冲击响应矩阵刻画中断情境下的路由决策，以期望平方价格位移为风险目标。采用对称构造证明集中度下界与平衡回退的递减律；对不可分决策推导独立随机路由的精确二阶矩及有效暴露粒度；提出条件期望取整得到无耦合配额约束的有限代理界，并设计保持端点计数的交换过程，与对偶下界对比。

Result: 对称构造显示：共享备份在主要端点数量增长时可保留一阶集中度下界，而平衡回退风险与幸存端点数量成反比。实验在60个合成组合网络、11340次情景评估中，交换过程在中心反馈设置、独立误差下，对单端点和双端点移除分别将风险降低6.57%与10.53%。对1024条记录API响应在构造的再平衡任务上重放，留出集下降较小，为3.30%（配对bootstrap区间2.07–4.57%）。误差强对齐、较劣端点及不可分性会限制分散化收益。

Conclusion: 本文贡献是一套可审计的路由压力测试与实现分析，而非对真实市场崩盘概率的估计。路由分散化的有效性取决于误差相关性、端点质量与可分性。

Abstract: Model failover restores availability, but changes which financial institutions share decision errors. We formulate outage-contingent routing through a local market-impact response matrix and study expected squared price displacement. A symmetric construction shows that a shared backup can leave an order-one concentration floor as the number of primary endpoints grows, while balanced fallback risk decreases inversely with the surviving endpoint count. For indivisible decisions, we derive the exact second moment of independent randomized routing and an effective-exposure granularity that determines its gap from fractional allocation. Conditional-expectation rounding gives a finite-agent bound without coupled quotas; a separate swap procedure preserves endpoint counts and is assessed against dual lower bounds. Across 60 synthetic portfolio networks and 11,340 scenario evaluations, the latter reduces risk by 6.57% and 10.53% for single and double endpoint removals at the central feedback setting with independent errors. A replay of 1,024 recorded API responses on constructed rebalancing tasks gives a smaller held-out reduction of 3.30% (paired bootstrap interval 2.07--4.57%). Strongly aligned errors, inferior endpoints, and indivisibility limit diversification. The contribution is an auditable routing stress test and implementation analysis, not an estimate of real-market crash probabilities.

</details>


### [596] [The Null Is the Hard Part: Exact Tests for Memorization in Generative Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00251)
*Sushovan Majhi,Pramita Bagchi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 生成模型记忆化审计缺乏零假设校准，导致误报严重；本文提出两种零假设（置换检验与匹配对照校准），并推荐以IECP小尺度质量作为统计量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有记忆化审计直接将相似度分数与阈值比较，缺乏零分布，结论可能有误：如MemBench的缓解措施被误判为近乎减半记忆化，数据复制测试在其自身零假设下把24个生成器中的10个误标为复制。核心难点在于为记忆化构建合适的零假设。

Method: 提出两类零假设：(1)整体模型层面，给定模型样本时训练图与留出图可交换，重标即置换检验，在留出图为随机划分时对任意统计量精确；(2)单图层面，用匹配对照（matched controls）校准，替代随机图排序与独立生成重采样两种失效的零假设。推荐统计量为受限尺度的近重复度量：Intersection Euler Characteristic Profile的小尺度质量，并用校准最大值捕捉偶发而非典型的复制。

Result: 在置换检验下，最近邻偏好仍在24个生成器中7个上触发，而受限近重复计数为0（McNemar p=0.016）；单图零假设失效导致2,365个对照中596个误发现，独立重采样使零假设过窄3倍；按匹配对照校准，61张MemBench图像中36张在5% FDR下被认证，留出对照仅在0.01%校准划分中被认证，每图两次生成即可恢复该计数；校准最大值认证46张。

Conclusion: 记忆化审计的难点在于零假设，而非统计量阈值；正确的零假设使原本"通过"的缓解措施与"复制"的生成器大幅减少。推荐使用IECP小尺度质量作为受限尺度统计量，它同时能计数被复制的不同图像并检验两模型是否复制相同图像。

Abstract: Memorization audits of generative models read similarity scores against thresholds, with no null distribution, and the conclusions they support can be wrong. By MemBench's rule, the benchmark's mitigations roughly halve Stable Diffusion's memorization; audited with false-discovery control, two thirds of the certified images are no longer detected under random prompt perturbations, five sixths under attention rescaling, and all of them under embedding optimization. The field's data-copying test, read against its own null, flags ten of twenty-four generators that reproduce nothing. We argue that for memorization the null is the hard part, and supply two. For a whole model, training and held-out images are exchangeable given its samples, and relabelling them is a permutation test, exact for any statistic when the held-out images are a random split; under it, a nearest-neighbour preference still fires on seven of those twenty-four, and a count restricted to the near-duplicate scale on none (McNemar p=0.016). For single images, the natural nulls fail twice, measurably: ranking an image among random images yields 596 false discoveries among 2,365 controls, and resampling independent generations makes the null three times too narrow. Calibrated against matched controls, the audit certifies 36 of 61 MemBench images at 5% false-discovery rate, held-out controls are certified in 0.01% of calibration splits, and on this benchmark two generations per image recover that count. A calibrated maximum, which reads occasional rather than typical copying, certifies 46. As the scale-restricted statistic we recommend the small-scale mass of the Intersection Euler Characteristic Profile, which also counts distinct images copied and tests whether two models copy the same ones.

</details>


### [597] [Sharp Oracle-Regret Tradeoffs for Projection-Free Online Convex Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00254)
*Vaneet Aggarwal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文刻画了在线凸优化中，当可行域访问仅能通过精确线性优化预言机实现时的可达遗憾。在凸且 G-Lipschitz 损失、直径上界 D、总预言机调用预算 Q、每轮严格调用上限 B 的设定下，无维度依赖的极小极大期望遗憾为 Θ(GD max{√T, T/(1+min{Q,BT})^{1/4}})。下界适用于任意随机化学习器；上界由一种带交错分块的计数近似梯度方法达到。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究动机在于许多实际场景中学习者无法自由访问或投影到可行域，只能通过线性优化预言机获取反馈。已有在线凸优化结果通常假设可以任意访问可行集，因此需要刻画在精确线性优化预言机受限（总调用数 Q 与每轮调用数 B 受限）条件下，遗憾的最优可达速率，并揭示总预算约束与严格每轮约束对学习能力的本质影响。

Method: 方法上，首先利用通用可行性条件证明每个动作必须落在给定内切球与前序预言机回复的凸包内。随后构造固定体下界：将新阶段方向与共享单纯形耦合，使得即便所有损失共享同一极小值点，有用回复仍会反复付出高代价，从而对任意随机化学习器给出下界。上界方面采用计数的近似梯度方法，并通过交错分块控制预言机调用，匹配下界速率；同时分析总预算与严格每轮预算作为特例，并在给定光滑度 β 时给出曲率相关的解析构造与下界，确定一般刻画保持紧致的阈值。

Result: 主要结果为无维度依赖的极小极大期望遗憾精确刻画：Θ(GD max{√T, T/(1+min{Q,BT})^{1/4}})。下界对任意随机化学习器成立，上界由交错分块的计数近似梯度法达到。由此得到特例：每轮仅一次调用时遗憾率为 T^{3/4}；要达到 √T 遗憾则需要二次量级的总预算。对于给定光滑度 β，解析构造给出曲率相关的下界，并识别出一般刻画仍保持 sharp 的阈值。

Conclusion: 结论是，当可行域仅能通过精确线性优化预言机访问时，在线凸优化的遗憾由总调用预算 Q 与每轮调用上限 B 共同决定，而非仅由总预算决定；每轮调用限制会显著影响最优速率。该刻画统一了总预算与严格每轮预算两种设定，并明确了在光滑情形下一般结果保持最优的曲率阈值，为受限预言机下的在线学习提供了完整的最优性边界。

Abstract: We characterize the regret attainable in online convex optimization when access to the feasible set is limited to an exact linear optimization oracle. The learner is given an inscribed ball and a diameter bound and must remain feasible on every consistent instance. For convex $G$-Lipschitz losses, diameter at most $D$, a total allowance of $Q$ oracle calls, and a strict limit of $B$ calls per round, the dimension-free minimax expected regret is $Θ(GD\max\{\sqrt T,T/(1+\min\{Q,BT\})^{1/4}\})$. The lower bound applies to arbitrary randomized learners. Universal feasibility first forces each action into the hull of the supplied ball and the preceding oracle replies. A fixed-body construction then couples fresh phase directions to a shared simplex, making useful replies costly repeatedly even though all losses have a common minimizer.
