Existing methods either fine-tune TSFMs for each target domain, incurring additional costs and offering limited transferability across backbones, or append retrieved series without verifying whether they support the current forecast. The key challenges are conflicting residual evidence from neighboring series and residual patterns that vary across TSFMs and forecasting tasks. We formulate test-time neighborhood scaling: using same-domain neighbor evidence without modifying the backbone. We propose RACE (Residual-Aware Correction of Forecasting Errors), a two-stage framework for using historical neighbors. We first retrieve query-compatible neighbors, align their residuals to the query scale, and aggregate coherent evidence into the training-free RACE-TF correction. Full RACE then uses a lightweight, domain-specific Gate to determine when applying the correction is beneficial, with a reusable training workflow across TSFM backbones. Across four TSFMs, RACE improves all three domain-aggregate metrics on both primary domains, with the largest gains on high-error queries. Within each domain, a Gate trained on one TSFM transfers to other backbones without adaptation, and the resulting pipeline improves all 72 cross-backbone metric comparisons over the matched frozen targets.

</details>


### [631] [VANDAM: Viewing a nucleotide sequence with DNA molecular priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00411)
*Jeremy Levy,Ariel Larey,Yury Nahshan,Raizy Kellerman,Elay Dahan,Amit Bleiweiss,Guy Leib,Omri Nayshool,Dan Ofer,Tal Zinger,Dan Dominissini,Gideon Rechavi,Marissa Wirth,Simon Lee,Dung Hoang,Noam D. Beckmann,Shane O'Connell,Nicole Bussola,Alexander W. Charney,Yoli Shavit,Nati Daniel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: VANDAM 通过将DNA分子先验（区域分子性质预测与局部分子特征注入）引入基因组基础模型的预训练目标，在四类架构、九个下游基因组任务上稳定提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基因组基础模型（GFM）采用"DNA即字符串"的范式，仅用掩码token预测目标进行预训练，未显式建模对生物功能至关重要的生化、结构与物理性质。作者认为，许多分子性质可由序列借助已有生物物理模型估计，因此其价值不在于提供独立模态，而在于作为先验被训练目标显式利用。

Method: 提出VANDAM框架，在GFM训练中扩展DNA分子先验：在自监督训练中，从池化表示（pooled representations）预测区域分子性质；当存在功能标签且该标签可奖励保留分子先验时，额外在输入层注入局部特征（local features）。

Result: VANDAM在四种架构家族和九个留出基因组任务上一致提升下游性能，且与基于token的目标互补。探针（probing）实验进一步表明，分子先验的使用可泛化到其他未见的分子性质。

Conclusion: 将分子先验显式融入预训练目标，是对token级目标的有效补充，能提升GFM的下游表现并具备对未见分子性质的泛化能力，为超越"DNA即字符串"范式提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Contemporary Genomic Foundation Models (GFMs) rely on a DNA-as-a-string paradigm that employs masked token prediction objectives for pretraining. However, this abstraction does not explicitly model the biochemical, structural, and physical properties essential to biological function. Many molecular properties can be estimated from sequence using established biophysical models, so their utility lies not in providing an independent modality, but in introducing priors that training objectives can explicitly exploit. We introduce VANDAM, a framework that extends the training of GFMs with DNA molecular priors. In self-supervised training, VANDAM predicts regional molecular properties from pooled representations. When functional labels are available and can reward retaining molecular priors, local features are additionally injected at the input. VANDAM consistently improves downstream performance across four architecture families and nine held-out genomic tasks by complementing token-based objectives. Probing experiments further demonstrate that the use of molecular priors generalizes to other unseen molecular properties.

</details>


### [632] [EchoPress: Query-Agnostic KV Cache Pruning via Virtual Context Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00412)
*Jiawei Lin,Saibo Geng,Thomas Bourgeat*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: EchoPress 是一种免训练的 KV cache 剪枝方法，利用标准 prefill 阶段已计算的 query 和 key 来近似 KVzip 的重建注意力分数，仅需重建首个 chunk 进行校准，在 50%-90% 驱逐率下精度媲美 KVzip，同时大幅降低压缩开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文推理中 KV cache 内存占用大，KVzip 通过逐块重建上下文估计重要性可获得良好压缩质量，但需额外前向传播；已有学习式近似方法虽降低开销却依赖模型特定训练，缺乏通用性。

Method: 分析 KVzip 如何识别重要缓存信息，并证明其重建分数可用 prefill 阶段已计算的信息近似；据此提出 EchoPress，一种免训练方法，用标准 prefill 的 query 和 key 近似重建注意力，且每个请求仅重建首个 chunk 来校准其余上下文的重要性分数。

Result: 在 LongBench 和 RULER 上，使用 Qwen3-8B 与 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct，EchoPress 在 50%-90% 驱逐率下任务精度与 KVzip 相当，压缩开销降低 1.7-19.6 倍，总 prefill 时间最多降低 2.9 倍。

Conclusion: EchoPress 表明无需模型特定训练即可高效近似 KVzip 的重要性估计，在保持精度同时显著降低压缩与 prefill 开销，为长上下文推理提供实用的 KV cache 剪枝方案。

Abstract: KV cache pruning reduces long-context inference memory usage by evicting less important key-value pairs. KVzip estimates importance through context reconstruction: prompting a model to repeat the context chunk by chunk. This achieves strong compression quality at the cost of additional forward passes. Learned approximations reduce this cost but require model-specific training. We analyze how KVzip identifies important cached information and show how to approximate its reconstruction scores using information already computed during prefill. These findings motivate EchoPress, a training-free method that approximates reconstruction attention using queries and keys from standard prefill. For each request, it reconstructs only the first chunk to calibrate importance scores for the remaining context. Experiments on LongBench and RULER with Qwen3-8B and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct show that EchoPress matches KVzip in task accuracy across eviction ratios from 50% to 90%, while reducing compression overhead by a factor of 1.7-19.6 and total prefill time by a factor of up to 2.9. Code is available at https://github.com/ljwljwljwljw/kvpress/tree/echo-press.

</details>


### [633] [Do Better Scores Mean Better Physics? Physics-Grounded Explanations for Sim2Real Neural Operators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00415)
*Somyajit Chakraborty,Xizhong Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在NACA4418翼型绕流中，神经算子预测误差与物理相关流动统计量误差并不一致，建议在聚合评分之外补充物理诊断指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习代理模型能加速物理仿真，但更低的预测误差未必对应更低的物理相关流动统计量误差，需检验这一脱节现象。

Method: 结合CFD仿真与PIV实验测量，采用保均值输入干预（从观测流场历史中去除选定区域的脉动速度），在四种神经算子上开展敏感性对比测试，并实施输出衰减压力测试。

Result: 去除能量最强10%有效观测单元脉动比等面积随机去除对预测影响更大（但掩码未按去除脉动能量匹配，故仅测敏感性）；CNO速度场误差更低，却在两个分析子集上波动能误差显著更高；输出衰减测试亦显示基准误差与域求和脉动能不一致。

Conclusion: 单基准结果无法确立反事实物理正确性，应同时报告互补的物理诊断指标，而非仅依赖聚合预测分数。

Abstract: Machine-learning surrogates accelerate physical simulation, but lower prediction error need not coincide with lower error in physically relevant flow statistics. We examine this question for flow around a NACA4418 airfoil using paired computational-fluid-dynamics simulations and experimental particle-image-velocimetry measurements. A mean-preserving input intervention removes velocity fluctuations from selected regions of observed flow histories. Across four neural operators, removing fluctuations from the most energetic 10% of valid observed cells changes forecasts more than equal-area random removal. Because the masks are not matched for removed fluctuation energy, this contrast measures sensitivity, not independent evidence of physical importance. Separately, a CNO has lower velocity-field error but substantially higher two-component fluctuation-energy error than the reference on both analysis subsets. An output attenuation stress test also demonstrates disagreement between benchmark errors and domain-summed fluctuation energy. These single-benchmark results motivate reporting complementary physical diagnostics alongside aggregate prediction scores; they do not establish counterfactual physical correctness.

</details>


### [634] [Source Identification Is Not Fitness Testing: Measuring the Limits of Synthetic-Data Attribution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00417)
*Joss Armstrong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在金融风险文本上验证生成数据来源可追溯性（改写后识别率从98.7%降至53.1%/29.0%），并比较两种样本选择规则，发现来源识别与训练数据筛选是两个不同问题，且来源分数与代理指标均未稳定改善递归训练退化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模型在自生成数据上反复训练会导致后续模型性能退化，因此希望借助数据来源（provenance）信息决定复用哪些生成样本。为此需检验两个前提：来源信息能否可靠恢复，以及它是否有助于识别更优训练数据。

Method: 以金融风险文本为对象，先对生成段落进行生成器归因，再在改写（paraphrase、style rewriting）后重复测试；同时设置生成-人类文本检测对照。随后在三轮“生成-再训练”循环中比较两种样本选择规则：一种基于来源信息，另一种基于独立参考模型的评分。

Result: 生成器归因在原始段落上准确率为98.7%，改写后降至53.1%（paraphrase）和29.0%（style rewriting）；生成-人类检测在所测人类对照集上接近完美。两种选择规则选出的样本不同，但计划中的比较未检测到结果模型退化程度存在稳定差异。

Conclusion: 识别数据来源与识别哪些数据对训练有用是两个相互独立的问题。实验将来源身份、面向准则的选择与递归训练结果三者分离：来源分数与所检验的准则型代理指标均不足以确定未来递归行为。

Abstract: Repeated training on model-generated data can degrade later models. One possible response is to use provenance when deciding which generated examples to reuse. We test both how reliably that provenance can be recovered and whether it helps identify better training data. Using financial-risk text, we first identify the source of generated passages and then repeat the test after rewriting them. Generator attribution is 98.7% accurate on the original passages but falls to 53.1% after paraphrasing and 29.0% after style rewriting. Generated-versus-human detection remains close to perfect against the tested human comparison set. We then compare two ways of selecting generated examples over three rounds of generation and retraining. One uses source information. The other uses a score from a separate reference model. The two rules select different examples, but the planned comparison does not detect a stable difference in the degradation of the resulting models. The results show that identifying where data came from and identifying which data are useful for training are separate problems. The experiment therefore separates source identity, criterion-facing selection, and recursive training outcome: neither the provenance score nor the tested criterion-facing proxy is established as sufficient for future recursive behaviour.

</details>


### [635] [CommunityKV: Efficient Long-Context Decoding via Graph Partitioning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00418)
*Joe McKenna,Anastasios Alexandridis,Nathan Susanj,Jing Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CommunityKV将稀疏注意力建模为社区检测问题，在预填充阶段利用已算出的QK^T构建token图并划分社区，通过常数时间的局部更新规则支持流式解码，在Qwen3和Llama-3.1上实现最高1.71倍的生成吞吐提升且精度相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文Transformer受限于自注意力的二次成本和KV缓存内存传输的线性增长。现有稀疏注意力方法要么需要大规模训练，要么在免训练场景下依赖语义粗糙的启发式规则或难以在解码中高效更新的昂贵聚类。

Method: CommunityKV把稀疏注意力表述为社区检测问题：从标准预填充中已计算的QK^T分数构建token图，将图划分为社区以检索语义连贯的token组；并提出局部更新规则，以常数时间将新生成token分配到社区，从而在流式解码全过程实现稀疏检索而无需全局重划分。支持每查询头一图，以及查询组图聚合两种配置。

Result: 在Qwen3和Llama-3.1模型、三个长上下文基准上评估。单查询头一图配置下，端到端生成吞吐最高为稠密注意力的1.25倍；查询组图聚合配置下最高达1.71倍，且精度相当。

Conclusion: CommunityKV表明社区检测可作为免训练稀疏注意力的有效框架，通过复用预填充阶段已有分数并采用常数时间局部更新，避免了全局重划分开销，在保持精度的同时显著提升长上下文生成的效率。

Abstract: Scaling Transformers to long contexts is constrained by the quadratic cost of self-attention and the linear growth of key-value cache memory transfer. Sparse attention mitigates this by retrieving only relevant tokens, but current approaches either require large-scale training or, within the training-free regime, rely on semantically coarse heuristics or expensive clustering that is difficult to update efficiently during decoding. We introduce CommunityKV, a framework that formulates sparse attention as a community detection problem. CommunityKV constructs a token graph from the $QK^T$ scores already computed during standard prefill, and partitions the graph into communities to enable retrieval of semantically coherent token groups. A local update rule assigns newly generated tokens to communities in constant time, enabling sparse retrieval throughout streaming decoding without global re-partitioning. We evaluate CommunityKV on Qwen3 and Llama-3.1 models across three long-context benchmarks. With one graph per query head, CommunityKV delivers up to $1.25\times$ the end-to-end generation throughput of dense attention, while query-group graph aggregation yields up to $1.71\times$ with comparable accuracy.

</details>


### [636] [The Life Cycle of a Massive Activation: Stochastic Birth, Weight-Decay-Driven Growth, and Competitive Consolidation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00423)
*S. Aaron McClendon,Jorge Gallego-Feliciano,Antonios Saravanos*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究Transformer中"巨幅激活"(massive activations)在训练过程中的规模调控机制，发现权重衰减(weight decay)因果性地控制全局激活规模的变化与达峰，并建立AdamW预条件增长与权重衰减相抗衡的平衡模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 巨幅激活是与注意力汇(attention sinks)相关的残差流坐标，其幅值远超常规激活，但其规模在训练中如何被调控尚不清楚，因此需要追踪其出现、增长与固化过程并识别调控因素。

Method: 结合训练轨迹分析与受控干预：(1)追踪不同随机种子下携带汇的通道演化；(2)进行消融实验，考察梯度衰减与汇token集合RMS幅值的关系；(3)在受控续训中移除或保留权重衰减；(4)构建AdamW预条件增长对抗权重衰减的平衡模型，并扫描衰减系数λ。

Result: 携带汇的通道随随机种子变化但在单次训练早期即稳定；长程训练中周围通道侵蚀、汇向少数冗余载体集中；梯度衰减随汇token的集体RMS幅值而非单一通道变化；移除衰减使规模持续上升，保留衰减则即使学习率恒定也会下降；扫描λ显示峰值时间近似对数线性移动，峰值幅值近似按λ^{-1/2}缩放，与平衡模型一致；预条件能维持大通道队列抵抗衰减。

Conclusion: 研究将巨幅激活的生命周期与规模调控的训练动态联系起来，确立权重衰减作为训练时调控激活幅值的杠杆。

Abstract: Massive activations, residual-stream coordinates with magnitudes far larger than typical activations, are associated with attention sinks in transformers, but how their scale is regulated during training remains incompletely understood. Combining training-trajectory analyses and controlled interventions, we trace their emergence, growth, and consolidation. Sink-carrying channels vary across random seeds but stabilize early within each run. Over longer training, surrounding channels erode and the sink concentrates onto a few redundant carriers. Across ablations, gradient attenuation follows the sink token's collective root-mean-square magnitude rather than any single channel, making collective scale central to understanding their effects. Our central result is that weight decay causally controls the turnover of global activation scale. In controlled continuations, removing decay near the peak allows this scale to keep rising, whereas retaining it produces decline even at constant learning rate. We develop a balance model for the rise and peak of massive-activation magnitude, in which AdamW-preconditioned growth opposes weight decay. Sweeping the decay coefficient $λ$ shifts peak timing approximately log-linearly and yields peak magnitudes scaling approximately as $λ^{-1/2}$, consistent with this balance. Optimizer measurements further show that preconditioning sustains the large-channel cohort against decay even when raw maintaining forces are too small to do so. Together, these findings connect the observed life cycle to scale-regulating training dynamics and establish weight decay as a training-time lever on activation magnitude.

</details>


### [637] [IrekoGPT: Turning Structured Pruning into Post-Hoc Slimmable LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00426)
*Pietro Moriello,Pietro Buzzega,Angelo Porrello,Simone Calderara*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: IrekoGPT 是一种事后方法，可将预训练 LLM 转换为推理时可调宽度的 slimmmable 模型：基于 SliceGPT 保留投影矩阵不剪枝，从而在单一模型中暴露不同宽度的嵌套子网络，并通过多压缩比逐层校准与无梯度岭回归修正下游线性层。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有剪枝/压缩方法通常生成固定宽度的模型，难以在推理阶段灵活调整计算量；SliceGPT 类方法对投影矩阵的剪枝也损失了宽度可调性。作者希望以低成本的事后改造方式，使单一预训练模型能在不同压缩比下复用同一组参数。

Method: 以 SliceGPT 为基础，保留其投影矩阵而不做剪枝，使同一模型可暴露不同宽度的嵌套子网络；对每一层在多个压缩比下进行校准以提升鲁棒性；对下游线性层使用无梯度的岭回归进行参数修正。

Result: 在 Llama 与 Qwen 系列模型上，初步结果显示其性能优于朴素 PCA 剪枝方案，且在高压缩比设置下提升最为明显。代码已开源：https://github.com/aimagelab/IrekoGPT

Conclusion: IrekoGPT 提供了一种无需重训练即可获得宽度可调 LLM 的事后框架，通过保留投影矩阵、多层多压缩比校准与岭回归修正，在 Llama/Qwen 上验证了优于朴素 PCA 剪枝的效果，尤其适合高压缩场景。

Abstract: We introduce IrekoGPT, a post-hoc method for converting pretrained LLMs into slimmable models whose width can be adjusted at inference time. Building on SliceGPT, we retain its projection matrices without pruning them, allowing a single model to expose nested subnetworks at different widths. We improve robustness by calibrating each layer across multiple compression ratios, and correct downstream linear layers through gradient-free ridge regression. Across Llama and Qwen models, preliminary results show improvements over naive PCA-based slimming, with the largest gains at high compression. Code is available at https://github.com/aimagelab/IrekoGPT

</details>


### [638] [SAGE: Similarity-Based Cleaning of Poisoned Training Data from Verified Examples](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01788)
*Chaeeun Han,Soodeh Atefi,Yevgeniy Vorobeychik,Aron Laszka*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SAGE方法，仅依赖少量经过专家验证的干净与投毒样本（ground-truth），结合在独立数据集上训练的通用特征提取器和非参数相似度加权预测，检测训练数据中的clean-label投毒样本，在七个基准攻击上取得显著优于现有防御的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习日益依赖公开且不可信的数据源，投毒攻击（尤其在clean-label场景下投毒样本与干净样本视觉上无法区分）威胁增大。现有防御要么假设对哪些样本被投毒零ground-truth信息，要么假设可获得大量已验证干净样本，而后者验证成本高昂且不切实际。因此需要一种仅依赖少量经验证样本（clean与poisoned均可）的实用防御方案。

Method: 提出Similarity-based Approach for Ground-truth-driven Exclusion（SAGE）。首先在一个独立数据集上训练通用特征提取器，避免在小规模验证集上过拟合；然后基于少量经取证专家验证的样本（含clean与poisoned），采用非参数的相似度加权预测对训练样本进行标记，识别并排除投毒样本。

Result: 在标准基准上针对七种clean-label攻击方法进行评估，结果表明：即使只有少量已验证的投毒样本，也能带来显著的防御优势；同时发现验证集中干净样本在不同类别间的分布，比验证样本的数量更为重要。

Conclusion: 依赖少量经验证样本（而非大量已验证干净数据）是可行且有效的投毒防御路径。SAGE通过独立训练特征提取器与非参数相似度加权预测，克服了小验证集易过拟合的问题。验证样本的类别覆盖均衡性对防御效果起关键作用。

Abstract: As machine learning increasingly relies on public, untrusted data sources, data poisoning attacks, which inject malicious examples into training data to induce misclassification of a chosen target, pose a growing threat. Existing defenses either assume zero ground-truth information about which examples are poisoned, or they assume access to a large set of examples verified to be clean. Satisfying the latter assumption incurs significant cost since reliable verification can be very resource- or labor-intensive. This cost is particularly high for clean-label attacks, where poisoned examples are visually indistinguishable from clean data. Since requiring a large set of verified examples is impractical, we propose relying on a small set of verified examples including both clean and poisoned ones, i.e., each example verified either to be clean or poisoned through inspection by a forensic expert. The challenge is then to detect poisons based on a set of verified examples that is so small that most classification models would overfit. To address this challenge, we propose Similarity-based Approach for Ground-truth-driven Exclusion (SAGE), which trains a generic feature extractor on a separate dataset and then flags poisoned training examples using a non-parametric, similarity-weighted prediction based on the verified set. On standard benchmarks against seven clean-label attack methods, we demonstrate that having access to even a handful of verified poisoned examples provides a substantial advantage. We also find that the distribution of verified clean examples across classes matters more than the number of verified examples.

</details>


### [639] [XOR-Trellis: Ultra-Low-Complexity Dequantization and Curvature-Aware Hadamard-Free LLM Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00432)
*Xiaofan Que,Nir Elkayam,Spandan Pyakurel,Shuokai Pan,Dibakar Gope*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出两种互补技术，解决了格编码量化（TCQ）在LLM权重量化部署中的并行反量化吞吐瓶颈与无变换量化精度问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 格编码量化可在超低位宽下压缩LLM权重且无需指数级大码本，但实际部署面临两大挑战：一是反量化并行吞吐需足够高以免成为推理瓶颈，二是需在不使用高开销非相干变换（如Hadamard）的前提下保持量化精度。

Method: 1）设计超低复杂度格反量化器，采用结构化、硬件友好的状态到值映射，同时保留多样化的重建选择以支撑格搜索；2）将离散格路径优化重新表述为曲率感知目标函数，在原始坐标空间中直接反映模型敏感度。

Result: 两种技术结合实现了高质量超低位格量化，具备低成本、高度并行的运行时重建能力，且无需依赖基于Hadamard的非相干处理。

Conclusion: 该方案在超低位宽下兼顾了反量化吞吐效率与量化精度，为格编码量化在LLM推理中的实用部署提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Trellis-coded quantization enables high-dimensional compression of large language model (LLM) weights at ultra-low bit widths without the exponentially large codebooks required by conventional vector quantization. Practical deployment, however, presents two challenges: reconstructing compressed weights at sufficient parallel throughput to avoid making dequantization an inference bottleneck, and maintaining quantization accuracy without costly incoherence transformations. We address these challenges with two complementary techniques. First, we introduce an ultra-low-complexity trellis dequantizer that uses a structured, hardware-efficient state-to-value mapping while preserving diverse reconstruction choices for trellis search. Second, we reformulate discrete trellis path optimization with a curvature-aware objective that reflects model sensitivity directly in the original coordinate space. Together, these techniques enable high-quality ultra-low-bit trellis quantization with inexpensive, highly parallel runtime reconstruction and without relying on Hadamard-based incoherence processing.

</details>


### [640] [A Safe Prototype Is Not a Safety Direction: Reference Dependence and Prompt Confounds in Response-Safety Embeddings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01801)
*Sahil Kadadekar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文审计了一种"用安全响应均值嵌入的余弦相似度给响应安全性打分"的sleeper-agent探测器，指出原始正质心规则无法确定安全与不安全的方向，并通过多编码器、多语料实验验证其表现接近随机甚至反向，而显式正负参考可将AUC提升至0.588-0.793。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期sleeper-agent探测器提出用已知安全响应均值嵌入的余弦相似度作为安全评分，但原始正质心规则缺乏依据：正向观测只能定位安全类相对编码器原点的位置，却无法确定区分安全与不安全响应的方向。论文旨在审计这一评分的有效性。

Method: 在两个提示受控、人工标注的语料及一个辅助的陪审团标注来源控制上，使用四个冻结编码器和按提示分组的数据划分进行审计；对比安全原型（safe prototype）与显式的"安全减不安全"参考（safe-minus-unsafe reference）方向；并在验证集校准5%误安全阈值、进行无标签参考与少量标注不安全样本的对照，以及仅提示词消融实验。

Result: 人工标注语料上安全原型ROC-AUC仅0.457-0.545（两个单元显著低于随机，一个高于随机），而显式参考在同一嵌入上达0.588-0.738；陪审团控制上原型反向（0.358-0.405），参考达0.754-0.793。阈值校准后参考在PKU-SafeRLHF接受更多安全响应（0.153-0.263 vs 0.039-0.061）、Aegis（0.189-0.291 vs 0.004-0.045），但在BeaverTails上不可靠。无标签参考可恢复部分到大部分排序，不安全比例仅5%时恢复很差，而80-634条标注不安全样本可恢复大部分。提示词消融显示提示-标签构成会抬高不受控评估结果。

Conclusion: 该结果仅针对原始正质心方法，不适用于所有单类方法或安全专用防护模型。类均值只是位置，未必是安全方向；需要声明参考并且有足够的不安全样本量才能确定方向。

Abstract: Can response safety be scored by cosine similarity to the mean embedding of known-safe responses? A recent sleeper-agent detector proposes exactly this score, yet the raw positive-centroid rule is not identified: positive observations locate the safe class relative to an encoder origin, but do not determine which direction separates safe from unsafe responses. We audit the rule on two prompt-controlled, human-labeled corpora and one auxiliary jury-labeled source control, using four frozen encoders and prompt-grouped splits. On the human-labeled corpora the safe prototype reaches ROC-AUC 0.457-0.545, with two cells significantly below chance and one above, while an explicit safe-minus-unsafe reference reaches 0.588-0.738 on the same embeddings; on the jury control the prototype is inverted (0.358-0.405) and the reference reaches 0.754-0.793. At validation-calibrated 5% false-safe thresholds, the reference accepts more safe responses on PKU-SafeRLHF (0.153-0.263 versus 0.039-0.061 across encoders) and Aegis (0.189-0.291 versus 0.004-0.045), but not reliably on BeaverTails. A fully unlabeled held-out reference recovers part to most of the referenced ranking, much less when only 5% of the pool is unsafe, whereas 80-634 labeled unsafe responses recover most of it. Prompt-only ablations show that prompt-label composition can inflate uncontrolled evaluations. This is a bounded result about a raw positive centroid, not all one-class methods or safety-specialized guards. A class mean is a location, not necessarily a safety direction; a declared reference with enough unsafe mass identifies orientation.

</details>


### [641] [Every Batch Is Its Own Validation Set: Leave-One-Out Gradient Matching for Online Data Selection in LLM Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00436)
*Hongyu Chen,Xinyi Luo,Ming Zhao,Lin Tang,Zihan Xu,Jing Li,Yuxuan Wang,Haoran Deng,Wei Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文揭示在线批选择中样本内梯度匹配存在协方差惩罚（对角线噪声），提出留一法目标将匹配转化为群体梯度误差的无偏估计，据此构建 LOOM，按梯度信噪比加权选子集，无需验证集即可超越全批训练及多种基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线批选择旨在从每个候选批中挑选最有用的样本微调语言模型。其中梯度匹配型选择器因无需留出数据而具吸引力，但实际效果几乎无法超越全批训练。作者旨在解释这一失败原因并给出可行的修正方案。

Method: 作者指出样本内梯度匹配把每个样本自身作为目标的一部分，使目标函数把该样本自身的梯度噪声计入其贡献，形成梯度 Gram 矩阵对角线上的协方差惩罚，从而偏向噪声最大的样本并使全批成为最优解。修正方法是去掉对角线：对每个样本而言，其他候选样本构成数据分布的独立采样，故去对角线后匹配目标成为对群体梯度更新误差的无偏估计。该留一目标的极小化解按梯度信噪比（SNR）对样本加权，并给出"半批更新误差低于全批"的精确条件。LOOM 在普通反向传播过程中以 Adam 预条件子的度量计算 Gram 矩阵，按 (1-e^{-γ}) 保证贪心选取加权子集，且不使用留出数据。

Result: 在四个微调任务、七种 1.5B 至 8B 参数骨干模型上，LOOM 在 Llama-3.1-8B 和 Qwen2.5-7B 上较全批训练分别提升 2.3 和 2.4 个点，超过所有样本内梯度匹配方法 2.4 个点，超过依赖验证集的 GREATS 和 OPUS 1.6–2.0 个点，并以低于其基准率五分之一的比例选出注入的标签噪声样本。

Conclusion: 样本内梯度匹配的失败源于对角线协方差惩罚，去除对角线后可获得无偏的更新误差估计，按梯度 SNR 加权选择子集能在异构 SNR 条件下以半批实现更低误差。LOOM 无需留出数据，在多种模型与任务上稳定优于全批训练及现有选择器，并能有效抑制标签噪声。

Abstract: Online batch selection fine-tunes a language model on the most useful part of each candidate batch. Selectors that match the gradient of the candidate batch are attractive because they need no held-out data, yet they rarely beat training on the whole batch. We show why. In-sample gradient matching uses every example as part of its own target, so its objective credits each example with its own gradient noise. This is the covariance penalty that makes training error optimistic, now sitting on the diagonal of the gradient Gram matrix: it steers selection toward the noisiest examples and makes the full batch the best solution the objective can reach. The fix costs nothing. For each example, the other candidates form an independent sample of the data distribution, so removing the diagonal turns the matching objective into an unbiased estimate of the update's error with respect to the population gradient. The minimizer of this leave-one-out objective weights examples by their gradient signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), and whenever per-example SNR is heterogeneous enough, half of a batch yields a lower-error update than the whole batch; we give the exact condition. We build \method{} on this principle. It computes the Gram matrix in the metric of the Adam preconditioner during the ordinary backward pass, selects a weighted subset greedily with a $(1-e^{-γ})$ guarantee, and uses no held-out data. Across four fine-tuning tasks and seven backbones from 1.5B to 8B parameters, LOOM improves on full-batch training by 2.3 and 2.4 points on Llama-3.1-8B and Qwen2.5-7B, exceeds every in-sample gradient matcher by 2.4 points and the validation-guided GREATS and OPUS by 1.6--2.0, and selects injected label noise at under a fifth of its base rate.

</details>


### [642] [One pool, many targets: a conservation layer and what archival data can identify](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00445)
*Zahra Khodagholi,Niloofar Yousefi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出可微的标量平衡层以刻画有限RISC池的竞争守恒，给出隐式梯度与秩不变性等理论结果，并在存档脱靶数据上审计剂量与跨情境两类实验，结论是耦合并未带来可证实的额外预测力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 成对的guide–transcript分数被独立解释为占据率时，无法保证有限guide-loaded RISC池的守恒，因此需要一个显式建模资源竞争的框架，并厘清独立打分与平衡竞争在何种条件下可区分。

Method: 构建可微标量平衡层：单个守恒方程（唯一正根）并具精确隐式梯度；由此推导重分配定理、有条件的high-resource极限、检索近似的分析，以及条件性秩不变性结果。随后在存档脱靶数据上审计剂量与跨情境两组实验，使用修正热力学亲和力、配对置换检验、construct-cluster bootstrap，以及与平衡关联簇标准误对应的描述性\GapNetOverSE{}。

Result: 修正后的热力学亲和力与实测抑制呈弱相关且方向符合可用预测器的要求；但配对置换检验和construct-cluster bootstrap均未能证明耦合带来额外预测价值，在不同置换零假设基线之间唯一稳健保留的是描述性的\GapNetOverSE{}。剂量拟合异质性强，且常违反模型隐含的指数约束——该约束为超线性而非亚线性，故数据无法识别竞争参数。竞争子集的可饱和压缩在留出guide家族上同时满足两个准确率目标，但在所测规模下并未更快。

Conclusion: 核心贡献是一个可复用的守恒算子，以及检验该算子所需的实验信息设计；在一个construct、一个剂量内，按分数占据率的排序无法区分平衡模型与独立打分。代码见 https://github.com/shadi97kh/One-Pool-Many-Targets。

Abstract: Pairwise guide--transcript scores do not enforce conservation of a finite guide-loaded RISC pool when they are interpreted independently as occupancies. We formulate a differentiable scalar equilibrium layer: one conservation equation with a unique positive root and exact implicit gradients. It yields a redistribution theorem, a qualified high-resource limit, an analysis of the retrieval approximation, and a conditional rank-invariance result: within one construct at one dose, rankings by fractional occupancy cannot distinguish equilibrium from independent scoring. We therefore audit the two experiments that proposition leaves open, dose and cross-context, on archival off-target data. Corrected thermodynamic affinities associate weakly with measured repression in the direction a working predictor requires, but a paired permutation test and a construct-cluster bootstrap do not establish added predictive value from the coupling: what survives their differing permutation-null baselines is \GapNet{}, a descriptive \GapNetOverSE{} of the equilibrium association's cluster standard error. The dose fits are heterogeneous and frequently violate the model-implied exponent constraint, which is superlinear rather than sublinear, so these data do not identify the competition parameter. A saturable compression of the competitor set holds both accuracy targets on held-out guide families but is not faster at the size measured. The contribution is a reusable conservation operator and the experimental information needed to test it. The code for this study is available at https://github.com/shadi97kh/One-Pool-Many-Targets.

</details>


### [643] [Exact information accounting for SGD methods](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00446)
*Akshay Balsubramani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文用信息论方法对SGD及其变体给出精确分析：预条件SGD步是高斯贝叶斯模型的后验均值更新，一步遗憾分解为内禀时间代价与比较器信息变化，并推广为目标函数的恒等式，统一解释收敛、鞍点逃离、平坦性与泛化等经典结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准几何分析（如收敛界、损失曲面分析）只能给出不等式式的界，无法精确刻画SGD各组成部分的贡献，也难以区分达到相同训练损失的优化器。作者希望以信息论视角给出等式的、可逐项测量的分析框架。

Method: 将预条件SGD步推导为高斯贝叶斯模型的后验均值更新；把一步遗憾分解为内禀时间代价与比较器信息变化两项，并给出目标函数本身的恒等式。在合成数据与真实训练中逐项测量该恒等式的各项。

Result: 凸收敛、严格鞍点逃离、平坦性与泛化的联系、标准学习率调度、自适应优化器以及噪声、动量、重尾、无梯度等变体，均对应恒等式的某一项或特例。真实网络上，该分解将经典收敛界的松弛归因于推导中被丢弃的项，并能区分达到相同训练损失的优化器（依据其步数与步间一致性）；其与泛化优劣的关系随网络而异。对无梯度SGD，该恒等式给出了曲率预条件器进入更新的方式；在数据无关的各向同性先验下，基于锐度的泛化证书在网络规模下空洞，除非所有参数的曲率谱几乎平坦。

Conclusion: 信息论恒等式为SGD及其变体提供了统一且可测量的精确分析框架，能解释并区分既有理论结论，同时揭示基于锐度的泛化证书在大规模网络中的局限性。

Abstract: As an alternative to the standard geometric analyses, we give an exact, information-theoretic analysis of stochastic gradient descent (SGD) and its variants. We show that a preconditioned SGD step is the posterior-mean update of a Gaussian Bayes model, and that its one-step regret splits into an intrinsic-time cost and a change in comparator information. The split extends to an identity for the objective itself. Convex convergence, strict-saddle-point escape, the link between flatness and generalization, the standard learning-rate schedules, adaptive optimizers, and the noisy, momentum, heavy-tailed, and gradient-free variants of SGD each correspond to a term or a special case of this identity. We measure its terms on synthetic and real training runs. On real networks it attributes the slack of classical convergence bounds to the terms their derivations drop and separates optimizers that reach the same training loss. That separation follows the number and consistency of their steps. Its relation to which of them generalizes better differs between networks. For gradient-free SGD the identity determines how a curvature preconditioner should enter the update. The sharpness-based generalization certificate it yields, with a data-independent isotropic prior, is vacuous at network scale unless the curvature spectrum is nearly flat across all parameters.

</details>


### [644] [Score the Update, Not the Token: Descent-Aligned Routing for Combinatorial LoRA Experts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00493)
*Priya Nair,Lukas Brenner,Maya Lindqvist,Daniel Whitmore,Wen-Hsuan Liu,Tom Saliencro,Amara Okonkwo,Rohan Desai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出VANE，将MoE-LoRA的路由从"对token打分"改为"对update打分"，通过reader-writer分解使所有专家对的效用可用共享rank-r空间的内积高效计算，在常识推理与多任务设定上以更少参数超过现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Mixture-of-LoRA-experts方法几乎都将每个专家的输入侧因子与输出侧因子绑定，且路由器仅对token打分、在看不到专家会写出什么的情况下选择专家。这种token路由只能捕捉效用中经由token均值的部分，按专家自身激活范数排序的路由器则完全看不到输出因子，导致路由质量受限。

Method: 作者提出路由应评估"更新"（update）而非token。基于一阶近似，将专家更新加入层输出所降低的损失等于该更新与输出处负损失梯度的内积，而该效用对token是二次的。若把专家拆分为reader（下投影）与writer（上投影），每个reader-writer对的效用就变成共享rank-r空间中的内积，N_AN_B个对可由N_A+N_B个向量打分。VANE据此构建：用低秩compass预测每个token的下降方向，在不形成任何实际更新的情况下以update与compass的对齐度对所有专家对打分，用加性门激活top-k对，并为每个对提供精确的一阶路由梯度。

Result: 在单领域常识推理以及使用Llama-3.2-3B与Llama-3.1-8B的四领域多任务混合设定上，VANE在十二个PEFT与MoE-LoRA基线中取得最佳平均成绩，分别高出0.9--1.1分和1.3--1.5分，且可训练参数不到8专家MoE-LoRA的一半。其路由分数与专家实测效用的吻合度也远高于token路由器。

Conclusion: 路由应当对专家更新而非token打分。通过reader-writer分解与共享rank-r空间内积，VANE能够高效、精确地为所有专家对评分并赋予其一阶路由梯度，以更少参数量取得更优性能，且路由分数更贴近专家的真实效用。

Abstract: Mixture-of-LoRA-experts methods raise the capacity of low-rank adaptation by routing each token to a few low-rank experts. Nearly all of them tie one input-side factor to one output-side factor per expert, and nearly all of them route by scoring the token: the router picks experts without seeing what any of them would write. We argue that the router should score the update. To first order, adding an expert's update to a layer output lowers the loss by the inner product between that update and the negative loss gradient at the output. This usefulness is quadratic in the token, so a router that is linear in the token sees only the part of it that runs through the token mean, and routers that rank experts by the norm of their own activations never see the output factor. If each expert is split into a reader (down-projection) and a writer (up-projection), the usefulness of every reader--writer pair becomes an inner product in the shared rank-$r$ space, and all $N_AN_B$ pairs can be scored from $N_A+N_B$ vectors. We build VANE on this identity. A low-rank compass predicts the descent direction of each token. VANE scores every pair by the alignment between its update and the compass without forming any update, activates the top-$k$ pairs with additive gates, and gives every pair its exact first-order router gradient. On single-domain commonsense reasoning and a four-domain multi-task mixture with Llama-3.2-3B and Llama-3.1-8B, VANE attains the best average among twelve PEFT and MoE-LoRA baselines, by 0.9--1.1 and 1.3--1.5 points respectively, with less than half the trainable parameters of an 8-expert MoE-LoRA. Its router scores also track the measured usefulness of experts far more closely than token routers do.

</details>


### [645] [Gumbel Straight Flow: Distilling Autoregressive Models into One-step Flow Maps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00497)
*Yeongmin Kim,Arnaud Doucet,Andrew Campbell,Valentin De Bortoli,Thomas Mensink,David Ruhe*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Gumbel Straight Flow（GSF），一种利用预训练自回归语言模型噪声-数据耦合的连续流映射语言模型，实现高质量少步采样。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前少步语言生成方法（如扩散/流匹配模型）在采样效率与生成质量上难以兼顾，需要借助预训练自回归模型的先验来改善噪声到离散token序列的耦合与路径采样。

Method: GSF基于预训练AR模型诱导的Gumbel噪声与one-hot token序列的耦合，理论上证明该耦合形成连接噪声与序列表示的非相交线性路径；进而采用流映射半群（semigroup）目标，令切向（速度）条件直接由AR教师模型引导。

Result: 在预训练及多种下游任务基准上，GSF优于现有少步语言生成基线。

Conclusion: 利用AR模型的噪声-数据耦合可构造直线式连续流路径，结合半群流映射目标与AR教师的速度引导，GSF能有效提升少步语言生成的采样质量与效率。

Abstract: We present Gumbel Straight Flow (GSF), a continuous flow map language model that leverages the noise-data coupling of a pretrained autoregressive language (AR) model. We theoretically demonstrate that the coupling between Gumbel noise and one-hot token sequences induced by an autoregressive model yields non-intersecting linear paths connecting the noise to the sequence representations. To further enhance high-quality few-step path sampling, we use a flow map semigroup objective where the tangent (velocity) condition is guided directly by the AR teacher. Across various benchmarks, including pretraining and downstream tasks, GSF can outperform current few-step language generation baselines.

</details>


### [646] [Denoising Surface: Modeling and Predicting Inference Cost for Diffusion LLM Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00499)
*Haoyu Zheng,Fangcheng Fu,Binhang Yuan,Yongqiang Zhang,Liang Deng,Hao Wang,Yuanyuan Zhu,Xiao Yan,Jiawei Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出去噪工作负载曲面(DWS)以刻画扩散大模型(dLLM)推理成本,配合轻量级提示预测器与DWS引导调度,将成本预测误差最多降低2.50倍、在线端到端时延最多降低1.92倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散大语言模型(dLLM)走向真实服务部署,请求管理与资源分配依赖准确的单请求推理成本估计。但常用成本代理在dLLM上失效:输出长度忽略了单次前向可解掩多个token;去噪步数忽略了各步成本的异构性。其本质原因是block-autoregressive生成机制带来"输出块×块内去噪步"的二维执行结构,而标量代理将其压缩为单一数值,丢失了刻画成本的关键信息。

Method: 提出去噪工作负载曲面(DWS),将二维"块-步"结构保留为概率曲面,用以加权异构的每步成本;设计由粗到细的训练方案,使仅依赖提示的轻量预测器能准确预测复杂的DWS。该预测器可在单CPU核心上高效运行,避免与服务模型争用GPU。由于DWS将请求相关的执行行为与部署相关的成本因子解耦,预测器无需重训练即可跨硬件配置迁移。基于DWS引导实现最短作业优先调度。

Result: 在真实服务实验中,相比基于标量的预测器,DWS将成本预测误差最多降低2.50倍;DWS引导的最短作业优先调度器将在线聊天场景的端到端时延最多降低1.92倍。

Conclusion: 通过保留dLLM二维块-步执行结构并以概率曲面建模,可在无需GPU、可跨硬件迁移的前提下显著提升成本估计精度,并有效改善在线服务的调度与时延表现。

Abstract: As diffusion large language models (dLLMs) become more capable, they are moving from research settings to real-world \textit{serving}, where request management (such as scheduling and resource allocation) relies on accurate estimation of per-request inference cost. However, common cost proxies fall short for dLLMs: output length ignores that one forward pass can unmask multiple tokens, and denoising-step count ignores the \textit{heterogeneous} per-step costs. We observe that the block-autoregressive generation mechanism induces a two-dimensional execution structure over output blocks and within-block denoising steps, whereas these proxies collapse it into a scalar, discarding information essential for characterizing the cost. Motivated by this insight, we propose the Denoising Workload Surface (DWS), which preserves this two-dimensional block-step structure as a probability surface to weight the heterogeneous per-step costs. We then design a coarse-to-fine training scheme that enables a lightweight prompt-only predictor to accurately predict the complex DWS. This predictor runs efficiently even on a single CPU core, avoiding GPU contention with the serving model. Since DWS decouples request-dependent execution behavior from deployment-specific cost factors, the predictor transfers across hardware configurations without retraining. In \textit{real-world} serving experiments, DWS reduces cost-prediction error by up to $2.50\times$ over scalar-based predictors, while the DWS-guided shortest-job-first scheduler reduces end-to-end latency by up to $1.92\times$ for online chatbots.

</details>


### [647] [One-Step Generative Modeling via Training Dynamics Action](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00518)
*Zhangyong Liang,Ying Huang,Haibin Ling*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出TDAction，以共享参数实现代价选择传输目标，在无蒸馏下ImageNet 256×256 FID低于1.1。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 一步生成模型通过训练时的迭代传输构建静态生成器。现有传输目标主要衡量分布层面的运动，但神经生成器需通过共享参数更新协同实现所有样本位移。因此核心问题为：当训练本身即构建最终一步映射的迭代过程时，应优化下一次分布移动，还是优化有限生成器学习最终映射的路径。

Method: 引入Training Dynamics Action（TDAction），依据局部共享参数实现代价选择传输目标，同时保持规定的分布进展水平。将代价建模为软终端控制问题，推导闭式Batch Tangent Action-to-Go值，兼顾参数努力与终端失配。该准则捕捉独立成对代价忽略的跨样本交互；在各向同性移动性下，对确定性平衡耦合与二次欧氏分配一致。随机切向探针提供低秩实现，构造共享的detached目标，且不引入推理时轨迹。

Result: 开展控制实验考察生成器几何、传输选择与实际局部作用之间的关系；在ImageNet 256×256上，TDAction在无蒸馏条件下取得低于1.1的FID。

Conclusion: TDAction将一步生成模型的传输目标从单纯的分布运动转向考虑共享参数实现代价的路径选择，通过软终端控制与闭式Action-to-Go值实现有效优化，在无蒸馏的图像生成任务中取得优异表现。

Abstract: One-step generative models construct a static generator through iterative training-time transport. Existing transport objectives primarily assess distributional motion, although a neural generator needs to realize the requested sample displacements jointly through shared parameter updates. The training-time construction raises the question: \emph{once training becomes the iterative process that constructs the final one-step map, what to optimize: the next distributional move, or the route by which the finite generator learns the final map?} To address the question, we introduce \textbf{T}raining \textbf{D}ynamics \textbf{A}ction (\textbf{TDAction}), which selects transport targets according to local shared-parameter realization cost while retaining a prescribed level of distributional progress. We formulate the cost as a soft-terminal control problem and derive a closed-form Batch Tangent Action-to-Go value that accounts for parameter effort and terminal mismatch. The criterion captures cross-sample interactions omitted by independent pairwise costs; under isotropic mobility, the criterion agrees with quadratic Euclidean assignment for deterministic balanced couplings. Randomized tangent probes provide a low-rank implementation that constructs shared detached targets without adding an inference-time trajectory. Controlled studies examine the relationship between generator geometry, transport selection, and realized local action. On ImageNet $256\times256$, TDAction attains an FID below $1.1$ without distillation.

</details>


### [648] [SimplexUQ: An Evaluation Framework and Benchmark for Conformal Uncertainty on Simplex-Valued Predictions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00523)
*Liang You,Hengyu Shi,Dongwen Ou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SimplexUQ 是首个针对单纯形值预测的 conformal 覆盖分配问题基准，用 12 个任务比较现有 wrapper，发现无普适最优方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Conformal prediction 只保证边际覆盖，单一校准阈值会导致覆盖在易/难区域分配不均（易区过覆盖、难区欠覆盖）。现有工作缺少针对单纯形值预测的系统、可复现的分配问题评测协议。

Method: 提出 SimplexUQ 基准与可复现协议，比较既有 conformal wrapper 而非提出新方法。任务集 SimplexTasks-12 含 6 个受控合成设定 + 6 个冻结预测器真实任务（类概率、主题混合、光谱丰度、细胞类型比例、年龄分布、情绪混合）。每次比较固定预测器、score 与无响应分层图，仅变 wrapper，报告边际覆盖、最差层覆盖、最大差异、任务内半径与计算量。另做固定图分析与预测器偏差扫描。

Result: 全局校准可能看似有效却严重失败：CIFAR-10 上边际覆盖 0.900，最差熵层仅 0.542；Mondrian 将该层提升至 0.886，并把最大差异从 0.358 降至 0.022。但无 wrapper 全面占优：平滑合成异质性下多种修复方法相当；固定图分析显示排名依赖评估组与协议；12 任务比较中 Mondrian 在其单一目标划分上 12 个任务差异均更低，BatchMVP 在重叠组上 5 个更低。偏差扫描显示去除预测器偏差仅部分降低全局阈值差异。

Conclusion: 该工作为经验比较而非新覆盖保证；释放任务卡、结果溯源、允许的派生数组与重建说明，并将 wrapper 选择定位为诊断性比较而非普适排名。

Abstract: Conformal prediction guarantees marginal coverage, but a single calibration threshold can still spread that coverage unevenly, over-covering easy regions and under-covering hard ones. SimplexUQ is, to our knowledge, the first benchmark and reproducible protocol for measuring this allocation problem on simplex-valued predictions; it compares existing conformal wrappers rather than proposing a new one. Its task suite, SimplexTasks-12, combines six controlled synthetic regimes with six frozen-predictor real tasks spanning class probabilities, topic mixtures, spectral abundances, cell-type fractions, age distributions, and emotion mixtures. Each comparison fixes the predictor, score, and response-free stratification map, varies only the wrapper, and reports marginal coverage, worst-stratum coverage, max disparity, and within-task radius and compute. Global calibration can look valid while failing badly: on CIFAR-10 it attains 0.900 marginal coverage but only 0.542 in the worst entropy stratum, and Mondrian calibration raises that stratum to 0.886 while reducing max disparity from 0.358 to 0.022. No wrapper dominates, however. Under smooth synthetic heterogeneity, several repairs are competitive; fixed-map analyses show that rankings depend on the evaluation groups and protocol; and in a 12-task comparison, Mondrian has lower disparity on its single target partition for all 12 tasks, whereas BatchMVP has lower disparity over overlapping groups on five. These are empirical comparisons, not new coverage guarantees. A controlled predictor-bias sweep shows that removing predictor bias only partly reduces global-threshold disparity. We release task cards, result provenance, permitted derived arrays, and rebuild instructions, and treat wrapper selection as a diagnostic comparison rather than a universal ranking.

</details>


### [649] [Random Recursive Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00541)
*Jama Hussein Mohamud,Mirco Ravanelli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出随机递归模型（RRM）：维护一个含 L 个可学习层的层池，在每个样本的每一步递归中独立有放回地采样一层，从而在保持递归参数效率的同时实现灵活的层复用，并在推理任务上以更少参数达到或超越基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有递归模型通过参数复用创造计算深度，是提升模型规模之外的参数高效替代方案，但多数方法反复应用单一学习变换或预先规定的变换序列，将计算限制在固定层顺序中，缺乏层复用的灵活性。

Method: RRM 维护一个由 L 个可学习层组成的层池，通过 T 次递归步骤，对每个样本和每个步骤独立地、有放回地采样一个层来执行计算。由此在递归的参数效率下获得灵活的层复用能力，并支持推理时改变深度（包括超出训练深度）、蒙特卡洛推理以及概率式测试时扩展。

Result: 在具有挑战性的推理任务上，RRM 匹配或超越基线，且常常减少 50–75% 的参数。它无需重训练或增加参数即可在推理时改变深度（含超出训练深度），并提升受益于更深迭代计算的任务；蒙特卡洛推理与概率式测试时扩展均可无需重训练地提升性能。

Conclusion: RRM 通过在递归中随机采样层，打破了固定层顺序的限制，兼顾参数效率与推理灵活性，其推理期深度调整和测试时扩展能力为神经网络架构设计提供了新方向。

Abstract: Recursive models create computational depth through parameter reuse, offering a parameter-efficient alternative to increasing model size. However, most recursive models repeatedly apply one learned transformation or a prescribed sequence of transformations, restricting computation to a fixed layer order. We introduce the Random Recursive Model (RRM), which maintains a pool of $L$ learned layers and performs $T$ recursive steps by sampling one layer independently with replacement for each example and step. This enables flexible layer reuse while retaining the parameter efficiency of recurrence. We evaluate RRM on challenging reasoning tasks, where it matches or exceeds the baselines, often with 50-75 % fewer parameters. RRM can vary its depth at inference, including beyond that seen during training, without retraining or adding parameters, improving tasks that benefit from deeper iterative computation. RRM also supports Monte Carlo inference and probabilistic test-time scaling, both of which improve performance without retraining. These insights may open new directions in neural network architecture design.

</details>


### [650] [Geometry-Dependent Bounds for Online Non-Monotone DR-Submodular Maximization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00545)
*Vaneet Aggarwal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究紧凸下闭集上非负非单调 DR-子模函数的对抗在线最大化，证明系数 4/9 的比较者一致一阶不等式，优于 0.401 基准，并给出与离线预言机上界（β*=0.4704…）匹配的间隙分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线非单调 DR-子模最大化的最优逼近系数尚未确定：在线基准为 0.401，与离线最优之间是否存在间隙、以及该系数能否提升，是本文的核心问题。

Method: 利用目标无关的有理动作进行有序坐标论证，证明比较者一致的一阶不等式得到系数 4/9；对 ζ·1∈K⊆[0,1]^d 得到改进系数 ᾱ(ζ)；反面用三组对称性间隙构造给出离线预言机上界；对系数已知的多项式给出二次型 1/2 与几何相关三次型系数；并用常目标序列构造离线 (4/9−ε) 逼近。

Result: 在线系数达 4/9（每轮一次梯度查询与一次投影，O(√T) 期望近似遗憾）；离线预言机上界 β*=0.470438681380894…（ζ=0，即便有精确值与全梯度）；ζ≥1/2 时上下界在 1/2 处吻合，最优亏缺为 Θ((1/2−ζ)^2)；三次型系数从 8/17 起（ζ=1/5 时为 0.49）；另有 O(T^{3/4}) 噪声值反馈与非预期自适应对手保证。

Conclusion: 该工作将在线系数从 0.401 提升至 4/9，并通过上下界匹配刻画了 ζ→1/2 时相对 1/2 的最优亏缺为 Θ((1/2−ζ)^2)，同时给出多项式情形的精确系数与稳健的反馈/对手设定下的遗憾保证。

Abstract: We study adversarial online maximization of nonnegative, non-monotone DR-submodular functions over compact convex down-closed sets. A learner commits each action before observing its objective and competes with the best fixed action in hindsight. We prove a comparator-uniform first-order inequality that gives coefficient $4/9$, improving the online $0.401$ benchmark, with one gradient query and one projection per round and $O(\sqrt T)$ expected approximate regret. If $ζ{\bf 1} \in K\subseteq[0,1]^d$, the coefficient improves to $\underlineα(ζ)=\tfrac12-(1-2ζ)_+^2/[2(3-2ζ)^2]$. The proof is a direct ordered-coordinate argument with an objective-independent rational action. Conversely, a three-group symmetry-gap construction yields an offline oracle upper bound $β_*=0.470438681380894\ldots$ at $ζ=0$, even with exact value and full-gradient responses. A parameterized extension and exact finite-instance bounds define an upper function for every $ζ$. The lower and upper bounds match at $1/2$ for $ζ\ge1/2$, and show that the optimal deficit from $1/2$ is $Θ((1/2-ζ)^2)$ as $ζ\uparrow1/2$. For coefficient-revealed polynomials we obtain $1/2$ for quadratics and a geometry-dependent cubic coefficient starting at $8/17$, including $0.49$ at $ζ=1/5$. A constant objective sequence yields an offline $(4/9-\varepsilon)$ approximation with polynomially many first-order queries on the cube and projections, without requiring a supplied positive lower bound on the optimum. We also give nonanticipating adaptive-adversary and value-feedback guarantees, including $O(T^{3/4})$ regret with one noisy value per round.

</details>


### [651] [Evaluating Hybrid Quantum-Classical Models for Reduced-Order Brain Deformation Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00554)
*Tao Liu,Ge He,Dongyu Liang,Wujie Wen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究评估混合量子-经典机器学习在脑形变场降阶预测中的表现，结果表明经典网络（POD-MLP、POD-LSTM）在精度与稳定性上均优于量子变体，但增强型VQC/QLSTM能显著改善最小量子基线的表达能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高维时空脑形变场预测计算不可行，需降阶处理；同时需系统检验近期量子机器学习（QML）在物理场学习任务中的实际优势，将其作为严格的测试平台。

Method: 采用本征正交分解（POD）将高维位移场投影到紧凑潜空间；设计两类学习目标：静态的时序到潜变量回归与自回归潜状态预测；将紧凑经典基线（POD-MLP、POD-LSTM）与最小及增强型混合量子架构（VQC、QLSTM）进行系统基准对比。

Result: 静态回归中，经典POD-MLP优于所有量子变体，但增强型VQC较最小VQC基线大幅提升；时序预测中，经典POD-LSTM在不同历史窗口与随机初始化下，预测精度与统计稳健性均优于增强型QLSTM。

Conclusion: 降阶物理场学习可作为近期QML的严格测试床；混合增强虽能恢复弱量子电路的表达能力，但经典架构在保真度与稳定性上仍具决定性优势。

Abstract: We evaluate hybrid quantum-classical machine learning for the reduced-order prediction of spatiotemporal brain deformation fields. To mitigate the computational intractability of high-dimensional displacement fields, we employ Proper Orthogonal Decomposition (POD) to project the data into a compact latent space. Within this framework, we formulate two distinct learning objectives: static temporal-to-latent regression and autoregressive latent state forecasting. We systematically benchmark compact classical baselines against both minimal and enhanced hybrid quantum architectures. Our results demonstrate that classical networks provide the strongest baselines in the present setting. For static regression, a classical POD-MLP outperforms all evaluated quantum variants, although an enhanced Variational Quantum Circuit (VQC) substantially improves upon a minimal VQC baseline. For temporal forecasting, a classical POD-LSTM delivers superior predictive accuracy and statistical robustness compared to an enhanced Quantum LSTM (QLSTM) across varying history windows and random initializations. Overall, this study establishes reduced-order physical field learning as a rigorous testbed for near-term QML, highlighting that while hybrid enhancements successfully recover expressivity in weak quantum circuits, classical architectures retain a definitive advantage in both fidelity and stability.

</details>


### [652] [Beyond Affine Transformations: A Soft Dominance Layer for Coordinate-Wise Neural Computation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00563)
*Mariano Rivera*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Soft Dominance Layer作为仿射变换的替代原语，通过sigmoid松弛实现可微阈值比较，MNIST单次实验精度0.9061（无退火）/0.9173（退火），低于MLP基线0.9827，属概念验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索能否用可学习的阈值比较原语替代传统神经网络层中的仿射变换，以获得直接的阈值解释性，而非声称替代仿射层。

Method: 每个输出单元将输入坐标与可学习参考向量比较，聚合平滑的不等式响应；用sigmoid松弛保证可微性，锐度参数α控制向硬阈值决策的过渡。

Result: MNIST单次运行中最高Soft Dominance精度为0.9061（无退火）与0.9173（退火），MLP基线为0.9827；学到的参考向量呈现空间结构；退火收益无统计支持。

Conclusion: 该原语具备可训练性与阈值解释性，但结果仅为描述性，尚不能确立配置优劣；需重复种子实验与更广数据集评估鲁棒性与实用价值。

Abstract: This paper presents a preliminary study of an alternative to the affine transformation underlying conventional neural-network layers. In the proposed Soft Dominance Layer, each output unit compares input coordinates with a learnable reference vector and aggregates smooth inequality responses. A sigmoid relaxation makes the comparisons differentiable, while a sharpness parameter $α$ controls their transition toward hard threshold decisions. The aim is to examine the trainability and direct threshold interpretation of this primitive, not to claim a replacement for affine layers. In single-run MNIST experiments, the highest observed Soft Dominance accuracy is $0.9061$ without annealing and $0.9173$ with annealing, compared with $0.9827$ for the MLP baseline. These descriptive results do not establish reliable configuration rankings or a statistically supported annealing benefit. Learned reference vectors exhibit spatial structure, providing qualitative evidence of structured learning. Repeated-seed experiments and broader datasets are required to assess robustness and practical relevance beyond this proof of concept.

</details>


### [653] [Attention Kernels for Learning Maps Between Heavy-Tailed Measures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00564)
*Kailen Hargenrader,Edoardo Calvello,Bohan Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究概率测度上的算子学习，指出softmax的指数加权在多项式尾测度上会导致测度级注意力积分发散，进而提出用增长更慢的注意力核替代指数，并构建基准验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在具有多项式尾（重尾）的概率测度上进行算子学习时，softmax中的指数加权会使测度级注意力积分发散，这使得标准transformer在处理重尾集成数据时可能失效，因此需要寻找增长更慢的替代注意力核。

Method: 构建两个具有闭式目标的重尾测度算子学习基准；在此基础上研究post-norm transformer中的注意力核增长与数据变换；对比softmax与三种增长更慢的核（共四种核）；并考察样本量对经验能量距离与Wasserstein距离在尾差异敏感性上的影响。

Result: 无数据变换时，softmax模型在两个重尾基准上均出现集成坍缩，而三种慢增长核避免了坍缩；Symlog预处理可使softmax在矩阵求逆任务上避免坍缩，但在剪切交换任务上无效；在高斯控制实验中四种核表现相近；样本量会影响经验能量距离与Wasserstein距离对尾差异的敏感性。

Conclusion: 增长更慢的注意力核是post-norm transformer在重尾集成数据上学习的有效设计选择。

Abstract: Operator learning on probability measures can be accomplished with transformers. For measures with polynomial tails, the exponential weighting in softmax can make the corresponding measure-level attention integrals diverge. This motivates replacing the exponential with slower-growing functions. We construct two benchmarks for operator learning on measures with closed-form targets. We use these benchmarks to study attention kernel growth and data transformation in post-norm transformers. Without data transformation, the softmax models exhibit ensemble collapse on both heavy-tailed benchmarks, while the three slower-growing kernels avoid collapse. Symlog preprocessing allows softmax to avoid collapse on the matrix inverse task but not on the sheared swap task. On the Gaussian control, all four kernels perform similarly. We also examine how sample size affects the sensitivity of empirical energy and Wasserstein distances to tail differences. These results support slower-growing attention kernels as an effective design choice for post-norm transformers learning from heavy-tailed ensembles.

</details>


### [654] [Make Sparse Rewards Count: Density-Aware Reward Aggregation for Multi-Reward RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00574)
*Tong Zheng,Skylar Zhai,Zhan Cheng,TianMing Sha,Youling Huang,Shuo Zhou,Shaotong Qi,Jingcheng Liang,Xuwei Ding,Pengcheng Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究多奖励强化学习中的批次级信号失衡问题，提出优势能量与活跃组密度成正比的规律，并据此提出DARA方法，通过逆平方根密度校正重新加权奖励信号，在工具调用与数学推理任务上更快达到目标行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多奖励强化学习需同时满足多个行为目标，但GDPO等奖励归一化方法仅保留组内相对信息，各目标学习进度仍不均衡。作者希望揭示这种残差批次级信号失衡的成因，并为其提供校准依据。

Method: 作者引入"优势能量"（某奖励在本批次内平方优势之和）作为分析工具，在理想化GDPO归一化下证明该能量与"活跃组密度"（该奖励在rollout组中产生非零相对优势的比例）成正比。基于此关系，提出Density-Aware Reward Aggregation (DARA)，推导逆平方根密度校正，对活跃频率较低的奖励赋予更大权重。DARA权重由每个rollout批次实时计算，可随训练中奖励活跃度变化自适应，且不改变底层策略优化目标。

Result: 在工具调用任务上，DARA比GDPO最快可减少26%的训练步数达到高格式合规；在数学推理任务上，最快可减少65%的步数达到接近饱和的长度合规，同时最终性能保持竞争力。

Conclusion: 优势能量与活跃组密度的正比关系揭示了多奖励训练中的残余信号失衡，DARA以逆平方根密度校正实现有效的奖励贡献校准。该方法无需修改策略优化目标，能自适应奖励活跃度变化，加快目标行为的学习速度，同时保持最终性能。

Abstract: Multi-reward reinforcement learning trains large language models to satisfy multiple behavioral objectives simultaneously. Reward-wise normalization, as used in GDPO, preserves reward-specific relative information within rollout groups, but different objectives can still exhibit uneven learning progress. We study this behavior through advantage energy, the sum of a reward's squared advantages over a batch. Under idealized GDPO normalization, we show that this energy is proportional to active-group density: the fraction of rollout groups in which the reward provides nonzero relative advantages. This reveals a residual batch-level signal imbalance and provides a basis for calibrating reward contributions. Based on this relation, we propose Density-Aware Reward Aggregation (DARA). We derive an inverse-square-root density correction that gives greater weight to signals from less frequently active rewards. DARA computes its weights from each rollout batch, adapting to changes in reward activity throughout training without modifying the underlying policy optimization objective. Experiments on tool calling and mathematical reasoning show that DARA learns the targeted behaviors faster than GDPO, reaching high format compliance in up to 26% fewer training steps on tool calling and near-saturated length compliance in up to 65% fewer steps on mathematical reasoning, while remaining competitive in final performance. Our code is available at https://github.com/zhaihaotian/DARA.

</details>


### [655] [From Task Mixtures to Specialized Experts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00580)
*Hojat Allah Salehi,Mehrdad Mahdavi,Andrew Arash Mahyari,M. Hadi Amini*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究协作式基础模型微调中的"复合异构性"（客户端间与客户端内数据均异构），提出基于路由的方法 FedSEE，性能整体提升 2.9 分、最差服务四分位提升 3.7 分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统联邦学习只处理客户端之间的异构性，而实际中客户端数据往往是多种任务/数据分布的未知混合，即客户端内部也存在异构性（复合异构性）。现有方法缺少对客户端内潜在任务混合的显式建模，可能导致负迁移。

Method: 在共享冻结表征上进行适配。理论上证明：当任务共享同一特征几何时，平方损失下客户端任务混合的最优模型是各底层任务最优模型的凸组合；当任务最优点构成单纯形时，任务对齐路由的风险低于任何单一适配模型。借助少量带任务标签的公开样本，构造凸规划恢复任务专家并匹配任务；据此提出 FedSEE，实现输入依赖的专家选择，使专家选择与客户端任务混合对齐。

Result: 实验表明 FedSEE 避免了所评估基线中出现的负迁移，整体性能提升 2.9 分，对服务最差的四分位客户端提升 3.7 分。

Conclusion: 有效专业化需要输入依赖、与客户端任务混合对齐的专家选择；基于该分析设计的 FedSEE 在复合异构场景下优于单一适配模型和现有基线。

Abstract: In collaborative foundation model fine-tuning, client data is rarely homogeneous. Instead, clients typically possess unknown mixtures of distinct data distributions, or tasks. Conventional federated learning primarily addresses heterogeneity across clients without explicitly resolving latent task mixtures within each client. We study this setting as compound heterogeneity, where data is heterogeneous both across and within clients. We study adaptation over a common frozen representation and show that, when tasks share the same feature geometry, the optimal model for a client's task mixture under squared loss is a convex combination of the optimal models for its underlying tasks. Thus, a single locally trained model represents the client's overall task mixture, while individual inputs may be drawn from different underlying task distributions. This motivates routing inputs to specialized experts, and we show that, when the task optima form a simplex, task-aligned routing achieves lower risk than any single adapted model for genuinely mixed clients. With access to a small set of task-labeled public samples, we derive a convex program to recover task experts and match them to their corresponding tasks. Our routing analysis shows that effective specialization requires input-dependent expert selection aligned with each client's task mixture. Motivated by this analysis, we propose FedSEE. Across our experiments, FedSEE avoids the negative transfer observed in the evaluated baselines and improves performance by 2.9 points overall and 3.7 points for the worst-served quartile.

</details>


### [656] [Right In-Place (RiP) Convolution: A Simple, General, and Near-Optimal Strategy for Memory-Efficient CNN Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00586)
*Opegbemi Matthias Busoye,Tolulope Matthew Busoye,Eghonghon-aye Eigbe*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文修正了Gural和Murmann原位卷积闭式解在两类情形下的错误，并提出RiP（Right In-Place）卷积：无需枚举输出网格、保持行主序访存，即可在共享工作区实现位一致的原位卷积，显著降低MCU上CNN推理的峰值激活内存。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在微控制器等受限硬件上，限制CNN推理的是激活内存而非算力。直接原位卷积可消除双缓冲开销，但已有的内存最优闭式解假设有效填充、单位步长、单位膨胀和奇数方形卷积核，且需非顺序遍历、带来2倍推理时间开销。此外该闭式解存在两类失效情形，因此需要修正并推广到任意步长、膨胀、填充与矩形核。

Method: 1) 指出并修正原闭式解的两类问题：少分配(k-1)Cin mod (Cout-Cin)个标量导致静默破坏仍存活的输入；当关键支路离开输出网格时产生最高达2432倍的无界高估。2) 提出RiP卷积：每层在共享工作区右对齐读输入、从索引0左对齐写输出，保持位一致。3) 将“债务”表示为输出像素索引的分段仿射函数，通过O(1)求断点得到最小安全间隙，无需枚举输出网格，并保持行主序访存。

Result: 在10000个随机层上RiP未产生破坏；在25个架构的84个卷积层中，58层与herringbone工作区完全一致，81层误差在5%以内；相比双缓冲平均节省24.8%内存。写入TinyEngine内核并部署到Raspberry Pi Pico 1和Pico 2后，11个MCUNet模型的峰值激活内存降低12.5%至33.3%，周期数不变且输出位一致，使Pico 1的256 KB SRAM可容纳的模型数从6个增至9个。

Conclusion: RiP卷积在保持位一致输出、不增加推理周期的前提下，以更低峰值激活内存实现原位卷积，并已实机部署验证，有效提升了受限MCU可承载的CNN模型规模。

Abstract: Activation memory, not compute, limits CNN inference on constrained hardware such as microcontrollers. Direct in-place convolution removes the dual-buffer cost, but the memory-optimal formulation of Gural and Murmann assumes valid padding, unit stride, unit dilation, and odd square kernels, and needs a non-sequential traversal costing $2\times$ inference time in transposes. We identify two regimes in which their published closed form does not hold: (1) an under-allocation of exactly $(k-1)C_{in} \bmod (C_{out}-C_{in})$ scalars, active on every convolutional layer of their own deployed network and manifesting as a silent corruption of still-live input; (2) an unbounded overestimate, up to $2{,}432\times$, once the critical leg leaves the output grid. We correct both and generalize to arbitrary stride, dilation, padding, and rectangular kernels. We then propose Right In-Place (RiP) convolution, a bit-identical operation in which every layer reads its input right-aligned in a shared workspace and writes its output left-aligned from index zero. The debt is piecewise affine in the output pixel index, so evaluating its breakpoints in $O(1)$ yields the minimum safe gap without enumerating the output grid, with row-major access preserved. Across $10{,}000$ random layers RiP produced no corruption, and across 84 convolutional layers from 25 architectures it matches the herringbone workspace exactly on 58 and within 5% on 81, using 24.8% less memory than dual buffering on average. Written into TinyEngine's kernels and deployed to a Raspberry Pi Pico 1 and Pico 2, it cuts peak activation memory across eleven MCUNet models by 12.5 to 33.3% at unchanged cycle counts and bit-identical outputs, raising the number of models that fit the Pico 1's 256 KB SRAM from six to nine.

</details>


### [657] [ALER: Adaptive Learnable Experience Rewriting for Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00592)
*Oleg Shchendrigin,Egor Cherepanov,Aleksandr I. Panov,Alexey K. Kovalev*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出记忆的两个新要求——重写与经验融合，并设计了带槽记忆的ALER智能体及Rune-Mazes环境，在多项任务中显著优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 部分可观测强化学习中的记忆架构与基准多只测试"保持"能力，即让信息保持不变直到需要时使用。但后续观测往往会使已存信息过时或改变其对下一步决策的含义，因此需要形式化重写与经验融合两项新要求。

Method: 形式化重写（将决策相关内容设为与旧值无关的值）与经验融合（按后续观测指定的规则变换旧内容）；统计此类任务所需记忆状态数。提出ALER，将LSTM与槽记忆配对，使用独立寻址的Gumbel-Softmax写入将权重集中于单一槽以覆写该槽，并用学习门在策略与价值头之前融合检索内容与循环状态。同时构建Rune-Mazes三个环境，在向量与像素观测下对隐藏线索实施反转、取消、重置或重复更新。

Result: 对比七个基线，ALER在全部16个Endless T-Maze配置中成功率至少0.82，在全部5个Rune T-Maze组合中至少0.99；在带Invert符文的四分支Rune Multi-Corridor上取得最高平均成功率；在像素级Rune MiniGrid Memory上，10个配置中有8个平均成功率高于PPO-LSTM。

Conclusion: 记忆不仅需要保持，还需支持重写与经验融合；通过槽记忆与门控融合机制，ALER能有效应对需要更多记忆状态的组合任务，验证了该形式化框架与新架构的有效性。

Abstract: In partially observable reinforcement learning (RL), a later observation can make stored information obsolete or change what it implies for the next decision. Memory architectures and benchmarks for RL mostly test retention, the ability to keep information unchanged until it is needed. We formalize two further requirements. Rewriting sets the decision-relevant content to a value independent of the old one, and experience fusion transforms the old content by a rule that a later observation specifies. For tasks built from such updates, we count the memory states that a solution needs, and several baselines reach their lowest success rates on compositions that need more states. We introduce ALER (Adaptive Learnable Experience Rewriting), an agent that pairs an LSTM with a slot memory. An independently addressed Gumbel-Softmax write that concentrates its weight on one slot overwrites that slot, and a learned gate fuses the retrieved content with the recurrent state before the policy and value heads. We also introduce Rune-Mazes, three environments in which rune observations invert, cancel, reset, or repeat updates of a hidden cue under vector and pixel observations. Against seven baselines, ALER reaches a success rate of at least $0.82$ in all sixteen Endless T-Maze configurations and at least $0.99$ on all five Rune T-Maze compositions, and it has the highest mean success rate on four-branch Rune Multi-Corridor with an Invert rune. On pixel-based Rune MiniGrid Memory, it has a higher mean success rate than PPO-LSTM in eight of ten configurations. Project page: https://quartz-admirer.github.io/ALER-Adaptive-Learnable-Experience-Rewriting/.

</details>


### [658] [MIKASA-Robo-VLA: Benchmarking Memory in VLA Models for Long-Horizon Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00604)
*Egor Cherepanov,Nikita Kachaev,Aleksandr I. Panov,Alexey K. Kovalev*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 MIKASA-Robo-VLA 基准，含 90 个语言条件操作任务，绝大多数隐藏动作所依赖的线索以评测 VLA 策略的记忆能力，并发布 22,500 条专家轨迹与 π0.5 基线结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主流视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略通常仅输入最近一帧或少数几帧观测，难以评估其如何利用任务过程中消失的信息，即缺乏针对记忆依赖场景的系统性评测手段。

Method: 重建并扩展 MIKASA-Robo 套件：90 个语言条件任务中 80 个隐藏任务相关线索，10 个为保留线索的反应式对照；每个任务均提供指令。对 70 个任务通过环境阶段时序定义信息空隙（gap），仅统计线索确证缺失的区间。发布 10 类记忆、22,500 条 oracle 轨迹，格式为 RLDS 与 LeRobotDataset v3。以 π0.5 为参考基线，仅用当前图像与本体感受、无观测历史与显式记忆模块，在 14 个任务上微调。

Result: 28 个任务的信息空隙超过所调研最宽固定上下文 VLA 的 16 帧窗口。π0.5 基线在 14 个任务上平均成功率 0.211 ± 0.044；其在 Long-split 任务上成功率较低，该差异受开环分块执行与子集中记忆类型分布混杂影响。

Conclusion: 由于空隙只计线索确证缺失的区间，所有记忆依赖任务在构造上均必然需要记忆，短空隙任务亦不例外。该基准为评测 VLA 的记忆机制提供了可控、可复现的测试平台与数据资源。

Abstract: Vision-language-action policies often see only one or a few recent frames, which makes it difficult to evaluate how they use information that disappears during a task. We introduce MIKASA-Robo-VLA, a benchmark of 90 language-conditioned manipulation tasks. All but 10 hide the cue an action depends on. Those 10 are reactive controls. MIKASA-Robo, the suite it rebuilds, has 32 tasks and uses language only in a representative VLA subset. Here every task provides an instruction, while memory-dependent tasks hide a task-relevant cue and reactive controls keep it available. For 70 tasks, environment phase timings specify an information gap, and for 28 of them the gap exceeds the 16-frame window of the widest fixed-context VLA we survey. The gap counts only the interval the cue is provably absent, not the full duration a policy must retain it, so every memory-dependent task still requires memory by construction, including the ones whose measured gap is short. We release 22,500 oracle trajectories across 10 memory types in RLDS and LeRobotDataset v3. A reference $π_{0.5}$ baseline with current images and proprioception, but no observation history or explicit memory module, is fine-tuned on 14 tasks and achieves 0.211 $\pm$ 0.044 mean task success. Its lower success on the evaluated Long-split tasks is confounded by open-loop chunking and the memory types represented in that subset. Project page: https://mikasarobo.github.io/

</details>


### [659] [Learning the identity: a case study of how SGD selects among functional decompositions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00615)
*Andy Arditi,Weian Xie,David Bau,Liu Ziyin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文以深度线性残差网络学习恒等映射为案例，指出总体损失存在一个解流形（恒等函数在不同层间的分解），而SGD可复现地偏好特定分解（如各向异性噪声下产生噪声相关谱，权重衰减也不能恢复零权重解）；将权重矩阵因式分解为两矩阵乘积会使权重坍缩为零。作者用熵损失（总体损失加最小批次梯度期望平方范数项）解析刻画其极小值点并预测SGD偏好解，实验与预测吻合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度线性残差网络学习恒等函数看似平凡（残差路径已实现恒等，只需权重归零），但零权重解只是总体损失极小值流形上的一点，该流形对应恒等函数在网络各层的不同分解。总体损失无法区分这些解，然而SGD却可复现地偏好某些特定分解（如各向异性标签噪声下学习层呈现依赖噪声的谱，即便有权重衰减也通常不恢复零权重解），仅改变参数化（如权重矩阵因式分解）就会使权重坍缩为零。作者希望解释这种看似神秘的现象，说明SGD为何偏好同一输入-输出函数的特定分解。

Method: 引入熵损失视角：在总体损失上增加一个与最小批次梯度期望平方范数成正比的项（Ziyin et al., 2025）。在恒等流形上总体损失为常数，熵项用于区分不同分解。作者对该熵损失的极小值点进行解析刻画，并据此推导SGD偏好解的结构预测。对比实验包括：各向异性标签噪声下有无权重衰减的SGD训练结果，以及将每个权重矩阵因式分解为两个矩阵乘积的参数化变体。

Result: 在各向异性标签噪声下，SGD学到的层呈现依赖噪声的谱，且即使用权重衰减也不会普遍恢复零权重解。仅改变参数化（将每个权重矩阵分解为两矩阵乘积）而不改变可实现函数集合时，权重会坍缩为零，甚至无需显式权重衰减。熵损失的解析极小值点所给出的SGD偏好解结构预测，与SGD训练得到的网络高度吻合。

Conclusion: 恒等学习任务是一个干净简洁的案例，表明熵损失视角能够阐明SGD为何偏好同一输入-输出函数的特定分解。总体损失平坦时，熵项（梯度范数惩罚）成为选择机制，从而可解释权重衰减失效与参数化改变导致零解坍缩等反直觉现象。

Abstract: One might think that learning the identity function with a deep linear residual network is trivial - the path along residual connections already implements the identity, and so the network need only drive its weights to zero. However, this zero-weight solution is just one point on an entire manifold of population-loss minimizers, each corresponding to a different decomposition of the identity across the network's layers. Although the population loss does not distinguish among these solutions, stochastic gradient descent (SGD) reproducibly favors particular ones. For instance, under anisotropic label noise, the learned layers exhibit a noise-dependent spectrum; even with weight decay, SGD does not generally recover the zero-weight solution. Changing only the parametrization, while leaving the set of realizable functions unchanged, yields different behavior: factoring each weight matrix as a product of two matrices causes the weights to collapse to zero, even without explicit weight decay.
  While perhaps mysterious and unintuitive at first, these phenomena can be understood through the lens of entropic loss, which augments the population loss with a term proportional to the expected squared norm of the minibatch gradient (Ziyin et al., 2025). On the identity manifold, the population loss is constant, while the entropic term distinguishes among these decompositions. We characterize its minimizers analytically and use them to derive predictions for the structure of solutions favored by SGD. Networks trained with SGD closely match these predictions.
  Overall, the identity learning task studied here serves as a clean and simple case study of how the lens of entropic loss can clarify why SGD favors particular decompositions of the same input-output function.

</details>


### [660] [Misalignment of Low-Loss Regions Causes Grokking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00620)
*Yongding Tian,Zaid Al-Ars,Maksim Kitsak,Peter Hofstee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文基于模式连通性与低损失区域几何提出分析框架，预测标准模算术设定并非总能产生grokking，并发现一个稳定的anti-grokking反例，指出现有相关性解释的局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: grokking（过拟合后验证集泛化的延迟出现）虽在小型算法任务中首次被观察到，但其底层机制尚无定论，且已有解释多为相关性描述，缺乏统一的几何刻画。

Method: 构建基于模式连通性（mode connectivity）与低损失区域几何的分析框架，考察训练/验证划分所诱导的低损失区域之间的关系；并在保持对称性的训练/验证划分下对标准模算术任务进行实验验证。

Result: 在保持对称性的划分下观察到稳定的anti-grokking现象，验证性能不再恢复，构成对现有grokking相关性解释的反例；分析表明grokking源于训练与验证划分诱导的低损失区域未对齐。

Conclusion: grokking的产生取决于训练与验证低损失区域是否错位；当二者对齐良好时，仅靠超参数无法诱发grokking，动力学退化为可训练或不可训练两类行为。

Abstract: Grokking refers to the delayed emergence of validation-set generalization after a model has already overfit the training set. Although first observed in small algorithmic tasks trained with transformers, its underlying mechanism remains unsettled. In this work, we develop an analysis framework based on mode connectivity and the geometry of low-loss regions. The framework predicts that the standard modular-arithmetic setting does not always produce grokking: under a symmetry-preserving train/validation split, we observe a stable anti-grokking case in which validation performance does not recover. This counterexample challenges several existing correlational explanations of grokking. More broadly, our analysis framework and results further suggest that grokking arises when the low-loss regions induced by the training and validation partitions are misaligned. Once these regions become well aligned, training hyperparameters alone cannot produce grokking and the observed dynamics collapse to either trainable or non-trainable behavior.

</details>


### [661] [Learning Linear Systems under Heavy-Tailed Noise: A Non-Asymptotic Analysis from A Single Trajectory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00637)
*Xiaomian Yang,Sungho Shin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对指数稳定向量自回归模型、重尾噪声、单条观测轨迹，建立了最小二乘估计的非渐近样本复杂度界，误差界为 $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(r^{1/2}T^{-1/2+1/p})$，并给出适用于亚指数、亚高斯噪声的统一分析框架及含外生输入情形的结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 向量自回归（VAR）在系统辨识与时间序列建模中应用广泛，但现有非渐近样本复杂度分析多依赖轻尾（如亚高斯）噪声假设或多次独立轨迹。实际数据常呈重尾特性，且往往只能获得单条轨迹。作者旨在放松噪声假设，在仅观测单条轨迹、噪声仅具有限 $p$ 阶矩（$p>2$）的条件下，刻画最小二乘估计的收敛速率。

Method: 在指数稳定性（系统矩阵谱半径小于1）前提下，假设噪声独立同分布、噪声协方差有界并满足持续激励条件。采用最小二乘估计器，基于单条轨迹构造估计误差。通过矩控制与浓度不等式处理仅有有限 $p$ 阶矩的重尾噪声，建立统一的样本复杂度分析框架，并将其推广至亚指数、亚高斯分布，以及带外生输入的自回归（ARX）模型。

Result: 在噪声具有限 $p$ 阶矩（$p>2$）时，估计误差以高概率满足 $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(r^{1/2}T^{-1/2+1/p})$，其中 $T$ 为样本数，$r$ 为噪声维度，$\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}$ 忽略对数项。该框架可导出亚指数与亚高斯噪声下的误差界。对含外生输入的自回归模型，误差界中的维度因子与模型阶数无关。

Conclusion: 论文为指数稳定 VAR 模型在重尾噪声、单轨迹条件下的最小二乘估计提供了非渐近样本复杂度保证，统一了重尾、亚指数与亚高斯噪声的分析，并表明 ARX 情形的误差对模型阶数不敏感，为实际系统辨识的样本需求提供了理论依据。

Abstract: We establish non-asymptotic sample complexity bounds for the least-squares estimation of vector autoregressive models for exponentially stable systems with heavy-tailed noise based on a single observed trajectory. By assuming i.i.d. noise, bounded noise covariance, and persistent excitation, we show that the estimation error is $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(r^{1/2}T^{-1/2+1/p})$ under bounded $p$th moment for $p > 2$, where $T$ is the number of samples, $r$ is the noise dimension, and $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\cdot)$ hides logarithmic terms. We also introduce a unifying approach to sample complexity analysis applicable to broad classes of noise distributions and showcase this by deriving error bounds for sub-exponential and sub-Gaussian noise distributions. Finally, we specialize our analysis to autoregressive models with exogenous inputs and show that the dimension factor of the error bound is independent of the model order.

</details>


### [662] [Group-Invariant Statistics Determine Embedding Geometry: Harmonic Analysis of Representations from Bach to the Night Sky](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00647)
*Liam Storan,Andreas Tolias,Nina Miolane*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文将语言模型词嵌入的几何结构（圆、Pringle流形、球面）推广为一般对称群下不可约表示（irrep）矩阵元的必然结果，并在月份、和弦、天体三个实验中验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以往工作把月份、星期、地点等概念的圆形与鞍形（"Pringle"）嵌入几何追溯到共现统计中的平移对称性，但该解释仅适用于阿贝尔格点上的距离依赖共现。作者希望证明更一般的对称性（任意有限群、紧群、齐性空间）同样能产生高度结构化的嵌入预测，从而把"几何源于数据统计对称性"这一观点系统化。

Method: 作者在理论上考虑由任意有限群、紧群与齐性空间定义的对称性：证明若某词族的共现统计在群G作用下不变，则学到的词嵌入由G的不可约表示的矩阵元构成；当G为循环群时，irrep即傅里叶模，因此出现圆与Pringle几何。实验上验证三种情形：(i) 循环群Z12对应月份，复现已知圆形几何；(ii) 二面体群作用于大小三和弦，统一音乐理论中移位与转位构成的T/I群与机器学习中"五度圈"的出现；(iii) 用球谐嵌入解释并复现LLM中天体的球面表示。

Result: 理论证明：共现统计在群G下不变时，嵌入由irrep矩阵元构成；循环群情形对应傅里叶模，给出圆与Pringle。实验验证：Z12下复现月份的圆形几何；二面体群情形下，T/I群作用在数学上"蕴含"了学到的和弦嵌入中出现的五度圈，从而统一了音乐理论与机器学习两个经典观察；成功解释并复现了近期发现的大语言模型天体的球谐球面表示。

Conclusion: 学习到的表示几何往往是底层数据统计对称性的直接结果：只要能识别数据中适当的群对称性，就能预测嵌入的不可约表示结构（圆、Pringle、球谐等）。这为从数据对称性角度解释和设计词嵌入几何提供了统一框架。

Abstract: The representations that language models learn for concepts such as months, weekdays, and places display consistent geometric structure: circles and saddle-shaped "Pringle" manifolds. Recent work traced these structures to $\textit{translation symmetry}$ in word co-occurrence statistics, deriving the observed Fourier geometry when co-occurrence depends only on distance on an abelian lattice of concepts. We demonstrate that more general notions of symmetry lead to equally structured predictions. Considering symmetries defined by arbitrary finite groups, compact groups, and homogeneous spaces, we prove that whenever the co-occurrence statistics of a word family are invariant under a group $G$, the learned word embeddings consist of matrix elements of the irreducible representations (irreps) of $G$. Circles and Pringles arise when $G$ is cyclic, in which case the irreps are Fourier modes. We verify the irrep structure in three experimental settings. (i) The cyclic group $\mathbb{Z}_{12}$: for the months of the year we recover the known circular geometry. (ii) A dihedral group acting on the major and minor triads: we unify two classical observations -- that transposition and chord inversion form a group ($T/I$) acting on chords (music theory), which $\textit{implies}$ that the well-known "circle of fifths" emerges in learned chord embeddings (machine learning). (iii) We explain and reproduce a recently discovered spherical representation of celestial objects in large language models (LLMs) as a spherical-harmonic embedding derived from our theory. Our results demonstrate that the geometry of learned representations is often a consequence of the statistical symmetry of underlying data.

</details>


### [663] [Learning Transferable Skills using Goal-Conditioned Bisimulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00676)
*Mohammad Amin Abbasfar,Farbod Azimmohseni,Mohammad Hossein Rohban*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出基于动作感知时序表征与双模拟的无监督技能发现方法，使技能可跨不同布局迁移，实现强OOD泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有无监督技能发现方法依赖专家数据或泛化能力有限，难以迁移到未见布局；核心挑战在于学习既能捕捉环境时序结构、又对布局变化鲁棒的表征。

Method: 提出学习动作感知时序表征的目标，满足函数等变性并保留局部时序结构；在此嵌入基础上，提出基于双模拟（bisimulation）的无监督技能发现，将技能行为仅条件化于直接影响其执行的子集状态特征。

Result: 综合实证评估表明，在给定环境中学习到的技能可有效应用于多种环境布局下的下游任务，展现出强分布外泛化能力。

Conclusion: 通过函数等变时序表征与双模拟技能条件化，可强制技能跨布局行为不变，从而实现可迁移的无监督技能发现与OOD泛化。

Abstract: Unsupervised skill discovery has emerged as a promising approach for leveraging reward-free datasets to pretrain general-purpose policies. However, current skill discovery methods either require access to expert data or exhibit limited generalization, failing to transfer effectively to previously unseen layouts. A key challenge is to learn representations that capture the temporal structure of the environment while remaining robust to variations across layouts. To address this issue, we present an objective for learning action-aware temporal representations that satisfy the functional equivariance property while preserving the local temporal structure of the environment. Building upon this embedding, we further propose unsupervised skill discovery using bisimulation, which learns transferable skills by conditioning the behavior of skills exclusively on the subset of state features that directly affect their execution. This enforces invariant behavior across different layouts, enabling skills to transfer effectively to other configurations. Finally, through comprehensive empirical evaluations, we show that skills learned in a given environment can be effectively applied to solve downstream tasks in various environment layouts, demonstrating strong out-of-distribution generalization.

</details>


### [664] [Exploring More, Reasoning Better: Stepwise Risk-Sensitive GRPO for Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00661)
*Yue YU,Bowen Zuo,David Crandall,Yinglun Zhu,Dongruo Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出StepRS-GRPO：在扩散大语言模型去噪过程中按状态调整风险系数，实现优势重标定，提升pass@1、pass@k与答案多样性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散大语言模型按序列或连续块去噪生成文本，多个token可并行揭示；RLVR对同一终端反馈在这些决策间复用，但各决策的条件上下文不断变化，导致优势估计与信用分配不匹配。因此需要让风险敏感度随去噪状态变化。

Method: 提出stepwise risk-sensitive GRPO（StepRS-GRPO），在保留原训练器的前提下，使组优势变换的风险系数随去噪状态变化；对二值奖励证明该变换等价于对中心化结果优势进行提示与状态相关的重标定。用基于能力的校准确定系数尺度，并通过端点与插值消融指导调度选择。

Result: 在多个dLLM骨干与数学推理基准上，相较中心化GRPO，StepRS-GRPO提升pass@1准确率与pass@k覆盖率，并增加答案多样性。消融中，质量匹配对照支持状态分配与调度方向的贡献，且将优势RMS匹配至中心化GRPO后增益仍存在；推理轨迹诊断显示多样性增益不限于最终答案字符串。

Conclusion: 对扩散语言模型而言，按去噪状态逐步调整风险敏感度是一种有效且与现有GRPO兼容的RLVR改进，可同时提升准确率、覆盖率与多样性。

Abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) generate text by denoising a sequence or successive blocks, allowing several tokens to be revealed in parallel. Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) reuses terminal feedback across these decisions, even as their conditioning context changes. We propose stepwise risk-sensitive GRPO (StepRS-GRPO), which varies the risk coefficient of the group-advantage transformation across denoising states while retaining the underlying trainer. For binary rewards, we show that this transformation is exactly a prompt- and state-dependent rescaling of centered outcome advantages. A capability-based calibration suggests a coefficient scale, while endpoint and interpolation ablations guide schedule selection. Across multiple dLLM backbones and mathematical reasoning benchmarks, StepRS-GRPO improves both pass@1 accuracy and pass@k coverage over centered GRPO, while increasing answer diversity. In our ablation studies, mass-matched controls support the contributions of state allocation and schedule direction, and the gains persist after matching the root mean square (RMS) of the advantages to that of centered GRPO. Reasoning-trace diagnostics further show that the diversity gains from StepRS-GRPO extend beyond final-answer strings.

</details>


### [665] [Reward as Observation: Learning Reward-Based Policies for Rapid Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00729)
*Morgan Byrd,Maks Sorokin,Robert Wright,Sehoon Ha*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种仅以奖励和动作为条件的基于奖励的策略，实现源环境与目标环境观测空间完全不同情况下的零样本迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度神经网络策略在新环境中适应能力差、迁移所需样本量大，而人类却能展现出色的适应能力。作者希望借助基于奖励的策略规避观测空间差异带来的迁移障碍。
